  • ocaml-uring minimum OCaml version: Raised to 5.2, removing an unnecessary compiler warning (ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#150)
  • ocaml-uring Region.init simplification: Slot count now derived automatically from buffer size and slot size, removing the need to pass a separate count (ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#145)
  • ocaml-uring AT_FDCWD cleanup: David Allsopp moved AT_FDCWD handling to C stubs, eliminating use of Obj.magic in the OCaml layer (ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#128)
  • lintcstubs-arity CI: Added as a test dependency in both ocaml-multicore/eio#846 and ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#143 to catch missing C prototype arities
  • ocaml-uring errno module: Anil Madhavapeddy opened ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#152 adding Linux-specific error codes
  • ocaml-uring bytes-buffer draft: Draft PR ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#153 exploring switching the buffer type from bigarray/cstruct to plain bytes
  • ocaml-uring CLOEXEC socket flag: PR ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#151 to allow setting CLOEXEC on socket creation, motivated by ocaml-multicore/eio#843

    • Notable Discussions

  • Kernel version gating for iouring: Anil Madhavapeddy raised in ocaml-multicore/eio#845 whether Eio_main should restrict iouring to kernel 7+ by default, given accumulating kernel bugs including a ZFS fixed-buffer regression
  • CLOEXEC socket flag defaulting: Thomas Leonard argued for always setting CLOEXEC for safety; Anil Madhavapeddy argued uring bindings should follow kernel defaults and Eio can apply the flag at a higher level (ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#151)
  • Statx mask semantics: Discussion in ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#142 clarified the distinction between stx_mask (fields filled) and stx_attributes_mask (supported attribute flags), and the meaning of an attribute being simultaneously unsupported and set
  • Region.init API design: Trade-off between allowing underfilled buffers vs. deriving slot count from buffer size, with Thomas Leonard suggesting the simpler derived approach in ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#145
  • Uring errno probing: In ocaml-multicore/eio#848, Anil Madhavapeddy noted interest in exposing errno values from uring probing, with Thomas Leonard confirming utility but deferring to a separate PR

    • Emerging Trends

  • Decoupling eio_linux from ocaml-uring internals: ocaml-multicore/eio#848 moves fixed-buffer region management into Eio, and ocaml-multicore/eio#849 removes scheduler-level retry handling specific to the uring fixed-buffer path; this mirrors simplification work in the uring library itself (ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#145)
  • Typed APIs replacing raw integers in ocaml-uring: Shift of Statx.attributes, attributes_mask, and mask from Int64.t to typed Attr.t/Mask.t, and making FLAGS.t fully abstract (ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#142), reflects a push toward compile-time–safe interfaces
  • Systematic Linux syscall coverage: Adding shutdown, socket, renameat, symlinkat, fallocate, and ftruncate in a single week (ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#147, ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#149) suggests a focused effort to bring uring bindings to feature parity with commonly needed Linux operations, likely driven by Eio requirements
  • OxCaml compatibility as a design constraint: Comments in ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#142 note avoiding eta-reduction to satisfy OxCaml's stricter requirements and keeping types abstract for future local interactions
  • Buffer type simplification under consideration: Draft PR ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#153 to replace bigarray/cstruct with plain bytes signals a potential reduction in the buffer abstraction stack
  • Kernel version compatibility as an explicit concern: Discussion in ocaml-multicore/eio#845 and the open hang bug ocaml-multicore/eio#801 indicate growing consideration of gating io_uring features on kernel version
entry.summary: Dune 3.24.0 alpha1/alpha2 released; OxCaml minus-40 bump and typing fixes; uring gains six syscalls; OCaml Workshop 2026 site launched.

entry.title: Week 22, 2026: Dune 3.24.0~alpha0 and ocaml-uring v2.14.0 released; eio gains ~100k req/s via io_uring flags; ephemeron GC fixes and profiling overhead eliminated in OCaml.
entry.content:
Weekly Summary

New Features

  • OCaml Core Compiler profiling overhead eliminated when -dprofile/-dcounters/-dtimings are not in use, removing up to 30% overhead in microbenchmarks with many small functions by skipping Profile.record_call unless profiling is requested (ocaml/ocaml#14832)
  • OCaml Core Windows Unix.select file-descriptor drop fixed: socket_poll_add returned the dispatched node rather than the updated list head, silently dropping fds and causing a memory leak; a regression test was added (ocaml/ocaml#14764)
  • OCaml Core Two ephemeron GC correctness fixes merged: ocaml/ocaml#14734 fixes orphaning during Phase_sweep_ephe; ocaml/ocaml#14733 corrects per-domain ephemeron work counters and removes a pessimistic ephe_next_round call causing unnecessary repeated work
  • OCaml Core Char.escaped documentation corrected in stdlib/char.mli; previous text incorrectly stated double-quote characters are escaped (ocaml/ocaml#14836)
  • OxCaml New caml_region_begin / caml_region_end C API added by Stephen Dolan, providing explicit region management hooks for the C runtime (oxcaml/oxcaml#6142)
  • OxCaml [@@flatten_floats] made an optional annotation rather than automatic for mixed float/float64 records by Ryan Tjoa, giving explicit control over memory representation (oxcaml/oxcaml#6106)
  • OxCaml Records with [@atomic] fields no longer receive unboxed versions by Ryan Tjoa, preventing unsound interactions between atomicity and unboxed representations (oxcaml/oxcaml#6124)
  • OxCaml --enable-keyword-edition configure option added for the 5.4 branch by David Allsopp, allowing builds to opt-in to keyword edition support (oxcaml/oxcaml#6140)
  • OxCaml quick_stat runtime function optimized by Stephen Dolan to reduce GC statistics overhead (oxcaml/oxcaml#6139)
  • OxCaml Merlin synced to 5.2.0minus-39 by Jakub Bachurski, pulling in updated jkind scannable constant, cmi_format using persistent_signature, and compilation_unit name mangling overrides (oxcaml/oxcaml#6136)
  • Multicore eio_linux now uses IORING_SETUP_DEFER_TASKRUN and IORING_SETUP_SINGLE_ISSUER when creating io_uring rings, improving HTTP benchmark throughput by ~100k req/s on supported hardware; falls back gracefully on older kernels via EINVAL catch (ocaml-multicore/eio#841, ocaml-multicore/eio#842)
  • Multicore eio_posix now passes MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC to recvmsg when receiving file descriptors, ensuring received fds are close-on-exec atomically; falls back to Unix.set_close_on_exec on macOS (ocaml-multicore/eio#843)
  • Multicore AT_FDCWD handling moved to C stubs in ocaml-uring, eliminating Obj.magic in the OCaml layer; openat2, linkat, unlink, mkdirat, and statx now accept Unix.file_descr option where None maps to AT_FDCWD in C (ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#128)
  • Multicore ocaml-uring v2.14.0 released by Thomas Leonard documenting Uring.Res module breaking change, new send_zc/sendmsg_zc zero-copy ops, and accumulated bug fixes (ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#140)
  • OCaml Tools DragonFly BSD added as a recognised platform in dune, fixing file-watcher and OS detection paths (ocaml/dune#14774) by Michael Neumann
  • OCaml Tools dune pkg solver strips upper-bound version constraints on dune itself from opam depends formulas, preventing solver failures from stale < 3.17 style bounds (ocaml/dune#14638) by Ali Caglayan
  • OCaml Tools melange.ppx_runtime_libraries field added to library stanzas for ppx rewriters needing separate native and Melange runtime libraries (ocaml/dune#14796) by Antonio Nuno Monteiro
  • OCaml Tools Merlin signature-help now correctly expands type aliases to display function signatures, fixing ocaml/merlin#1927 (ocaml/merlin#2067) by Carine Morel
  • OCaml Tools New http-server reftest command and repository-http.test suite in opam enabling HTTP-based repository lifecycle testing (ocaml/opam#6939)
  • OCaml Tools New Promise module with type-safe JavaScript promise bindings and Lwt interop via Js_of_ocaml_lwt.Promise in jsofocaml, closing ocsigen/jsofocaml#2031
  • OCaml Tools New Fetch module binding the Fetch API with typed Abort primitives (AbortController/AbortSignal) in jsofocaml, closing the 2017 feature request ocsigen/jsofocaml#596
  • OCaml Tools Popover API implemented in Dom_html by Sylvain Boilard, covering showPopover, hidePopover, togglePopover, and toggle events (ocsigen/jsofocaml#1734)
  • OCaml Tools New --effects=native backend for wasm_of_ocaml using the WebAssembly Stack Switching proposal, targeting Chrome 148+ and recent Node.js canary builds
  • OCaml Ecosystem albatross 2.7.2 includes a security fix (OSEC-2026-09) for unbounded resource usage in albatross-console when querying with extreme count values while the ring buffer is full (ocaml/opam-repository#29971)
  • OCaml Ecosystem solo5 0.11.0 brings ~3x network throughput improvement on Linux via eventfd(2) for TAP interfaces, seccomp filter support in solo5-hvt, and stricter C compiler warning flags (ocaml/opam-repository#29965)
  • OCaml Ecosystem slipshow 0.11.0 adds a built-in LSP server (slipshow lsp) with diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, occurrence highlighting, and completion support (ocaml/opam-repository#29951)
  • OCaml Ecosystem irky 0.1 is a new IRC client library forked from irc-client, providing direct-style IO for both Unix and Eio with optional SSL/TLS (ocaml/opam-repository#29925) by Simon Cruanes
  • OCaml Ecosystem awso 0.9.0 (6 packages) provides OCaml bindings for 400+ AWS API services auto-generated from botocore (ocaml/opam-repository#29921) by Michael Bacarella
  • OCaml Ecosystem transom 0.1.0 is a new OCaml sidecar library for Tauri-style desktop apps connecting a webview frontend to an OCaml process over newline-delimited JSON (ocaml/opam-repository#29963)
  • OCaml Ecosystem contract 0.1.0 is a new typed HTTP API contract library with OpenAPI 3.0.3 output (ocaml/opam-repository#29961)
  • OCaml Ecosystem openrouterapi 0.1.0 is a new Async-based client for the OpenRouter LLM aggregation API with streaming, tool calling, and multimodal content support (ocaml/opam-repository#29914) by mtcaret
  • OCaml Ecosystem smtml 0.28.0 adds Z3 native API implementations for Re.allchar, Re.diff, and String.replace, plus tail-recursive symbol traversal and Bitv128 conversions (ocaml/opam-repository#29966)
  • OCaml Ecosystem Windows GHA CI now returns red status on opam file syntax errors by running opam lint on changed packages (ocaml/opam-repository#29964) by Jan Midtgaard
  • OCaml Ecosystem caqti-lwt 2.3.0 lwt < 6~ upper bound relaxed, enabling packages like Dream to install with Lwt 6 and OCaml 5.5 (ocaml/opam-repository#29937)
  • OCaml Ecosystem Platform release changelogs for nine tools published on ocaml/ocaml.org: dune-release 2.2.1, mdx 2.5.2, merlin v5.7-505~preview, merlin v5.7.1-504, ocaml-lsp 1.26.0-5.5~preview, OCaml 5.5.0~beta1, ocamlformat 0.29.0, odoc 3.2.0, opam-publish 3.0.0, and utop 2.17.0 (ocaml/ocaml.org#3641)

    • Group Activity Summaries

    OCaml Ecosystem

    opam-repository merged 26 PRs with new packages and a security fix; ocaml.org published changelogs for nine platform tools.

    New Features

  • albatross 2.7.2 includes a security fix (OSEC-2026-09) for unbounded resource usage in albatross-console when querying with extreme count values while the ring buffer is full, contributed by Reynir Björnsson (ocaml/opam-repository#29971)
  • solo5 0.11.0 brings ~3x network throughput improvement on Linux via eventfd(2) for TAP interfaces, seccomp filter support in solo5-hvt, and stricter C compiler warning flags, released by Calascibetta Romain (ocaml/opam-repository#29965)
  • uring 2.14.0 adds a new Uring.Res module for result values without Obj.magic, plus send_zc and sendmsg_zc zero-copy send operations (breaking change), released by Thomas Leonard (ocaml/opam-repository#29954)
  • slipshow 0.11.0 adds a built-in LSP server (slipshow lsp) with diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, occurrence highlighting, and completion support, released by Paul-Elliot Anglès d'Auriac (ocaml/opam-repository#29951)
  • irky 0.1 is a new IRC client library forked from irc-client, providing direct-style IO for both Unix and Eio with optional SSL/TLS, released by Simon Cruanes (ocaml/opam-repository#29925)
  • awso 0.9.0 (6 packages) provides OCaml bindings for 400+ AWS API services auto-generated from botocore, with synchronous and async backends, released by Michael Bacarella (ocaml/opam-repository#29921)
  • transom 0.1.0 is a new OCaml sidecar library for Tauri-style desktop apps, connecting a webview frontend to an OCaml process over newline-delimited JSON, released by @funwithcthulhu (ocaml/opam-repository#29963)
  • contract 0.1.0 is a new typed HTTP API contract library with OpenAPI 3.0.3 output, released by @funwithcthulhu (ocaml/opam-repository#29961)
  • openrouterapi 0.1.0 is a new Async-based client for the OpenRouter LLM aggregation API with streaming, tool calling, and multimodal content support, released by mtcaret (ocaml/opam-repository#29914)
  • smtml 0.28.0 adds Z3 native API implementations for Re.allchar, Re.diff, and String.replace, plus tail-recursive symbol traversal and Bitv128 conversions, released by @filipeom (ocaml/opam-repository#29966)
  • opentelemetry 0.91.1 (9 packages) fixes lazy initialization of random generators and respects ~parent:P_none in traces, released by Simon Cruanes (ocaml/opam-repository#29953)
  • Windows GHA CI now returns a red status on opam file syntax errors by running opam lint on changed packages, fixing a longstanding gap (ocaml/opam-repository#29513), implemented by Jan Midtgaard (ocaml/opam-repository#29964)
  • caqti-lwt 2.3.0 has its lwt < 6~ upper bound relaxed, enabling packages like Dream to install caqti-lwt with Lwt 6 and OCaml 5.5, by @funwithcthulhu (ocaml/opam-repository#29937)
  • async_ssl v0.16.1-2 and v0.17.0-2 restore -Wno-implicit-function-declaration suppression, fixing builds on CentOS 10 and GCC 14+ platforms, by Michael Bacarella (ocaml/opam-repository#29939)
  • Platform release changelogs for nine tools published on ocaml.org: dune-release 2.2.1, mdx 2.5.2, merlin v5.7-505~preview, merlin v5.7.1-504, ocaml-lsp 1.26.0-5.5~preview, OCaml 5.5.0~beta1, ocamlformat 0.29.0, odoc 3.2.0, opam-publish 3.0.0, and utop 2.17.0, by sabine (ocaml/ocaml.org#3641)
  • Dune 3.24.0~alpha0 release page automatically scraped to ocaml.org, documenting promotion fixes, directory targets promoted to stable, and the new %{pkg::
    :} pform (ocaml/ocaml.org#3666)
  • OCaml Planet updated with Anil's .plan post covering Pint of Science, OxCaml dissertations, and TESSERA 1.1, plus OCaml Weekly News for 26 May 2026 (ocaml/ocaml.org#3663, ocaml/ocaml.org#3665)

    • Overview

  • ocaml/opam-repository saw 26 merges this week covering new package releases, a security fix, dependency constraint updates, and a CI reliability improvement for opam syntax validation
  • ocaml/ocaml.org published platform release changelogs for nine tools, added a Dune 3.24.0~alpha0 release page via automated scraping, and received a documentation quality issue about Core library usage in GC examples
  • Combined contributor activity across both repositories included approximately 20 individuals spanning package authors, reviewers, and infrastructure maintainers
  • The week's opam-repository activity spans multiple domains: systems programming (solo5, uring, albatross), web frameworks (caqti-lwt, awso), formal methods (z3, smtml, symex), and developer tooling (slipshow LSP, doctor)
  • OCaml 5.5 compatibility surfaced as a cross-cutting concern, with several opam-repository packages updating constraints and ocaml.org publishing the OCaml 5.5.0~beta1 changelog

    • Activity

  • dune 3.24.0~alpha0 pre-release opened as a draft by Shon Feder covering 18 packages with new %{pkg::
    :} pform, directory targets promoted to stable, relocatable compiler enabled by default, and removal of deprecated (lang coq) in favour of Rocq (ocaml/opam-repository#29969)
  • object 0.1 (unified ELF/MACH-O/PE/COFF object file reader) opened by Tim McGilchrist and blocked on CI failures including Array.find_opt availability on OCaml 4.11, dune lower bound issues, and ppc64/arm64 failures (ocaml/opam-repository#29973)
  • awso 0.9.1 (7 packages with Eio backend) opened by Michael Bacarella, requiring OCaml 5.3+ with tls >= 2.1.0 and mirage-crypto-rng >= 1.2.0 for CVE-2026-45388 mitigation (ocaml/opam-repository#29967)
  • Dependency constraint fixes: jext 0.1.0 revdep syntax fix for ez_api by Maxime Levillain (ocaml/opam-repository#29957); albatross syntax fix by Reynir Björnsson (ocaml/opam-repository#29958)
  • Ecosystem compatibility releases: camlp5-buildscripts 0.07 adds bos 0.3.0 and OCaml 5.5 compatibility by @chetmurthy (ocaml/opam-repository#29950); lua-ml 0.9.5 by Daniil Baturin (ocaml/opam-repository#29945); ez_api 3.0.0 by Maxime Levillain (ocaml/opam-repository#29893)
  • coccinelle 1.3.1 moved pcre from depends to depopts, allowing installation on Debian systems as libpcre3-dev is removed, by Denis Efremov (ocaml/opam-repository#29974)
  • Formal methods tooling: z3 4.16.0 by @filipeom (ocaml/opam-repository#29933); symex 0.3 by @redianthus (ocaml/opam-repository#29972)
  • ctypes opam files synced with upstream to produce relocatable dune-package files using modern dune defaults, by Anil Madhavapeddy (ocaml/opam-repository#29956)
  • rtree 0.2.0 adds remove and bounds functions and fixes incomplete values results, submitted by Patrick Ferris and re-submitted by Anil Madhavapeddy after an accidental browser closure (ocaml/opam-repository#29959)
  • ocaml.org backstage post on the wasm-of-ocaml WASI prototype opened by sabine, awaiting review (ocaml/ocaml.org#3667)
  • GC documentation feedback opened by opale arguing that stdlib-only patterns should be demonstrated rather than relying on Core library functions (ocaml/ocaml.org#3664)

    • Notable Discussions

  • The jext.0.1.0 syntax error incident (ocaml/opam-repository#29957) was reported by Reynir Björnsson: a malformed opam file caused opam-mirror (a MirageOS unikernel) to crash with a fatal Stdlib.Parsing.Parse_error; this directly motivated Jan Midtgaard's CI fix in ocaml/opam-repository#29964
  • asyncssl and OpenSSL ENGINE API (ocaml/opam-repository#29939): Michael Bacarella noted the gradual disappearance of openssl/engine.h from modern Linux distributions and nudged Jane Street to drop deprecated ENGINE API bindings in janestreet/asyncssl#43
  • coccinelle stdcompat upper bound (ocaml/opam-repository#29974) surfaced compatibility blocks on OCaml 5.4 and 4.14.3 tracked upstream at ocamllibs/stdcompat#70 and ocamllibs/stdcompat#73, alongside the removal of libpcre3-dev from Debian
  • caqti-lwt metadata-only change (ocaml/opam-repository#29937) prompted clarification from upstream maintainer Petter A. Urkedal on the policy of minimal-scope metadata changes to avoid unnecessary CI load
  • GC documentation and Core library use (ocaml/ocaml.org#3664): opale raised that the garbage collector documentation uses Core library functions absent from stdlib (e.g. Gc.tune), arguing the docs should highlight stdlib ergonomic gaps rather than deferring to Core

    • Emerging Trends

  • Eio and OCaml 5+ backend adoption continues: irky 0.1 provides a direct-style Eio IO backend (ocaml/opam-repository#29925), awso 0.9.1 adds an Eio AWS backend (ocaml/opam-repository#29967), and uring 2.14.0 continues to underpin the Eio ecosystem (ocaml/opam-repository#29954)
  • OCaml 5.5 / Lwt 6 compatibility is a recurring theme: caqti-lwt constraint relaxation (ocaml/opam-repository#29937), camlp5-buildscripts OCaml 5.5 support (ocaml/opam-repository#29950), and the OCaml 5.5.0~beta1 changelog on ocaml.org (ocaml/ocaml.org#3641) all reflect coordinated ecosystem-wide preparation
  • CI infrastructure reliability receives incremental attention: the Windows GHA opam-lint fix (ocaml/opam-repository#29964) resolves a known gap demonstrated by the jext incident (ocaml/opam-repository#29957)
  • Formal methods tooling cluster: z3 4.16.0, smtml 0.28.0, and symex 0.3 all landed in the same week (ocaml/opam-repository#29933, ocaml/opam-repository#29966, ocaml/opam-repository#29972), suggesting coordinated activity in the OCaml formal verification space
  • C compiler compatibility continues to require patching: async_ssl needed flags restored for GCC 14+ (ocaml/opam-repository#29939) and coccinelle adjusted for libpcre3-dev removal from Debian (ocaml/opam-repository#29974)
  • Documentation quality feedback is emerging on ocaml.org, with ocaml/ocaml.org#3664 representing community push for stdlib-first examples — a concern given the website's role as the primary OCaml learning resource

    • OCaml Tools

    Active week across dune, js_of_ocaml, opam, merlin, and odoc with new BSD support, Promise/Fetch APIs, and HTTP repo test infrastructure.

    New Features

  • [ocaml/dune] DragonFly BSD added as a recognised platform, fixing file-watcher and OS detection paths — ocaml/dune#14774 by Michael Neumann
  • [ocaml/dune] dune pkg solver now strips upper-bound version constraints on dune itself from opam depends formulas, preventing solver failures from stale < 3.17 style bounds — ocaml/dune#14638 by Ali Caglayan, closes ocaml/dune#14637
  • [ocaml/dune] melange.ppx_runtime_libraries field added to library stanzas for ppx rewriters needing separate native and Melange runtime libraries — ocaml/dune#14796 by Antonio Nuno Monteiro
  • [ocaml/dune] Shell command completion support (bash, zsh, PowerShell) opened via ocaml/dune#14779 by Ambre Austen Suhamy, using vendored cmdliner 2.1.1
  • [ocaml/merlin] Signature-help with type aliases now correctly expands aliases to display function signatures — ocaml/merlin#2067 by Carine Morel, fixes ocaml/merlin#1927
  • [ocaml/opam] New http-server reftest command and repository-http.test suite enabling HTTP-based repository lifecycle testing — ocaml/opam#6939 merged by R. Boujbel
  • [ocsigen/jsofocaml] New Promise module with type-safe JavaScript promise bindings and Lwt interop via Js_of_ocaml_lwt.Promise, closing ocsigen/jsofocaml#2031
  • [ocsigen/jsofocaml] New Fetch module binding the Fetch API with typed Abort primitives (AbortController/AbortSignal), closing the 2017 feature request ocsigen/jsofocaml#596
  • [ocsigen/jsofocaml] Popover API implemented in Dom_html via ocsigen/jsofocaml#1734 by Sylvain Boilard, covering showPopover, hidePopover, togglePopover, and toggle events
  • [ocsigen/jsofocaml] New --effects=native backend for wasm_of_ocaml using the WebAssembly Stack Switching proposal, targeting Chrome 148+ and recent Node.js canary builds

    • Overview

  • Six of ten tracked repositories saw activity this week; ocaml/ocamlfind, ocaml/opam-file-format, and ocaml-dune/spawn had no recorded commits or issues
  • ocsigen/jsofocaml was the highest-volume repository with 56 commits across 99 files (4204 insertions), delivering major new async API bindings and compiler improvements
  • ocaml/dune continued broad-front development covering platform support, anonymous action expansion, Melange, watch-mode, and RPC
  • ocaml/opam progressed the HTTP repository performance initiative with merged test infrastructure and queued PRs for tar library integration
  • ocaml/merlin merged a signature-help fix and closed a batch of long-standing issues (some from 2013–2021) after confirming fixes are in place
  • ocaml/odoc saw OxCaml feature PRs advance under review; layout support (ocaml/odoc#1415) was confirmed closed
  • ocaml/ocaml-lsp received one new feature PR adding hover information for OCaml compiler warnings (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1606)

    • Activity

  • [ocaml/dune] Rudi Grinberg expanded anonymous actions to cover pkg-config (ocaml/dune#14782), mdx dependency queries (ocaml/dune#14787), inline-test partitions (ocaml/dune#14788), and odoc dependency queries (ocaml/dune#14786)
  • [ocaml/dune] Antonio Nuno Monteiro advanced the single-context-universal Melange stack with installation rules (ocaml/dune#14800), conditional library tests (ocaml/dune#14812), and a cross-compilation target-env fix (ocaml/dune#14817)
  • [ocaml/dune] Scheduler file-watcher refactored in ocaml/dune#14778: watcher events now flow through a thread-safe fiber channel; FSEvents startup and failure propagation fixed in ocaml/dune#14764
  • [ocaml/dune] Cache copy-mode entries now have ctime refreshed on restore to retain recently-used entries (ocaml/dune#14777); build path separator inconsistency on Windows fixed (ocaml/dune#14616)
  • [ocaml/dune] Danny Willems opened ocaml/dune#14798 fixing Emacs byte-compile warnings in editor integration and adding an Emacs CI workflow
  • [ocaml/opam] R. Boujbel opened ocaml/opam#6945 (tar library integration via new OpamTar module, READY TO MERGE) and ocaml/opam#6949 (conditional hard upgrade for opam root, READY TO MERGE), both prerequisites for ocaml/opam#6625
  • [ocaml/opam] Lock file undefined variable fix opened as ocaml/opam#6947 (fixing ocaml/opam#6946), approved by Nathan Rebours
  • [ocaml/merlin] Locate fix for let-punnings (ocaml/merlin#2066) by Paul-Elliot Anglès d'Auriac remains under review; introduces a tie-breaking mechanism in Mbrowse to disambiguate overlapping AST node locations, fixing ocaml/merlin#1796
  • [ocaml/merlin] Emacs 31 compatibility update opened (ocaml/merlin#2076) by Danny Willems replacing obsolete when-let macro with let + when
  • [ocaml/merlin] Batch of long-standing stale issues closed after verifying fixes are in place, including ocaml/merlin#369, ocaml/merlin#298, ocaml/merlin#598, ocaml/merlin#1404, and others dating back to 2013
  • [ocaml/odoc] OxCaml modalities PR ocaml/odoc#1420 and zero-alloc annotation PR ocaml/odoc#1422 remain under review; layout tracking issue ocaml/odoc#1415 was closed
  • [ocaml/odoc] Inline raise tag rendering fix opened as ocaml/odoc#1440; multiline link fix opened as ocaml/odoc#1439, both by Tim ats
  • [ocsigen/jsofocaml] Compiler closure generation heavily refactored: dispatch per effects mode split, CPS closures stored directly in cps_pair, and a flat dispatch loop introduced to bound statement-nesting depth, resolving ocsigen/jsofocaml#2122
  • [ocsigen/jsofocaml] UGEINT bytecode lowering bug fixed (wrong result on equal operands) with regression test added
  • [ocaml/ocaml-lsp] PixieDust opened ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1606 implementing hover information for OCaml compiler warnings, addressing feature request ocaml/ocaml-lsp#717

    • Notable Discussions

  • [ocaml/dune] The 3.24.0 release tracker ocaml/dune#14620 remains open; enabled_if with %{read:...} in (executable ...) incorrectly rejected at dune language 3.23 was filed as ocaml/dune#14789; a cache poisoning issue producing null-byte module names after the ocamldep-to-anonymous-actions migration was reported in ocaml/dune#14767
  • [ocaml/dune] Sandbox-breaking of git rev-parse rules (ocaml/dune#14723) prompted discussion about exposing a %{git-sha} rule variable, leading Romain Beauxis to open ocaml/dune#14810
  • [ocaml/merlin] On ocaml/merlin#2066, Ulysse identified a regression where the locate fix broke type-enclosing on punned values; Paul-Elliot Anglès d'Auriac revised the approach to use a general tie-breaking function selecting pattern vs expression nodes based on query type
  • [ocaml/opam] Review of ocaml/opam#6945 by Nathan Rebours raised API design questions on type naming, I/O strategy, and the fact that directory metadata and empty directories are silently dropped when modifying archives; review also uncovered a subtle path prefix correctness bug in OpamFilename.starts_with (ocaml/opam#6948)
  • [ocaml/odoc] Paul-Elliot Anglès d'Auriac recommended on ocaml/odoc#1440 that the raise tag inlining fix should be implemented in the Document layer rather than the HTML backend, to avoid backend-specific workarounds
  • [ocsigen/jsofocaml] The jsofocaml 6.4 release tracking issue ocsigen/jsofocaml#2241 was opened by @hhugo, gathering the batch of new APIs under an upcoming release milestone

    • Emerging Trends

  • Anonymous actions replacing intermediate files in dune: adoption is broadening across the build system (pkg-config, mdx, odoc, inline-test partitions, C compiler detection) via ocaml/dune#14782, ocaml/dune#14787, ocaml/dune#14788, and ocaml/dune#14786
  • OxCaml feature parity in odoc: multiple concurrent PRs (ocaml/odoc#1420, ocaml/odoc#1422) target modalities and zero-alloc annotations, building on the merged layout support (ocaml/odoc#1410); new external contributors Tim ats and Marek Kubica joined this effort
  • Replacing external tool dependencies with native OCaml libraries in opam: the tar tool replacement (ocaml/opam#6945) follows a broader pattern in ocaml/opam#6625 of enabling in-process archive manipulation to improve performance and portability
  • Async API completeness in jsofocaml: Promise, Fetch, and AbortController landed together as an interdependent tier, closing ocsigen/jsofocaml#596 (from 2017); the API-STATUS roadmap was updated to reflect these closures
  • Wasm effects backend expansion: the new --effects=native stack-switching mode joins JSPI and CPS in wasm_of_ocaml, tracking the evolving WebAssembly standards landscape
  • Issue backlog triage in merlin: long-standing issues (some from 2013–2021) are being closed by verifying existing fixes and adding regression tests, as seen in ocaml/merlin#2073, ocaml/merlin#2075, and the batch closure of ocaml/merlin#298, ocaml/merlin#369, ocaml/merlin#1404
  • LSP hover richness: ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1606 continues a pattern of enriching hover responses with OCaml-specific semantic information, making compiler diagnostic information accessible directly in editors

    • OxCaml

    oxcaml/oxcaml landed runtime performance improvements, a new C API, type system fixes, and a Merlin sync; opam-repository addressed Dune patch compatibility.

    New Features

  • New caml_region_begin / caml_region_end C API added by Stephen Dolan, providing explicit region management hooks for the C runtime (oxcaml/oxcaml#6142)
  • [@@flatten_floats] is now an optional annotation rather than automatic for mixed float/float64 records by Ryan Tjoa, giving explicit control over memory representation of heterogeneous float records (oxcaml/oxcaml#6106)
  • Records with [@atomic] fields no longer receive unboxed versions by Ryan Tjoa, preventing unsound interactions between atomicity and unboxed representations (oxcaml/oxcaml#6124)
  • --enable-keyword-edition configure option added for the 5.4 branch by David Allsopp, allowing builds to opt-in to keyword edition support (oxcaml/oxcaml#6140)
  • quick_stat runtime function optimized by Stephen Dolan to reduce GC statistics overhead (oxcaml/oxcaml#6139)
  • Profile info collection is now skipped when profiling is disabled by Stephen Dolan, reducing overhead in non-profiling builds (oxcaml/oxcaml#6141)
  • Fixed non-empty array types with bottom kind being incorrectly created by Basile Clément (oxcaml/oxcaml#6134)
  • Merlin synced to 5.2.0minus-39 by Jakub Bachurski, pulling in updated jkind scannable constant, cmi_format using persistent_signature, and compilation_unit name mangling overrides (oxcaml/oxcaml#6136)
  • Missing flags in ocamlnat/expect.opt drivers added by Chris Casinghino (oxcaml/oxcaml#6159)

    • Overview

  • Activity was concentrated in oxcaml/oxcaml, with 9 PRs merged covering runtime performance, type system correctness, and a Merlin sync; oxcaml/opam-repository handled compatibility work driven by upstream Dune changes
  • oxcaml/merlin, oxcaml/jsofocaml, and janestreet/opam-repository had no recorded activity this week
  • Seven contributors merged work in oxcaml/oxcaml; three contributors were active in oxcaml/opam-repository
  • Several large draft PRs remain in flight: functorization (oxcaml/oxcaml#5903), layout polymorphism (oxcaml/oxcaml#5870), zero-alloc on higher-order args (oxcaml/oxcaml#5493), and loop deletion (oxcaml/oxcaml#5840)

    • Activity

  • Sort variable and any-kind record fixes opened by Ryan Tjoa: fixing sort variables for variable-representation constructor patterns (oxcaml/oxcaml#6156), fixing any-record refined to all-float64 getting wrong Record_boxed representation (oxcaml/oxcaml#6143), and creating sort variables for record fields with kind any (oxcaml/oxcaml#6145)
  • Draft tracing variable availability through the compiler (+1612/-40) opened by Simon Spies, aimed at improving debugger support (oxcaml/oxcaml#6158)
  • Draft CFG merge functions (Identical Code Folding) opened by Xavier Clerc (oxcaml/oxcaml#6148)
  • CFG jump threading to avoid bit materialization by @ttebbi-janestreet (+1030/-93) under review (oxcaml/oxcaml#6104)
  • Basic functorization support by Zesen Qian (+3414/-178) continues under review (oxcaml/oxcaml#5903)
  • Layout polymorphic functions by Jack Rickard (+972/-674) remains in review (oxcaml/oxcaml#5870)
  • Zero-alloc attribute on higher-order function arguments by Andrej Ivašković (+3461/-929) is ongoing (oxcaml/oxcaml#5493)
  • Deletion of empty loops by Mark Shinwell (+6631/-369) continues as a large in-progress optimization (oxcaml/oxcaml#5840)
  • Box types work by Ryan Tjoa (+1536/-162) continues (oxcaml/oxcaml#5342)
  • Christian Persson opened oxcaml/opam-repository#51 to fix ignore-opam.patch line-number drift caused by Dune's new pure-OCaml patch engine (ocaml/dune#14177)
  • oxcaml/opam-repository#48 (ocaml-variants fails to build in a Dune project) was closed after a fix by Ali Caglayan
  • oxcaml/opam-repository#46 tracking the bump to v0.18~preview.130.100+614 remains open; David Allsopp confirmed the release is prepared and expected to land imminently

    • Notable Discussions

  • Pedro N. Rodriguez H opened oxcaml/oxcaml#6146 asking about the recommended idiom for t @ unique-checked destruction with read accessors, touching on the interaction between uniqueness and borrowing in OxCaml's mode system; the discussion pointed to existing borrowing documentation
  • On oxcaml/opam-repository#51, Ali Caglayan raised whether OxCaml maintainers plan to keep patch line numbers accurate going forward, or whether Dune should enable fuzzy patch matching — offering to implement the latter if preferred
  • On oxcaml/opam-repository#46, David Allsopp clarified that the v0.18~preview.130.100+614 packages are assembled via automated tooling and that ~30 packages flagged by Artem Pianykh as missing are tracked on the dev branch before promotion to main

    • Emerging Trends

  • Unboxed record representation correctness is receiving focused attention, with multiple PRs tightening rules around which records receive unboxed versions: [@atomic] fields (oxcaml/oxcaml#6124), mixed float records (oxcaml/oxcaml#6106), and any-kinded fields (oxcaml/oxcaml#6143, oxcaml/oxcaml#6145, oxcaml/oxcaml#6156)
  • Runtime performance micro-optimizations continue to land in small focused commits, covering GC statistics (oxcaml/oxcaml#6139) and profiling infrastructure (oxcaml/oxcaml#6141)
  • CFG-level compiler optimizations are growing with both jump threading (oxcaml/oxcaml#6104) and identical code folding (oxcaml/oxcaml#6148) in flight simultaneously
  • Dune's migration to a pure-OCaml patch implementation (ocaml/dune#14177) is exposing previously hidden line-number drift in opam package patches; repository maintainers may need to audit other patches for similar drift

    • OCaml Core

    Ephemeron GC fixes landed, compiler profiling overhead eliminated, Windows Unix.select bug fixed, Antonin Décimo added as maintainer.

    New Features

  • Compiler profiling overhead eliminated when -dprofile/-dcounters/-dtimings are not in use: the backend previously called Profile.record_call once per function per compilation phase regardless of whether profiling was enabled, causing up to 30% overhead in microbenchmarks with many small functions. The fix skips all profiling work unless requested; profile_column was moved from Profile to Clflags. (ocaml/ocaml#14832)
  • Windows Unix.select file-descriptor drop fixed: socket_poll_add returned the dispatched node rather than the (potentially updated) list head, silently dropping some fds from results and causing a memory leak. A regression test was added. (ocaml/ocaml#14764)
  • Char.escaped documentation corrected in stdlib/char.mli: the previous text incorrectly stated that double-quote characters are escaped; Char.escaped '"' returns "\"" and double-quotes are not escaped. (ocaml/ocaml#14836)
  • Two ephemeron GC correctness fixes merged: ocaml/ocaml#14734 fixes ephemeron orphaning during Phase_sweep_ephe (dangling pointers across GC cycles); ocaml/ocaml#14733 corrects per-domain ephemeron work counters and removes a pessimistic ephe_next_round call that caused unnecessary repeated work in multicore benchmarks.
  • Regression test for warning 60 location bug: warning 60 (unused module) was previously reported at the wrong file location when a non-aliasable module substitution was involved. (commit 1d2d55d, ocaml/ocaml#12745)
  • Manual option documentation improved: -match-context-rows now shows its number argument in the options listing, with formatting and wording fixes in unified-options.etex and the ocamlc/ocamlopt man pages. (ocaml/ocaml#14838)

    • Overview

  • All activity this week was in ocaml/ocaml; ocaml/RFCs had no activity.
  • Six PRs were merged in ocaml/ocaml spanning GC correctness, compiler performance, a Windows stdlib bug fix, CI improvements, cross-compilation fixes, and documentation.
  • Antonin Décimo was officially added as a maintainer of ocaml/ocaml via ocaml/ocaml#14837.
  • Thirteen contributors were active across code, review, benchmarking, and documentation roles.
  • The modular IO RFC implementation (ocaml/ocaml#14775) progressed as a draft PR, linking RFC work to upstream compiler development.

    • Activity

  • New maintainer: Antonin Décimo added to CONTRIBUTING.md following a maintainer meeting decision (ocaml/ocaml#14837).
  • Newly opened — runtime events hang fix: Michael Bacarella opened ocaml/ocaml#14834 to fix a hang when an event exceeds the ring buffer size (originally reported in ocaml/ocaml#13335), proposing a fatal error instead of an infinite loop; under review by Gabriel Scherer.
  • CI improvements: Olivier Nicole merged ocaml/ocaml#14821 to disable "cold" tests in GitHub Actions and AppVeyor CI (permitted by ocaml/ocaml#14713); David Allsopp hardened the C++ test to skip correctly on musl libc targets (ocaml/ocaml#14827).
  • Cross-compilation build fix: @shym merged ocaml/ocaml#14835 fixing a broken .depend file caused by ocamldep misidentifying Str as otherlibs/str instead of Ast_helper.Str in Typing_recovery_state (introduced in ocaml/ocaml#14241), which had broken cross-compilation CI.
  • Build cleanup: The fake ocamlyacc.opt file produced during cross-compilation builds was removed (ocaml/ocaml#14833).
  • Changelog/documentation housekeeping: Olivier Nicole added a missing PR number for Fun.todo (ocaml/ocaml#14829); Enea Zani fixed minor grammar across three documentation files (ocaml/ocaml#14830).
  • Ongoing — GC pacing: Damien Doligez continues ocaml/ocaml#14796, with Eduardo Souza providing macro-benchmark results (5×5 parameter sweep across 22 benchmarks) showing wall-time improvements across all tested configurations.
  • Ongoing — further ephemeron correctness: Gabriel Scherer has three additional ephemeron PRs in review: ocaml/ocaml#14813 (no orphaned ephemerons across GC cycles), ocaml/ocaml#14774 (wait for all domains to finish marking before a new ephemeron round), and ocaml/ocaml#14745 (test suite for known ephemeron bugs).
  • Ongoing — faster minor GC: Nick Barnes updated ocaml/ocaml#14571 after addressing review comments; inlining the hot path in oldify_one offers 2–3% total runtime improvements in promotion-heavy workloads.
  • Ongoing — constructor eta-expansion: Alain Frisch opened ocaml/ocaml#14803 proposing auto eta-expansion of constructors in function-type contexts (e.g. List.map Some [1;2;3]).
  • Ongoing — extensible IO channels: Simon Cruanes has a draft ocaml/ocaml#14775 implementing extensible IO channels per the modular IO RFC.
  • Ongoing — type system alias following: Stefan Muenzel continues ocaml/ocaml#14746 to allow alias following when checking signature inclusion; Jacques Garrigue identified remaining issues in review.
  • Ongoing — C API bigarray exposure: David Allsopp works on ocaml/ocaml#14804 to expose caml_ba_compare and related bigarray functions outside CAML_INTERNALS.
  • Ongoing — libunix fixes: Antonin Décimo has ocaml/ocaml#14740 with Unix library correctness fixes including missing blocking sections in realpath and lockf.
  • Ongoing — OCAMLRUNPARAM tests: Gabriel Scherer opened ocaml/ocaml#14822 adding tests for current OCAMLRUNPARAM parsing behaviour as groundwork for follow-up cleanups.

    • Notable Discussions

  • ocaml/ocaml discussion #14451 on cross-compilation status was active: @yotambarnoy asked about the maturity of cross-compiling OCaml for Android using make crossopt, coinciding with the cross-compilation build fixes in ocaml/ocaml#14835 and ocaml/ocaml#14808.

    • Emerging Trends

  • Sustained ephemeron correctness effort: The merging of ocaml/ocaml#14733 and ocaml/ocaml#14734 continues a multi-week series of GC fixes led by Gabriel Scherer, with three more PRs (ocaml/ocaml#14813, ocaml/ocaml#14774, ocaml/ocaml#14745) in the review pipeline, reflecting the complexity of multicore ephemeron semantics.
  • Targeted, benchmark-backed compiler performance improvements: ocaml/ocaml#14832 (profiling overhead), ocaml/ocaml#14571 (minor GC), and ocaml/ocaml#14796 (GC pacing) all follow a pattern of measurable, data-driven optimisation with explicit benchmark results.
  • Cross-compilation robustness: Multiple PRs (ocaml/ocaml#14835, ocaml/ocaml#14833, ocaml/ocaml#14808) address cross-compilation edge cases, and active user discussion (ocaml/ocaml discussion #14451) signals growing interest in Android and musl targets.
  • OxCaml upstream flow: Several PRs this week (e.g. ocaml/ocaml#14832 from oxcaml/oxcaml#6141, ocaml/ocaml#14571) continue the pattern of performance and correctness work originating in the OxCaml fork and flowing back into upstream OCaml.

    • Multicore

    eio gains io_uring performance flags and fd security fix; ocaml-uring v2.14.0 released with Obj.magic elimination.

    New Features

  • eio_linux now uses IORING_SETUP_DEFER_TASKRUN and IORING_SETUP_SINGLE_ISSUER when creating io_uring rings, improving HTTP benchmark throughput by roughly 100k req/s on supported hardware (~350k to ~450k); falls back gracefully on older kernels (pre-Linux 6.1) via EINVAL catch (ocaml-multicore/eio#841, ocaml-multicore/eio#842)
  • eio_posix now passes MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC to recvmsg when receiving file descriptors, ensuring received fds are close-on-exec atomically; falls back to Unix.set_close_on_exec on macOS where the flag is absent (ocaml-multicore/eio#843)
  • AT_FDCWD handling moved to C stubs in ocaml-uring, eliminating Obj.magic in the OCaml layer; openat2, linkat, unlink, mkdirat, and statx now accept Unix.file_descr option where None maps to AT_FDCWD natively in C (ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#128)
  • Fixed dio_offset_align statx getter in ocaml-uring that was incorrectly returning stx_dio_mem_align instead of stx_dio_offset_align (ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#141)
  • ocaml-uring v2.14.0 released by Thomas Leonard, documenting breaking changes (Uring.Res module), new ops (send_zc, sendmsg_zc), and accumulated bug fixes (ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#140)

    • Overview

  • Activity this week was concentrated in ocaml-multicore/eio and ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring, with lighter maintenance work in ocaml-multicore/meio; the remaining six repositories had no recorded activity
  • ocaml-multicore/eio merged four PRs: two io_uring performance flag PRs (ocaml-multicore/eio#841, ocaml-multicore/eio#842), one fd security fix (ocaml-multicore/eio#843), and a benchmark Dockerfile update (ocaml-multicore/eio#844)
  • ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring shipped the v2.14.0 release (ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#140), merged the AT_FDCWD C-stub migration (ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#128) and a statx getter fix (ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#141), and opened several new PRs for additional ops and bug fixes
  • ocaml-multicore/meio had one new PR opened for a cmdliner migration (ocaml-multicore/meio#75) and three stale PRs closed (ocaml-multicore/meio#67, ocaml-multicore/meio#71, ocaml-multicore/meio#74)
  • Contributors active this week: Thomas Leonard, Anil Madhavapeddy, Patrick Ferris, and David Allsopp

    • Activity

  • eio — ongoing: Patrick Ferris's chown support PR (ocaml-multicore/eio#781) continues under review by Thomas Leonard, with discussion around making uid/gid optional and documenting the follow parameter
  • eio — ongoing: Patrick Ferris's draft PR for incremental directory reading (ocaml-multicore/eio#821) received detailed feedback from Thomas Leonard covering API naming, error handling scope, batching of thread jobs, and resource cleanup
  • eio — new issue: Thomas Leonard opened ocaml-multicore/eio#845 to track disabling fixed buffers by default in eio_linux, after a ZFS kernel bug was reported requiring a reboot when fixed buffers are used; this followed closure of ocaml-multicore/eio#797
  • eio — housekeeping: Benchmark Dockerfiles updated to reference a recent version of ocaml-uring and work around a change in opam install --deps-only behaviour (ocaml-multicore/eio#844)
  • ocaml-uring — new ops PR: Anil Madhavapeddy opened ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#147 adding shutdown, socket, renameat, and symlinkat operations with tests (not yet merged)
  • ocaml-uring — bug fixes opened: Statx.Attr inverted-condition bug (ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#142), Region.init bounds check (ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#145), io_uring_submit error reporting (ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#144), and debug message format fixes (ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#146) — all opened this week, merging shortly after
  • ocaml-uring — CI: lintcstubs-arity dependency changed from optional to hard test dependency so CI reliably catches missing primitive regenerations (ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#143)
  • meio — backlog cleanup: Patrick Ferris closed three stale PRs superseded by the new cmdliner approach: Eio tracing events port (ocaml-multicore/meio#71), OCaml 5.1.0 compatibility generalisation (ocaml-multicore/meio#67), and earlier Stdlib.Arg usage error improvement (ocaml-multicore/meio#74)

    • Notable Discussions

  • In ocaml-multicore/eio#843, Anil Madhavapeddy and Thomas Leonard discussed macOS compatibility for MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC: Anil Madhavapeddy initially flagged that the flag would not work on macOS, while Thomas Leonard clarified it is POSIX-specified but optional for implementations; the solution uses compile-time detection with a set_close_on_exec fallback on macOS
  • In ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#142, Thomas Leonard proposed that the Statx.Attr.check function should use the abstract t type rather than raw int64, aligning it with Attr.mem; Anil Madhavapeddy implemented a revised version making the type abstract and adding Flags.(=) and of/to_int conversions; Patrick Ferris was consulted on the proposed changes
  • In ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#144, Anil Madhavapeddy raised that caml_unix_error is unavailable on OCaml 4.x and proposed dropping OCaml 4.x support for the library, given that its primary consumer eio targets OCaml 5.x only
  • ocaml-multicore/eio#797 (io_uring security and stability concerns) was closed by Thomas Leonard after triaging the ZFS fixed-buffer kernel crash into the dedicated tracking issue ocaml-multicore/eio#845

    • Emerging Trends

  • Targeted io_uring flag adoption with benchmarked justification: three consecutive PRs (ocaml-multicore/eio#840, ocaml-multicore/eio#841, ocaml-multicore/eio#842) explored IORING_SETUP_SINGLE_ISSUER, IORING_SETUP_COOP_TASKRUN, and IORING_SETUP_DEFER_TASKRUN with careful benchmarking and graceful fallback paths for older kernels
  • Elimination of unsafe OCaml patterns: the merger of ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#128 removes the last Obj.magic usage from ocaml-uring by moving AT_FDCWD handling into C stubs; the ongoing Statx.Attr abstraction (ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#142) continues this push toward type-safe C interop
  • Safer defaults over marginal performance: the new issue ocaml-multicore/eio#845 signals a shift away from fixed buffers as a default in eio_linux, preferring stability over the performance benefit after a ZFS kernel crash was reported
  • Cross-platform correctness investment: both the MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC fix (ocaml-multicore/eio#843) and the ongoing chown PR (ocaml-multicore/eio#781) required platform-specific handling between Linux and macOS, reflecting sustained attention to portability alongside Linux-specific performance work
  • OCaml 5.x-only alignment: the question raised in ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#144 about dropping OCaml 4.x support from ocaml-uring, driven by eio's 5.x requirement, suggests the lower layers of the stack may follow eio's lead in formalising a 5.x minimum
entry.summary: Dune 3.24.0~alpha0 and ocaml-uring v2.14.0 released; eio gains ~100k req/s via io_uring flags; ephemeron GC fixes and profiling overhead eliminated in OCaml.

entry.title: Week 20, 2026: Dune 3.24 cycle opened, odoc 3.2.1 released, OxCaml gained preemption support, and ocaml-uring shipped a type-safe result API.
entry.content:
Weekly Summary

New Features

  • OCaml Core Jack Joergensen added caml_c_thread_register_in_domain to the C API (ocaml/ocaml#14275), enabling C threads to register into a chosen domain by passing its unique ID rather than always landing in domain 0.
  • OCaml Core David Allsopp fixed detection of argument defaults in configure (ocaml/ocaml#14802), correcting a spurious error when installing OCaml via opam on OpenSUSE with site-config present.
  • OCaml Core @chetmurthy fixed pprintast to preserve attributes on package types (ocaml/ocaml#14797), preventing silent attribute loss when pretty-printing (module M with type t = ...) expressions; backported to the 5.5 branch.
  • Multicore Thomas Leonard added the Uring.Res module (ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#131) providing a private int type for uring operation results with int_result/fd_result accessors, eliminating Obj.magic usage and resolving the long-standing ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#117.
  • Multicore Thomas Leonard applied MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC atomically when receiving file descriptors via recvmsg (ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#132), preventing FD leakage to child processes in multi-threaded programs.
  • Multicore Patrick Ferris contributed Eio_unix.Stdenv.override (ocaml-multicore/eio#823), allowing individual capabilities (stdin, stdout, net, fs, etc.) to be replaced in an existing environment without reconstructing a full environment object.
  • OxCaml Aspen Smith merged the initial preemption implementation (oxcaml/oxcaml#4881), adding foundational preemption support to the OxCaml runtime.
  • OxCaml Liam Stevenson merged ikinds enablement (oxcaml/oxcaml#5999), turning on integer kind support in the compiler.
  • OxCaml Jakub Bachurski added [@magic_staged_modes] (oxcaml/oxcaml#6066) to delay mode checks until program generation, enabling quoting of non-legacy (e.g. local) expressions in metaprogramming.
  • OxCaml Simon Spies integrated the LLDB OxCaml language plugin (oxcaml/oxcaml#4961) and bumped to OxCaml LLDB 21.1.0+oxcaml0 (oxcaml/oxcaml#5996) with name-mangling fixes for native debugging.
  • OxCaml Kevin Svetlitski enabled -gdwarf-inlined-frames via OCAMLPARAM (oxcaml/oxcaml#6061), providing opam-switch-wide extra debug info across all libraries.
  • OxCaml Zesen Qian added user documentation for the borrow_ operator (oxcaml/oxcaml#5928), providing comprehensive documentation for the borrowing feature in the uniqueness extension.
  • OxCaml Kostia Balytskyi merged injected parsetree support in Merlin's mpipeline (oxcaml/oxcaml#6078), enabling faster-path completion by type-checking a reduced parsetree.
  • OCaml Tools The Dune 3.24 development cycle opened with language version bump (ocaml/dune#14559); allocation profiling via DUNE_TRACE=+alloc (ocaml/dune#14401); directory targets promoted to stable (ocaml/dune#14579); conditional (melange.modules ..) field added (ocaml/dune#14482); and RPC client count in watch mode status line (ocaml/dune#14489), by Rudi Grinberg and Antonio Nuno Monteiro.
  • OCaml Tools Jon Ludlam released odoc 3.2.1 with three crash fixes for merlin-lib (ocaml/odoc#1430), core_unix (ocaml/odoc#1433), and base (ocaml/odoc#1426); @art-w added rendering of OxCaml unboxed named types with trailing # suffix (ocaml/odoc#1407).
  • OCaml Tools @hhugo added jsofocaml QuickJS-NG runtime support with a new quickjs dune profile and full test suite CI job (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2229); Jérôme Vouillon expanded the DOM API with HTMLCollection, Performance.now(), and selection* attributes (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2221).
  • OCaml Tools Jérôme Vouillon reduced Wasm constant-expression globalization, lowering toplevel function size ~50% for the PRT benchmark (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2211).
  • OCaml Tools R. Boujbel added OpamPathName and OpamRepositoryPathName modules to opam-format (ocaml/opam#6917); Nathan Rebours removed chdir-based APIs (OpamFilename.in_dir, OpamSystem.in_dir) in favour of a ?dir argument (ocaml/opam#6910).
  • OCaml Ecosystem Jon Ludlam published odoc.3.2.1 to opam-repository (ocaml/opam-repository#29891); Raphaël Proust published lwt.5.10.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29888); Mark Elvers published ocluster.0.4.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29900) with QEMU and HCS (Windows containers) backends and obuilder.0.7.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29887) with Overlayfs and native Windows container support.
  • OCaml Ecosystem Semgrep added pyro-caml.1.0.0, pyro-caml-instruments, and pyro-caml-ppx (ocaml/opam-repository#29901), a continuous OCaml profiler with a Pyroscope backend and PPX instrumenter.
  • OCaml Ecosystem Yuriy Krasilnikov added ecma-regex.0.1.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29915) providing ECMAScript regular expression syntax with Unicode property escapes and JSON Schema compatibility.
  • OCaml Ecosystem Anatole fixed Tour of OCaml docstring code blocks to include the # REPL prompt prefix (ocaml/ocaml.org#3649), reducing beginner confusion.

    • Group Activity Summaries

    OCaml Ecosystem

  • odoc OxCaml unboxed named types now rendered with trailing # suffix from compiler Pextra_ty representation (ocaml/odoc#1407) by @art-w; voodoo include-path fix computing transitive closure of lib_deps before emitting -I flags (ocaml/odoc#1434) by Jon Ludlam
  • opam OpamPathName and OpamRepositoryPathName modules added to opam-format to eliminate hardcoded path strings (ocaml/opam#6917) by R. Boujbel; OpamSystem commands gain ?dir argument replacing chdir-based APIs, removing OpamFilename.in_dir, OpamSystem.in_dir, and OpamSystem.chdir (ocaml/opam#6910) by Nathan Rebours

    • OxCaml

    34 PRs merged in oxcaml/oxcaml spanning preemption, metaprogramming, DWARF debugging, and unboxed-type docs; odoc CI pin removed.

    New Features

  • Initial preemption implementation merged by Aspen Smith (oxcaml/oxcaml#4881), adding the foundational preemption mechanism to the runtime.
  • Enable ikinds merged by Liam Stevenson (oxcaml/oxcaml#5999), turning on integer kind support in the compiler.
  • Add [@magic_staged_modes] to delay mode checks until program generation by Jakub Bachurski (oxcaml/oxcaml#6066), enabling quoting of non-legacy (e.g. local) expressions in metaprogramming.
  • Facility to register -X extra params added by Basile Clément (oxcaml/oxcaml#6003), allowing internal undocumented compiler options to be registered via a new Extra_options module.
  • Use new LLDB OxCaml language plugin integrated by Simon Spies (oxcaml/oxcaml#4961), switching to a dedicated OxCaml language plugin for LLDB.
  • Bump to OxCaml LLDB 21.1.0+oxcaml0 by Simon Spies (oxcaml/oxcaml#5996), picking up name-mangling-related changes for the LLDB plugin.
  • Allow setting -gdwarf-inlined-frames via OCAMLPARAM by Kevin Svetlitski (oxcaml/oxcaml#6061), enabling opam switches with extra debug info across all libraries.
  • Allow aliased interface files to not exist when building the cmi_bundle for metaprogramming by Jack Rickard (oxcaml/oxcaml#6043), fixing crashes when module aliases had no CMI and preventing link-time dropping of quote-only modules.
  • Add user documentation for the borrow_ operator by Zesen Qian (oxcaml/oxcaml#5928), providing comprehensive documentation for the borrowing feature in the uniqueness extension.
  • Merlin: add support for injected parsetrees to mpipeline by Kostia Balytskyi (oxcaml/oxcaml#6078), enabling faster-path completion by allowing Merlin to type-check a reduced parsetree.
  • Removed temporary odoc CI pin in oxcaml/opam-repository by David Allsopp (oxcaml/opam-repository#45), switching from a pre-release git commit pin to the released upstream odoc 3.2.0.

    • Overview

  • oxcaml/oxcaml had the most activity with 34 merged PRs from 23 contributors, covering compiler correctness, metaprogramming, DWARF/debugging, and documentation.
  • oxcaml/opam-repository saw one merged PR (odoc CI pin removal) and one open issue requesting a Jane Street preview package bump to v0.18~preview.130.100+614.
  • oxcaml/merlin had one in-progress draft PR (oxcaml/merlin#239) for the OCaml 5.4 upstream merge, currently blocked by merge conflicts.
  • oxcaml/jsofocaml and janestreet/opam-repository had no recorded activity this week.

    • Activity

  • Compiler correctness fixes: Richard Eisenberg fixed a compiler panic with [@@unboxed] and existentials (oxcaml/oxcaml#6046); Ryan Tjoa fixed scannable axis printing (oxcaml/oxcaml#6060), kind annotation checks for existential patterns (oxcaml/oxcaml#5935), and incorrect switch-table lifting with local coercions (oxcaml/oxcaml#6084).
  • Metaprogramming fixes: Jakub Bachurski fixed stage-tracking fatal errors hiding type errors (oxcaml/oxcaml#6070); Andrej Ivašković fixed infix operator lambda generation (oxcaml/oxcaml#5982) and constructor logic for extension constructors in quotations (oxcaml/oxcaml#5983).
  • Mode solver fix: @julesjacobs and Zesen Qian corrected an unsound map comparison in the mode solver morph map (oxcaml/oxcaml#6047).
  • Flambda2 / Reaper improvements: Nathanaëlle Courant fixed bugs in rewriting of sets of closures (oxcaml/oxcaml#6005); Basile Clément reduced if-cascades in Reaper code generation (oxcaml/oxcaml#5938); Mark Shinwell reverted a Flambda2 change that caused regressions (oxcaml/oxcaml#6085).
  • Debugging and tooling: @jdimino-js added verbose fatal errors for array primitives (oxcaml/oxcaml#6079); James Rayman added a warning for [@untagged] external int8/int16 returns (oxcaml/oxcaml#6081); Chris Casinghino fixed a missing-parens bug in pprintast (oxcaml/oxcaml#6052).
  • Testing infrastructure: @ttebbi-janestreet improved expect-asm test stability by normalising label names (oxcaml/oxcaml#5993); Simon Spies added binary-level emit tests for small integers (oxcaml/oxcaml#5942); David Allsopp resolved OCaml 5.4 merge conflicts and updated test baselines across four PRs (oxcaml/oxcaml#5972, oxcaml/oxcaml#5988, oxcaml/oxcaml#5989, oxcaml/oxcaml#6015).
  • Documentation: James Rayman expanded small integer docs with overflow behaviour (oxcaml/oxcaml#6069), C interop section (oxcaml/oxcaml#6063), unboxed array representation table fixes (oxcaml/oxcaml#6088), and the mixed-block v6 changelog fix (oxcaml/oxcaml#6096).
  • oxcaml/merlin 5.4 upstream merge: @dkalinichenko-js continues work on the large upstream merge draft (oxcaml/merlin#239) incorporating 424,854 additions across 888 files, currently in a conflicting state.
  • Jane Street preview package bump: Artem Pianykh opened oxcaml/opam-repository#46 requesting a bump to v0.18~preview.130.100+614 for ~30 packages including oxcaml_intrinsics, ocaml_simd, unboxed, and vec.

    • Notable Discussions

  • Custom [@@or_null] payload shape design debated on oxcaml/oxcaml#5830 between @julesjacobs and @dkalinichenko-js, exploring "best-kind design" vs. "ordinary-scheme design" for user-defined nullable types.
  • DWARF emission standardisation discussed on oxcaml/oxcaml#6093 by Simon Spies, with @julesjacobs raising concerns about correct DW_AT_byte_stride and element counts for packed unboxed arrays.
  • Shape.Uid.t and Global_module.Name.t integration discussed on oxcaml/oxcaml#6071 by Liam Stevenson, with @julesjacobs questioning potential loss of -for-pack information from declaration UIDs.
  • Frametables in .rodata section discussed on oxcaml/oxcaml#6094 by Kevin Svetlitski, with @julesjacobs providing a macOS fix for Apple's assembler not accepting .section .rodata.
  • Regalloc rematerialisation draft by Xavier Clerc (oxcaml/oxcaml#6077) reports a 5% reduction in stack slots and 2.4% reduction in spills measured across compiler files.
  • Claude-based code review skill proposed by Richard Eisenberg in oxcaml/oxcaml#6072, with Simon Spies trialling and reporting results; discussion noted pagination fixes needed.
  • Jane Street preview package bump tracking in oxcaml/opam-repository#46 by Artem Pianykh, noting ~30 packages missing a release commit for v0.18~preview.130.100+614, with reference to upstream janestreet/ocamlintrinsicskernel#5.

  • Metaprogramming maturity: Multiple fixes and features landed for quotation and evaluation semantics (oxcaml/oxcaml#5982, oxcaml/oxcaml#5983, oxcaml/oxcaml#6043, oxcaml/oxcaml#6066, oxcaml/oxcaml#6070), with larger open PRs (oxcaml/oxcaml#6086, oxcaml/oxcaml#6092) pushing new quoting capabilities.
  • Compilation speed focus: Several open PRs labelled "compilation speed" (oxcaml/oxcaml#6065, oxcaml/oxcaml#6068) alongside benchmarking-only PRs from @julesjacobs (oxcaml/oxcaml#6053, oxcaml/oxcaml#6054, oxcaml/oxcaml#6055, oxcaml/oxcaml#6058) measuring regalloc and prologue validation overheads.
