    • OCaml Core

    GC ephemeron fixes, a new C threading API, pprintast correctness, and RFC discussion on persistent compiler processes.

    New Features

  • ocaml/ocaml#14275 by Jack Joergensen: caml_c_thread_register_in_domain added to the C API, enabling C threads created outside the OCaml runtime to register into a chosen domain by passing the domain's unique ID, rather than being forced into domain 0 via caml_c_thread_register.
  • ocaml/ocaml#14797 by @chetmurthy: Fixed pprintast to preserve attributes on package types, avoiding silent attribute loss when pretty-printing (module M with type t = ...) expressions; backported to the 5.5 branch.
  • ocaml/ocaml#14802 by David Allsopp: Fixed detection of argument defaults in configure, correcting a spurious error when installing OCaml via opam on OpenSUSE with the site-config package present (follow-up to ocaml/ocaml#14760, ocaml/ocaml#14761).

    • Overview

  • ocaml/ocaml saw 14 commits merged across GC ephemeron refactoring, pprintast correctness, configure fixes, stdlib documentation cleanup, and CI dependency updates.
  • ocaml/RFCs had no new commits but received a substantive design comment on the persistent compiler processes RFC (ocaml/RFCs#60).
  • Active open work in ocaml/ocaml includes a constructor auto-eta-expansion proposal (ocaml/ocaml#14803), Weak iteration additions (ocaml/ocaml#14792), bigarray C API exposure (ocaml/ocaml#14804), and an riscv64 jump-table miscompilation report (ocaml/ocaml#14799).
  • Key contributors this week: Gabriel Scherer (GC work, reviews), David Allsopp (configure, bigarray API), Antonin Décimo (CI, cross-compilation), and Nicolás Ojeda Bär (reviews across both repositories).

    • Activity

  • ocaml/ocaml#14732 by Gabriel Scherer: Refactored ephemeron phase-change logic in major_gc.c, extracting prepare_for_ephe_sweeping and related helpers as a behavior-neutral cleanup ahead of GC pacing work (ocaml/ocaml#14796).
  • ocaml/ocaml#14722 by Gabriel Scherer: Fixed orphaning of ephemerons in runtime/major_gc.c, addressing a bug uncovered while studying ocaml/ocaml#14349.
  • ocaml/ocaml#14808 opened by Antonin Décimo: Minor build fixes for cross-compilation, including a .gitignore entry for yacc/ocamlyacc.opt and assembly fixes for *-pc-windows targets with Wine or clang-cl.
  • ocaml/ocaml#14804 opened by David Allsopp: Expose caml_ba_compare and related bigarray internals currently hidden behind CAML_INTERNALS, to allow external code to construct custom_operations structs for custom bigarray wrappers.
  • ocaml/ocaml#14801 opened by Jacques Garrigue: Add level to abbreviations in Texpand to address a typing internals issue; under review by Gabriel Scherer.
  • ocaml/ocaml#14810 by Gabriel Scherer: Removed outdated comment from stdlib/lazy.mli about ill-founded recursive definitions under -rectypes, superseded by ocaml/ocaml#14805.
  • ocaml/ocaml#14811 by Ronan Desplanques: Fixed identifier mismatch in Ptyp_constr docstring in parsing/parsetree.mli (lident → tconstr), reviewed by Nicolás Ojeda Bär.
  • ocaml/ocaml#14806 by @vip892766gma: Fixed duplicated "the" typos in typing/typecore.ml and typing/errortrace_report.ml, reviewed by Nicolás Ojeda Bär.
  • ocaml/ocaml#14786 by Antonin Décimo: Updated GitHub Actions dependencies (actions/cache, actions/upload-artifact, actions/download-artifact) in the TSan workflow; reviewed by David Allsopp.
  • ocaml/RFCs#60 by Nicolás Ojeda Bär: The persistent compiler processes RFC (open since January 2026) received a comment from @copy proposing an alternative design based on exposing a cleaner compiler API by removing global state from compiler modules.

    • Notable Discussions

  • ocaml/ocaml#14803 by Alain Frisch: Constructor auto-eta-expansion — proposes auto-expanding argument-less constructors when a function type is expected (e.g. List.map Some [1;2;3]); Nicolás Ojeda Bär raised concerns about making constructor interpretation type-directed and suggested narrowing ocaml/ocaml#9005 to unary constructors as a less invasive alternative; a developer meeting was proposed.
  • ocaml/ocaml#14792 by Romain Beauxis: Weak.{iter, iteri, foldi_left} — 24 comments from Nicolás Ojeda Bär, Gabriel Scherer, Stefan Muenzel, Vincent Laviron, and Daniel Bünzli debating allocation trade-offs in foldi_left vs. ergonomics of iteri.
  • ocaml/ocaml#14799 by @nickbetteridge: riscv64 jump-table miscompilation when -march includes compressed instructions (e.g. rv64gc) — the assembler can compress 4-byte j slots to 2-byte c.j, breaking dispatch; 13 comments exploring the issue and possible fixes.
  • ocaml/ocaml#14809 by @chetmurthy: Pretty-printing bug with Ptyp_functor in OCaml 5.5 beta — inline extensions in the Ptyp_functor grammar are not reflected in the constructed AST, reported as a follow-on to ocaml/ocaml#14797.
  • ocaml/RFCs#60: @copy suggested that exposing a more ergonomic compiler API (removing global state from compiler modules) could be a complementary or alternative approach to persistent compiler processes, benefiting Merlin and enabling finer-grained parallelisation.

    • Emerging Trends

  • GC ephemeron correctness: ocaml/ocaml#14732 and ocaml/ocaml#14722 are part of a sustained effort by Gabriel Scherer to stabilise ephemeron handling in major_gc.c before the new GC pacing logic (ocaml/ocaml#14796) lands.
  • Stdlib iteration API completeness: ocaml/ocaml#14792 proposes Weak.foldi_left as a zero-allocation primitive, consistent with broader work to add fold/iter variants across stdlib collection modules.
  • Cross-compilation robustness: ocaml/ocaml#14808 and ocaml/ocaml#14802 both address reliability when cross-compiling or installing on less common Linux distributions.
  • Pretty-printer round-trip fidelity: ocaml/ocaml#14797 and the follow-on ocaml/ocaml#14809 highlight continued attention to pprintast accuracy, important for ppx rewriters and Merlin.
  • Compilation overhead reduction: Debate in ocaml/RFCs#60 between a persistent-process model and a cleaner compiler API reflects sustained interest in reducing per-invocation startup and .cmi unmarshalling costs for build tools like dune.

    • Multicore

    Activity concentrated in eio and ocaml-uring: new Uring.Res type-safe API, Stdenv.override, and CLOEXEC bug fix.

    New Features

  • Uring.Res module added to ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring via ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#131: provides a private int type for uring operation results, with int_result/int_exn for numeric results, fd_result/fd_exn for file descriptor results, and a pp pretty-printer emitting symbolic error names. Resolves the long-standing ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#117 without requiring Obj.magic in user code.
  • MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC flag applied atomically when receiving file descriptors via recvmsg in ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#132, preventing FD leakage to child processes in multi-threaded programs.
  • Eio_unix.Stdenv.override added to ocaml-multicore/eio via ocaml-multicore/eio#823: allows replacing individual capabilities (stdin, stdout, net, process_mgr, clock, fs, etc.) in an existing environment without reconstructing a full environment object.

    • Overview

  • Activity this week was concentrated in ocaml-multicore/eio (3 PRs merged) and ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring (4 PRs merged); the remaining 7 repositories had no recorded activity.
  • Thomas Leonard was the primary contributor, authoring all 4 merged PRs in ocaml-uring and reviewing/rebasing the key eio PR ocaml-multicore/eio#823.
  • Patrick Ferris contributed the Stdenv.override feature ocaml-multicore/eio#823 and a configurable eventfd proposal ocaml-multicore/eio#836.
  • David Allsopp's prototype PRs ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#129 and ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#130 informed the final Uring.Res design, though both were closed in favour of the lighter-weight approach in ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#131.
  • Three long-standing ocaml-uring issues were closed: WSL2 sendmsg failure ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#55, unusable accept FD ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#117, and ZFS write_fixed hang ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#113.

    • Activity

  • ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#131 Merged by Thomas Leonard: Uring.Res module using a private int type, superseding the extra-C-call approach in ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#129 and the job-ID encoding approach in ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#130.
  • ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#132 Merged by Thomas Leonard: atomic MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC for recvmsg, fixing a race condition where a child process could inherit FDs before the flag was set manually.
  • ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#133 Merged by Thomas Leonard: write_fixed documentation warning for old ZFS versions, prompted by @toastal, closing ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#113.
  • ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#134 Merged by Thomas Leonard: test hang fix on Linux 5.10, where a failed send previously caused an indefinite wait on the receive side.
  • ocaml-multicore/eio#823 Merged: Eio_unix.Stdenv.override authored by Patrick Ferris, rebased and reviewed by Thomas Leonard.
  • ocaml-multicore/eio#839 Merged by Thomas Leonard: eio Linux backend updated to cast Uring.Res.t values back to int for compatibility with the new ocaml-uring API.
  • ocaml-multicore/eio#832 Merged by Volker Diels-Grabsch: README cleanup removing a redundant as 'a constraint from the custom environment type example.
  • ocaml-multicore/eio#836 Closed without merging: configurable eventfd proposal by Patrick Ferris; Thomas Leonard suggested using dup to reserve FD numbers before Eio initialises as a simpler workaround.

    • Notable Discussions

  • Type-safe uring result API design debated across three PRs in ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring: David Allsopp's ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#129 used an extra C call for safe int-to-FD conversion; ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#130 explored encoding return types in 4 bits of the job ID. Thomas Leonard identified allocation overhead and Eio integration complexity (unknown error codes becoming EUNKNOWNERR, extra match arms per operation) as drawbacks of the fully-typed approach, favouring the private int approach in ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#131.
  • Configurable eventfd for shell FD management (ocaml-multicore/eio#836): Patrick Ferris proposed making eventfd creation configurable for use in msh (a POSIX shell built on Eio). Thomas Leonard suggested that opening /dev/null, duping it to reserve high FD numbers before Eio initialises, then closing them achieves the same goal without an API change.
  • Tempdir utilities and atomic rename (ocaml-multicore/eio#831): Anil Madhavapeddy noted a key use case for the open proposal by Volker Diels-Grabsch — creating a temp file in the same directory as an existing Eio.Path to enable atomic cross-directory-safe renames when downloading files.

    • Emerging Trends

  • API safety without runtime overhead: the Uring.Res module (ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#131) eliminates Obj.magic for converting uring result integers to Unix.file_descr using a private int type; the Stdenv.override addition (ocaml-multicore/eio#823) extends the capability-passing pattern to support ergonomic composition without full environment reconstruction — both reflect a focus on making the libraries safe by default.
  • OS-compatibility hardening: the MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC fix (ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#132) and the Linux 5.10 test hang fix (ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#134) address correctness across kernel versions and environments beyond the primary development platform.
  • Shell and systems-programming use cases: interest in using Eio as a foundation for shell-level programs (FD management in ocaml-multicore/eio#836, temp file handling in ocaml-multicore/eio#831, process spawning) is growing, driven by projects like msh.
entry.summary: Dune 3.24 cycle opened, odoc 3.2.1 released, OxCaml gained preemption support, and ocaml-uring shipped a type-safe result API.

entry.title: Week 19, 2026: Dune 3.23.0 released with sandboxing by default; OxCaml Merlin consolidated into monorepo and ikinds enabled by default across 24 contributors.
entry.content:
Weekly Summary

New Features

  • OCaml Tools ocaml/dune 3.23.0 released (ocaml/dune#14212) by Shon Feder: user rules are now sandboxed by default, compile_commands.json generated for C/C++ foreign stubs, shared jsoo runtimes, hardlink sandboxing on Windows, and dune clean target arguments
  • OCaml Tools Relocatable compiler in dune pkg (ocaml/dune#14357): dune now detects and uses the relocatable OCaml compiler from David Allsopp's opam repository, treating the compiler as a cacheable package and closing ocaml/dune#13229 and ocaml/dune#14012
  • OCaml Tools dune rpc flush-file-watcher command (ocaml/dune#14467): new RPC procedure allowing clients to synchronise with the file watcher before issuing build requests
  • OCaml Tools RPC connection status in build status line (ocaml/dune#14424): shows a [rpc N] section; Console.Status_line gained add_section/remove_section APIs for composable persistent fragments
  • OCaml Tools Live sandbox throttle (ocaml/dune#14464): a global limit of 250 slots prevents unbounded concurrent sandbox directory creation
  • OCaml Tools Array-backed filename sets (ocaml/dune#14487): long-lived filename sets in watch mode now use sorted arrays (Filename.Array.Set) instead of balanced trees, reducing memory footprint in long-running watch sessions
  • OCaml Tools Removal of .all-deps transitive dependency files (ocaml/dune#14407): transitive module dependency closures now computed directly from ocamldep/ocamlobjinfo actions, fixing a "Rule not found" error
  • OCaml Tools cram boolean expressions in runtest_alias (ocaml/dune#14425): cram tests now support boolean expressions in the runtest_alias field
  • OCaml Tools ocaml/opam update handles file/directory renames (ocaml/opam#6915): OpamRepositoryBackend.get_diff rewritten to handle cases where a repository changes a file into a directory (or vice versa), closing ocaml/opam#3830 filed in 2019
  • OCaml Tools ocaml/merlin Misc module relocated (ocaml/merlin#2059): Misc and Format_doc moved from merlin_utils to ocaml_utils, reducing diff against the upstream OCaml compiler
  • OCaml Tools ocaml/ocaml-lsp pin-depends in opam template (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1603): merlin-lib and ocaml-index pins added directly to ocaml-lsp-server.opam.template so opam switch create . works without manual pinning
  • OCaml Tools ocsigen/jsofocaml Wasm string conversion fix (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2230): stubs for length and intoCharCodeArray added to the string_ops fallback, fixing wasm:js-string import resolution on engines lacking the JS String Builtins proposal
  • OCaml Tools ocsigen/jsofocaml Node.js 26 compatibility (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2234): removed --experimental-wasm-imported-strings and --experimental-wasm-stack-switching flags, which Node.js 26 now enables by default
  • OCaml Tools ocaml/odoc ROADMAP.md restructured (ocaml/odoc#1421) by Jon Ludlam, formalising four work streams: OxCaml support, new markup syntax, custom tags/plugins, and improved source rendering
  • OxCaml ikinds enabled by default in oxcaml/oxcaml: the -ikinds flag replaced by -no-ikinds; prerequisite ikind substitution fix also merged (oxcaml/oxcaml#5998, oxcaml/oxcaml#5999) by @julesjacobs and Liam Stevenson
  • OxCaml Merlin added as a git subtree at external/merlin/ in oxcaml/oxcaml, bringing full Merlin history into the monorepo with CI integration (oxcaml/oxcaml#5568) by Liam Stevenson
  • OxCaml Patricia trees use GADTs to encode invariants: Empty can only appear at toplevel, enabling allocation-free Set operations; Set.union code size halved (oxcaml/oxcaml#5899) by Nathanaëlle Courant
  • OxCaml Shorter AVX/VEX encodings in the x86 binary emitter: 2-byte VEX prefix support (oxcaml/oxcaml#6012), shorter vmovq/movapd/movupd (oxcaml/oxcaml#6022), and 2-byte VEX for YMM reg-reg moves (oxcaml/oxcaml#6033) by Simon Spies
  • OxCaml Allow implicit kind redeclaration: nested [@@@implicit_kind] annotations differing from outer declaration now permitted (oxcaml/oxcaml#5980) by @dkalinichenko-js
  • OxCaml Doc comments on kind declarations preserved: bug that silently dropped (** ... *) documentation on kind declarations fixed (oxcaml/oxcaml#5987) by Chris Casinghino
  • OxCaml Better error messages for Invalid_native_repr_for_primitive: now include a Hint: pointing to [@unpacked] for product layouts in C stub arguments (oxcaml/oxcaml#5985) by James Rayman
  • OxCaml New extlib.1.8.0+ox package enabling extlib to build under OxCaml (oxcaml/opam-repository#44)
  • OxCaml New dune.3.22.2+ox and odoc.3.2.0+ox packages (plus odoc-driver, odoc-md, odoc-parser, sherlodoc variants), resolving a CI breakage (oxcaml/opam-repository#39)
  • OxCaml New oxcaml.action-required virtual package providing actionable error messages for users missing the overlay repository (oxcaml/opam-repository#40)
  • OxCaml oxcaml/merlin repository deprecated: contents removed and README redirected to oxcaml/oxcaml as canonical home (oxcaml/merlin#240) by Liam Stevenson
  • OCaml Core Seq.repeat is now constant-space (ocaml/ocaml#14783) by Jeremy Yallop: implemented with a single cyclic closure and cons cell rather than allocating new cells per element
  • OCaml Ecosystem OCaml compiler archival cutoff raised to 4.11: ocaml/opam-repository#29848 removed 1,132 package definition files (53,000+ lines) for compilers below 4.11
  • OCaml Ecosystem dune 3.23.0 published on ocaml/opam-repository (ocaml/opam-repository#29844) with release announcement on ocaml.org (ocaml/ocaml.org#3637)
  • OCaml Ecosystem miou 0.6.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29855) adds a Miou.Trace module with runtime event integration and Miou.take for consuming tasks from Miou.orphans
  • OCaml Ecosystem vif 0.0.1~beta3 (ocaml/opam-repository#29876) adds UNIX domain socket listener support, graceful server shutdown, and an OPTIONS route method
  • OCaml Ecosystem Camlp5 8.05.00 (ocaml/opam-repository#29874) adds OCaml 5.5.0 syntax support; bugfix 8.04.01 (ocaml/opam-repository#29884) corrects labeled tuple handling
  • OCaml Ecosystem ppxderivingjsonschema 0.0.7 (ocaml/opam-repository#29819) adds [@@jsonschema.compact_variants], [@@jsonschema.format], [@@jsonschema.description], [@jsonschema.default], and [@jsonschema.attrs] attributes, making option types nullable
  • OCaml Ecosystem art 0.4.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29873) adds the Art.map function to the Adaptive Radix Tree library
  • OCaml Ecosystem AbsInt added to the ocaml.org industrial users page (ocaml/ocaml.org#3647), documenting their use of OCaml in the Astrée static analyser and CompCert compiler
  • OCaml Ecosystem Draft release changelog pages added to ocaml.org for dune-release 2.2.1, mdx 2.5.2, merlin v5.7.0-504/v5.7.1-504/v5.7-505~preview, ocaml-lsp 1.26.0-5.5~preview, ocamlformat 0.29.0, OCaml 5.5.0~alpha2/~beta1, odoc 3.2.0, opam-publish 3.0.0, and utop 2.17.0 via ocaml/ocaml.org#3641
  • OCaml Ecosystem CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md formally added to opam-repository (ocaml/opam-repository#29850), adopting the OCaml Code of Conduct

    • Group Activity Summaries

    OCaml Ecosystem

    OCaml 4.11 archival cutoff enforced, dune 3.23.0 released and documented, and robur-coop Miou ecosystem packages published in bulk.

    New Features

  • OCaml compiler archival cutoff raised to 4.11: ocaml/opam-repository#29848 removed 1,132 package definition files (53,000+ lines) for compilers below 4.11, with a companion archival PR at ocaml/opam-repository-archive#35.
  • dune 3.23.0 released via ocaml/opam-repository#29844: user rules are now sandboxed by default, dune clean accepts target arguments, dune promote promotes all paths matching a prefix, and compile_commands.json is generated for C/C++ foreign stubs when building @check. Minimum OCaml version to build dune raised from 4.08 to 4.14. Release announcement published on ocaml.org via ocaml/ocaml.org#3637.
  • miou 0.6.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29855) adds a Miou.Trace module with runtime event integration and Miou.take for consuming tasks from Miou.orphans.
  • vif 0.0.1~beta3 (ocaml/opam-repository#29876) adds UNIX domain socket listener support, graceful server shutdown, and an OPTIONS route method.
  • Camlp5 8.05.00 (ocaml/opam-repository#29874) adds OCaml 5.5.0 syntax support; bugfix 8.04.01 (ocaml/opam-repository#29884) corrects labeled tuple handling in constructor expressions.
  • ppxderivingjsonschema 0.0.7 (ocaml/opam-repository#29819) adds [@@jsonschema.compact_variants], [@@jsonschema.format], [@@jsonschema.description], [@jsonschema.default], and [@jsonschema.attrs] attributes, and makes option types nullable.
  • art 0.4.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29873) adds the Art.map function to the Adaptive Radix Tree library.
  • CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md formally added to opam-repository (ocaml/opam-repository#29850), adopting the OCaml Code of Conduct.
  • AbsInt added to the ocaml.org industrial users page via ocaml/ocaml.org#3647, documenting their use of OCaml in the Astrée static analyser and CompCert compiler.
  • Draft release changelog pages added to ocaml.org for dune-release 2.2.1, mdx 2.5.2, merlin v5.7.0-504 / v5.7.1-504 / v5.7-505~preview, ocaml-lsp 1.26.0-5.5~preview, ocamlformat 0.29.0, OCaml 5.5.0~alpha2 / ~beta1, odoc 3.2.0, opam-publish 3.0.0, and utop 2.17.0 via ocaml/ocaml.org#3641.
  • conf-jq extended with OpenBSD package name (ocaml/opam-repository#29871), conf-cmake extended with NixOS depext support (ocaml/opam-repository#29856), and conf-guile corrected for OpenBSD and RHEL 9 (ocaml/opam-repository#29872).

    • Overview

  • ocaml/opam-repository saw its largest structural change of recent weeks with the archival of all packages requiring OCaml < 4.11 (ocaml/opam-repository#29848), removing over 53,000 lines and 1,132 files.
  • dune 3.23.0 was released on opam-repository (ocaml/opam-repository#29844) and its release announcement published on ocaml.org (ocaml/ocaml.org#3637), representing coordinated activity across both repositories.
  • Calascibetta Romain submitted nine coordinated releases for the robur-coop Miou networking stack, spanning scheduler, kernel, network, HTTP, FAT, and web server layers.
  • ocaml/ocaml.org focused on retroactively filling platform release documentation gaps: draft changelog pages were added for 12+ releases and alpha series data tracked with ignore: true for newsletter use (ocaml/ocaml.org#3640, ocaml/ocaml.org#3641).
  • Three new standalone packages were accepted: doctor 0.1.0 (OCaml environment diagnostics, ocaml/opam-repository#29854), ppxforbid + ppxenforce 0.1.0 (compile-time access control PPX, ocaml/opam-repository#29853), and sha256-cng 0.1.0 (Windows-native SHA-256, ocaml/opam-repository#29885).
  • Cross-platform depext coverage expanded with OpenBSD and RHEL 9 fixes for conf-jq (ocaml/opam-repository#29871), conf-guile (ocaml/opam-repository#29872), and NixOS support for conf-cmake (ocaml/opam-repository#29856).

    • Activity

  • Hannes Mehnert merged the archival PR (ocaml/opam-repository#29848) and released mirage 4.11.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29870), ca-certs 1.0.3 (ocaml/opam-repository#29869), ca-certs-nss 3.123.1 (ocaml/opam-repository#29868), and albatross 2.7.1 (ocaml/opam-repository#29851).
  • Calascibetta Romain released the full Miou networking stack: miou 0.6.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29855), httpcats 0.3.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29859) with revdeps prep (ocaml/opam-repository#29858), mkernel 0.0.2 (ocaml/opam-repository#29860), mnet 0.0.2 (ocaml/opam-repository#29861), mtbox 0.0.1~beta1 (ocaml/opam-repository#29864), hurl 0.0.1~beta2 (ocaml/opam-repository#29865), mfat 0.0.1~beta1 (ocaml/opam-repository#29866), mhttp 0.0.2 (ocaml/opam-repository#29867), and vif 0.0.1~beta3 (ocaml/opam-repository#29876).
  • Shon Feder released dune 3.23.0 (18 packages) to opam-repository (ocaml/opam-repository#29844), closing the earlier draft alpha PR (ocaml/opam-repository#29824) to avoid CI overload, and authored the dune 3.23.0 release announcement on ocaml.org (ocaml/ocaml.org#3637).
  • @sabine opened the batch draft platform release changelog PR (ocaml/ocaml.org#3641), added dune alpha release data (ocaml/ocaml.org#3640), added AbsInt to industrial users (ocaml/ocaml.org#3647), and clarified contribution guidelines for industrial user listings (ocaml/ocaml.org#3645).
  • Marcello Seri reviewed multiple PRs, adjusted Camlp5 OCaml version bounds (ocaml/opam-repository#29875), applied the caisar upper-bound fix for ppxderivingjsonschema (ocaml/opam-repository#29849), and added the formal CODEOFCONDUCT.md (ocaml/opam-repository#29850).
  • @chetmurthy released Camlp5 8.05.00 (ocaml/opam-repository#29874) and bugfix 8.04.01 (ocaml/opam-repository#29884).
  • Reynir Björnsson released git-net and git-kv 0.2.2 (ocaml/opam-repository#29877) and opened ocaml/opam-repository#29881 proposing archival of ocaml-src dev packages.
  • Marek Kubica fixed depexts for conf-jq on OpenBSD (ocaml/opam-repository#29871) and conf-guile on OpenBSD and RHEL 9 (ocaml/opam-repository#29872), triggered by work on ocaml/odoc#1422.
  • Mathieu Barbin released cmdlang 0.0.11 (5 packages) (ocaml/opam-repository#29878), enabling OCaml 5.4/5.5 CI and deprecating Param.create.
  • Max Slater released ocamlintrinsicskernel v0.17.2 fixing MSVC compilation errors (ocaml/opam-repository#29880); Frédéric Recoules released unisim_archisec 0.0.14 fixing x86 instruction decoding segfaults (ocaml/opam-repository#29879).
  • Anil Madhavapeddy released opam-0install 0.6.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29847) adding cmdliner 2.0.0+ compatibility.
  • Sacha Ayoun added the Caml in the Capital recurring meetup and corrected the S-REPLS location on ocaml.org (ocaml/ocaml.org#3633).
  • Anton Melnikov fixed a missing space in the values-and-functions tutorial (ocaml/ocaml.org#3639).
  • Tobias Mock opened a documentation update to add the --with-dev-setup flag to the managing dependencies tutorial (ocaml/ocaml.org#3646), currently open.
  • Issues ocaml/opam-repository#29059, ocaml/opam-repository#29569, and ocaml/opam-repository#29102 were closed following the 4.11 archival and related cleanup.

    • Notable Discussions

  • Jules Aguillon flagged in ocaml/ocaml.org#3641 that a code block in the draft mdx 2.5.2 changelog was malformed and suggested removing an inaccurate AI-generated section rather than publishing summary text that diverges from the actual changelog.
  • @sabine raised a process concern in ocaml/ocaml.org#3641: release announcements should ideally be written by maintainers on discuss.ocaml.org first, and the current stop-gap approach of drafting pages from changelog data cannot be verified without maintainer input.
  • Reynir Björnsson opened ocaml/opam-repository#29881 proposing to archive ocaml-src.{4.13,4.14,5.0}.dev packages that have no checksums and are marked avoid-version, to reduce noise in opam-mirror; Hannes Mehnert agreed they appear unused since OCaml 5.1 dropped the .dev style.
  • @funwithcthulhu submitted the ocaml-doctor package (ocaml/opam-repository#29845) and was guided by Anil Madhavapeddy and Shon Feder to rename it to doctor per the repository's naming policy discouraging the ocaml- prefix; the contributor promptly reopened as ocaml/opam-repository#29854.
  • Charles Averill asked in ocaml/opam-repository#29883 how to release two related packages (lstar-rocq with Rocq code and lstar with extracted OCaml) from the same repository so users do not need Rocq installed, reporting that dune-release bistro -p lstar-rocq,lstar only released the Rocq package; the issue remains open.

    • Emerging Trends

  • The OCaml compiler floor is rising: the archiving policy cutoff was updated from 4.08 to 4.11 (ocaml/opam-repository#29848), and dune 3.23.0 itself raised its minimum build requirement from 4.08 to 4.14 (ocaml/opam-repository#29844). A further cleanup of ocaml-src dev packages without checksums is under discussion (ocaml/opam-repository#29881).
  • The robur-coop Miou ecosystem produced coordinated releases across nine packages (miou, mkernel, mnet, mtbox, mhttp, mfat, hurl, httpcats, vif) in a single week (ocaml/opam-repository#29855, ocaml/opam-repository#29860, ocaml/opam-repository#29861, ocaml/opam-repository#29864, ocaml/opam-repository#29865, ocaml/opam-repository#29866, ocaml/opam-repository#29867, ocaml/opam-repository#29876), reflecting active development of a unikernel networking stack built on the Miou scheduler.
  • Platform release documentation is catching up: multiple platform tool releases from February–May 2026 had no corresponding ocaml.org announcement pages; ocaml/ocaml.org#3641 and ocaml/ocaml.org#3642 represent an effort to retroactively document these, while dune alpha changelogs are now tracked with ignore: true (ocaml/ocaml.org#3640) to avoid premature publication.
  • Cross-platform depext coverage is expanding: this week added OpenBSD entries for conf-jq (ocaml/opam-repository#29871), fixed conf-guile for OpenBSD and RHEL 9 (ocaml/opam-repository#29872), and added NixOS support for conf-cmake (ocaml/opam-repository#29856).
  • Windows-specific OCaml packages are growing: sha256-cng 0.1.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29885) uses the native Windows CNG/BCrypt API, and ocamlintrinsicskernel v0.17.2 (ocaml/opam-repository#29880) fixed MSVC compilation errors, continuing a pattern of increased Windows ecosystem investment.

    • OCaml Tools

    Dune 3.23.0 released with 3.23.1 regression cycle underway; opam fixes 7-year-old update bug; Merlin rename propagated to ocaml-lsp.

    New Features

  • ocaml/dune 3.23.0 released (ocaml/dune#14212): shipped 2026-05-05 by Shon Feder, including user-rule sandboxing by default, compile_commands.json for C/C++ stubs, shared jsoo runtimes, hardlink sandboxing on Windows, and dune clean target arguments.
  • Relocatable compiler in dune pkg (ocaml/dune#14357): dune now detects and uses the relocatable OCaml compiler from David Allsopp's opam repository, enabling the compiler to be treated as a cacheable package and closing ocaml/dune#13229 and ocaml/dune#14012.
  • dune rpc flush-file-watcher command (ocaml/dune#14467): new RPC procedure allowing clients to synchronise with the file watcher before issuing build requests, added to dune-rpc's public API.
  • RPC connection status in build status line (ocaml/dune#14424): the build status line now shows a [rpc N] section; Console.Status_line gained add_section/remove_section APIs for composable persistent fragments.
  • Live sandbox throttle (ocaml/dune#14464): a global limit of 250 slots prevents unbounded concurrent sandbox directory creation, reducing disk pressure during large parallel builds.
  • Array-backed filename sets (ocaml/dune#14487): long-lived filename sets in watch mode now use sorted arrays (Filename.Array.Set) instead of balanced trees, reducing memory footprint in long-running watch sessions.
  • Removal of .all-deps transitive dependency files (ocaml/dune#14407): transitive module dependency closures are now computed directly from ocamldep/ocamlobjinfo actions, removing intermediate materialised files and fixing a "Rule not found" error.
  • cram: boolean expressions in runtest_alias (ocaml/dune#14425): cram tests now support boolean expressions in the runtest_alias field.
  • dune install error in package-managed workspaces (ocaml/dune#14427): running dune install when dune package management is active now produces a clean user error rather than crashing.
  • ocaml/opam update handles file/directory renames (ocaml/opam#6915): OpamRepositoryBackend.get_diff was rewritten to handle cases where a repository changes a file into a directory (or vice versa), closing ocaml/opam#3830 filed in 2019. A new OpamFilename.Unix module was added for cross-platform path handling.
  • ocaml/merlin Misc module relocated (ocaml/merlin#2059): Misc and Format_doc moved from merlin_utils to ocaml_utils (src/ocaml/utils/), reducing diff against the upstream OCaml compiler.
  • ocaml/odoc ROADMAP.md restructured (ocaml/odoc#1421): by Jon Ludlam, formalising four work streams: OxCaml support, new markup syntax, custom tags/plugins, and improved source rendering, plus Sherlodoc improvements.
  • ocaml/ocaml-lsp pin-depends in opam template (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1603): merlin-lib and ocaml-index pins added directly to ocaml-lsp-server.opam.template so opam switch create . works without manual pinning.
  • ocsigen/jsofocaml Wasm string conversion fix (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2230): stubs for length and intoCharCodeArray added to the string_ops fallback, fixing wasm:js-string import resolution on engines lacking the JS String Builtins proposal.
  • ocsigen/jsofocaml Node.js 26 compatibility (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2234): removed --experimental-wasm-imported-strings and --experimental-wasm-stack-switching flags, which Node.js 26 now enables by default.

    • Overview

  • Six of ten tracked repositories had activity this week; ocaml/ocamlfind, ocaml/opam-file-format, and ocaml-dune/spawn had no commits or open PRs.
  • ocaml/dune was the most active repository with 50+ commits: dune 3.23.0 shipped on 2026-05-05 (ocaml/dune#14212) and a 3.23.1 regression cycle was immediately opened (ocaml/dune#14441) to address post-release issues in opam generation, OCaml version compatibility, and jsoo shared runtimes.
  • ocaml/opam resolved a 7-year-old crash when repository directories changed shape (ocaml/opam#6915, closing ocaml/opam#3830), and opened multiple draft PRs advancing the repository layer overhaul (ocaml/opam#6625).
  • ocaml/odoc updated its roadmap (ocaml/odoc#1421) to formalise OxCaml support, and addressed xref2 substitution failures against real-world OCaml 5.x packages (ocaml/odoc#1429, ocaml/odoc#1431).
  • ocaml/merlin merged a compiler synchronisation refactor (ocaml/merlin#2059) and opened an architectural discussion on integrating ocamlgrep structural search (ocaml/merlin#2063).
  • ocaml/ocaml-lsp adapted to Merlin's module rename (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1601) and improved developer setup by encoding Merlin pin-depends in the opam template (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1603).
  • ocsigen/jsofocaml merged four PRs covering Wasm correctness, variable coalescing, and Node.js 26 compatibility, while a dune 3.23 upgrade remains blocked on upstream regressions (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2231).

    • Activity

  • ocaml/dune 3.23.1 regression fixes: Robin Bate Boerop gated opam bound deduplication on (lang dune 3.23) (ocaml/dune#14466, fixing ocaml/dune#14436); Ali Caglayan fixed bootstrapping with ocamlfind-secondary on OCaml < 4.14 (ocaml/dune#14443); Jérôme Vouillon fixed alphabetical sort corruption in shared jsoo runtime ordering (ocaml/dune#14438); both ocaml/dune#14466 and ocaml/dune#14443 were backported to the 3.23.1-rc (ocaml/dune#14471, ocaml/dune#14465).
  • ocaml/dune sandbox lifecycle refactored (ocaml/dune#14483): Sandbox.create/destroy replaced by Sandbox.with_, with a None mode for lightweight non-sandboxed actions.
  • ocaml/dune melange test coverage expansion: Antonio Nuno Monteiro merged six melange test PRs (ocaml/dune#14418, ocaml/dune#14419, ocaml/dune#14420, ocaml/dune#14478, ocaml/dune#14480, ocaml/dune#14475) covering nested subdirs, wrapped/unwrapped libraries, and melange-specific source preferences.
  • ocaml/dune directory symlink resolution (ocaml/dune#13792): Ambre Austen Suhamy landed support for resolving directory symlinks in fetched source archives, partially fixing ocaml/dune#9873.
  • ocaml/dune menhir opam dep injection fix (ocaml/dune#14434): menhir dependency now only injected for packages that actually use menhir, fixing ocaml/dune#14428.
  • ocaml/dune portable lock directories single solve (ocaml/dune#14458): Ali Caglayan opened a draft PR to implement a single SAT solve for all platforms, addressing ocaml/dune#13645.
  • ocaml/dune RPC debug improvements (ocaml/dune#14405): Rudi Grinberg added in-flight RPC request tracking to SIGUSR2 debug dumps.
  • ocaml/opam autopin cleanup UX (ocaml/opam#6923): draft PR by Nathan Rebours to silently unpin automatically pinned packages when the user declines installation confirmation, complementing the regression test in ocaml/opam#6922.
  • ocaml/opam repository load consistency (ocaml/opam#6924): draft PR by Kate to homogenise initial and diff-based repository loads, part of the tar.gz archive story (ocaml/opam#6625).
  • ocaml/opam documentation and CI improvements: depopts filter note made bold in Manual (ocaml/opam#6920, closing ocaml/opam#5367); doc changes now trigger the documentation build job in CI (ocaml/opam#6927, fixing ocaml/opam#6810).
  • ocaml/odoc [@@zero_alloc] OxCaml annotation PR (ocaml/odoc#1422): by Marek Kubica, parsing zero_alloc attributes with opt, strict, and arity payloads; under active review by Paul-Elliot Anglès d'Auriac.
  • ocaml/odoc xref2 substitution bug fixes (ocaml/odoc#1430): fix for assertion failure in subst.ml and uncaught exception in apply_inner_substs discovered via merlin-lib (ocaml/odoc#1429) and core_unix (ocaml/odoc#1431) build failures.
  • ocaml/odoc bisect_ppx dependency removed (ocaml/odoc#1428) and OxCaml opam conflict constraint added (ocaml/odoc#1432) by David Allsopp.
  • ocaml/merlin saved-parts testing PR (ocaml/merlin#2060) by Thomas Refis remains open, investigating a difference in how Merlin handles saved types versus the upstream typechecker.
  • ocsigen/jsofocaml variable coalescing fix (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2233): corrected handling of unlabelled break targeting labelled non-iteration statements; CFG builder refactored with a new visit_owning_stmt to make context-ownership explicit.
  • ocsigen/jsofocaml Wasm lifecycle events PR (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2232): Jason Gross proposed dispatching wasmoocaml:loaded and wasmoocaml:error CustomEvents on globalThis when async Wasm instantiation completes, ported from ocaml-wasm/wasmofocaml#143.
  • ocsigen/jsofocaml dune 3.23 CI fix (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2236): addressed newly enforced menhir lower bound in dune 3.23.

    • Notable Discussions

  • dune 3.23.1 regression tracker (ocaml/dune#14441): Shon Feder opened a dedicated tracker immediately after 3.23.0. Identified regressions include menhir spurious dep injection (ocaml/dune#14428), opam bound deduplication activating for pre-3.23 projects (ocaml/dune#14436), OCaml < 4.14 build breakage (ocaml/dune#14443), and jsoo shared runtime ordering corruption (ocaml/dune#14438).
  • Per-module inter-library dependency filtering (ocaml/dune#14472): Robin Bate Boerop restructured the long-running ocaml/dune#14116 PR addressing ocaml/dune#4572. Alain Frisch engaged on the trade-off between per-module fine-grained deps (larger graph, less recompilation) versus compiler-side .cmx stability checks.
  • ocamlgrep integration architecture (ocaml/merlin#2063): Martin Jambon proposed integrating structural type-aware OCaml code search as a Merlin subcommand (ocaml/merlin#2064). Ulysse raised concerns about dependency layering and suggested deeper integration sharing Merlin's artifact caches. The discussion also surfaced the project's emerging position on AI-assisted contributions: authors must have full ownership of submitted code.
  • opam autopin cleanup UX (ocaml/opam#6923): Nathan Rebours and Kate agreed to silently unpin automatically pinned packages on declined installation, while leaving packages pinned after install failure since partial state may have been written.
  • top-module over-invalidation in dune (ocaml/dune#14477): Robin Bate Boerop filed a performance bug where dune ocaml top-module rebuilds artefacts when any library dependency's interface changes, even libraries only referenced from .mli which top-module drops; reproduction test in ocaml/dune#14476.
  • ocaml/odoc [@@zero_alloc] representation (ocaml/odoc#1422): Marek Kubica and Paul-Elliot Anglès d'Auriac debated a record type { opt; strict; arity } vs. a variant representation, and whether to silently ignore invalid payloads (given the OxCaml compiler will catch them at source).
  • ocaml-lsp opam downgrade on OCaml 4.14 (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1604): Török Edwin reported that opam upgrade attempts to downgrade ocaml-lsp-server from 1.21.0-4.14 to 1.17.0 due to version resolution interplay with the lsp sub-library split.

    • Emerging Trends

  • OxCaml support across the toolchain: ocaml/odoc is formalising OxCaml feature support via a tracking issue (ocaml/odoc#1411), roadmap update (ocaml/odoc#1421), new annotation PR (ocaml/odoc#1422), and opam conflict constraints (ocaml/odoc#1432); dune's relocatable compiler work (ocaml/dune#14357) provides a foundation for this via improved package management.
  • Per-module dependency precision in dune: the multi-PR effort (ocaml/dune#14472, ocaml/dune#14473, ocaml/dune#14474) by Robin Bate Boerop to filter compile-rule dependencies per module using ocamldep output continues to grow in scope, with discussion from Alain Frisch on performance implications for large monorepos.
  • Build engine resource management in dune: multiple merged PRs this week (ocaml/dune#14464, ocaml/dune#14483, ocaml/dune#14487) by Rudi Grinberg reflect a sustained drive to reduce memory pressure, file descriptor exhaustion, and disk usage in long-running watch sessions.
  • Tight Merlin–LSP coupling requiring coordinated tracking: the need for both a compatibility patch (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1601) and an opam pin change (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1603) in the same week illustrates a recurring pattern where ocaml-lsp must track Merlin's main branch closely between releases, with developer onboarding breakage as a consequence (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1602).
  • Post-release regression discipline in dune: the 3.23.1 cycle (ocaml/dune#14441) demonstrates a maturing practice of gating behaviour changes on (lang dune X.Y) version, with ocaml/dune#14466 and ocaml/dune#14453 retroactively applying version guards to previously unguarded changes.
  • Wasm correctness and runtime compatibility in jsofocaml: fixes for string conversion fallbacks (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2230), variable coalescing (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2233), and a new lifecycle events proposal (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2232) reflect continued broadening of Wasm target support alongside ongoing native effects (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2189) and WASI runtime work (ocsigen/jsofocaml#1831).
  • opam repository layer overhaul progressing steadily: the coordinated set of PRs (ocaml/opam#6915, ocaml/opam#6924, ocaml/opam#6929, ocaml/opam#6871) are all preparatory for tar.gz archive support as a first-class repository format (ocaml/opam#6625).

    • OxCaml

    Merlin consolidated into oxcaml/oxcaml monorepo, ikinds enabled by default, and new opam packages added for dune, odoc, and extlib.

    New Features

  • ikinds enabled by default in oxcaml/oxcaml: the -ikinds flag replaced by -no-ikinds; prerequisite ikind substitution fix also merged (oxcaml/oxcaml#5998, oxcaml/oxcaml#5999) by @julesjacobs and Liam Stevenson
  • Merlin added as a git subtree at external/merlin/ in oxcaml/oxcaml, bringing full Merlin history into the monorepo with CI integration (oxcaml/oxcaml#5568) by Liam Stevenson
  • Patricia trees use GADTs to encode invariants: Empty can only appear at toplevel, enabling allocation-free Set operations; Set.union code size halved (oxcaml/oxcaml#5899) by Nathanaëlle Courant
  • Shorter AVX/VEX encodings in the x86 binary emitter: 2-byte VEX prefix support (oxcaml/oxcaml#6012), shorter vmovq/movapd/movupd (oxcaml/oxcaml#6022), and 2-byte VEX for YMM reg-reg moves (oxcaml/oxcaml#6033) by Simon Spies
  • Allow implicit kind redeclaration: nested [@@@implicit_kind] annotations differing from outer declaration now permitted (oxcaml/oxcaml#5980) by @dkalinichenko-js
  • Doc comments on kind declarations preserved: bug that silently dropped (** ... *) documentation on kind declarations fixed (oxcaml/oxcaml#5987) by Chris Casinghino
  • Better error messages for Invalid_native_repr_for_primitive: now include a Hint: pointing to [@unpacked] for product layouts in C stub arguments (oxcaml/oxcaml#5985) by James Rayman
  • Fix hidden dependency cache checking: -H warning behavior now consistent regardless of cache state and lookup order (oxcaml/oxcaml#6020) by @julesjacobs
  • Fix modes bug in untypeast/pprintast roundtrip: modalities on val/external items now correctly restored (oxcaml/oxcaml#5986) by Chris Casinghino
  • Syntactic sugar for fexpr switch branches inlining goto handler code directly (oxcaml/oxcaml#5474) by Keryan Didier
  • fexpr: Display stub information for code symbols in Flambda2 IR output (oxcaml/oxcaml#6004) by Basile Clément
  • New extlib.1.8.0+ox package enabling extlib to build under OxCaml (oxcaml/opam-repository#44)
  • New dune.3.22.2+ox and odoc.3.2.0+ox packages (plus odoc-driver, odoc-md, odoc-parser, sherlodoc variants), resolving a CI breakage since dune 3.22 is required for OxCaml detection by latest odoc (oxcaml/opam-repository#39)
  • New opam-core.2.5.1+ox and opam-format.2.5.1+ox packages aligned with the upstream opam 2.5.1 release (oxcaml/opam-repository#41)
  • New oxcaml.action-required virtual package providing actionable error messages for users missing the overlay repository (oxcaml/opam-repository#40)
  • oxcaml/merlin repository deprecated: contents removed and README redirected to oxcaml/oxcaml as canonical home (oxcaml/merlin#240) by Liam Stevenson

    • Overview

  • oxcaml/oxcaml was highly active with 24 contributors: Merlin integrated as a subtree (oxcaml/oxcaml#5568), ikinds enabled by default (oxcaml/oxcaml#5999), and sustained 5.4 merge preparation (oxcaml/oxcaml#5958)
  • oxcaml/opam-repository added five new or updated packages (extlib, dune 3.22.2, odoc 3.2.0, opam-core/format 2.5.1), removed deprecated odoc 3.1.0+ox patches (oxcaml/opam-repository#43), and added onboarding infrastructure (oxcaml/opam-repository#40)
