    • OCaml Core

    Quiet week in ocaml/ocaml: stdlib improvements, typechecker refactoring, Unix bug fixes, and CI hardening; ocaml/RFCs had no activity.

    New Features

  • ocaml/ocaml#14783 by Jeremy Yallop: Seq.repeat is now constant-space, implemented with a single cyclic closure and cons cell rather than allocating new cells per element, reducing memory usage for long sequences.

    • Overview

  • Activity this week was entirely in ocaml/ocaml; ocaml/RFCs had no recorded activity.
  • Seven PRs were merged into trunk spanning stdlib optimisation (ocaml/ocaml#14783), typechecker refactoring (ocaml/ocaml#14800, ocaml/ocaml#14795), Unix library thread-safety and Windows correctness (ocaml/ocaml#14715, ocaml/ocaml#14788), ocamldoc (ocaml/ocaml#14794), and CI hardening (ocaml/ocaml#14787, ocaml/ocaml#14676).
  • Notable open work includes a draft new GC pacing algorithm (ocaml/ocaml#14796) and native atomic fetch-add across multiple backends (ocaml/ocaml#14575).
  • Discussions touched on runtime event flooding, Dynarray concurrency documentation, and a stdlib proposal for a non-empty list type.

    • Activity

  • ocaml/ocaml#14800 by Matthew Marques: Localized nondep_type_rec memoisation state into a new Nondep_scope module in typing/ctype.ml, replacing module-global hash tables with per-call scope instances; reviewed by Stefan Muenzel and Gabriel Scherer.
  • ocaml/ocaml#14715 by Antonin Décimo: Fixed null-pointer dereferences and a missing HAVE_GETLOGIN_R define in several POSIX thread-safe functions in libunix (getgrnam_r, getgrgid_r, getpwnam_r, getpwuid_r, getlogin_r); cherry-picked to 5.5 by Florian Angeletti.
  • ocaml/ocaml#14795 by Florian Angeletti: Removed dead mutual recursion in typing/env.ml that had been present since OCaml 4.00, splitting store_{type,value,...} / module_components into independent definitions.
  • ocaml/ocaml#14794 by Florian Angeletti: Fixed the ocamldoc is_function predicate to recognise modular explicit (module-dependent) function types.
  • ocaml/ocaml#14788 by Nicolás Ojeda Bär: Mapped Win32 ERROR_DIRECTORY (267) to ENOTDIR instead of EUNKNOWNERR(-267), fixing ocaml/ocaml#14767 so that Unix.opendir on a file raises the expected error on Windows.
  • ocaml/ocaml#14787 by Olivier Nicole: Fixed a wrong GITHUB_TOKEN variable name not propagated to check-changes-updated.sh and clarified CI comments from ocaml/ocaml#14676.
  • ocaml/ocaml#14676 by Austin Theriault: Prevented shell injection in GitHub Actions by placing GHA expression variables into environment variables rather than expanding them directly in run scripts.

    • Notable Discussions

  • ocaml/ocaml#14791 opened by nicki: Proposes emitting EV_DOMAIN_CONDITION_WAIT only in the instrumented runtime after observing event flooding in large Infer runs (46K events vs. ~750 for other phases at -j14); Gabriel Scherer questioned whether the event should be removed entirely, noting that Condition.wait is a user-level action rather than a runtime action.
  • ocaml/ocaml#14798 by Nathan Taylor: Proposes rewording the Dynarray concurrency documentation to be more precise; Gabriel Scherer confirmed only resizing operations are truly unsafe, noting the broader work of documenting concurrent usage for all stdlib mutable structures remains pending.
  • ocaml/ocaml#14261 by Mathieu Barbin: Ongoing discussion on adding a Nonempty_list.t type to the stdlib (using the (::) constructor trick for list-syntax compatibility) purely for interoperability between third-party libraries, without adding further API beyond the type definition.

    • Emerging Trends

  • Removal of global mutable state from the typechecker: ocaml/ocaml#14800 (Nondep_scope) and ocaml/ocaml#14795 continue a pattern of converting module-level hash tables and dead mutual recursions into locally-scoped values, improving thread-safety and modularity of compiler internals.
  • Cross-platform Unix correctness: ocaml/ocaml#14715 and ocaml/ocaml#14788 both address platform-specific bugs in the Unix library, reflecting sustained effort to align POSIX bindings across Linux, macOS, and Windows.
  • Draft GC pacing algorithm: ocaml/ocaml#14796 by Damien Doligez introduces a new GC pacing algorithm (686 additions across 17 files) as an early-stage draft, signalling upcoming changes to GC throughput tuning.
  • Native atomic fetch-add across backends: ocaml/ocaml#14575 by Zane Hambly continues review for emitting native Iatomic_fetch_add on amd64, arm64, riscv, and power, advancing multicore performance.

    • Multicore

    Quiet week across the multicore group; eio saw a design discussion on adding Eio.Promise.map.

    Overview

  • Activity this week was limited to ocaml-multicore/eio; all other repositories (domainslib, ocaml-uring, meio, saturn, eio-trace, picos, kcas, ocaml-iomux) had no recorded activity.
  • Patrick Ferris opened ocaml-multicore/eio#838 proposing an Eio.Promise.map function to enable functional-style promise composition without requiring a switch.
  • Thomas Leonard responded with a detailed analysis of the design constraints, explaining why a straightforward implementation is non-trivial given Eio's concurrency safety guarantees.

    • Activity

  • Patrick Ferris opened ocaml-multicore/eio#838 requesting an Eio.Promise.map function, noting that the existing workaround (Fiber.fork ~sw) requires a switch and undermines the switchless promise API design.
  • Thomas Leonard outlined three obstacles in ocaml-multicore/eio#838: promise resolution intentionally runs no user code (making it safe from signal handlers), so the resolving domain cannot execute the mapping function; delegating to the awaiting domain still requires a switch; and lazy evaluation introduces locking concerns when multiple domains await simultaneously.
  • Patrick Ferris concluded in ocaml-multicore/eio#838 that his specific use case — a non-yielding, immediate transformation analogous to Option.get — can accept a switch, resolving the immediate need.

    • Notable Discussions

  • ocaml-multicore/eio#838: Thomas Leonard explained that Condition.register_immediate exists for immediate callbacks but is intended for IO library integration rather than general use, clarifying where Eio.Promise.map would fit in the broader API surface.
  • The exchange in ocaml-multicore/eio#838 surfaces a recurring tension in Eio's design: ergonomic functional composition (e.g. Promise.map, Promise.bind) versus the deliberate constraint that promise resolution must not execute arbitrary user code.

    • Emerging Trends

  • The proposal in ocaml-multicore/eio#838 reflects continued interest in making Eio's promise primitives composable in a functional style, similar to patterns common in Lwt or Async, while preserving Eio's stronger concurrency-safety guarantees.
entry.summary: Dune 3.23.0 released with sandboxing by default; OxCaml Merlin consolidated into monorepo and ikinds enabled by default across 24 contributors.

entry.title: Week 18, 2026: odoc 3.2.0, merlin 5.7.1-504, and dune 3.23.0 alpha released; OxCaml kind system refined; oxcaml virtual package established in opam-repository.
entry.content:
Weekly Summary

New Features

  • OCaml Tools odoc 3.2.0 released (ocaml/odoc#1425) by Jon Ludlam, shipping OxCaml compiler-libs compatibility (ocaml/odoc#1423), persistent LaTeX macros for HTML/KaTeX (ocaml/odoc#1391), multi-file markdown-generate eliminating shell scripting (ocaml/odoc#1387), OCaml 5.5 support (ocaml/odoc#1406), and a fix for Arrow_functor Not_found crashes (ocaml/odoc#1427)
  • OCaml Tools Merlin v5.7.1-504 released (ocaml/merlin#2062) by Ulysse, fixing a CMI cache invalidation bug where new .cmi files in the build path failed to trigger invalidation due to hidden deps in OCaml 5.2; merged indexes now point to each other, producing smaller index files
  • OCaml Tools dune 3.23.0 alpha0/1/2 released (ocaml/dune#14211) by Shon Feder with new %{pkg:foo:lib:file} pforms for querying package install layouts (ocaml/dune#14200), source-files-changed events in the watch-mode RPC stream (ocaml/dune#14396), and trace output with rusage snapshots at build start/end (ocaml/dune#14402)
  • OCaml Tools Compilation_context.t per-Compilation_mode.t architectural refactor landed in ocaml/dune#13346 by Antonio Nuno Monteiro, separating native/Melange/other modes into distinct contexts with follow-ons (ocaml/dune#14410, ocaml/dune#14411)
  • OCaml Tools dune-rpc connection error handling hardened across three PRs by Rudi Grinberg: write-side disconnects treated consistently (ocaml/dune#14384), pending requests terminated on disconnect (ocaml/dune#14368), write errors now raise Connection_dead (ocaml/dune#14361)
  • OCaml Tools ppx_optcomp conditional support added to the dune bootstrap build by Rudi Grinberg (ocaml/dune#14404), with follow-on PPX lexer cleanups (ocaml/dune#14406, ocaml/dune#14408)
  • OCaml Tools %test_module blocks stripped during bootstrap to prevent spurious build failures by Ali Caglayan (ocaml/dune#14355)
  • OCaml Tools OpamFilename.Unix module added to opam for path manipulation using / as separator regardless of OS (ocaml/opam#6914)
  • OCaml Tools Wasm toplevel embeds CMIs in .wasmo zip output in jsofocaml, completing OCaml 5.5 Wasm separate-compilation support (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2220)
  • OCaml Tools String concatenation peephole rewrite fixed in jsofocaml — + removed from commutative operators, fixing reversed operands that caused Filename.temp_file to return malformed paths (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2228)
  • OCaml Tools Merlin Misc module refactored to ocaml_utils to reduce diff against the upstream compiler (ocaml/merlin#2059)
  • OxCaml New kind abbreviations landed in oxcaml/oxcaml#5921 by Ryan Tjoa: value_maybe_null, value_maybe_separable, immutable_data_or_null, mutable_data_or_null, and sync_data_or_null; scannable axes now take the meet instead of overriding
  • OxCaml float64-only records now represented as mixed blocks (oxcaml/oxcaml#5796) by Ryan Tjoa, with [@@represent_as_float_array] attribute for legacy compatibility
  • OxCaml DWARF5 DW_AT_name/DW_AT_linkage_name compliance fixed (oxcaml/oxcaml#5976) by Kevin Svetlitski
  • OxCaml -name-mangling-scheme flag added to ocamlopt by Mark Shinwell to override per-compilation-unit name mangling convention (oxcaml/oxcaml#5963)
  • OxCaml Legacy unique_ and once_ mode prefix syntax removed by Zesen Qian; all tests updated to use the modern @ mode syntax (oxcaml/oxcaml#5931)
  • OxCaml Layout-polymorphic values now print as in the toplevel with appropriate debugger and printer checks (oxcaml/oxcaml#5866) by Zesen Qian
  • OxCaml arg_is_non_zero flag removed from Cclz/Cctz intrinsics by Richard Eisenberg, simplifying CMM and operation types (oxcaml/oxcaml#5827)
  • OxCaml Register allocator affinity extended to use phi-move information by Xavier Clerc, reducing move counts by ~0.5–2.2% (oxcaml/oxcaml#5844)
  • OxCaml OxCaml merlin CMI cache fix backported — hidden_were_allowed now recorded in Missing entries to prevent stale negative cache results (oxcaml/merlin#237) by Liam Stevenson
  • OCaml Core Seq.(cycle, repeat, forever) closure allocation reduced by Haz via tail closure reuse (ocaml/ocaml#14781), merged by Florian Angeletti
  • OCaml Core Value_rec_check switched to Ident.Map with Map.union join by Stefan Muenzel (ocaml/ocaml#14777), merged by Gabriel Scherer
  • OCaml Core OCamlFDO symbol names restored — caml_hot__code_begin/caml_hot__code_end hard-wired and hot-code registration moved to startup_nat.c by Nick Barnes (ocaml/ocaml#14778)
  • OCaml Ecosystem oxcaml virtual package added to ocaml/opam-repository (ocaml/opam-repository#29809) by David Allsopp, establishing the pattern for OxCaml-dependent packages to signal requirements without opaque solver failures
  • OCaml Ecosystem lwd 0.5 released as 7 packages (ocaml/opam-repository#29832) by Ulysse, with quick_sample/quick_release API additions, nested sampling detection, fixed mutation in Join nodes, and brr-lwd reactive attribute updates
  • OCaml Ecosystem notty-miou 0.0.1 and nottui-miou 0.0.1 — first release of terminal library bindings for the Miou scheduler (ocaml/opam-repository#29833) by Calascibetta Romain
  • OCaml Ecosystem cattery 0.0.1 — first release of a pool library for Miou (ocaml/opam-repository#29810) by Calascibetta Romain
  • OCaml Ecosystem wol 1.0, wol-eio 1.0, wol-mirage 1.0 — Wake-on-LAN magic packet libraries with Eio and MirageOS variants (ocaml/opam-repository#29831) by Ryan Gibb
  • OCaml Ecosystem hdr_histogram 0.0.5 — ~1.8x faster value recording, new int-based record_value, hdr_percentiles_print binding, and Windows support (ocaml/opam-repository#29817) by Tim McGilchrist
  • OCaml Ecosystem ppxderivingjsonschema 0.0.7 adds @@jsonschema.compact_variants, @@jsonschema.format, @@jsonschema.description, @jsonschema.default for record fields, and fixes parametric recursive type schema generation (ocaml/opam-repository#29819)
  • OCaml Ecosystem ciao_lwt 0.2 adds OCaml 5.4 and 5.5 compatibility and improved bound expression handling in Lwt migration (ocaml/opam-repository#29811) by Jules Aguillon
  • OCaml Ecosystem charset 0.3.0 by Jeremy Yallop (ocaml/opam-repository#29839)
  • OCaml Ecosystem Hash Tables tutorial accuracy fix on ocaml/ocaml.org: corrected O(1) complexity description from "linear" to "constant" time by @LordPatate (ocaml/ocaml.org#3630)

    • Group Activity Summaries

    OCaml Ecosystem

    23 packages merged in opam-repository including the oxcaml virtual package; ocaml.org received tutorial fixes and 14 new Planet posts.

    New Features

  • oxcaml virtual package added to ocaml/opam-repository by David Allsopp, providing a signalling mechanism for OxCaml dependency with a user-friendly error message guiding users to the OxCaml opam remote (ocaml/opam-repository#29809)
  • lwd 0.5 released as 7 packages by Ulysse: includes quick_sample/quick_release API additions, nested sampling detection, fixed mutation handling in Join nodes, updated brr-lwd for multiple reactive attributes/events, and migrated nottui to notty-community (ocaml/opam-repository#29832)
  • notty-miou 0.0.1 and nottui-miou 0.0.1 — first release of terminal library bindings for the Miou scheduler by Calascibetta Romain (ocaml/opam-repository#29833)
  • cattery 0.0.1 — first release of a pool library for the Miou scheduler by Calascibetta Romain (ocaml/opam-repository#29810)
  • wol 1.0, wol-eio 1.0, and wol-mirage 1.0 — new Wake-on-LAN magic packet construction packages with Eio and MirageOS variants by Ryan Gibb (ocaml/opam-repository#29831)
  • merlin 5.7.1-504 — fixes a cache invalidation issue introduced by hidden deps in OCaml 5.2, and improves merged index format for smaller index files with cross-references by Ulysse (ocaml/opam-repository#29828)
  • hdr_histogram 0.0.5 — ~1.8x faster value recording, new record_value using int instead of int64, new hdr_percentiles_print binding, and Windows support by Tim McGilchrist (ocaml/opam-repository#29817)
  • ppxderivingjsonschema 0.0.7 — adds @@jsonschema.compact_variants, @@jsonschema.format, @@jsonschema.description, ~ocaml_doc flag, @jsonschema.attrs composite attribute, @jsonschema.default for record fields, makes option types nullable, and fixes schema generation for parametric recursive types (ocaml/opam-repository#29819)
  • ciao_lwt 0.2 — compatibility with OCaml 5.4 and 5.5, plus improved handling of bound expressions in Lwt migration by Jules Aguillon (ocaml/opam-repository#29811)
  • charset 0.3.0 — new release by Jeremy Yallop (ocaml/opam-repository#29839)
  • Hash Tables tutorial accuracy fix on ocaml/ocaml.org: corrected O(1) complexity description from "linear" to "constant" time by @LordPatate (ocaml/ocaml.org#3630)

    • Overview

  • ocaml/opam-repository saw 23 merges covering new packages, compatibility fixes, and infrastructure improvements; active areas included the Miou scheduler ecosystem, OxCaml integration, OCaml 5.5 compatibility, and Windows platform support
  • ocaml/ocaml.org had lower volume with a merged tutorial accuracy fix (ocaml/ocaml.org#3630), five batches of automated OCaml Planet scraping (ocaml/ocaml.org#3628, #3629, #3632, #3634, #3635), and two new community PRs under review
  • Combined contributor count: approximately 27 contributors across both repositories
  • Notable infrastructure milestone: the oxcaml virtual package (ocaml/opam-repository#29809) establishes a pattern for how OxCaml-dependent packages signal requirements in the main opam repository

    • Activity

  • Networking stack packages merged in ocaml/opam-repository: arc 0.0.2 with unverified chain signing support by Calascibetta Romain (ocaml/opam-repository#29826); dmarc 0.0.2 updating public_suffix_list.dat (ocaml/opam-repository#29808); utcp 0.0.3 fixing TCP sequence number arithmetic per RFC 1982 by Hannes Mehnert (ocaml/opam-repository#29829)
  • Messaging and async: nats-client 0.0.10 with async/sync dependency alignment (ocaml/opam-repository#29816); valkey 0.3.1 by Avi Fenesh (ocaml/opam-repository#29837)
  • OCaml 5.5 compatibility fixes: caqti-miou 2.3.1 avoids exhaustiveness check failure by Petter A. Urkedal (ocaml/opam-repository#29814); upper bound added to core.v0.17.1 for Gc.stat record changes by Jan Midtgaard (ocaml/opam-repository#29820); cohttp-async 6.1.0 and 6.2.1 marked compatible with OCaml >= 5.3 (ocaml/opam-repository#29824)
  • Proof assistant and formal methods tooling: anders 5.0.0 and 5.1.0 with OCaml 5.0 support and new type theory primitives by @5HT (ocaml/opam-repository#29821, #29835); lem 2026-05-01 release by Brian Campbell (ocaml/opam-repository#29836); smtml 0.26.0 with bitvector optimizations by filipeom (ocaml/opam-repository#29812)
  • Lwt ecosystem: lwt 6.1.2 packaged by Raphaël Proust (ocaml/opam-repository#29752)
  • Windows platform improvements: conf-mingw-w64-* packages cleaned up and mechanised by David Allsopp (ocaml/opam-repository#29795); conf-perl Cygwin/MSYS2 support under review by Sora Morimoto (ocaml/opam-repository#29613)
  • Newly opened PRs in opam-repository: dune 3.23.0~alpha2 with sandboxed rules by default and opam file manual promotion by Shon Feder (ocaml/opam-repository#29824); rocq-stdlib 9.1.0 draft moving package back to main opam-repository by Matthieu Sozeau (ocaml/opam-repository#29830); BER MetaOCaml avoid-version flag draft by Olivier Nicole (ocaml/opam-repository#29815)
  • New PR on ocaml.org: Sacha Ayoun proposed adding the recurring Caml in the Capital event to community listings and correcting the S-REPLS location (ocaml/ocaml.org#3633)
  • Documentation expansion on ocaml.org: @LordPatate opened a follow-up PR expanding the Hashtbl vs Map tutorial to explain trade-offs between the two data structures (ocaml/ocaml.org#3631)

    • Notable Discussions

  • The oxcaml virtual package design (ocaml/opam-repository#29809) prompted discussion about user-friendly error messages vs available: false; Anil Madhavapeddy and Jan Midtgaard supported the action-required approach with purposeful version string ordering (action-required < archived < latest) as preferable to opaque solver failures
  • The lwd 0.5 release (ocaml/opam-repository#29832) required two review rounds to fix dependency constraint issues: tyxml-lwd needed a tyxml >= 4.6.0 lower bound and lwd needed a qcheck >= 0.14 bound, both fixed upstream before merging
  • The BER MetaOCaml avoid-version draft (ocaml/opam-repository#29815) is investigating preventing OCaml variant compilers from being selected by the solver for unrelated switches; Jan Midtgaard identified a flags vs tags field naming issue
  • dune 3.23.0~alpha2 (ocaml/opam-repository#29824) was preceded by two cancelled alpha releases (alpha0 ocaml/opam-repository#29822 and alpha1 ocaml/opam-repository#29823) due to release process errors by Shon Feder
  • Cuihtlauac Alvarado reviewed the Hashtbl vs Map documentation expansion on ocaml.org (ocaml/ocaml.org#3631), providing guidance on capitalization conventions (standard library module names should be capitalized; generic data structure terms should not) and phrasing improvements

    • Emerging Trends

  • The Miou scheduler ecosystem is expanding with three new packages this week: cattery 0.0.1 (pool), notty-miou 0.0.1 (terminals), nottui-miou 0.0.1 (UI) — all from Calascibetta Romain and the robur-coop community (ocaml/opam-repository#29810, #29833)
  • OCaml 5.5 compatibility is an active concern across opam-repository: caqti-miou (ocaml/opam-repository#29814) and core.v0.17.1 (ocaml/opam-repository#29820) both required bounds or fixes this week due to Gc.stat record changes
  • OxCaml integration into the main opam-repository infrastructure is beginning: the virtual package PR (ocaml/opam-repository#29809) establishes the pattern for OxCaml-dependent packages to signal their requirements without causing opaque solver failures
  • Windows platform support continues to expand: conf-mingw-w64-* packages mechanised (ocaml/opam-repository#29795), conf-perl Cygwin/MSYS2 support under review (ocaml/opam-repository#29613), and hdr_histogram 0.0.5 adding Windows support (ocaml/opam-repository#29817)
  • Dune 3.23.0 alpha preparation (ocaml/opam-repository#29824) signals a significant upcoming release with breaking changes: user rules sandboxed by default, removal of --makefile flag, and mandatory manual promotion of opam files
  • OCaml Planet feed maintenance on ocaml/ocaml.org may be needed: persistent scraping errors across multiple sources (ocamlpro, mirage, 0branch, dinosaure, emilpriver, patricoferris) and 404s from YouTube feeds appear across every scrape PR this week (ocaml/ocaml.org#3628, #3629, #3632, #3634, #3635)
  • Community tutorial contributions on ocaml.org are increasing: @LordPatate submitted two PRs in one week targeting Hash Tables documentation — a factual fix (ocaml/ocaml.org#3630) followed by a broader conceptual improvement (ocaml/ocaml.org#3631)

    • OCaml Tools

    Three releases landed (dune 3.23.0 alpha, odoc 3.2.0, Merlin 5.7.1) alongside OxCaml compat and OCaml 5.5 Wasm work.

    New Features

  • ocaml/dune: New %{pkg:foo:lib:file} pforms for querying package install layouts landed in ocaml/dune#14200 by Ali Caglayan, closing ocaml/dune#14193 and ocaml/dune#3378; a draft ocaml/dune#14373 extends this to full package sets.
  • ocaml/dune: ppx_optcomp conditional support in the bootstrap build added by Rudi Grinberg in ocaml/dune#14404, with follow-on PPX lexer clean-ups (ocaml/dune#14406, ocaml/dune#14408).
  • ocaml/dune: %test_module blocks are now stripped during bootstrap to prevent spurious build failures (ocaml/dune#14355 by Ali Caglayan).
  • ocaml/dune: Source-files-changed event added to dune's watch-mode RPC stream by Rudi Grinberg (ocaml/dune#14396), enabling clients to react to file-system changes without polling.
  • ocaml/dune: Trace output now includes self rusage snapshots (CPU, memory, I/O counters) at build start/end via ocaml/dune#14402 by Rudi Grinberg.
  • ocaml/dune: Compilation_context.t is now built per Compilation_mode.t — the large architectural refactor landed in ocaml/dune#13346 by Antonio Nuno Monteiro, followed by ocaml/dune#14410 and ocaml/dune#14411.
  • ocaml/dune: dune-rpc connection error handling hardened: write-side disconnects treated consistently (ocaml/dune#14384), pending requests terminated on disconnect (ocaml/dune#14368), write errors now raise Connection_dead (ocaml/dune#14361).
  • ocaml/merlin: Fixed typer cache invalidation bug where new .cmi files appearing in the build path did not trigger invalidation, causing stale type information (ocaml/merlin#2062); released as Merlin v5.7.1-504.
  • ocaml/merlin: Refactored the Misc module to ocaml_utils to reduce the diff against the upstream compiler (ocaml/merlin#2059).
  • ocaml/odoc: odoc 3.2.0 released (ocaml/odoc#1425) by Jon Ludlam, including persistent LaTeX macros, multi-file markdown-generate, OxCaml support, OCaml 5.5 support, and bug fixes.
  • ocaml/odoc: OxCaml compiler-libs compatibility merged by @art-w, handling new AST nodes gracefully (ocaml/odoc#1423).
  • ocaml/odoc: @@zero_alloc annotation support for OxCaml signatures in progress by Marek Kubica (ocaml/odoc#1422).
  • ocaml/odoc: Fixed Not_found crash for OCaml 5.5's Arrow_functor type expressions (ocaml/odoc#1427, closes ocaml/odoc#1426).
  • ocaml/opam: New OpamFilename.Unix module added for path manipulation that always uses / as separator regardless of OS (ocaml/opam#6914).
  • ocaml/opam: Fixed OpamFile dummy file comparison to detect dummy filenames with directory prefixes (ocaml/opam#6913).
  • ocsigen/jsofocaml: Wasm toplevel now embeds CMIs in .wasmo zip output, completing OCaml 5.5 Wasm separate-compilation support (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2220).
  • ocsigen/jsofocaml: Fixed compiler peephole rewrite for string concatenation — + removed from commutative operators, fixing reversed operands bug that caused Filename.temp_file to return malformed paths (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2228).
  • ocsigen/jsofocaml: Fixed caml_oo_cache_id missing return statement in JS runtime (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2224) and Int64.of_string out-of-bounds trap in Wasm runtime (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2223).

    • Overview

  • Three releases across the group: dune 3.23.0 alpha0/1/2 (ocaml/dune#14211), odoc 3.2.0 (ocaml/odoc#1425), and Merlin v5.7.1-504 (ocaml/merlin#2062).
  • OxCaml compatibility was a cross-cutting theme: odoc merged AST compatibility (ocaml/odoc#1423) and jsofocaml fixed its OxCaml CI workflow (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2219) and opened an OxCaml 5.2.0minus31 update draft (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2225).
  • OCaml 5.5 support landed in multiple repositories: jsofocaml completed Wasm support (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2220), odoc shipped it in 3.2.0 and fixed an Arrow_functor crash (ocaml/odoc#1427), and dune received a trunk build fix (ocaml/dune#14319).
  • ocaml/dune was the most active repository with 30+ PRs merged or opened, driven primarily by Rudi Grinberg, Ali Caglayan, Antonio Nuno Monteiro, and Robin Bate Boerop.
  • ocaml/opam saw seven new PRs opened covering patch handling, path API modules, performance benchmarking, and documentation improvements, with two first-time contributors.
  • ocaml/opam-file-format and ocaml-dune/spawn had no recorded activity this week.

    • Activity

  • ocaml/dune: Three 3.23.0 alpha pre-releases published to opam-repository by Shon Feder, tracked in ocaml/dune#14211; release PR ocaml/dune#14212 remains open.
  • ocaml/dune: RPC subsystem refactoring merged across multiple PRs: server registry moved into its own module (ocaml/dune#14367), Dune_engine.Rpc moved to Rpc.Global (ocaml/dune#14362), read/write paths simplified (ocaml/dune#14366) — all by Rudi Grinberg.
  • ocaml/dune: Extensive observational test baselines added by Robin Bate Boerop across 14+ PRs (ocaml/dune#14308, ocaml/dune#14309, ocaml/dune#14310, ocaml/dune#14374, ocaml/dune#14375, and others) in preparation for the per-module -I flag filtering work (ocaml/dune#14186).
  • ocaml/dune: Newly opened feature drafts: allocation profiling (ocaml/dune#14401), action runners revival (ocaml/dune#14240), include_qualified directory renaming (ocaml/dune#13691), and relocatable compiler integration (ocaml/dune#14357).
  • ocaml/dune: ocamldep refactoring by Rudi Grinberg eliminated named targets (ocaml/dune#14385) and simplified sandbox handling (ocaml/dune#14386).
  • ocaml/opam: Patch system overhaul PR ocaml/opam#6915 by R. Boujbel (1777 additions) to allow dir -> file type changes when applying patches.
  • ocaml/opam: Path element name modules PR ocaml/opam#6917 by R. Boujbel (2072 additions across 41 files) adds explicit modules for well-known opam path component names.
  • ocaml/opam: opam install benchmark infrastructure added in ocaml/opam#6912 by Kate to enable data-driven performance decisions.
  • ocaml/opam: Two first-time contributors opened documentation PRs: Guilherme FACCINI BANDEIRA on manpage highlighting (ocaml/opam#6921) and Corentin Coulombel on depopts filter documentation (ocaml/opam#6920).
  • ocsigen/jsofocaml: QuickJS-NG support proposed by @hhugo in ocsigen/jsofocaml#2229: adds a quickjs dune profile, quickjs_shim.js compatibility shim, host-portability bug fixes, and a make tests-quickjs CI target.
  • ocsigen/jsofocaml: Initial OCaml 5.6 support draft opened by Jérôme Vouillon in ocsigen/jsofocaml#2227; OCaml 5.5 support tracking issue ocsigen/jsofocaml#2193 closed.
  • ocsigen/jsofocaml: Large DOM API type corrections opened by Jérôme Vouillon in ocsigen/jsofocaml#2221 (3215 additions), fixing inputElement.defaultChecked, createVideo return type, and selection.collapse signature.
  • ocaml/merlin: Dependabot opened ocaml/merlin#2061 to bump cachix/install-nix-action (includes a Nix sandbox privilege escalation security fix).
  • ocaml/ocamlfind: @shym opened CI workflow update PR ocaml/ocamlfind#116 and rebased the threads exception fix ocaml/ocamlfind#99 for systhreads-disabled builds.
  • ocaml/ocaml-lsp: Automated flake.lock update (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1437) refreshed merlin5_3 and nixpkgs dependencies.

    • Notable Discussions

  • DUNE_PKG environment variable proposal (ocaml/dune#14318 by @desumn) was discussed at the dune dev-meeting and closed; consensus was insufficient user demand to add an environment variable for overriding the dune package variable.
  • ocamlgrep integration into Merlin proposed by Martin Jambon in ocaml/merlin#2063: the tool enables project-wide type-aware pattern search (e.g. (__ : int list) to find all expressions of type int list). Nicolás Ojeda Bär confirmed full LexiFi support for the proposal; Xavier Van de Woestyne asked whether Sherlodoc already covers similar ground.
  • Merlin typer cache root cause traced: during review of ocaml/merlin#2062, Ulysse connected the cache bug to a two-year-old prediction by Gabriel Scherer in ocaml/ocaml#12246.
  • --assume-built with ocaml-variants failure: Olivier Nicole reported in ocaml/opam#6911 that the new make INSTALL_MODE=opam install instruction creates ocaml-compiler-fixup.sh instead of ocaml-variants-fixup.sh; Kate identified both upstream OCaml compiler docs and ocaml-variants.opam need updating.
  • Neutral JS target environment requested by Stéphane Glondu in ocsigen/jsofocaml#2226 for runtimes like QuickJS, noting that --target-env=browser is counter-intuitive for QuickJS targets; this connects to @hhugo's QuickJS-NG PR (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2229).
  • CPS tail-call recursion depth issue identified by Stéphane Glondu in ocsigen/jsofocaml#2215: "Uncaught InternalError: too much recursion" after Babel transpilation of CPS-style functions, highlighting difficulties debugging transpiled OCaml on constrained JS engines.

    • Emerging Trends

  • OxCaml compatibility as a sustained group-wide effort: three repositories (ocaml/dune, ocaml/odoc, ocsigen/jsofocaml) simultaneously addressing OxCaml compiler-libs changes, suggesting coordinated upstream tracking rather than ad-hoc fixes.
  • Per-compilation-mode context separation in dune: the architectural direction of ocaml/dune#13346 (landed this week) separating native/Melange/other modes into distinct Compilation_context.t instances, with follow-ons ocaml/dune#14411 and ocaml/dune#14410 extending it; unlocks per-mode object directories and cleaner mode-specific rules.
  • RPC subsystem hardening in dune: multiple disconnect and error handling fixes (ocaml/dune#14361, ocaml/dune#14368, ocaml/dune#14384) combined with structural refactors (ocaml/dune#14362, ocaml/dune#14366, ocaml/dune#14367) suggest the RPC layer is being prepared for the planned action runners (ocaml/dune#14240).
  • Broader JS runtime support in jsofocaml: QuickJS-NG PR (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2229), the --target-env=neutral request (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2226), and browser compatibility documentation (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2216) all push toward running jsofocaml output on engines beyond Node.js.
  • Reducing compiler diffs in Merlin: moving modules like Misc into compiler-synced locations (ocaml/merlin#2059) continues as a sustained effort to lower maintenance burden for OCaml version upgrades.
  • Performance measurement infrastructure in opam: ocaml/opam#6912 benchmark infrastructure enables data-driven decisions, paired with active API surface cleanup (ocaml/opam#6910, ocaml/opam#6680) and Windows path correctness improvements (ocaml/opam#6914, ocaml/opam#6917).
  • Test baseline practice in dune: Robin Bate Boerop's 14+ observational test PRs (ocaml/dune#14308 through ocaml/dune#14391) locking in current behavior before planned per-module dependency changes indicate larger module-level dependency changes are forthcoming.

    • OxCaml

    20 commits landed in oxcaml/oxcaml spanning kind/layout, DWARF, and flambda2; merlin and opam-repository also saw updates.

    New Features

  • oxcaml/oxcaml#5921 by Ryan Tjoa: scannable axes now take the meet instead of overriding; new kind abbreviations value_maybe_null, value_maybe_separable, immutable_data_or_null, mutable_data_or_null, and sync_data_or_null added
  • oxcaml/oxcaml#5796 by Ryan Tjoa: float64-only records are now represented as mixed blocks instead of float array blocks, with a legacy [@@represent_as_float_array] attribute for compatibility
  • oxcaml/oxcaml#5976 by Kevin Svetlitski: flipped DW_AT_name and DW_AT_linkage_name to comply with the DWARF5 spec
  • oxcaml/oxcaml#5963 by Mark Shinwell: added a -name-mangling-scheme ocamlopt flag to override the per-compilation-unit name mangling convention
  • oxcaml/oxcaml#5931 by Zesen Qian: removed legacy unique_ and once_ mode prefix syntax; all tests updated to use the modern @ mode syntax
  • oxcaml/oxcaml#5866 by Zesen Qian: layout-polymorphic values now print as in the toplevel, with appropriate checks in the debugger and toplevel printers
  • oxcaml/oxcaml#5827 by Richard Eisenberg: removed the arg_is_non_zero flag from Cclz/Cctz intrinsics, simplifying CMM and operation types
  • oxcaml/oxcaml#5929: efficiency improvements to .cmx export
  • oxcaml/merlin#237 by Liam Stevenson: CMI cache now records hidden_were_allowed in Missing entries, fixing stale negative cache results when allow_hidden settings change (backport of ocaml/merlin#2062)
  • oxcaml/merlin#233 by Liam Stevenson: typeopt.ml/typeopt.mli diff against upstream compiler reduced — irrelevant sections commented out, error handling improved to raise proper errors instead of Misc.fatal_error

    • Overview

  • oxcaml/oxcaml was the most active repository with 20 commits spanning the kind/layout system, flambda2 inlining, backend fixes, DWARF debugging, and ongoing 5.4 upstream merge work
  • oxcaml/opam-repository had 3 new PRs opened for compiler-compatible package additions (opam-core patch, opam-format, dune) and 4 older issues closed
  • oxcaml/merlin merged 2 PRs — a CMI cache correctness fix (#237) and a compiler diff reduction (#233) — plus a Nix flake update (#236)
  • oxcaml/jsofocaml and janestreet/opam-repository had no recorded activity this week
  • Over 15 contributors were active across the group, with David Allsopp contributing across three repositories

    • Activity

  • oxcaml/oxcaml#5954 by Guillaume Bury: fixed incorrect replay of inlining decisions during continuation specialization (match-in-match correctness bug)
  • oxcaml/oxcaml#5917 by Nathanaëlle Courant: speculative inlining now accounts for the size of lifted constants, correcting previously incorrect size estimates
  • oxcaml/oxcaml#5844 by Xavier Clerc: register allocator affinity extended to use phi-move information, reducing move counts by ~0.5–2.2% depending on allocator
  • oxcaml/oxcaml#5978 by Mark Shinwell: fixed arm64 binary emitter ordering bug that caused JIT code to re-enter compilerlibs and trigger zero-alloc exceptions
  • oxcaml/oxcaml#5910 by Mark Shinwell: added profiling instrumentation for .cmx loading in Flambda 2
  • oxcaml/oxcaml#5940 by James Rayman: added codegen tests for recently merged shift intrinsics
  • oxcaml/oxcaml#5821: replaced Not_found with Envaux.Module_not_found for cleaner error handling
  • oxcaml/oxcaml#5941: made large_functor_size effectively ignored by default
  • Several 5.4 merge fixup PRs landed including oxcaml/oxcaml#5953 by David Allsopp, covering test reference promotions, DWARF/llvmize reference updates, Dynlink mis-merge fix, Nix workflow update, and testsuite corrections
  • oxcaml/opam-repository#40 by David Allsopp: added oxcaml.action-required package (with available: false) mirroring ocaml/opam-repository#29809
  • oxcaml/opam-repository#41 by Jérôme Vouillon: updated opam-core OxCaml patch for oxcaml-compiler 5.2.0minus31 compatibility, removing the upper-bound conflict
  • oxcaml/opam-repository#42 by @art-w: added opam-format 2.5.1+ox, needed transitively for odoc; depends on #41 merging first
  • oxcaml/opam-repository#15 and oxcaml/opam-repository#28 closed by David Allsopp with root-cause explanations
  • oxcaml/merlin#236 by Gavin Gray: Nix flake build toolchain bumped from OCaml 5.2 to 5.4, NixPkgs pinned to 2026-02-14 to avoid a menhirGLR packaging conflict

    • Notable Discussions

  • oxcaml/oxcaml#5960 opened by Mark Shinwell: large draft PR proposing GC-driven unloading of metaprogramming compilation units using Code_block heap objects, back-pointers in .text, and frame descriptor flags; Nick Barnes noted the resemblance to tree-shaking
  • oxcaml/oxcaml#5966 opened by Zesen Qian: proposes that modalities on module declarations apply to the module directly rather than being pushed inward onto individual items
  • oxcaml/oxcaml#5880: effect-syntax compilation fix for maybe_region_layout discussed at length; Zesen Qian and @dkalinichenko-js agreed to merge and track remaining type-soundness concerns in a dedicated follow-up oxcaml/oxcaml#6001
  • oxcaml/oxcaml#5962 by @ainageorges: replacing Map with Hashtbl in the mode solver after a soundness issue with compare_morph was identified; Zesen Qian and @julesjacobs raised questions about mutation safety and iteration-order stability
  • oxcaml/oxcaml#5832 by Tim McGilchrist: arm64 frame pointer port; Mark Shinwell provided a detailed review identifying a signal-safety regression in the prologue and nine other concerns
  • oxcaml/opam-repository#35 by Nirnay Roy: asked how to publish an opam package depending on oxcaml; David Allsopp confirmed this is now supported via the "oxcaml" depends field (since commit 231c88c), with policy for releasing such packages to the main opam-repository still to be determined

    • Emerging Trends

  • The 5.4 upstream merge remains the highest-activity workstream in oxcaml/oxcaml, with David Allsopp and collaborators landing a stream of fixup PRs (e.g. #5953); the oxcaml/merlin#236 Nix flake bump to OCaml 5.4 tracks the same progression
  • Metaprogramming and JIT infrastructure is expanding: binary emitter correctness (oxcaml/oxcaml#5978), GC-driven unloading design (oxcaml/oxcaml#5960), and quotation constructor fixes (oxcaml/oxcaml#5983, oxcaml/oxcaml#5982) are active in parallel
  • Kind and layout system refinement continues with coordinated changes: scannable axes semantics (oxcaml/oxcaml#5921), float64 record unboxing (oxcaml/oxcaml#5796), and new or_null abbreviations — a coherent push toward consistent unboxed-type semantics
  • DWARF debugging quality is receiving sustained attention: DWARF5 name attribute compliance (oxcaml/oxcaml#5976), name-mangling flag (oxcaml/oxcaml#5963), and an in-progress PR for inlined function parameter attribution (oxcaml/oxcaml#5961)
  • Preemptible fibers (oxcaml/oxcaml#5913) are receiving active review as the follow-on to the initial preemption implementation
  • Upstream diff minimisation in oxcaml/merlin is a recurring theme: #233 reduces the typeopt.ml delta and #237 backports an upstream fix, reflecting a preference for cherry-picking over local reinvention
  • OxCaml ecosystem package coverage is growing incrementally, with PRs for dune (oxcaml/opam-repository#39), opam-core (oxcaml/opam-repository#41), and opam-format (oxcaml/opam-repository#42) all active, alongside growing community interest in third-party package publishing (oxcaml/opam-repository#35)

    • OCaml Core

    Seq constant-space improvements merged, OCamlFDO compatibility restored, and the modular IO RFC revived via a new ocaml/ocaml PR.

    New Features

  • Haz reduced closure allocation in Seq.(cycle, repeat, forever) by reusing tail closures in ocaml/ocaml#14781, merged by Florian Angeletti.
  • Stefan Muenzel improved Value_rec_check in ocaml/ocaml#14777 by switching to Ident.Map and using Map.union for join, merged by Gabriel Scherer.
  • Nick Barnes restored hard-wired caml_hot__code_begin/caml_hot__code_end symbol names required by OCamlFDO and moved hot-code segment registration into startup_nat.c in ocaml/ocaml#14778, merged by Gabriel Scherer.

    • Overview

  • ocaml/ocaml merged six or more PRs this week spanning Stdlib Seq performance, man page improvements, OCamlFDO compatibility, typechecker debuggability, and CI security hardening.
  • ocaml/RFCs saw a single event: Simon Cruanes withdrew his 2022 proposal ocaml/RFCs#30 to remove the modular IO RFC, citing lack of intent to implement it himself.
  • The modular IO topic connects both repositories: the RFC withdrawal in ocaml/RFCs coincides with Simon Cruanes opening ocaml/ocaml#14775 proposing extensible IO channels implementing that same RFC in the compiler repo.
  • Ten contributors were active across the group, with merged work from Florian Angeletti, Nick Barnes, Stefan Muenzel, Haz, @shym, Austin Theriault, and Jeremy Yallop.

    • Activity

  • @shym overhauled the ocamlc man page in ocaml/ocaml#14782 with improved formatting, synopsis reformatting, sub-list rendering, and -o option clarifications, plus minor fixes to the ocamlopt man page; merged 2026-05-03.
  • Florian Angeletti added a breakpoint capability on tfunctor nodes in the typechecker debugger in ocaml/ocaml#14771 and improved unscoped-identifier printing in ocaml/ocaml#14772; both merged 2026-04-27.
  • Florian Angeletti documented a newly found typechecker loop triggered by conjunctive types after Keep_expansion in ocaml/ocaml#14769; merged 2026-04-29.
  • Austin Theriault fixed shell injection vulnerabilities in GitHub Actions workflows in ocaml/ocaml#14676; merged 2026-05-04.
  • Jeremy Yallop opened ocaml/ocaml#14783 making Seq.repeat constant-space via a single cyclic closure-and-cons-cell pair (merged post-week) and ocaml/ocaml#14784 proposing a fully cyclic Seq.cycle reducing per-element memory from 41 words to 1 word; the latter remains open under discussion.
  • Stefan Muenzel opened ocaml/ocaml#14779 proposing a fix for the typechecker loop in ocaml/ocaml#14769 by detecting cycles in update_level; open and under review.
  • Florian Angeletti opened ocaml/ocaml#14776 fixing a missing wrap_trace_gadts_instance call in moregen when checking first-class module inclusion; open and under review.
  • Antonin Décimo opened ocaml/ocaml#14786 to update GitHub Actions dependencies and avoid outdated Node version warnings; open and awaiting review.
  • Simon Cruanes closed ocaml/RFCs#30 (open since 2022-02-03) without merging, noting he no longer plans to implement the proposal and inviting others to re-open or write an updated version.

    • Notable Discussions

  • ocaml/ocaml#14784 and ocaml/ocaml#14785 sparked a debate between Jeremy Yallop and Haz on whether Seq.cycle should produce a truly cyclic (sharing) structure or a constant-space infinite one; ocaml/ocaml#14785 was closed as superseded by ocaml/ocaml#14784.
  • ocaml/ocaml#14780 opened by Vincent Balat reports that module type of M when M is accessed through an alias unexpectedly strengthens functor parameter signatures, blocking application to sibling modules; attracted discussion on the intended semantics of module alias strengthening.
  • ocaml/ocaml#14779 discusses the root cause of the typechecker loop in ocaml/ocaml#14769: update_level encountering the expanded type of its own argument, and the correct approach to detect and break that cycle.

    • Emerging Trends

  • Seq constant-space work is converging across multiple PRs: ocaml/ocaml#14781 landed, ocaml/ocaml#14783 merged post-week, and ocaml/ocaml#14784 proposes a fully cyclic Seq.cycle, showing sustained effort from Jeremy Yallop and Haz to minimise allocation in lazy sequences.
  • Typechecker debuggability additions by Florian Angeletti (ocaml/ocaml#14771, ocaml/ocaml#14772) continue a pattern of building internal tooling to support OCaml 5.5 typechecker development.
  • Native-code tooling compatibility work in ocaml/ocaml#14778 reflects continued effort to keep the runtime compatible with profile-guided optimisation workflows such as OCamlFDO.
  • Modular IO is regaining attention: the RFC withdrawal in ocaml/RFCs#30 and the new implementation proposal ocaml/ocaml#14775 together suggest the design may advance at the implementation level rather than through further RFC revision.

    • Multicore

    Minimal activity across the multicore group; ocaml-uring closed a stale draft PR addressing Linux 5.x kernel header compatibility.

    Overview

  • Activity this week was limited to a single repository: ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring.
  • The remaining 8 repositories (eio, domainslib, meio, saturn, eio-trace, picos, kcas, ocaml-iomux) recorded no activity during this period.

    • Activity

  • ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#110: a draft PR from Chris Armstrong to import fcntl.h from linux/fcntl.h for access to io_uring constants only available on Linux 5.x kernels was closed without merging; it had accumulated merge conflicts and remained in draft state since October 2023.
entry.summary: odoc 3.2.0, merlin 5.7.1-504, and dune 3.23.0 alpha released; OxCaml kind system refined; oxcaml virtual package established in opam-repository.

entry.title: Week 17, 2026: Dune 3.23 ships and targets 3.24; OxCaml mixed-block overhaul and 5.4 merge advance; OCaml 5.5.0 beta1 lands in opam-repository.
entry.content:
Weekly Summary

New Features

  • OCaml Tools Native OCaml patch action vendors hannesm/patch to replace external patch/gpatch binary dependency, fixing portability issues ocaml/dune#14177 (ocaml/dune#12232, ocaml/dune#7699)
  • OCaml Tools Async_io ported to Lev rewrites dune's async I/O layer to use the bundled libev-based event loop, with the alarm-clock thread also migrated (ocaml/dune#14243, ocaml/dune#14329)
  • OCaml Tools Trace file backups — trace.csexp is now backed up as trace.csexp.old before each build (ocaml/dune#14269)
  • OCaml Tools dune tools reference documentation added covering all subcommands (exec, install, which, env) (ocaml/dune#14198)
  • OCaml Tools Dune version bumped to 3.24 as main branch targets the upcoming release after 3.23 preparations (ocaml/dune#14333)
  • OCaml Tools Index pointer system for ocaml-index — merged indexes now store pointers to constituent index files rather than embedding data inline, reducing file sizes; adds Outdated_store exception and is_on_disk predicate to the Granular_marshal API (ocaml/merlin#2051)
  • OCaml Tools MenhirLib snapshot refreshed in Merlin, resolving copy-rule failures with recent menhir versions (ocaml/merlin#2058)
  • OCaml Tools GitHub Actions CI for ocamlfind covering Linux, macOS, and Windows with OCaml 4.14, 5.4, and 3.08 (ocaml/ocamlfind#113)
  • OxCaml All-value/void mixed records and variants now compile to uniform blocks, enabling polymorphic comparison and marshalling and removing the 254-field limit; mixed block version bumped to v6 (oxcaml/oxcaml#5774 by Ryan Tjoa)
  • OxCaml [@@flatten_floats] attribute now required to preserve flattened representation for records mixing float and float64 fields (oxcaml/oxcaml#5795 by Ryan Tjoa)
  • OxCaml caml_modify skipped for non_pointer fields in mixed blocks, avoiding unnecessary write-barrier overhead (oxcaml/oxcaml#5831 by Ryan Tjoa)
  • OxCaml Improved codegen for integer comparisons — bit-result comparisons use xor before comparison and three-way comparisons use select (x >= y) (x > y) -1, reducing chain latency and instruction count (oxcaml/oxcaml#5738 by @ttebbi-janestreet)
  • OxCaml Flambda2 switch-table optimization extended to naked numbers and symbols, covering patterns like variants returning float32 or int32 constants (oxcaml/oxcaml#3242 by Mark Shinwell)
  • OxCaml Random.State functions annotated as accepting the state @ local, allowing stack-allocated random states without heap allocation (oxcaml/oxcaml#5908 by Vesa Karvonen)
  • OxCaml Dummy_use operation removed from the register allocator backend, simplifying the backend after the operation was found to be ineffective (oxcaml/oxcaml#5614 by @ttebbi-janestreet)
  • OxCaml Diamond-aware mode hints improve error messages when a mode Meet or Join involves parallel lattice elements (oxcaml/oxcaml#5858 by @ainageorges)
  • OxCaml Syntax coloring added to the fexpr printer for Flambda2 IR dumps, making debug output easier to read in terminals (oxcaml/oxcaml#5925 by Basile Clément)
  • OxCaml Syntax documentation for all scannable axis annotations in Merlin expanded to cover non_pointer, non_pointer64, non_float, separable, maybe_separable, non_null, and maybe_null with hover text and documentation links (oxcaml/merlin#235 by Liam Stevenson)
  • OxCaml -Ix flag support in Merlin so both -I and -Ix compiler load path flags are correctly parsed, with a new test suite verifying behavior (oxcaml/merlin#234 by Liam Stevenson)
  • OxCaml oxcaml-patch-guards mechanism pushed to oxcaml/opam-repository main, allowing multiple versions of upstream patched packages to coexist in an OxCaml switch (oxcaml/opam-repository#27)
  • OCaml Core Ephemeron list API added to C runtime — caml_ephe_list_tail, caml_ephe_list_cons, caml_ephe_list_append, caml_ephe_list_pop and variants refactor major_gc.c to use higher-level abstractions (ocaml/ocaml#14735 by Gabriel Scherer)
  • OCaml Core reserved_header_bits exposed to ocamltest — adds val reserved_header_bits : int to ocamltest_config.mli, allowing tests to query reserved block header bits (ocaml/ocaml#14744 by Olivier Nicole)
  • OCaml Core -Wformat-signedness C compiler warning enabled when available, fixing discrepancies between %x-family format specifiers and signed/unsigned argument types (ocaml/ocaml#14694 by Antonin Décimo)
  • OCaml Ecosystem OCaml 5.5.0 beta1 added to opam-repository via ocaml/opam-repository#29750 by Kate, with coordinated compatibility fixes for mdx, ppx_import, earlybird, goblint, and more
  • OCaml Ecosystem valkey.0.2.0 — Eio-native OCaml 5 client for the Valkey key-value store with RESP3, TLS, cluster routing, and auto-reconnect (ocaml/opam-repository#29783 by Avi Fenesh)
  • OCaml Ecosystem idna.0.4.0 — Pure-OCaml IDNA2008 hostname validation with Punycode and Unicode NFC normalization, no C dependencies (ocaml/opam-repository#29801 by Yuriy Krasilnikov)
  • OCaml Ecosystem atd.4.2.0 (13 packages) adds Java list aliases, OCaml YAML output, and jsonlike serializers (ocaml/opam-repository#29802 by Martin Jambon)
  • OCaml Ecosystem bos.0.3.0 with XDG directory support, realpath, and a deadlock fix (ocaml/opam-repository#29791 by Daniel Bünzli)
  • OCaml Ecosystem cmdliner.2.1.1 with bash-completion and Windows path fixes (ocaml/opam-repository#29788 by Daniel Bünzli)
  • OCaml Ecosystem dns.10.2.5 (13 packages) with constant-time TSIG MAC verification security fix (ocaml/opam-repository#29779 by Hannes Mehnert)
  • OCaml Ecosystem ocaml-ai-sdk.0.3 adds Anthropic native structured outputs, HTTP timeouts, and new Claude model catalog (ocaml/opam-repository#29761)
  • OCaml Ecosystem conf-mingw-w64 spring-clean (~70 packages) hardening pkgconf calls and adding consistent metadata as preparatory work for MSYS2 UCRT64 support (ocaml/opam-repository#29795 by David Allsopp)
  • OCaml Ecosystem wire.0.9.0 — binary wire format DSL with EverParse 3D output (ocaml/opam-repository#29786), alcobar.0.3.1 — Alcotest-compatible fuzzing library (ocaml/opam-repository#29784), both by Thomas Gazagnaire
  • OCaml Ecosystem ocgtk preview1 — GTK4 bindings for OCaml announced via Planet post (ocaml/ocaml.org#3624)
  • OCaml Ecosystem "Tailwind Without Node" blog post by Thomas Gazagnaire describing pure-OCaml Tailwind CSS v4 with browser-side compilation via jsofocaml (ocaml/ocaml.org#3625)

    • Group Activity Summaries

    OCaml Ecosystem

    30+ opam packages merged including OCaml 5.5.0 beta1 and new AI/LLM tooling; ocaml.org published seven Planet posts on Tailwind CSS and GTK4.

    New Features

  • ocaml/opam-repository#29783 valkey.0.2.0 — Eio-native OCaml 5 client for the Valkey key-value store with RESP3, TLS, cluster routing, and auto-reconnect, submitted by Avi Fenesh.
  • ocaml/opam-repository#29801 idna.0.4.0 — Pure-OCaml IDNA2008 hostname validation, UTS#46, Punycode and Unicode NFC normalization with no C dependencies, submitted by Yuriy Krasilnikov.
  • ocaml/opam-repository#29786 wire.0.9.0 — Initial release of a binary wire format DSL with EverParse 3D output, by Thomas Gazagnaire.
  • ocaml/opam-repository#29789 slugline.1.0.0 — First release of a small portable OCaml slugifier, by Xavier Van de Woestyne.
  • ocaml/opam-repository#29745 openrouterapi.0.0.1 — OCaml Async-based client for the OpenRouter unified LLM API, by mtcaret.
  • ocaml/opam-repository#29782 rescriptdep.0.1.2 — Dependency analyzer for ReScript modules using cmi files, submitted by woonki.
  • ocaml/opam-repository#29784 alcobar.0.3.1 — Fork of Crowbar renamed Alcobar, a fuzzing library with Alcotest-compatible API, by Thomas Gazagnaire.
  • ocaml/opam-repository#29781 ppx_mikmatch.1.4 — PPX for matching regular expressions with OCaml patterns via ocaml-re, by Leonardo Santos.
  • ocaml/opam-repository#29806 nats-client.0.0.9 (2 packages) — Lean OCaml NATS protocol client with async support, open for review, by Heb.
  • ocaml/ocaml.org#3624 ocgtk preview1 — GTK4 bindings for OCaml now available on opam, announced via Planet post by Chris Armstrong.
  • ocaml/ocaml.org#3625 "Tailwind Without Node" — Blog post by Thomas Gazagnaire describing a pure-OCaml Tailwind CSS v4 implementation that eliminates the Node.js dependency, with browser-side compilation via jsofocaml.
  • ocaml/ocaml.org#3626 "Library Operating Systems for the Desktop" — Blog post covering the 2025 ICFP paper on OCaml unikernels running Docker Desktop's networking stack, named Publication of the Year by the Cambridge Ring.

    • Overview

  • ocaml/opam-repository processed 30+ pull requests this week, including OCaml 5.5.0 beta1, multiple new package releases, a 13-package ATD major version (ocaml/opam-repository#29802), and a large Windows conf-mingw-w64 infrastructure cleanup (~70 packages, ocaml/opam-repository#29795).
  • ocaml/ocaml.org had lighter code activity, with three automated OCaml Planet scraping PRs merged (ocaml/ocaml.org#3624, ocaml/ocaml.org#3625, ocaml/ocaml.org#3626) adding seven new community blog posts, and one platform releases PR pending (ocaml/ocaml.org#3621).
  • 27 contributors were active across the group, with the majority of activity concentrated in opam-repository.
  • Security received attention via a constant-time TSIG MAC verification fix in dns.10.2.5 (ocaml/opam-repository#29779) and a Windows depext variable-expansion bug fix (ocaml/opam-repository#29751).
  • AI/LLM tooling continued to expand with ocaml-ai-sdk.0.3 (ocaml/opam-repository#29761) and openrouter_api.0.0.1 (ocaml/opam-repository#29745) both merging this week.

    • Activity

  • OCaml 5.5.0 beta1 added to opam-repository via ocaml/opam-repository#29750; Kate submitted coordinated compatibility fixes across mdx, ppx_import, grenier, earlybird, goblint, charset, camldiets, bitmasks, and abella (see #29757, #29759, #29762, #29771, #29772, #29770).
  • atd.4.2.0 (13 packages) merged via ocaml/opam-repository#29802, adding Java list aliases, OCaml YAML output, and jsonlike serializers, by Martin Jambon.

    Dune targets 3.24 with Lev scheduler overhaul and native OCaml patch; OxCaml, Windows portability, and indexer scalability are cross-cutting themes.

  • Native OCaml patch action (ocaml/dune#14177): vendors hannesm/patch to replace the external patch/gpatch binary dependency, fixing portability issues ocaml/dune#12232 and ocaml/dune#7699
  • Async_io ported to Lev (ocaml/dune#14243): rewrites the async I/O layer to use the bundled libev-based Lev event loop, with the alarm-clock thread also migrated (ocaml/dune#14329)
  • Trace file backups (ocaml/dune#14269): trace.csexp is now backed up as trace.csexp.old before each build
  • dune tools reference documentation (ocaml/dune#14198): new reference page documents all dune tools subcommands (exec, install, which, env)
  • Dune version bumped to 3.24 (ocaml/dune#14333): main branch targets the upcoming 3.24 release after 3.23 preparations
  • Index pointer system for ocaml-index (ocaml/merlin#2051): merged indexes now store pointers to constituent index files rather than embedding data inline, reducing file sizes; adds Outdated_store exception and is_on_disk predicate to the Granular_marshal API
  • MenhirLib snapshot refreshed (ocaml/merlin#2058): vendored parser updated using the upstream --dump-menhirLib flag, resolving copy-rule failures with recent menhir versions
  • GitHub Actions CI for ocamlfind (ocaml/ocamlfind#113): covers Linux, macOS, and Windows with OCaml 4.14, 5.4, and 3.08, including make-based builds, opam pin installs, and a topfind smoke test
  • Copilot AI agent integration for dune (ocaml/dune#14321): adds .github/copilot-instructions.md and a copilot-setup-steps.yml workflow to configure GitHub Copilot with the Nix dev shell environment

    • OxCaml

    oxcaml/oxcaml saw a mixed-block overhaul, Flambda2 and backend improvements, and 5.4 merge progress; opam and merlin had smaller but steady updates.

    New Features

  • All-value/void mixed records and variants now compile to uniform blocks, enabling polymorphic comparison and marshalling and removing the 254-field limit; mixed block version bumped to v6 (oxcaml/oxcaml#5774 by Ryan Tjoa)
  • [@@flatten_floats] attribute now required to preserve flattened representation for records mixing float and float64 fields; without it the compiler no longer flattens (oxcaml/oxcaml#5795 by Ryan Tjoa)
  • caml_modify skipped for non_pointer fields in mixed blocks, avoiding unnecessary write-barrier overhead (oxcaml/oxcaml#5831 by Ryan Tjoa)
  • Improved codegen for integer comparisons: bit-result comparisons use xor before comparison instead of zero-extending after, and three-way comparisons use select (x >= y) (x > y) -1, reducing chain latency and instruction count (oxcaml/oxcaml#5738 by @ttebbi-janestreet)
  • Flambda2 switch-table optimization extended to naked numbers and symbols, covering patterns like variants returning float32 or int32 constants (oxcaml/oxcaml#3242 by Mark Shinwell)
  • Random.State functions annotated as accepting the state @ local, allowing stack-allocated random states without heap allocation (oxcaml/oxcaml#5908 by Vesa Karvonen)
  • Dummy_use operation removed from the register allocator backend, simplifying the backend after the operation was found to be ineffective at keeping temporaries live (oxcaml/oxcaml#5614 by @ttebbi-janestreet)
  • Diamond-aware mode hints improve error messages when a mode Meet or Join involves parallel lattice elements (oxcaml/oxcaml#5858 by @ainageorges)
  • Syntax coloring added to the fexpr printer for Flambda2 IR dumps, making debug output easier to read in terminals (oxcaml/oxcaml#5925 by Basile Clément)
  • Syntax documentation for all scannable axis annotations in Merlin expanded to cover non_pointer, non_pointer64, non_float, separable, maybe_separable, non_null, and maybe_null, each with hover text and documentation links (oxcaml/merlin#235 by Liam Stevenson)
  • -Ix flag support in Merlin so both -I and -Ix compiler load path flags are correctly parsed, with a new test suite verifying behavior (oxcaml/merlin#234 by Liam Stevenson)
  • oxcaml-patch-guards mechanism pushed to main in oxcaml/opam-repository, allowing multiple versions of upstream patched packages to coexist in an OxCaml switch (oxcaml/opam-repository#27)
  • Updated patched upstream packages added: ocamlbuild.0.16.1+ox, sedlex.3.7+ox, topkg.1.1.1+ox, uutf.1.0.4+ox, ctypes.0.24.0+ox, ctypes-foreign.0.24.0+ox (oxcaml/opam-repository#27, oxcaml/opam-repository#23)
  • Documentation: mutable field modalities now documented in the modes syntax reference (oxcaml/oxcaml#5897 by @julesjacobs)
  • Documentation: with-kind syntax rationale added explaining how type t with ty @@ modality behaves for mode-crossing (oxcaml/oxcaml#5896 by @julesjacobs)
  • Public docs terminology cleanup: removed monadic/comonadic language (oxcaml/oxcaml#5893), replaced "upstream compiler" with "stock OCaml" (oxcaml/oxcaml#5894), fixed extension docs (oxcaml/oxcaml#5898) — all by @julesjacobs

    • OCaml Core

    Ephemeron GC fixes, type system regressions, Windows compatibility work, and the primitive aliases RFC advancing in ocaml/RFCs.

    New Features

  • Ephemeron list API (ocaml/ocaml#14735): Gabriel Scherer added higher-level helper functions to runtime/caml/weak.h — caml_ephe_list_tail, caml_ephe_list_cons, caml_ephe_list_append, caml_ephe_list_pop and variants — refactoring major_gc.c to use these abstractions and reducing duplication.
  • reserved_header_bits exposed to ocamltest (ocaml/ocaml#14744): Olivier Nicole added val reserved_header_bits : int to ocamltest_config.mli, allowing tests to query how many bits of a block header are reserved, and fixing atomic-locs/cmm.ml when ocamlopt is absent.
  • -Wformat-signedness C compiler warning (ocaml/ocaml#14694): Antonin Décimo enabled the -Wformat-signedness warning when available, fixing discrepancies between %x-family format specifiers and signed/unsigned argument types across the runtime.
