  • A major new proposal (ocaml/ocaml#14775) implementing the modular IO RFC was opened this week, directly connecting the two repositories.
  • Windows compatibility received attention via two active bug reports (ocaml/ocaml#14758, ocaml/ocaml#14767) and a fix PR (ocaml/ocaml#14764).
  • Gabriel Scherer's ongoing ephemeron GC correctness series continues to grow, now spanning seven related PRs.

    • Activity

  • Simon Cruanes opened ocaml/ocaml#14775 proposing extensible IO channels, implementing the modular IO RFC with a polymorphic channel type alongside existing native channels.
  • Gabriel Scherer opened ocaml/ocaml#14774 Ephemerons: wait on all domains before asking for another marking round, continuing the multi-PR ephemeron GC correctness series.
  • Florian Angeletti opened ocaml/ocaml#14763 Lambda: merge nested labelled applications, addressing a spurious intermediary closure created during partial application of optional-argument functions.
  • Florian Angeletti opened ocaml/ocaml#14772 typechecker debugging: better unscoped printing, adding a U: prefix printer for unscoped identifiers in debug output.
  • Florian Angeletti opened ocaml/ocaml#14770 proposing removal of the rigid variants mode for unification, and ocaml/ocaml#14769 adding a regression test for a typechecker loop with conjunctive types.
  • Florian Angeletti opened ocaml/ocaml#14771 debugger: breakpoint on tfunctor, enabling breakpoints on module-dependent functions.
  • 张睿 Zhang Rui opened ocaml/ocaml#14764 fixing a logic error in socket_poll_add in select_win32.c.
  • Török Edwin opened ocaml/ocaml#14761 fixing a build error on OpenSUSE caused by a conflict between --with-relative-libdir and a non-standard libdir default.
  • Anarchos opened ocaml/ocaml#14773 adapting the testsuite for Haiku OS specifics.
  • Merged ocaml/ocaml#14768 (Stefan Muenzel): fix for type checker regression in nondep_type_rec_aux (ocaml/ocaml#14766).
  • Merged ocaml/ocaml#14709 (Florian Angeletti): ocamldoc now uses Module_name (Library name) page title format.
  • Merged ocaml/ocaml#14755 (Yang Lin): corrected a broken link in testsuite/HACKING.adoc.
  • Primitive aliases RFC ocaml/RFCs#44 by Nailen Matschke remains open with positive-committee-recommendation; a clarifying exchange with Clément Blaudeau narrowed the scope of with external x = y constraints.

    • Notable Discussions

  • ocaml/ocaml#14767 Win32: opendir returns EUNKNOWNERR -267 — Adrián Montesinos González reported that Sys.readdir fails on Windows with an unmapped error code; Nicolás Ojeda Bär confirmed the bug and suggested mapping ERROR_DIRECTORY to ENOTDIR.
  • ocaml/ocaml#14758 [Win32] Unix.select raises 'original file handle not found' — 张睿 Zhang Rui provided a detailed analysis, discovered an additional logic error in socket_poll_add, and opened ocaml/ocaml#14764 with a fix; Nicolás Ojeda Bär encouraged the patch submission.
  • ocaml/ocaml#14760 OCaml 5.5.0~beta1 configure failure on OpenSUSE — Török Edwin traced the issue to libdir=${exec_prefix}/lib64 triggering a false conflict with --with-relative-libdir, and opened ocaml/ocaml#14761 with a fix.
  • ocaml/ocaml#14765 Syserror exception in Format.flushstandard_formatters — Olivier Andrieu reported that closing stdout before program exit causes an uncaught Sys_error from OCaml's format library finalizers.
  • ocaml/RFCs#44 — Nailen Matschke clarified that a with external x = y constraint form would not allow abstract primitives and that existing with type t = u constraints already cover the plausible use cases, effectively closing off a potential scope expansion of the RFC.

    • Emerging Trends

  • Ephemeron GC overhaul: Gabriel Scherer has a series of related PRs (ocaml/ocaml#14722, ocaml/ocaml#14732, ocaml/ocaml#14733, ocaml/ocaml#14734, ocaml/ocaml#14735, ocaml/ocaml#14745, ocaml/ocaml#14774) systematically fixing ephemeron marking correctness and refactoring the runtime, following bugs exposed by multicore randomized testing.
  • Windows platform fixes: Multiple issues (ocaml/ocaml#14758, ocaml/ocaml#14767) and PRs (ocaml/ocaml#14764) highlight continued effort to improve Win32 compatibility in Unix and I/O subsystems.
  • Type system regression tracking: The well-foundedness check (ocaml/ocaml#11648) continues to surface edge cases (ocaml/ocaml#14754, ocaml/ocaml#14766, ocaml/ocaml#14769), with reactive fixes from type system contributors.
  • RFC-to-implementation pipeline: ocaml/ocaml#14775 translating the modular IO RFC into a concrete PR demonstrates active follow-through from RFC design to compiler implementation.
  • Primitive aliases RFC ocaml/RFCs#44 is narrowing in scope through committee-supported design discussion, moving toward a more tractable implementation target.

    • Multicore

    Quiet week across the multicore group; only picos saw activity with a follow-up on OCaml 5.5 support.

    Overview

  • Minimal activity across the multicore group during week 17 of 2026.
  • Eight of nine repositories (eio, domainslib, ocaml-uring, meio, saturn, eio-trace, kcas, ocaml-iomux) recorded no new commits, PRs, or issues.
  • picos was the only repository with recorded activity, limited to a follow-up comment on a previously merged PR.

    • Activity

  • Kate posted a follow-up comment on ocaml-multicore/picos#387 ("Add support for OCaml 5.5"), a PR originally opened in February 2026 and merged on 2026-03-17.
entry.summary: Dune 3.23 ships and targets 3.24; OxCaml mixed-block overhaul and 5.4 merge advance; OCaml 5.5.0 beta1 lands in opam-repository.

entry.title: Week 16, 2026: opam 2.5.1 security release, OxCaml gains scannable axes and metaprogramming beta, dune targets 3.23.0, and odoc/js_of_ocaml add OxCaml support.
entry.content:
Weekly Summary

New Features

  • OCaml Tools opam 2.5.1 released (ocaml/opam#6899) by Kate, addressing security vulnerability OSEC-2026-03 — .install files with path-escape attempts via .. or absolute paths are now invalidated (ocaml/opam#6897); Nix depexts JSON injection fix (ocaml/opam#6894); Gentoo detection restored (ocaml/opam#6886)
  • OxCaml Scannable axes: separability becomes a scannable axis in a large type system refactoring by Ryan Tjoa — merges Pointerness into an expanded Separability lattice and redefines immediate as scannable non_pointer (oxcaml/oxcaml#5169)
  • OxCaml First version of static evaluator for layout polymorphism merged by Luke Maurer — a lambda calculus evaluator for statically evaluating layout-polymorphic expressions (oxcaml/oxcaml#5512)
  • OxCaml Runtime metaprogramming promoted from alpha to beta extension by Jack Rickard (oxcaml/oxcaml#5843), with improved graceful error reporting for unsupported features (oxcaml/oxcaml#5823)
  • OxCaml Separate functor inlining size limits added by Mark Shinwell, introducing -flambda2-small-functor-size and -flambda2-large-functor-size flags; inline available attributes added to Stdlib's Hashtbl, Map, and Set functors (oxcaml/oxcaml#5878)
  • OxCaml New -Ix compiler flag added by Chris Casinghino to mark include directories where CMX files are always available, as infrastructure for future layout polymorphism error reporting (oxcaml/oxcaml#5654)
  • OxCaml caml_modify skipped for non_pointer types by Ryan Tjoa, improving codegen for types never GC-traced; bumps mixed block version to v6 (oxcaml/oxcaml#5831)
  • OxCaml Tick thread state reset after fork() in child process by Aspen Smith, reinitializing mutex and restarting the tick thread to maintain Unix.fork() support in multithreaded programs (oxcaml/oxcaml#5829)
  • OxCaml Signature-help optional argument highlighting fixed in oxcaml/merlin so already-provided labelled arguments are skipped and optional arguments are correctly surfaced (oxcaml/merlin#216)
  • OCaml Tools compile_commands.json generation for C/C++ foreign stubs in dune, produced as part of @check under (lang dune 3.23), enabling clangd integration (ocaml/dune#14185, by Ali Caglayan)
  • OCaml Tools SIGTERM before SIGKILL sent to child processes on shutdown and watch-mode cancellation, closing a 7-year-old issue (ocaml/dune#14224, fixes ocaml/dune#2445, by Robin Bate Boerop)
  • OCaml Tools Opam file generation now requires explicit promotion via dune promote under dune 3.23; source opam files used directly in release mode (ocaml/dune#14108, by Rudi Grinberg)
  • OCaml Tools Inline tests execute for byte-only libraries when a library has (modes byte) (ocaml/dune#14174, fixes ocaml/dune#9757, by Robin Bate Boerop)
  • OCaml Tools OxCaml upstream support merged into odoc across modes, layouts, iarray, labeled tuples, and unboxed records (ocaml/odoc#1399, via @art-w); OCaml 5.5 compatibility added including external types and module arrow types (ocaml/odoc#1406, by Paul-Elliot Anglès d'Auriac)
  • OCaml Tools OxCaml support merged into jsofocaml across 140 files (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2105), adding Float32 operations, small integer types (int8_u, int16_u), unboxed int indexing, Float16 conversion primitives, and atomic/domain primitives, by Jérôme Vouillon
  • OCaml Core Format.pp_print_dynarray added for printing Dynarray.t values with a separator, mirroring pp_print_array and pp_print_iarray (ocaml/ocaml#14726)
  • OCaml Core Nested with constraints in package types now supported as syntactic sugar: (module T with type x = ... with type y = ...) accepted alongside the existing and form (ocaml/ocaml#14710, closes ocaml/ocaml#14274)
  • OCaml Core Atomic.update (formerly Atomic.modify) merged, providing a high-level retry-loop abstraction over compare_and_set (ocaml/ocaml#10798)
  • OCaml Ecosystem ocgtk 0.1~preview1 adds OCaml bindings for GTK 4 and a new conf-gtk4 virtual package with depexts for Linux and macOS (ocaml/opam-repository#29729)
  • OCaml Ecosystem ppx_mixins 0.1 introduces a PPX for mixing module type signatures including [%mixins Printable + Comparable] syntax (ocaml/opam-repository#29741, by Sacha Ayoun)
  • OCaml Ecosystem ocaml-ai-sdk 0.2 adds stream transformers, retry with exponential backoff, OpenTelemetry-compatible telemetry, and Unicode-aware chunking (ocaml/opam-repository#29724)
  • OCaml Ecosystem openrouter_api 0.0.1 is a new Async-based client for the OpenRouter unified LLM API covering chat completions with streaming, tools, and structured outputs (ocaml/opam-repository#29745)
  • OCaml Ecosystem atd 4.1.0 (13 packages) adds atd-jsonlike and atd-yamlx packages plus for externally-tagged sum types (ocaml/opam-repository#29709, by Martin Jambon)
  • OCaml Ecosystem Hilite MDX syntax highlighting rolled out consistently across all ocaml.org content parsers, fixing long-standing incorrect highlighting of OCaml interactive session syntax (ocaml/ocaml.org#3593)
  • OCaml Ecosystem Platform release scraper now auto-detects pre-releases and supports per-project ignore patterns; alpha/beta/rc[0-9]/preview tags automatically marked experimental: true (ocaml/ocaml.org#3616)

    • Group Activity Summaries

    OCaml Ecosystem

    opam 2.5.1 released; Windows/MSYS2 improvements, new OCaml packages (GTK4, AI tooling), and syntax highlighting fixes on ocaml.org.

    New Features

  • ocgtk 0.1~preview1 adds OCaml bindings for GTK 4 along with a new conf-gtk4 virtual package providing depexts for major Linux distributions and macOS via ocaml/opam-repository#29729; Windows support is deferred to a follow-up.
  • ppx_mixins 0.1 and 0.2.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29741, ocaml/opam-repository#29746) introduce a PPX for mixing module type signatures into type declarations, including [%mixins Printable + Comparable] syntax; submitted by Sacha Ayoun.
  • ezlua 0.1 (ocaml/opam-repository#29655) adds an OCaml-Lua codec runtime and high-level interpreter API by Simon Cruanes.
  • ocaml-ai-sdk 0.2 (ocaml/opam-repository#29724) adds stream transformers, retry with exponential backoff, OpenTelemetry-compatible telemetry, and Unicode-aware chunking modes, by José Nogueira.
  • openrouterapi 0.0.1 (ocaml/opam-repository#29745) is a new Async-based OCaml client for the OpenRouter unified LLM API covering chat completions with streaming, tools, and structured outputs, submitted by mtcaret.
  • azure-cosmos-db 0.4.0 (3 packages, ocaml/opam-repository#29682) adds Eio and Lwt backends for the Azure Cosmos DB interface by Morten Knaack.
  • atd 4.1.0 (13 packages, ocaml/opam-repository#29709) adds atd-jsonlike and atd-yamlx packages plus for externally-tagged sum types, by Martin Jambon.
  • Hilite MDX syntax highlighting is now used consistently across all ocaml.org content parsers (backstage, changelog, cookbook, exercise, is-ocaml-yet, platform releases) via ocaml/ocaml.org#3593, fixing long-standing incorrect highlighting of OCaml interactive session syntax.
  • Platform release scraper now auto-detects pre-releases and supports per-project ignore patterns via ocaml/ocaml.org#3616; tags matching alpha, beta, rc[0-9], or preview are marked experimental: true automatically.

    • Overview

  • ocaml/opam-repository had a high-activity week: opam 2.5.1 landed (ocaml/opam-repository#29731), dune 3.22.2 fixed a --diff-command regression (ocaml/opam-repository#29704), and numerous new packages and updates were merged across domains including multimedia, databases, formal verification, and AI tooling.
  • ocaml/ocaml.org focused on content quality and tooling: syntax highlighting was rolled out across all parsers (ocaml/ocaml.org#3593), the platform release scraper gained pre-release detection (ocaml/ocaml.org#3616), and new backstage posts covered wasmofocaml and Merlin.
  • Cross-repository coordination was evident: opam 2.5.1 and dune 3.22.2 releases were published to opam-repository and simultaneously documented on ocaml.org by the same contributors.
  • Windows/MSYS2 ecosystem support saw a concentrated batch of improvements including UCRT64 conf package updates and several compatibility fixes (ocaml/opam-repository#29579).
  • The OCaml 5.5.0 release readiness tracker (ocaml/opam-repository#29463) continues to be monitored, with platform tools (opam, dune, merlin, lsp-server, odoc, ocamlformat) and key ecosystem libraries tracked.

    • Activity

  • opam 2.5.1 (8 packages, ocaml/opam-repository#29731) released by Kate, followed by an upgrade alert update noting NixOS stable 25.11 remains on 2.4.x (ocaml/opam-repository#29733); documented on ocaml.org in ocaml/ocaml.org#3614.
  • dune 3.22.2 (18 packages, ocaml/opam-repository#29704) fixes a --diff-command regression from 3.22.1 by Shon Feder; changelog added to ocaml.org in ocaml/ocaml.org#3608.
  • ffmpeg 1.3.0 (8 packages, ocaml/opam-repository#29703) and liquidsoap 2.4.3 (4 packages, ocaml/opam-repository#29708, ocaml/opam-repository#29715) merged by Romain Beauxis.
  • alt-ergo 2.6.3 (4 packages, ocaml/opam-repository#29722) adds ae.pow_int and ae.pow_real support by Pierre Villemot.
  • postgresql 5.4.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29738) exposes the libpq socket as Unix.file_descr and sqlite3 5.4.1 (ocaml/opam-repository#29737) releases the OCaml runtime lock around more SQLite API calls, both by Markus Mottl.
  • elpi 3.7.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29728) adds dependency computation API, separate scoping AST, and REPL improvements by Enrico Tassi.
  • Caqti 2.3.0 (7 packages, ocaml/opam-repository#29690) maintenance release with bugfixes by Petter A. Urkedal.
  • albatross 2.7.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29712) adds BHyve virtual machine support for MirageOS unikernel orchestration by Hannes Mehnert.
  • ochre and ochre-cli 1.0.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29700), textmate-language 0.6.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29706), and tm-grammars 2.0.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29717) form a syntax-highlighting toolchain update by David Sancho and Alan.
  • htmlofjsx 0.0.9 (ocaml/opam-repository#29716) adds JSX pretty-printing and render performance improvements by David Sancho.
  • runtimeeventstools 0.5.4 (ocaml/opam-repository#29694) reinstates olly latency and fixes cmdliner 2.0 compatibility by Tim McGilchrist.
  • ocaml-lsp 1.26.0 and merlin 5.7.0-504 changelogs added to ocaml.org by PixieDust in ocaml/ocaml.org#3605.
  • Backstage posts published on wasmofocaml (ocaml/ocaml.org#3612) and Merlin signature help (ocaml/ocaml.org#3610) by sabine.
  • discuss.ocaml.org announcements for platform releases added via ocaml/ocaml.org#3619.
  • Why3 1.8.2 compatibility extended to OCaml 5.5 and Rocq 9 (ocaml/opam-repository#29734) by Guillaume Melquiond.
  • checkseum 0.5.3 (ocaml/opam-repository#29747) fixes clang 16.0.6 compilation by Calascibetta Romain.
  • qcow 0.14.0 (4 packages, ocaml/opam-repository#29696) fixes handling of images larger than 4TB by Pau Ruiz Safont.
  • vsrocq-language-server 2.4.1 and 2.4.3 (ocaml/opam-repository#29727, ocaml/opam-repository#29732) released via vscoqbot automation.
  • MDX CI test setup opened by Yassine Haouzane in ocaml/ocaml.org#3622.

    • Notable Discussions

  • The MSYS2 UCRT64 transition (ocaml/opam-repository#29579, closing ocaml/opam-repository#29575, ocaml/opam-repository#29576, ocaml/opam-repository#29577, ocaml/opam-repository#29578) was merged by Sora Morimoto: six conf-mingw-w64-*-x86_64 packages now support UCRT64 alongside MINGW64, prompted by MSYS2's deprecation of the MINGW64 environment in March 2026.
  • OCaml 5.5.0 release readiness is tracked in ocaml/opam-repository#29463 by Florian Angeletti, covering platform tools and key ecosystem libraries.
  • conf-brotli required two rounds of fixes (ocaml/opam-repository#29718, ocaml/opam-repository#29726) to address broken build field syntax and Cygwin-specific issues, involving discussion of correct opam filter syntax for pkgconf arguments on Windows.
  • stdcompat incompatibility with OCaml 4.14.3 (ocaml/opam-repository#29667) and upper bounds for jsofocaml-compiler (ocaml/opam-repository#29714) were addressed to prevent widespread build failures.
  • wadi 0.1.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29620), a Dune-free OCaml build system using a single wadi.toml manifest with content-based incremental builds, is awaiting further action from submitter @improvingjef.
  • combobulate Emacs integration note (ocaml/ocaml.org#3603) opened by PixieDust prompted a request from Xavier Van de Woestyne to also replace ocaml-eglot with ocaml-eglot-mode in the same file.

    • Emerging Trends

  • Windows/MSYS2 improvements are accumulating: UCRT64 support for mingw-w64 conf packages (ocaml/opam-repository#29579), MSYS2 depexts for conf-m4/conf-perl/conf-findutils, and multiple conf-brotli (ocaml/opam-repository#29718, ocaml/opam-repository#29726) and camlidl (ocaml/opam-repository#29653) fixes reflect sustained investment in Windows OCaml support.
  • AI/LLM tooling is growing in the ecosystem: ocaml-ai-sdk 0.2 (ocaml/opam-repository#29724) adds streaming and telemetry infrastructure, and openrouter_api 0.0.1 (ocaml/opam-repository#29745) provides access to multiple LLM providers.
  • wasmofocaml is receiving documentation attention: the backstage post (ocaml/ocaml.org#3612) covers 6.1–6.3 changes and highlights dynlink/toplevel support as a path to running the OCaml Playground on wasmofocaml.
  • Editor tooling documentation is a recurring focus: the combobulate Emacs PR (ocaml/ocaml.org#3603) and the Merlin signature help backstage post (ocaml/ocaml.org#3610) both highlight continued investment in the OCaml editor experience.
  • Syntax highlighting correctness for OCaml interactive sessions was addressed at both the library level in opam-repository (textmate-language 0.6.0 via ocaml/opam-repository#29706) and the site level on ocaml.org (ocaml/ocaml.org#3593).
  • x-maintenance-intent annotations are being encouraged more consistently as part of the archiving policy workflow in ocaml/opam-repository.

    • OCaml Tools

    opam 2.5.1 security release, dune approaching 3.23.0, and OxCaml support merged into odoc and js_of_ocaml.

    New Features

    ocaml/dune
    - compile_commands.json generation for C/C++ foreign stubs produced as part of @check when using (lang dune 3.23), enabling clangd and other tools (ocaml/dune#14185, by Ali Caglayan)
    - SIGTERM before SIGKILL sent to child processes on shutdown and watch-mode cancellation, closing a 7-year-old issue (ocaml/dune#14224, fixes ocaml/dune#2445, by Robin Bate Boerop)
    - Opam file generation now requires explicit promotion via dune promote; generation triggered by @install, @runtest, and @opam; in release mode source opam files are used directly (ocaml/dune#14108, by Rudi Grinberg) — requires dune 3.23
    - RPC lifecycle trace events added for accepting clients and shutting down the RPC server (ocaml/dune#14232, by Rudi Grinberg)
    - Watch mode build iterations included in build events, enabling external tooling to track rebuild cycles (ocaml/dune#14166, by Rudi Grinberg)
    - Auto-injection of menhir lower bound in generated opam files when the menhir extension is used (ocaml/dune#14168, fixes ocaml/dune#10707, by Robin Bate Boerop)
    - Duplicate dune version bounds fixed in generated opam files (ocaml/dune#14175, fixes ocaml/dune#3916, by Robin Bate Boerop)
    - Inline tests now execute for byte-only libraries when a library has (modes byte) (ocaml/dune#14174, fixes ocaml/dune#9757, by Robin Bate Boerop)
    - Dyn.pp now prints valid OCaml literals for Char, Int32/Int64/Nativeint, and Float (ocaml/dune#13394, by Ali Caglayan)

    ocaml/odoc
    - OxCaml upstream support merged, rebasing Luke Maurer's patches from the oxcaml/odoc fork via @art-w, adding OxCaml-specific syntax handling including modes, layouts, iarray, labeled tuples, and unboxed records (ocaml/odoc#1399)
    - OCaml 5.5 compatibility added by Paul-Elliot Anglès d'Auriac, including support for external types and module arrow types in signatures (ocaml/odoc#1406)
    - Fixed missing parentheses for polymorphic parameters in OxCaml rendering (ocaml/odoc#1404, by @art-w)

    ocaml/opam
    - opam 2.5.1 released (ocaml/opam#6899), a security and bug-fix release merged by Kate
    - Security fix (OSEC-2026-03): .install files with destination filepaths attempting path escape via .. or absolute paths are now invalidated (ocaml/opam#6897)
    - Nix depexts now loads package names from a JSON file instead of inlining them, fixing a potential string injection vulnerability (ocaml/opam#6894)
    - Gentoo distribution detection restored with support for single-quoted values in /etc/os-release (ocaml/opam#6886)

    ocsigen/jsofocaml
    - OxCaml support merged across 140 files (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2105), adding Float32 operations, small integer types (int8_u, int16_u), unboxed int indexing, Float16 conversion primitives, and new atomic/domain primitives, by Jérôme Vouillon
    - JSPI effects availability clarified in documentation: --effects=jspi works out-of-the-box in Chrome 137 and Node.js 25+ (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2213)

    Overview

  • Six of ten repositories saw activity this week; ocaml/ocamlfind, ocaml/opam-file-format, and ocaml-dune/spawn had no commits or PRs
  • ocaml/opam shipped opam 2.5.1 (ocaml/opam#6899), a security and bug-fix release addressing a path-escape vulnerability (OSEC-2026-03) and two GC corruption bugs in C stubs
  • ocaml/dune is approaching the 3.23.0 release (ocaml/dune#14211), targeting 2026-04-20, with 228 files changed across the week and 11 new features landing
  • ocsigen/jsofocaml merged OxCaml compatibility across 140 files (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2105), adding Float32, small int types, atomic primitives, and dedicated CI pipelines
  • ocaml/odoc merged three PRs bringing OxCaml upstream support (ocaml/odoc#1399), OCaml 5.5 compatibility (ocaml/odoc#1406), and polymorphic parameter fixes (ocaml/odoc#1404)
  • ocaml/merlin had four new PRs opened covering menhirLib snapshot updates, misc.ml synchronization with upstream OCaml, and saved parts investigation (ocaml/merlin#2058, ocaml/merlin#2059, ocaml/merlin#2060)
  • ocaml/ocaml-lsp had only an automated Nix flake lock update (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1437) bumping the merlin input to the 2026-04-17 snapshot

    • Activity

    ocaml/dune
    - Per-module inter-library dependency filtering under intensive review by Robin Bate Boerop, targeting ocaml/dune#4572; a 40-70% null-build regression is being investigated, with Rudi Grinberg proposing memoizing library closure computation (ocaml/dune#14256) as mitigation
    - Port Async_io to Lev (libev) opened by Rudi Grinberg to replace the select-based I/O loop and lift the 1024 fd limit (ocaml/dune#14243)
    - Action runners with bubblewrap sandbox draft opened by Rudi Grinberg for beta testing ahead of 3.24 (ocaml/dune#14240)
    - %{pkg:foo:lib} pforms for package install layouts opened by Ali Caglayan, fixing ocaml/dune#3378 and ocaml/dune#14193
    - New Fd.t managed file descriptor type introduced in Stdune replacing bare Unix.file_descr across multiple PRs (ocaml/dune#14202, ocaml/dune#14205, ocaml/dune#14206, ocaml/dune#14207, ocaml/dune#14210, ocaml/dune#14216)
    - OxCaml CI Nix job added (ocaml/dune#14248) and revdeps-dev-build workflow replaced with a Nix derivation (ocaml/dune#14228) by Ali Caglayan to fix OxCaml trunk CI (ocaml/dune#14214)
    - dune 3.22.2 release completed (ocaml/dune#14112) and 3.23.0 release tracker opened (ocaml/dune#14211) by Shon Feder

    ocaml/merlin
    - Thomas Refis opened ocaml/merlin#2058 to update menhirLib's snapshotting to use --dump-menhirLib flag after copy rules began failing with 2026 menhir versions
    - Liam Stevenson opened ocaml/merlin#2059 to synchronize misc.ml and format_doc.ml with upstream OCaml compiler structure across 30 files
    - Thomas Refis opened ocaml/merlin#2060 investigating saved parts handling and browse tree blowup, motivated by ocaml/ocaml#14241
    - Version constraint updated from 5.6-504 to 5.7.0-504 in ocaml-lsp CI check, signaling preparation for Merlin 5.7.0

    ocaml/odoc
    - Shon Feder opened tracking issue ocaml/odoc#1411 with seven sub-issues covering remaining OxCaml rendering gaps: unboxed types (ocaml/odoc#1413/#1414), layouts (ocaml/odoc#1415), modalities (ocaml/odoc#1416), modes (ocaml/odoc#1417), @zero-alloc annotation (ocaml/odoc#1418), and include functor (ocaml/odoc#1419)
    - @art-w opened three follow-on OxCaml PRs: modalities (ocaml/odoc#1420), kind annotations (ocaml/odoc#1410), and unboxed named types (ocaml/odoc#1407), all awaiting rebase before merge

    ocaml/opam
    - GC corruption fixed in OpamStubs.uname by registering roots for intermediate strings (ocaml/opam#6880, by Anil Madhavapeddy)
    - GC corruption fixed in OpamStubs.enumRegistry on Windows (ocaml/opam#6882)
    - Minimum OCaml build version raised from 4.08 to 4.11 (ocaml/opam#6879)
    - result type renamed to solver_result in opamTypes to avoid conflict with Stdlib.result (ocaml/opam#6885)
    - Discussion opened on standardising C stub allocation patterns to prevent future GC corruptions (ocaml/opam#6883, with review feedback from David Allsopp)
    - PR opened to remove build directories earlier during package installation, addressing performance issue ocaml/opam#5884 (ocaml/opam#6906)

    ocsigen/jsofocaml
    - Wasm toplevel function size reduction pursued via ocsigen/jsofocaml#2211 (constant expressions into global variables, halving PRT benchmark toplevel size) and draft ocsigen/jsofocaml#2212 (loop extraction for engine tiering), by Jérôme Vouillon
    - WASI runtime (ocsigen/jsofocaml#1831) and Wasm native effects (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2189) remain blocked on ocsigen/jsofocaml#2177 and ocaml/dune#13613 pending a new dune release

    Notable Discussions

  • dune 3.23.0 release tracker (ocaml/dune#14211) opened by Shon Feder, targeting 2026-04-20; current blockers include sandboxed package dependency regression (ocaml/dune#14213) and OxCaml CI compatibility (ocaml/dune#14214)
  • Sandboxed package deps regression (ocaml/dune#14213) raised by Ali Caglayan as a blocker for 3.23.0; a reproduction case is being developed in ocaml/dune#14189
  • Allow arbitrary opam fields in dune-project (ocaml/dune#14197) opened by Marek Kubica; Rudi Grinberg proposed (opam_fields (depexts "...")) syntax as a lighter-weight alternative to opam.template files
  • Dune Monitor long-term plan (ocaml/dune#14121) by Rudi Grinberg outlines making dune monitor a standalone binary using Lwt instead of Fiber, with Notty/Lwd rendering and RPC/trace-file observation
  • opam 2.5.1 release impact on setup-ocaml (ocaml/opam#6901): Austin Theriault reported setup-ocaml breakage when binaries were unavailable at release; Kate clarified that release binaries are for the install script, not setup-ocaml
  • Supply chain security for opam releases (ocaml/opam#6900): Austin Theriault requested switching to GitHub immutable releases; Sora Morimoto suggested combining this with GitHub artifact attestations
  • opam-installer dependency cycle (ocaml/opam#6907): Kate raised that opam-installer depends on opam-core which depends on jsonm, making it hard to bootstrap jsonm without opam
  • Merlin saved parts and browse tree blowup (ocaml/merlin#2060): Thomas Refis identified that mimicking the typechecker's saved-types behavior leads to unwanted nesting; Xavier Van de Woestyne suggested opening a tracking ticket for the performance implications
  • @inline tag on module declarations (ocaml/odoc#1408): Jon Ludlam explained why the approach differs from inlined includes — inline modules require tracking during path/reference resolution — and closed the PR as needs further architectural work

    • Emerging Trends

  • OxCaml compatibility is becoming a group-wide priority: dedicated support landed in ocaml/odoc (ocaml/odoc#1399), ocsigen/jsofocaml (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2105), and ocaml/dune (ocaml/dune#14248) this week, each with dedicated CI pipelines and test suites
  • Nix flake as the standard cross-compiler testing mechanism: ocaml/dune replaced its revdeps-dev-build workflow with a full Nix derivation (ocaml/dune#14228); ocaml/ocaml-lsp auto-updates its flake.lock (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1437); ocaml/merlin bumped cachix/install-nix-action (ocaml/merlin#2056)
  • Synchronization with upstream OCaml compiler: ocaml/merlin has multiple open PRs (ocaml/merlin#2058, ocaml/merlin#2059) reducing historical drift with upstream; ocaml/odoc is tracking OCaml 5.5 features; ocsigen/jsofocaml is blocked on WASI and effects work pending a new dune release (ocaml/dune#13613)
  • Security hardening at the release and runtime level: opam 2.5.1 addressed OSEC-2026-03 (ocaml/opam#6897) and two GC corruption bugs (ocaml/opam#6880, ocaml/opam#6882); downstream supply chain concerns are driving discussions about immutable releases and artifact attestations (ocaml/opam#6900)
  • Resource safety abstractions in dune: systematic replacement of raw Unix.file_descr with a managed Fd.t type (ocaml/dune#14202 et al.) mirrors opam's work standardising C stub GC root registration (ocaml/opam#6883), reflecting a broader push toward eliminating resource-management bugs
  • Wasm backend optimisation focus in jsofocaml: both ocsigen/jsofocaml#2211 and ocsigen/jsofocaml#2212 target the toplevel/init function as a recurring Wasm engine bottleneck, alongside JSPI standardization shifting documentation from experimental caveats to concrete browser version guidance (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2213)

    • OxCaml

    Major oxcaml/oxcaml week: scannable axes, static evaluator, metaprogramming beta, functor inlining limits, and Merlin signature-help fixes.

    New Features

  • Scannable axes: separability becomes a scannable axis in a large type system refactoring by Ryan Tjoa — merges Pointerness into an expanded Separability lattice, renames the base sort Value to Scannable internally, and redefines immediate as scannable non_pointer (oxcaml/oxcaml#5169)
  • First version of static evaluator for layout polymorphism merged by Luke Maurer — a lambda calculus evaluator for statically evaluating layout-polymorphic expressions; inter-module evaluation not yet supported (oxcaml/oxcaml#5512)
  • Runtime metaprogramming promoted from alpha to beta extension by Jack Rickard, reflecting increased maturity of the feature (oxcaml/oxcaml#5843)
  • Separate functor inlining size limits added by Mark Shinwell, introducing -flambda2-small-functor-size and -flambda2-large-functor-size flags; large functors are now ineligible for speculative inlining unless annotated, and inline available attributes were added to Stdlib's Hashtbl, Map, and Set functors (oxcaml/oxcaml#5878)
  • New -Ix compiler flag added by Chris Casinghino to mark include directories where CMX files are guaranteed always available, as infrastructure for future layout polymorphism error reporting (oxcaml/oxcaml#5654)
  • caml_modify skipped for non_pointer types by Ryan Tjoa, improving codegen for types whose values are never GC-traced pointers; also bumps the mixed block version to v6 (oxcaml/oxcaml#5831)
  • New reversible name mangling scheme (Structured_mangling module) introduced by Simon Spies, Tim McGilchrist, and Samuel Hym — encodes arbitrary strings into output-safe identifiers with full reversibility, used for parameterized library symbols (oxcaml/oxcaml#5099)
  • Patricia tree bit-packed integer representation merged by Basile Clément, improving internal data structure efficiency in Flambda2 (oxcaml/oxcaml#5833)
  • Tick thread state reset after fork() in child process by Aspen Smith, reinitializing mutex and restarting the tick thread in child processes to maintain Unix.fork() support in multithreaded programs (oxcaml/oxcaml#5829)
  • Graceful error reporting when runtime metaprogramming encounters unsupported language features, by Andrej Ivašković, replacing internal errors with user-facing messages (oxcaml/oxcaml#5823)
  • Signature-help optional argument highlighting fixed in oxcaml/merlin so that already-provided labelled arguments are skipped and optional arguments are correctly surfaced as the active parameter (oxcaml/merlin#216)
  • Signature-help trigger on unfinished let...in bindings test case added in oxcaml/merlin reproducing the bug where signature-help failed when the in keyword was missing (oxcaml/merlin#215)

    • Overview

  • oxcaml/oxcaml was the dominant source of activity this week, with 13 significant features merged and numerous PRs opened across the compiler, runtime, Flambda2, and type system
  • oxcaml/merlin merged two signature-help improvements and opened three new PRs for compiler sync, typeopt cleanup, and syntax-doc support for scannable axes
  • oxcaml/opam-repository had two new CI-fix PRs from Matthew Else and continued discussion on the patching infrastructure draft (oxcaml/opam-repository#27)
  • janestreet/opam-repository saw a long-standing arm64 async_ssl patch PR (janestreet/opam-repository#37) closed without merging after 14 months
  • oxcaml/jsofocaml had no activity this week
  • Approximately 24 contributors were active across the group, with the largest concentration in oxcaml/oxcaml

    • Activity

  • OCaml 5.4 upstream merge in oxcaml/oxcaml is in an active test-fixing phase: David Allsopp opened five fix PRs (oxcaml/oxcaml#5880, oxcaml/oxcaml#5881, oxcaml/oxcaml#5882, oxcaml/oxcaml#5883, oxcaml/oxcaml#5867) and Simon Spies opened the minus-31 changes merge (oxcaml/oxcaml#5853); Nick Barnes has multiple runtime PRs open (oxcaml/oxcaml#5845, oxcaml/oxcaml#5846, oxcaml/oxcaml#5847)
  • Flambda2 Reaper refactoring saw three cleanup PRs merged by Nathanaëlle Courant: dep_solver split (oxcaml/oxcaml#5776), post-split cleanup (oxcaml/oxcaml#5787), and review address (oxcaml/oxcaml#5875); code size computation PR (oxcaml/oxcaml#5793) remains open
  • IRC register allocator refinements from Xavier Clerc: merged split-pass occur check fix (oxcaml/oxcaml#5537), opened affinity-aware coalescing (oxcaml/oxcaml#5863) and affinity data structure refactoring (oxcaml/oxcaml#5849)
  • Layout polymorphism infrastructure: Zesen Qian merged four PRs (oxcaml/oxcaml#5791, oxcaml/oxcaml#5817, oxcaml/oxcaml#5835, oxcaml/oxcaml#5792); Chris Casinghino opened experimental weak parameterized symbols (oxcaml/oxcaml#5873); Jack Rickard opened draft layout polymorphic functions PR (oxcaml/oxcaml#5870)
  • Flambda2 precision improvements opened: improved alloc_mode use for unknown types (oxcaml/oxcaml#5820) by Mark Shinwell, continuation argument type refinement (oxcaml/oxcaml#5850) by Nathanaëlle Courant, and improved argument_types_useful check (oxcaml/oxcaml#5760) by Basile Clément
  • Testsuite: Keryan Didier merged the large mlexamples migration into the main testsuite (oxcaml/oxcaml#5346, 12k additions/42k deletions) and opened fexpr output checking for toplevel expect tests (oxcaml/oxcaml#5837)
  • opam-repository CI fixes: Matthew Else opened oxcaml/opam-repository#38 cherry-picking fixes from the dev branch to repair builds of odoc, sherlodoc, ocaml-lsp-server, and macOS-specific dependencies
  • Merlin compiler sync and diff reduction: Liam Stevenson opened PRs to sync compiler changes from 5.2.0minus-37 (oxcaml/merlin#234) and reduce divergence in typeopt.ml (oxcaml/merlin#233); also opened syntax-doc support for scannable axes (oxcaml/merlin#235)
  • Various bug fixes merged in oxcaml/oxcaml: naked int8/int16 kind errors (oxcaml/oxcaml#5852), consistent nullability in typeopt (oxcaml/oxcaml#5841), staging in Printtyp (oxcaml/oxcaml#5785), macOS compilation (oxcaml/oxcaml#5714), REPL metaprogramming syntax directive (oxcaml/oxcaml#5801)
  • additional union_total function families for patricia trees added by Nathanaëlle Courant, avoiding allocations in common union operations (oxcaml/oxcaml#5803)

    • Notable Discussions

  • Scannable axes on abstract kinds (oxcaml/oxcaml#5874) prompted a design discussion between Ryan Tjoa and Richard Eisenberg about where to place Scannable_axes.t in the kind representation — whether it belongs on base_and_axes or within each kind constructor — with consensus that the current approach is a reasonable interim pending a fuller kind system redesign
  • Diamond-aware mode error hints (oxcaml/oxcaml#5858) generated discussion between Zesen Qian and @ainageorges on correctly selecting which branch of a Meet/Join hint is "at fault" in diamond-shaped mode lattices, settling on using left-adjoint preservation of colimits
  • Alloc mode for returns (oxcaml/oxcaml#5877) received extensive early review from Leo White identifying numerous places where alloc_mode should be changed to return_mode, particularly around Lsend, Fexpr.alloc_mode_for_applications, and Cmx_format.alloc_mode
  • Flambda2 CMX export info optimization (oxcaml/oxcaml#5809) by Nicolas Trangez proposed moving export data out of the inline Marshal block into a .cmx section to speed up linking, with Mark Shinwell looping in Chris Casinghino for awareness
  • External contributor overhead surfaced when Jack Rickard replaced an external contributor's portability fix (oxcaml/oxcaml#5848 by AmberDevs) with an identical internal PR (oxcaml/oxcaml#5865) due to administrative overhead for external contributions
  • layout.sh placement debated in oxcaml/opam-repository#27: @dkalinichenko-js asked whether the patch-guard generation script should live in internal release infrastructure; David Allsopp argued for keeping it public to ease external contributor access
  • Merlin signature-help PR coordination in oxcaml/merlin#223: Liam Stevenson is holding review until Charlène_Gros rebases after oxcaml/merlin#215 and oxcaml/merlin#216 were merged

    • Emerging Trends

  • Flambda2 Reaper (dead code elimination) is receiving intensive refactoring across oxcaml/oxcaml: dep_solver.ml was split into separate points-to analysis, unboxing analysis, and types rewrite modules (oxcaml/oxcaml#5776, oxcaml/oxcaml#5787, oxcaml/oxcaml#5875), with code size computation (oxcaml/oxcaml#5793) still pending
  • OCaml 5.4 upstream merge is in an active test-fixing phase in oxcaml/oxcaml with many small PRs resolving individual test suite failures across typing, runtime, and effects subsystems; the merge branch consumed significant contributor bandwidth this week
  • Layout polymorphism infrastructure is expanding in multiple directions: static evaluation (oxcaml/oxcaml#5512), persistent module staticity (oxcaml/oxcaml#5834), CMI serialization (oxcaml/oxcaml#5835), draft layout polymorphic functions (oxcaml/oxcaml#5870), and experimental weak symbol deduplication (oxcaml/oxcaml#5873)
  • Runtime metaprogramming is progressing through staged rollout in oxcaml/oxcaml: promoted from alpha to beta (oxcaml/oxcaml#5843) with improved error reporting (oxcaml/oxcaml#5823) and REPL compatibility fixes (oxcaml/oxcaml#5801)
  • Patricia tree optimizations continue to land incrementally in oxcaml/oxcaml: bit-packed integer representation (oxcaml/oxcaml#5833), allocation-avoiding union_total families (oxcaml/oxcaml#5803), and a pending high-bits flag proposal (oxcaml/oxcaml#5543)
  • IRC register allocator receiving a series of refinements in oxcaml/oxcaml from Xavier Clerc: affinity-aware coalescing (oxcaml/oxcaml#5863), split-pass occur check (oxcaml/oxcaml#5537), and structural refactoring (oxcaml/oxcaml#5849)
  • Merlin compiler diff reduction is an active maintenance theme: Liam Stevenson is systematically syncing upstream compiler changes (oxcaml/merlin#234) and reducing per-file divergence (oxcaml/merlin#233) as Merlin moves toward subtree integration (oxcaml/oxcaml#5568)
  • opam overlay CI stability remains an active concern in oxcaml/opam-repository: both oxcaml/opam-repository#37 and oxcaml/opam-repository#38 address build failures across odoc, sherlodoc, ocaml-lsp-server, and macOS dependencies

    • OCaml Core

    Typechecker improvements, stdlib additions (Atomic.update, pp_print_dynarray), runtime fixes, and ephemeron GC refactoring in ocaml/ocaml.

    New Features

  • Format.pp_print_dynarray added to the standard library for printing Dynarray.t values with a separator, mirroring pp_print_array and pp_print_iarray — ocaml/ocaml#14726
  • Nested with constraints in package types now supported as syntactic sugar: (module T with type x = ... with type y = ...) accepted alongside the existing and form — ocaml/ocaml#14710, closes ocaml/ocaml#14274
  • Atomic.update (formerly Atomic.modify) merged, providing a high-level retry-loop abstraction over compare_and_set — ocaml/ocaml#10798
  • ctype.mli exposes new filter_arity function and Pattern_env.save/reset state for external use — ocaml/ocaml#14738
  • errortrace.mli gains a new Kind_differ error variant for better reporting of mismatched privacy levels on object method types — ocaml/ocaml#14738

    • Overview

  • Activity concentrated in ocaml/ocaml; ocaml/RFCs had no new activity this week
  • 12 PRs merged in ocaml/ocaml spanning typechecker correctness, memory optimization, runtime fixes, and build system improvements
  • 7 new PRs/issues opened across stdlib, runtime, and documentation areas, including multiple competing implementations for ocaml/ocaml#14658 (OCAMLRUNPARAM unit suffixes)
  • 14 individual contributors active in ocaml/ocaml this week, led by Florian Angeletti, Samuel Vivien, Gabriel Scherer, and Antonin Décimo

    • Activity

  • Merged — Florian Angeletti fixed a spurious syntactic arity error for module-dependent arrow types — ocaml/ocaml#14721, closes ocaml/ocaml#14719
  • Merged — Florian Angeletti reduced typechecker memory use during exhaustiveness counter-example search by scoping type node pools to individual branches — ocaml/ocaml#14727
  • Merged — Samuel Vivien simplified field-kind handling in eqtype and moregen — ocaml/ocaml#14738 — and unified the order of missing-field checks between the two functions — ocaml/ocaml#14737
  • Merged — Antonin Décimo enabled -Wwrite-strings throughout the C runtime — ocaml/ocaml#14666 — followed by a Cygwin build fix it exposed — ocaml/ocaml#14751
  • Merged — Nicolás Ojeda Bär fixed an uninitialized malloc in ocamlyacc's symtab.c that could produce incorrect line directives — ocaml/ocaml#14748, closes ocaml/ocaml#14747
  • Merged — Stephen Dolan added overflow checking to caml_ba_reshape fixing an out-of-bounds read/segfault — ocaml/ocaml#14691, closes ocaml/ocaml#14655 and ocaml/ocaml#14674
  • Merged — David Allsopp hardened ocamltest to reject expect tests that use include and fixed AFL test noise — ocaml/ocaml#14749
  • Merged — @hhugo fixed swapped None/Some branches in bytecomp/dll.ml open_dll when upgrading a DLL from checking to execution mode — ocaml/ocaml#14703
  • Merged — Brandon Stride added a regression test for the rectypes keep-expansion fix — ocaml/ocaml#14730, covers ocaml/ocaml#11648
  • Newly opened — Stefan Muenzel opened ocaml/ocaml#14754 to fix cyclic types introduced by with type module constraints by rechecking well-foundedness after applying them
  • Newly opened — Stefan Muenzel opened ocaml/ocaml#14746 to allow aliases when checking signature inclusion, fixing ocaml/ocaml#14204
  • Newly opened — Gabriel Scherer opened ocaml/ocaml#14759 to add C stubs for testing OCAMLRUNPARAM parsing directly
  • Newly opened — Yang Lin opened ocaml/ocaml#14757 to add explicit unit suffixes to memory-size OCAMLRUNPARAM options, and ocaml/ocaml#14755 to fix a broken link in testsuite/HACKING.adoc
  • Newly opened — Yihang "Corvo" Liu opened ocaml/ocaml#14756 adding kw/Mw/Gw, kB/MB/GB, and kiB/MiB/GiB suffixes to OCAMLRUNPARAM word-sized params, closing ocaml/ocaml#14658
  • Newly opened (bug) — 张睿 Zhang Rui reported an internal error in select_win32.c related to cross-list socket merging corrupting lpOrigIdx — ocaml/ocaml#14758
  • Closed without merge — Stefan Muenzel closed ocaml/ocaml#14736 after discovering it incorrectly accepted parameter-reordered types; superseded by ocaml/ocaml#14746

    • Notable Discussions

  • OCAMLRUNPARAM unit suffix design attracted discussion between Gabriel Scherer, Yang Lin, and Yihang "Corvo" Liu about whether to support MiB/MB/Mw or only IEC-style prefixes to avoid SI vs binary ambiguity — ocaml/ocaml#14757, ocaml/ocaml#14756, ocaml/ocaml#14658
  • ocamlyacc calloc vs malloc prompted an exchange between Xavier Leroy, Gabriel Scherer, and Nicolás Ojeda Bär about whether zero-initialization by default hides bugs or reduces CVE risk in this legacy codebase — ocaml/ocaml#14748
  • Merging eqtype and moregen continued with Samuel Vivien landing two preparatory PRs (ocaml/ocaml#14738, ocaml/ocaml#14737) and opening ocaml/ocaml#14739 for the final merge; Jacques Garrigue noted subtle differences in variable handling — ocaml/ocaml#14364
  • Mass typo-fix PR policy sparked debate when ocaml/ocaml#14752 was submitted fixing occured → occurred across ocamldoc; Florian Angeletti expressed concern about accepting PRs optimising GitHub metrics, with Gabriel Scherer ultimately merging and closing the discussion

    • Emerging Trends

  • Ephemeron GC refactoring is a multi-PR campaign by Gabriel Scherer building on ocaml/ocaml#14720: ocaml/ocaml#14732 refactors phase-change helpers, ocaml/ocaml#14734 fixes orphaning during sweep phase, ocaml/ocaml#14733 clarifies ephemeron counters, and ocaml/ocaml#14735 introduces higher-level list operations
  • C compiler warnings cleanup is an ongoing effort by Antonin Décimo: -Wwrite-strings landed this week (ocaml/ocaml#14666) and -Wformat-signedness (ocaml/ocaml#14694) is open for review
  • Typechecker diagnostics improvements feature prominently this week: object-type privacy errors (ocaml/ocaml#14738), signature-inclusion alias errors (ocaml/ocaml#14746), and arity error fixes (ocaml/ocaml#14721) all landed or are in review
  • Atomic stdlib expansion: Atomic.update merged (ocaml/ocaml#10798) and Atomic.fold_update (ocaml/ocaml#14725) is proposed as a follow-up to support pop-style operations on lock-free data structures

    • Multicore

    Low-activity week; eio saw a Windows backend CPU spin bug identified and an unlink PR awaiting review.

    Overview

  • Activity this week was limited to ocaml-multicore/eio; all other repositories (domainslib, ocaml-uring, meio, saturn, eio-trace, picos, kcas, ocaml-iomux) had no recorded activity
  • Two open threads in eio: a pending PR for Eio.Path.unlink (ocaml-multicore/eio#833) and a newly filed Windows backend bug (ocaml-multicore/eio#837)

    • Activity

  • Volker Diels-Grabsch followed up on ocaml-multicore/eio#833, which adds a missing_ok parameter to Eio.Path.unlink (tracking the underlying request in ocaml-multicore/eio#828), asking Thomas Leonard for guidance on what changes are needed for the PR to be accepted
  • 张睿 Zhang Rui filed ocaml-multicore/eio#837 reporting 100% CPU usage on Windows with the eio_windows backend when using Fiber.both and Eio.Flow.copy for bidirectional TCP proxy workloads; the same pattern works correctly on Linux

    • Notable Discussions

  • In ocaml-multicore/eio#837, 张睿 Zhang Rui traced the Windows CPU spin to lib/eio_windows/sched.ml: the update function does not remove a file descriptor from to_write when transitioning to read-only mode (and vice versa), causing both read and write events to be polled simultaneously and spinning the scheduler; a locally patched version confirmed the fix resolves the issue

    • Emerging Trends

  • Windows backend correctness in ocaml-multicore/eio is surfacing as an area needing attention: ocaml-multicore/eio#837 exposes a latent poll-set bookkeeping bug in eio_windows that causes busy-looping under real-world bidirectional I/O workloads, suggesting Windows-specific code paths may benefit from more systematic review and testing
entry.summary: opam 2.5.1 security release, OxCaml gains scannable axes and metaprogramming beta, dune targets 3.23.0, and odoc/js_of_ocaml add OxCaml support.

entry.title: Week 15, 2026: Dune 3.22.2, merlin v5.7.0-504, and ocaml-lsp 1.26.0 released; OCaml keep-expansion typechecker merged; OxCaml sets Runtime 5 as default.
entry.content:
Weekly Summary

New Features

  • OCaml Core Primitive aliases (implementing ocaml/RFCs#44) landed via ocaml/ocaml#13377, enabling external foo = Bar.baz syntax to alias C primitives; contributed by Nailen Matschke, reviewed by Jeremy Yallop, Leo White, and Florian Angeletti
  • OCaml Core Atomic.update merged via ocaml/ocaml#10798, adding a retry-loop helper ('a -> 'a) -> 'a t -> unit to Atomic, Atomic.Loc, and Atomic.Array; contributed by Gabriel Scherer
  • OCaml Core Format.pp_print_iarray added via ocaml/ocaml#14724 and Format.pp_print_dynarray via ocaml/ocaml#14726, both by Olivier Nicole, filling stdlib gaps noted in ocaml/ocaml#14320
  • OCaml Core ocamltest cold predicate introduced via ocaml/ocaml#14713 by Gabriel Scherer, allowing tests to be disabled by default and run only when explicitly requested, closing ocaml/ocaml#12418
  • OxCaml Runtime 5 is now the default in oxcaml/oxcaml#5780
  • OxCaml Custom user-defined [@@or_null] declarations with custom constructor names now supported, generalising the built-in Null/This representation (oxcaml/oxcaml#5668)
  • OxCaml Texp_apply_layout node added to the typed AST for layout-polymorphic function instantiation (oxcaml/oxcaml#5634)
  • OxCaml New reversible name mangling scheme added, enabling full module path reconstruction from mangled symbols (oxcaml/oxcaml#5099)
  • OxCaml -Ix flag added for include paths where .cmx files are guaranteed available, threading cmx_guaranteed through the persistent env (oxcaml/oxcaml#5654)
  • OxCaml Small integer shift intrinsics added to the backend (oxcaml/oxcaml#5814); prologue shrink-wrap enabled by default (oxcaml/oxcaml#5762)
  • OxCaml Bigarray construction routines now return @ unique values (oxcaml/oxcaml#5767)
  • OxCaml Merlin OCaml 5.4 compatibility: opam dependency bumped to >= 5.4 & < 5.5, base-effects conflict removed, and ocaml_ignored_flags expanded for new OxCaml backend flags (oxcaml/merlin#227)
  • OCaml Tools Dune watch-mode tracing adds trace events for watch-mode iterations via ocaml/dune#14163, enabling profiling of incremental builds, by Rudi Grinberg
  • OCaml Tools dune init start-file scaffolds the recommended entry point for driving dune in watch mode (ocaml/dune#14083); dune internal sexp-pp pretty-prints s-expressions for debugging dune files (ocaml/dune#14068); --deps flag to dune rules prints rule dependencies directly (ocaml/dune#14071); all by Rudi Grinberg
  • OCaml Tools Dune extracted_files field in the rocq.extraction stanza prevents extracted non-OCaml files from being wiped on subsequent builds (ocaml/dune#13997)
  • OCaml Tools Dune copy action extended to support directory targets, a prerequisite for Melange runtime asset promotion (ocaml/dune#14059)
  • OCaml Tools Merlin refactor-extract-region experimental command for extracting a code region into a fresh let binding, released in v5.7.0-504 via ocaml/merlin#1948
  • OCaml Tools Merlin enhancements: "Other" variant in locate-types results (ocaml/merlin#2025), -end-position to enclosing command (ocaml/merlin#2029), and multiple signature help fixes (ocaml/merlin#2023, ocaml/merlin#2032, ocaml/merlin#2036)
  • OCaml Tools ocaml-lsp 1.26.0 ships ocamllsp/refactorExtract (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1545), destruct (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1583), and locate_types (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1584) custom LSP requests
  • OCaml Tools textDocument/rangeFormatting standard LSP support added to ocaml-lsp, enabling format-on-selection in editors (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1591)
  • OCaml Tools ocaml-lsp build system agnosticism via $OCAMLLSP_PROJECT_BUILD_SYSTEM and $OCAMLLSP_PROJECT_ROOT environment variables, breaking the previous Dune-only assumption (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1600)
  • OCaml Tools Wasm dynlink and toplevel support merged into wasm_of_ocaml after development since February: loads .wasmo/.wasma files, supports Dynlink.loadfile, builds interactive toplevels, and adds --dynlink, --toplevel, --no-cmis, --export CLI flags (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2187) by Jérôme Vouillon
  • OCaml Ecosystem New ocaml-ai-sdk (0.1) by José Nogueira: type-safe provider-agnostic AI SDK with Anthropic and OpenAI backends (ocaml/opam-repository#29679)

  • Runtime 5 is now the default in oxcaml/oxcaml#5780
