  • OCaml Tools Improved Dune Windows cache with hard links in ocaml/dune#13714 and correct read-only file handling in ocaml/dune#13713 by Roven Gabriel
  • OCaml Tools Fixed Dune relative path handling in %{bin:..} and %{bin-available:..} in ocaml/dune#13712 by Antonio Nuno Monteiro
  • OCaml Tools Fixed Dune memo system deadlock checking for self-dependency cycles in ocaml/dune#13710 by Antonio Nuno Monteiro
  • OCaml Tools Added Merlin experimental refactor-extract-region command in ocaml/merlin#1948 by Tim ats
  • OCaml Tools Added OCaml-LSP range formatting support via textDocument/rangeFormatting in ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1591 by Brian Ward
  • OCaml Tools Added OCaml-LSP locate types custom request (ocamllsp/locateTypes) in ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1584 by Xavier Van de Woestyne
  • OCaml Tools Added OCaml-LSP refactor extract custom query (ocamllsp/refactorExtract) in ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1545 by Tim ats
  • OCaml Ecosystem Fixed exercise sorting to display numerically instead of alphabetically in ocaml/ocaml.org#3553 by Lucas Rodrigues
  • OCaml Ecosystem Fixed solution visibility bug in exercises page in ocaml/ocaml.org#3548 by @leevicode

    • Group Activity Summaries

    OCaml Ecosystem

    Exercise page fixes merged and governance calendar features under development

    New Features

  • Fixed exercise sorting on exercises page to display numerically (1, 2, 3...) instead of alphabetically (1, 10, 100...) by Lucas Rodrigues in ocaml/ocaml.org#3553
  • Fixed solution visibility bug where solutions were incorrectly shown when Statement tab was selected in exercises page by @leevicode in ocaml/ocaml.org#3548

    • Overview

  • ocaml/ocaml.org received two bug fixes for the exercises page and several new PRs for governance calendar features
  • Exercise page improvements from new contributors addressed sorting and display issues reported in ocaml/ocaml.org#3552 and ocaml/ocaml.org#3544
  • Governance infrastructure development expanded with ICS calendar scraping and iCal export capabilities in ocaml/ocaml.org#3550 and ocaml/ocaml.org#3536
  • Internationalization work continued with mt_caret seeking feedback on language support implementation in ocaml/ocaml.org#3238

    • Activity

  • sabine opened two PRs for governance features: ICS calendar scraper to pull events from platform team calendars in ocaml/ocaml.org#3550 and draft governance dev meetings calendar page with iCal export in ocaml/ocaml.org#3536
  • mt_caret continues work on internationalization support for tutorial documentation with language frontmatter tags and Japanese translation example, seeking feedback on approach in ocaml/ocaml.org#3238
  • Automated OCaml Planet content scrapers merged new blog posts throughout the week in ocaml/ocaml.org#3546, ocaml/ocaml.org#3547, ocaml/ocaml.org#3549, and ocaml/ocaml.org#3554
  • New platform releases scraper PR opened for tracking platform version updates in ocaml/ocaml.org#3551
  • Guillaume Munch-Maccagnoni reported missing math formatting in documentation pages via KaTeX not displaying properly in odoc-generated pages in ocaml/ocaml.org#3233

    • Emerging Trends

  • Exercise page improvements gaining momentum with contributions from Lucas Rodrigues and @leevicode addressing sorting bugs in ocaml/ocaml.org#3552 and display issues in ocaml/ocaml.org#3544
  • Governance infrastructure development expanding with calendar-based features for platform team meetings, including ICS scraping in ocaml/ocaml.org#3550 and iCal export capabilities in ocaml/ocaml.org#3536 related to ocaml/ocaml.org#3305
  • Content internationalization advancing with Japanese translation infrastructure and language selector implementation awaiting community feedback in ocaml/ocaml.org#3238
  • Documentation rendering issues remain unresolved with math formatting via KaTeX not displaying properly in odoc-generated pages reported in ocaml/ocaml.org#3233

    • OCaml Tools

    Package management improvements, LSP refactoring features, and OCaml 5.5 support work across tooling ecosystem

    New Features

  • Dune tar extraction compatibility on systems with non-auto-detecting tar implementations (e.g., OpenBSD) by passing explicit decompression flags in ocaml/dune#13688 by Ali Caglayan
  • Dune Windows cache now uses hard links for better performance (ocaml/dune#13714) and correctly handles renames onto read-only files during deduplication (ocaml/dune#13713) by Roven Gabriel
  • Dune relative path handling in %{bin:..} and %{bin-available:..} now interprets paths correctly relative to the dune file location in ocaml/dune#13712 by Antonio Nuno Monteiro
  • Dune memo system deadlock fix checking for self-dependency cycles before blocking on ivar in ocaml/dune#13710 by Antonio Nuno Monteiro, resolving issue from 2022 (ocaml/dune#5771)
  • Merlin experimental refactor-extract-region command for extracting code regions into fresh let bindings in ocaml/merlin#1948 by Tim ats
  • OCaml-LSP range formatting support via textDocument/rangeFormatting request enables formatting selected code regions while preserving context in ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1591 by Brian Ward
  • OCaml-LSP locate types custom request (ocamllsp/locateTypes) returns tree representation of all types composing an expression's type in ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1584 by Xavier Van de Woestyne
  • OCaml-LSP refactor extract custom query (ocamllsp/refactorExtract) provides commands to extract arbitrary code regions into fresh let bindings in ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1545 by Tim ats

    • Overview

  • Dune led activity with extensive package management improvements including tar extraction fixes (ocaml/dune#13688), Windows cache enhancements (ocaml/dune#13714, ocaml/dune#13713), and resolution of long-standing bugs from 2022-2024
  • OCaml-LSP delivered new refactoring capabilities with range formatting (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1591), type location queries (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1584), and extract commands (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1545)
  • Merlin merged experimental refactor-extract-region command (ocaml/merlin#1948) enabling code extraction into let bindings
  • OCaml 5.5 support work initiated in ocsigen/jsofocaml#2195 and requested for ocaml/odoc#1401
  • Opam received Windows compatibility fixes (ocaml/opam#6862) and UI action ordering improvements (ocaml/opam#6864)
  • Cross-repository refactoring work coordinated between Tim ats in Merlin and OCaml-LSP for code extraction features
  • No activity reported in ocaml/ocamlfind or ocaml-dune/spawn repositories

    • Activity

  • Dune 3.22.0 release draft opened by Shon Feder in ocaml/dune#13718 with nine new PRs opened this week including ppx cookie collection (ocaml/dune#13737), trace file placement (ocaml/dune#13735), and Rocq module error handling (ocaml/dune#13733)
  • jsofocaml OCaml 5.5 support draft PR created by @hhugo with 11,849 additions across 73 files (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2195), following issue request by Kate (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2193)
  • OCaml-LSP jump functionality performance improvements opened by PixieDust showing response time improvements from 523ms to 244ms (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1461)
  • Odoc markdown backend improvements proposed by David Sancho for OCaml code block formatting consistency (ocaml/odoc#1403)
  • Opam-file-format documentation issue reported by Greg Troxel regarding missing menhir dependency information in README (ocaml/opam-file-format#64)
  • Merlin CI workflow fixed by Ulysse updating OCaml-LSP repository URL (ocaml/merlin#2044)
  • jsofocaml runtime and compiler fixes prepared for merge by Jérôme Vouillon addressing wasm runtime issues (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2192) and global flow optimizations (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2194)

    • Notable Discussions

  • Archive decompression support requested by Marek Kubica for XZ (ocaml/dune#13715) and LZMA (ocaml/dune#13716) compressed tarballs in Dune
  • Dune CI testing improvements proposed by Shon Feder to test lower bounds and package correctness (ocaml/dune#13731), with packaging misconfiguration reported for dune-action-trace (ocaml/dune#13732)
  • OCaml-LSP range formatting approach debated by Sidharth Kshatriya, Brian Ward, and Xavier Van de Woestyne about handling code snippets versus whole documents (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1591)
  • Opam-file-format build dependency documentation discussed after Greg Troxel encountered menhir requirement not mentioned in README while updating pkgsrc package (ocaml/opam-file-format#64)
  • Merlin OxCaml compatibility bug reported by Ben Lieberman where Merlin enters debugger repeatedly when using OxCaml with Emacs (ocaml/merlin#2045)
  • jsofocaml wasmofocaml support limitations identified requiring Jérôme Vouillon's attention for OCaml 5.5 compatibility (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2193)

    • Emerging Trends

  • Package management robustness continues as focus area with comprehensive work on archive extraction, lock file handling, depext filtering, and autolocking across multiple Dune PRs by Ali Caglayan
  • Windows platform support receiving dedicated attention with Dune cache improvements (ocaml/dune#13714, ocaml/dune#13713) and opam MSYS2 build fixes (ocaml/opam#6862)
  • Long-standing bug resolution with closure of Dune issues from 2022-2024 including infinite loop in cycle checking (ocaml/dune#5771), OpenBSD tar compatibility (ocaml/dune#10123), and relative path handling (ocaml/dune#9564)
  • Custom LSP request expansion continues with new specialized extensions for type location (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1584) and code refactoring (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1545), building on pattern established by earlier custom requests
  • Merlin integration driving new features with multiple OCaml-LSP PRs depending on corresponding Merlin implementations for jump functionality (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1461) and extraction commands (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1545)
  • OCaml 5.5 preparation gaining momentum across tooling ecosystem with support work in jsofocaml (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2195) and requests for odoc updates (ocaml/odoc#1401)
  • Cross-platform compatibility improvements addressing OpenBSD tar implementations, Windows cache behavior, and preparing for broader archive format support (XZ, LZMA)

    • OxCaml

    48 PRs merged across compiler and tooling with focus on backend optimization and type system refinement

    New Features

  • Improved register allocation by only reloading (not spilling) loop invariant registers in oxcaml/oxcaml#5514 by @ttebbi-janestreet
  • Optimized shift operations by eliminating unnecessary sign extensions on shift amounts in oxcaml/oxcaml#5535 by @ttebbi-janestreet
  • Avoided redundant sign extensions in Cmm builtins returning int32 in oxcaml/oxcaml#5550 by @ttebbi-janestreet
  • Fixed loop optimization bug in the split pass in oxcaml/oxcaml#5542 by Xavier Clerc
  • Fixed loop optimization bug in the split pass in oxcaml/oxcaml#5542 by Xavier Clerc
  • Replaced array block index syntax with explicit %unsafearrayidx primitives in oxcaml/oxcaml#5556 by Ryan Tjoa
  • Optimized block index bounds checking by shifting instead of masking in oxcaml/oxcaml#5328 by Ryan Tjoa
  • Fixed missing mode-crossing in functional record update in oxcaml/oxcaml#5564 by Stephen Dolan
  • Fixed inlining bug in classic mode with void parameters in oxcaml/oxcaml#5555 by Mark Shinwell
  • Fixed inlining bug in classic mode with void parameters in oxcaml/oxcaml#5555 by Mark Shinwell
  • Prevented failure when rewriting types for value slots with no sources in oxcaml/oxcaml#5547 by Nathanaëlle Courant
  • Prevented fatal errors when unused symbol fields are unboxed in oxcaml/oxcaml#5540 by Nathanaëlle Courant
  • Refactored let-bound variable rewriting to reduce code complexity in oxcaml/oxcaml#5541 by Nathanaëlle Courant
  • Replaced assert false with informative fatal errors in oxcaml/oxcaml#5549 by Mark Shinwell
  • Fixed ordering of cannot_unbox0 rules in oxcaml/oxcaml#5528 by Nathanaëlle Courant
  • Fixed type rewriting to include constant types in oxcaml/oxcaml#5391 by Basile Clément
  • Fixed type rewriting to include constant types in oxcaml/oxcaml#5391 by Basile Clément
  • Added static computation framework with new tlambda→slambda→rawlambda pipeline in oxcaml/oxcaml#5430 by Jack Rickard
  • Made name mangling scheme configurable via configure options in oxcaml/oxcaml#5097 by Tim McGilchrist
  • Exposed Domain.maxdomaincount for reliable multicore detection in oxcaml/oxcaml#5522 by Stephen Dolan
  • Exposed Domain.maxdomaincount for reliable multicore detection in oxcaml/oxcaml#5522 by Stephen Dolan
  • Added comprehensive CFI/DWARF backtrace testing with gdb validation in oxcaml/oxcaml#5409 by Stephen Dolan
  • Expanded codegen test coverage for intrinsics and builtins (3300+ lines) in oxcaml/oxcaml#5489 by @ttebbi-janestreet
  • Expanded codegen test coverage for intrinsics and builtins (3300+ lines) in oxcaml/oxcaml#5489 by @ttebbi-janestreet
  • Improved type recovery in function applications with argument type mismatches in local opens, fixing "Not in environment" errors in oxcaml/merlin#222 by Liam Stevenson
  • Synchronized with upstream OCaml compiler version 5.2.0minus-32 including updates to jkind system, mode analysis, and type system internals in oxcaml/merlin#224 by Liam Stevenson
  • Synchronized with upstream OCaml compiler version 5.2.0minus-32 including updates to jkind system, mode analysis, and type system internals in oxcaml/merlin#224 by Liam Stevenson

    • Activity

  • New PRs in oxcaml/oxcaml: 22 pull requests opened including slambda fracturing implementation in oxcaml/oxcaml#5544 by Jack Rickard, AVX2 gather instructions fix in oxcaml/oxcaml#5567 by Max Slater, abstract kinds for recursive modules in oxcaml/oxcaml#5517 by Chris Casinghino, and CFG terminator simplification series (oxcaml/oxcaml#5545, oxcaml/oxcaml#5546, oxcaml/oxcaml#5562) by Xavier Clerc
  • 5.4 merge progress in oxcaml/oxcaml: Continued conflict resolution with .mli files in oxcaml/oxcaml#5557, bytecomp in oxcaml/oxcaml#5426, and tools/ in oxcaml/oxcaml#5503 by David Allsopp and Simon Spies
  • Signature help enhancements in oxcaml/merlin: Charlène_Gros opened four PRs for labelled-only arguments tests in oxcaml/merlin#205, optional argument fix in oxcaml/merlin#216, let..in binding issues in oxcaml/merlin#223, and unfinished let...in test cases in oxcaml/merlin#215
  • Package publication in oxcaml/opam-repository: Nirnay Roy opened oxcaml/opam-repository#35 asking about publishing the nx-oxcaml package from the raven project to opam

    • Notable Discussions

  • Type recovery implementation strategy in oxcaml/merlin: Ulysse and Liam Stevenson discussed the fix for oxcaml/merlin#222, discovering the solution was already implemented upstream in commit 732bd24, leading to cherry-picking the upstream approach instead of the original implementation
  • Signature help downstream coordination in oxcaml/merlin: Charlène_Gros informed Kostia Balytskyi in oxcaml/merlin#216 about fixes merged in upstream ocaml/merlin#2032 and requested review
  • CI troubleshooting in oxcaml/merlin: Charlène_Gros and Liam Stevenson resolved CI failures in oxcaml/merlin#205 on labelled arguments tests caused by unrelated file changes, fixed by rebasing onto main

    • Emerging Trends

  • Backend performance focus in oxcaml/oxcaml: Series of optimizations targeting elimination of unnecessary operations including sign extensions (oxcaml/oxcaml#5535, oxcaml/oxcaml#5550), redundant register spills (oxcaml/oxcaml#5514), and improved bounds checking (oxcaml/oxcaml#5328)
  • Unboxed types API maturation in oxcaml/oxcaml: Refinement of primitive APIs with explicit %unsafearrayidx in oxcaml/oxcaml#5556, better safety boundaries between safe and unsafe operations, and mode-crossing fixes in oxcaml/oxcaml#5564
  • Reaper robustness improvements in oxcaml/oxcaml: Systematic bug fixing including error handling (oxcaml/oxcaml#5547, oxcaml/oxcaml#5540, oxcaml/oxcaml#5549), type rewriting (oxcaml/oxcaml#5391, oxcaml/oxcaml#5528), and code simplification (oxcaml/oxcaml#5541)
  • Static evaluation infrastructure in oxcaml/oxcaml: New compilation pipeline (tlambda→slambda→rawlambda) introduced in oxcaml/oxcaml#5430 with follow-up slambda fracturing in oxcaml/oxcaml#5544 by Jack Rickard
  • Test coverage expansion across repositories: Comprehensive CFI/DWARF testing in oxcaml/oxcaml#5409, codegen test suite (3300+ lines) in oxcaml/oxcaml#5489, and signature help test cases in oxcaml/merlin (oxcaml/merlin#205, oxcaml/merlin#215)
  • Signature help refinement in oxcaml/merlin: Focused development from Charlène_Gros addressing edge cases in labelled arguments (oxcaml/merlin#205), optional parameters (oxcaml/merlin#216), and incomplete let bindings (oxcaml/merlin#215, oxcaml/merlin#223)

    • OCaml Core

    OCaml compiler saw 15 PRs merged and 14 new PRs opened, with focus on type system fixes, runtime improvements, and OCaml 5.5 regressions

    New Features

  • Added ocaml/ocaml#14525 Fun.todo function to signal unimplemented functionality, with code location support and optional todo alert for detecting remaining placeholder code (merged by Olivier Nicole, closing long-standing ocaml/ocaml#13072)
  • Improved ocaml/ocaml#14512 warning 16 (unerasable-optional-argument) detection to properly handle module-dependent function types (Tfunctor) introduced in OCaml 5.5 (merged by Alistair, fixing regression ocaml/ocaml#14622)
  • Optimized ocaml/ocaml#14620 UTF-8 lexeme processing in the compiler for better performance (merged by Gabriel Scherer)
  • Made continuation objects more efficient by reducing from two fields to one in ocaml/ocaml#14469 (backported to trunk via ocaml/ocaml#14613)
  • Fixed ocaml/ocaml#14604 uncaught Cannot_apply exception when mixing polymorphic types and unboxed constructors (merged by Gabriel Scherer, fixing ocaml/ocaml#14603)

    • Overview

  • The core group saw focused activity exclusively in ocaml/ocaml with 15 PRs merged and 14 new PRs opened during week 10
  • ocaml/RFCs had no activity this week
  • Primary focus areas included type system fixes for OCaml 5.5 regressions, runtime cleanup and domain management, performance optimizations, and continued work on complex type system refactorings
  • 34 contributors participated in code review, issue reporting, and development across ocaml/ocaml
  • Multiple OCaml 5.5 regressions were identified and addressed, particularly related to the new Tfunctor type constructor introduced by modular explicits in ocaml/ocaml#14622, ocaml/ocaml#14630, and ocaml/ocaml#14629

    • Activity

  • Type System: ocaml/ocaml#14611 opened to keep expansion rebase well-founded, continuing work on long-standing ocaml/ocaml#11648 (by Jacques Garrigue)
  • Type System: ocaml/ocaml#14625 opened addressing recursive modules and module-dependent functions (by Vincent Laviron)
  • Type System: ocaml/ocaml#14626 opened to fix handling of module-dependent functions in warning 16 (by Alistair)
  • Type System: ocaml/ocaml#14624 opened documenting Tfunctor FIXMEs needing attention (by Gabriel Scherer)
  • Garbage Collection: ocaml/ocaml#14610 opened to consume budget when marking ephemerons (by Nick Barnes)
  • Runtime: ocaml/ocaml#14614 opened introducing fatal error when unjoined domains remain at cleanup-on-exit, addressing issues in ocaml/ocaml#14594 (by Gabriel Scherer)
  • Security: ocaml/ocaml#14615 opened to fix CVE-2026-28364 (by Caleb Wolfe)
  • Performance: ocaml/ocaml#14618 opened for faster unicode normalization in misc module (by Stefan Muenzel)
  • Documentation: ocaml/ocaml#14616 opened to document values given to MSVC prefetch intrinsics (by Antonin Décimo)
  • Tooling: ocaml/ocaml#14617 opened to make ocamldeprecatedcli alert fatal in compiler development flags (by Florian Angeletti)
  • Error Messages: Improved ocaml/ocaml#14600 type parameter error messages to clarify they are bound in type declarations (merged by Florian Angeletti, addressing ocaml/ocaml#6634)
  • Code Cleanup: Removed ocaml/ocaml#14601 impossible unbound error path in extension constructor declarations (merged by Florian Angeletti)
  • Dead Code: Removed ocaml/ocaml#14623 dead Ctype.arity code (merged by Gabriel Scherer)
  • CI Improvements: Disabled ocaml/ocaml#14612 in-prefix tests with --enable-tsan on Inria CI to avoid test failures (merged by Olivier Nicole)
  • Jenkins: Ensured ocaml/ocaml#14608 Jenkins workers always clean up installation (merged by David Allsopp)
  • Backports: Cherry-picked ocaml/ocaml#14613 continuation optimization from trunk (merged by Damien Doligez)
  • Backports: Re-added ocaml/ocaml#14609 missing commit from ocaml/ocaml#14547 (merged by David Allsopp)
  • Backports: Fixed ocaml/ocaml#14607 linking with libasmrun_shared.so on Risc-V for 4.14 branch (merged by David Allsopp)

    • Notable Discussions

  • Runtime Cleanup: Extensive discussion on ocaml/ocaml#14594 about segfaults and timeouts in parallel tests with cleanup-at-exit mode, exploring fundamental design questions about thread cancellation and resource cleanup, with follow-up PR ocaml/ocaml#14614 proposing fatal errors for unjoined domains
  • Feature Request: ocaml/ocaml#14627 proposing programmable patterns for OCaml to enable pattern matching on abstract types without exposing constructors, similar to Haskell's pattern synonyms and F#'s active patterns
  • Type System Regression: ocaml/ocaml#14622 reporting warning 16 incorrectly raised with GADTs and first-class modules in 5.5 (closed by ocaml/ocaml#14512, caused by modular explicits introducing Tfunctor type constructor)
  • Type System Regression: ocaml/ocaml#14630 about signature inference failure with recursive functions and first-class modules in 5.5, likely to be fixed by ocaml/ocaml#14537
  • Type System Regression: ocaml/ocaml#14629 about local open changing typechecker behavior for optional argument elimination in 5.5
  • Performance: ocaml/ocaml#14621 identifying tests taking too long on AppVeyor CI (some over 185 seconds, including forbidden.ml at 185s)
  • Stdlib: ocaml/ocaml#14619 questioning why List.concat/flatten is not tail-recursive

    • Emerging Trends

  • Multiple OCaml 5.5 regressions identified related to modular explicits and the new Tfunctor type constructor in ocaml/ocaml#14622, ocaml/ocaml#14630, and ocaml/ocaml#14629, highlighting need for systematic audits when introducing new type constructors
  • Continued active work on the complex keep-expansion type system refactoring in ocaml/ocaml#11648, with cross-review between Jacques Garrigue and Stefan Muenzel
  • Focus on runtime cleanup and domain management issues, particularly around cleanup-at-exit mode and proper resource management in ocaml/ocaml#14594 and ocaml/ocaml#14614
  • Performance optimization work focusing on UTF-8 processing in ocaml/ocaml#14620 and Unicode normalization in ocaml/ocaml#14618
  • Security vulnerability addressed with ocaml/ocaml#14615 fixing CVE-2026-28364

    • Multicore
entry.summary: 63 PRs merged with type system fixes, backend optimizations, and new developer tooling features

entry.title: Week 9, 2026: OCaml 5.5.0~alpha1 released with compiler cloning, Merlin 5.7-505~preview shipped, mosaic TUI framework launched, 40+ packages merged
entry.content:
Weekly Summary

New Features

  • OCaml Ecosystem OCaml 5.5.0~alpha1 compiler release by Florian Angeletti with new compiler-cloning meta-package enabling relocatable compiler switches that can be duplicated without recompilation when using the same compiler version and configuration (ocaml/opam-repository#29462)
  • OCaml Tools Merlin 5.7-505~preview editor integration release by Ulysse with Other variant for locate-types results, fixed record field autocompletion, and signature help improvements to stop looping over parameters once finished (ocaml/merlin releases, ocaml/opam-repository#29480)
  • OCaml Ecosystem Mosaic 0.1.0 terminal UI framework by Thibaut Mattio with React-inspired hooks, Elm Architecture (Model-View-Update), Flexbox and CSS Grid layout via Toffee engine, rich component library including Box/Text/Canvas/Code with syntax highlighting, designed for 60+ FPS performance with minimal allocations (ocaml/opam-repository#29312)
  • OCaml Ecosystem Matrix 0.1.0 low-level terminal library (part of mosaic) with immediate-mode runtime, full Unicode support, modern terminal protocols (Kitty keyboard, SGR mouse tracking, bracketed paste), native alpha blending, PTY/VTE support, and automatic capability detection (ocaml/opam-repository#29312)
  • OCaml Ecosystem Toffee 0.1.0 CSS layout engine ported from Rust Taffy implementing CSS Grid Level 1, Flexbox, and Block layout algorithms in pure OCaml with zero dependencies (ocaml/opam-repository#29312)
  • OCaml Ecosystem GitHub Actions tutorial guides users through setting up OCaml in CI workflows with practical examples (ocaml/ocaml.org#3458)
  • OCaml Ecosystem Docker tutorial explains using official OCaml Docker images for containerized development (ocaml/ocaml.org#3457)
  • OCaml Ecosystem OCaml-CI tutorial documents using OCaml's continuous integration service for projects (ocaml/ocaml.org#3456)
  • OCaml Ecosystem Completely rewritten opam switches tutorial with step-by-step walkthrough covering global vs local switches, creation, switching, and removal with updated examples for OCaml 5.4.0 (ocaml/ocaml.org#3526)
  • OCaml Ecosystem Governance dev meetings calendar page at /governance/dev-meetings-calendar with calendar-style view and iCal export capability (ocaml/ocaml.org#3536)
  • OCaml Ecosystem Mirage 4.10.5 with DHCP enabled by default and charrua 3.0 update, improving network configuration out-of-the-box for unikernels (ocaml/opam-repository#29454)
  • OCaml Ecosystem DNS 10.2.4 with improved resolver error propagation through new Dns_client.request_error variant, providing better visibility into DNS resolution failures (ocaml/opam-repository#29455)
  • OCaml Ecosystem Lwt 6.1.1 with new Lwt_stream.create_and_push function for creating streams with an explicit push function, enabling imperative stream construction (ocaml/opam-repository#29449)
  • OCaml Ecosystem kqueue 0.7.0 adds EVFILT_USER and EVFILT_SIGNAL event filters, simpler event addition interface avoiding record/callback allocation, and fold for events operation (ocaml/opam-repository#29489)
  • OCaml Ecosystem conf-zlib 1 with extensive platform updates adding support for centos, suse, opensuse, freebsd, msys2 systems and improved fedora/debian compatibility (ocaml/opam-repository#29394)
  • OCaml Ecosystem conf-bzip2 1 with MinGW support via new conf-mingw-w64-bzip2 packages and cygwin fixes for systems without pkgconf (ocaml/opam-repository#29395)

    • Group Activity Summaries

    OCaml Ecosystem

    OCaml 5.5.0~alpha1 with compiler cloning released; major documentation and infrastructure improvements on ocaml.org

    New Features

  • OCaml 5.5.0~alpha1 compiler release by Florian Angeletti with new compiler-cloning meta-package enabling relocatable compiler switches that can be duplicated without recompilation when using the same compiler version and configuration (ocaml/opam-repository#29462)
  • Mosaic 0.1.0 terminal UI framework by Thibaut Mattio with React-inspired hooks, Elm Architecture (Model-View-Update), Flexbox and CSS Grid layout via Toffee engine, rich component library including Box/Text/Canvas/Code with syntax highlighting, designed for 60+ FPS performance with minimal allocations (ocaml/opam-repository#29312)
  • Matrix 0.1.0 low-level terminal library (part of mosaic) with immediate-mode runtime, full Unicode support, modern terminal protocols (Kitty keyboard, SGR mouse tracking, bracketed paste), native alpha blending, PTY/VTE support, and automatic capability detection (ocaml/opam-repository#29312)
  • Toffee 0.1.0 CSS layout engine ported from Rust Taffy implementing CSS Grid Level 1, Flexbox, and Block layout algorithms in pure OCaml with zero dependencies (ocaml/opam-repository#29312)
  • GitHub Actions tutorial guides users through setting up OCaml in CI workflows with practical examples (ocaml/ocaml.org#3458)
  • Docker tutorial explains using official OCaml Docker images for containerized development (ocaml/ocaml.org#3457)
  • OCaml-CI tutorial documents using OCaml's continuous integration service for projects (ocaml/ocaml.org#3456)
  • Completely rewritten opam switches tutorial with step-by-step walkthrough covering global vs local switches, creation, switching, and removal with updated examples for OCaml 5.4.0 (ocaml/ocaml.org#3526)
  • Governance dev meetings calendar page at /governance/dev-meetings-calendar with calendar-style view and iCal export capability (ocaml/ocaml.org#3536)
  • Mirage 4.10.5 with DHCP enabled by default and charrua 3.0 update, improving network configuration out-of-the-box for unikernels (ocaml/opam-repository#29454)
  • DNS 10.2.4 with improved resolver error propagation through new Dns_client.request_error variant, providing better visibility into DNS resolution failures (ocaml/opam-repository#29455)
  • Lwt 6.1.1 with new Lwt_stream.create_and_push function for creating streams with an explicit push function, enabling imperative stream construction (ocaml/opam-repository#29449)
  • kqueue 0.7.0 adds EVFILT_USER and EVFILT_SIGNAL event filters, simpler event addition interface avoiding record/callback allocation, and fold for events operation (ocaml/opam-repository#29489)
  • conf-zlib 1 with extensive platform updates adding support for centos, suse, opensuse, freebsd, msys2 systems and improved fedora/debian compatibility (ocaml/opam-repository#29394)
  • conf-bzip2 1 with MinGW support via new conf-mingw-w64-bzip2 packages and cygwin fixes for systems without pkgconf (ocaml/opam-repository#29395)

    • Activity

  • OCaml 5.5.0 release tracking with new issue ocaml/opam-repository#29463 opened by Florian Angeletti to track platform tools and ecosystem readiness for OCaml 5.5, replacing closed 5.4.0 tracking issue (ocaml/opam-repository#27916)
  • Raven 1.0.0~alpha3 draft PR ocaml/opam-repository#29490 by Thibaut Mattio includes major ML framework rewrite with new nx-oxcaml pure-OCaml tensor backend using SIMD approaching C backend performance, kaun-board TUI training monitor, brot tokenization library (renamed from saga) claiming 1.3-6x speedup over HuggingFace, unified Nx/Rune tensor types, and complete quill notebook rewrite with terminal UI and web frontend
  • TextMate grammars ecosystem emerging with tm-grammars 1.0.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29474) by David Sancho bundling multiple language grammars (initially proposed as 40+ separate packages, consolidated to single package with sub-libraries following Anil Madhavapeddy suggestion) and textmate-language 0.5.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29488) by Alan fixing OCaml grammar compatibility and handling captures as lists
  • Syndic 1.8.0 RSS/Atom parser PR ocaml/opam-repository#29478 by Calascibetta Romain fixing timezone handling for RFC822 dates, adding documentation contributions, and allowing selectively relaxed parsing rules, awaiting OCaml version constraint fix
  • elpi 3.5.0 PR ocaml/opam-repository#29470 by Enrico Tassi closed after discussion of OCaml 4.14 arm64 assembler errors; maintainer will release 3.6 using menhir --table mode to reduce code size and avoid OCaml compiler bug affecting 4.14.2-4.14.3, following suggestion by Xavier Leroy
  • ortools 9.15.0-1 update PR ocaml/opam-repository#29483 by Timothy Bourke removes eigen3 depext and adjusts conf-zlib/conf-bzip2 dependencies after recent work on those packages; Linux and macOS builds working but MSYS2 fails on zlib detection
  • Eliom ecosystem updates with Eliom 12.0.1 (ocaml/opam-repository#29481), ocsigen-start 8.0.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29467), and ocsigen-toolkit 4.2.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29457) by Vincent Balat advancing the web/mobile application framework
  • Web framework additions including vif 0.0.1~beta2 (ocaml/opam-repository#29458) simple web framework for OCaml 5 with effect handlers, mhttp 0.0.1 HTTP implementation for unikernels, and htmlofjsx 0.0.8 (ocaml/opam-repository#29453) for rendering HTML with JSX syntax, all by Calascibetta Romain
  • Relocatability initiative via PR ocaml/opam-repository#29451 by David Allsopp adding relocatable virtual package to indicate relocatable packages for Dune package management, with conflicts added to all compilers < 5.5, ocamlfind, and ocamlbuild
  • Build system refactoring replaced ood-gen code generator with data-packer and data-scrape on ocaml.org, reducing CPU usage by 2.5x and output size by 7x while improving build times by 15% (ocaml/ocaml.org#3463)
  • RSS feed repair removed debug output from data-packer that was breaking planet.xml, news.xml, and other feeds with prepended loader messages (ocaml/ocaml.org#3530)
  • Extensive markdown linting and typo fixes on ocaml.org across 87 exercise files (ocaml/ocaml.org#3494), root-level and developer docs (ocaml/ocaml.org#3493), and 50+ data files (ocaml/ocaml.org#3495) improving consistency and fixing broken links
  • Platform Newsletter for November 2025 to January 2026 added with changelog announcements for OCaml 5.4.1, 4.14.3, and Dune 3.21.1 releases (ocaml/ocaml.org#3519, ocaml/ocaml.org#3522, ocaml/ocaml.org#3524, ocaml/ocaml.org#3525)
  • MirageOS ecosystem activity with dns 10.2.4 (ocaml/opam-repository#29455) by Hannes Mehnert, mirage-crypto 2.0.3 (ocaml/opam-repository#29368) adding mirage-crypto-rng-mkernel, ocaml-solo5 1.2.1 (ocaml/opam-repository#29425) Solo5 bindings update
  • Configuration package improvements with conf-zlib updates (ocaml/opam-repository#29482) installing libz.a on fedora, conf-bzip2 cygwin fixes (ocaml/opam-repository#29485), conf-oniguruma pkgconf usage in win32 (ocaml/opam-repository#29469), and conf-sdl2 using sdl2-compat-devel for Fedora 42+ (ocaml/opam-repository#29437)
  • Merlin 5.7-505~preview (ocaml/opam-repository#29480) with improved type location and autocompletion merged, opam-publish 3.0.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29443) tool for repository contributions, unionFind 20260226 (ocaml/opam-repository#29468) data structure implementations by François Pottier
  • Navigation improvements on ocaml.org with governance page accessible via Community tab (ocaml/ocaml.org#3538) and infrastructure link added to Tools mobile dropdown (ocaml/ocaml.org#3542)
  • Academic institutions page updated with fixed course URLs for Ashoka University, Caltech CS 164, BITS Pilani, and archived links for Universidade da Beira Interior (ocaml/ocaml.org#3537)
  • Enhanced package documentation page with new section explaining automatic odoc generation via ocaml-docs-ci and improved missing docs error page with better reporting flow (ocaml/ocaml.org#3471)

    • Notable Discussions

  • MetaOCaml incorrectly installed with opam switch create ocaml-option-tsan command due to solver choosing ocaml-variants.x.y+BER with metaocaml as post-dependency instead of ocaml-variants.x.y+options, discussed in issue ocaml/opam-repository#28249 opened by Olivier Nicole with workaround suggestion to use explicit ocaml-variants.+options in switch creation; Alina Banerjee and KC Sivaramakrishnan provided working command, potential fix involves adding avoid-version flags to metaocaml packages
  • macOS switch cloning failure reported in issue ocaml/opam-repository#29479 where second switch creation for OCaml 5.5.0~alpha fails with "cannot create temp file for here document: Operation not permitted" error at line 23 of clone script, affecting heredoc operations; issue closed and redirected to opam repo issue #6861 by @jrfondren
  • TextMate grammars package design discussion in PR ocaml/opam-repository#29474 where Anil Madhavapeddy suggested consolidating 40+ individual tm-grammar- packages into single tm-grammars package with findlib submodules to reduce opam solver pressure while maintaining simple dependency cone; David Sancho agreed and updated PR accordingly
  • elpi assembler error in PR ocaml/opam-repository#29470 discussed by Enrico Tassi, Raphaël Proust, Xavier Leroy, and Anil Madhavapeddy where OCaml 4.14.2-4.14.3 arm64 compiler generates "conditional branch out of range" errors for large grammar.ml file; Xavier Leroy suggested using menhir --table mode to reduce code size and confirmed fix will be in OCaml 4.14.4
  • Discussion about opam 3.0 release announcement scope with Kate explaining that while version was bumped due to breaking changes (option prefixes disallowed, one option removed), the release consists mostly of fixes and niche features affecting only a small number of users (ocaml/ocaml.org#3498)
  • Conversation about governance dev meetings calendar feature request led to proposal for dedicated subpage rendering governance events alongside community events, with implementation now in progress (ocaml/ocaml.org#3305)
  • Immutable policy discussion continues in issue ocaml/opam-repository#29072 regarding stricter enforcement of package immutability, pin-depends usage, and reproducibility concerns raised by Hannes Mehnert
  • Package naming and renaming discussion in raven PR ocaml/opam-repository#29490 where Thibaut Mattio asks about defined process for renaming packages (saga→brot in this release), considering removal of previous raven packages from opam-repository given limited user base and stabilizing APIs

    • Emerging Trends

  • Terminal UI renaissance with multiple new frameworks including mosaic (React-inspired hooks, Elm Architecture, Flexbox/Grid) (ocaml/opam-repository#29312), kaun-board (ML training monitoring), vif (OCaml 5 effects-based web framework) (ocaml/opam-repository#29458), and windtrap (unified testing) (ocaml/opam-repository#29387) demonstrating growing interest in rich terminal applications
  • OCaml 5.x ecosystem maturity shown through 5.5.0~alpha1 release (ocaml/opam-repository#29462) with compiler cloning feature, effects-based libraries (vif, ciao_lwt migration tool ocaml/opam-repository#29477, ambient-context 0.2 with Eio support ocaml/opam-repository#29418), and runtime events integration (trace 0.12 ocaml/opam-repository#29471), indicating transition from experimental to production-ready effects usage
  • Machine learning investment visible in raven ecosystem evolution with pure-OCaml tensor backend (nx-oxcaml) using SIMD to approach C performance, specialized TUI tooling (kaun-board), high-performance tokenization (brot) (ocaml/opam-repository#29490), demonstrating commitment to competitive ML tooling in OCaml
  • Cross-platform and Windows support emphasis through extensive conf-package updates (conf-zlib adding centos/suse/opensuse/freebsd/msys2 ocaml/opam-repository#29394, conf-bzip2 MinGW support ocaml/opam-repository#29395, conf-oniguruma cygwin fixes ocaml/opam-repository#29469) and Windows-specific build system improvements, reducing historical Windows support gap
  • Package relocatability initiative via new relocatable virtual package (ocaml/opam-repository#29451) and compiler-cloning feature preparing ecosystem for Dune package management and improved switch portability
  • Documentation quality and onboarding focus with infrastructure tutorials (GitHub Actions, Docker, OCaml-CI) (ocaml/ocaml.org#3456, ocaml/ocaml.org#3457, ocaml/ocaml.org#3458), opam switches tutorial rewrite (ocaml/ocaml.org#3526), systematic markdown linting (ocaml/ocaml.org#3493, ocaml/ocaml.org#3494, ocaml/ocaml.org#3495), and improved navigation showing commitment to newcomer experience
  • Syntax highlighting ecosystem emerging with TextMate grammar support (tm-grammars, textmate-language) (ocaml/opam-repository#29474, ocaml/opam-repository#29488), tree-sitter integration, and Code component in mosaic, enabling consistent syntax highlighting across terminal applications
  • MirageOS unikernel development continues with DNS improvements (10.2.4 error propagation ocaml/opam-repository#29455), mirage 4.10.5 (DHCP by default ocaml/opam-repository#29454), new mhttp library, qcow 0.13.0 memory optimizations (ocaml/opam-repository#29420), and ocaml-solo5 updates (ocaml/opam-repository#29425) maintaining active unikernel ecosystem
  • Web framework diversity increasing with vif (effects-based), Eliom updates (12.0.1, ocsigen-start 8.0.0) (ocaml/opam-repository#29481, ocaml/opam-repository#29467), htmlofjsx (JSX syntax) (ocaml/opam-repository#29453), mhttp (unikernel HTTP), showing multiple approaches to web development in OCaml
  • Build system optimization emphasis with ocaml.org data-packer refactoring achieving 2.5x CPU reduction and 7x output size reduction (ocaml/ocaml.org#3463), showing attention to developer experience and CI performance

    • OCaml Tools

    OxCaml

    OCaml Core

    Multicore
entry.summary: OCaml 5.5.0~alpha1 released with compiler cloning, Merlin 5.7-505~preview shipped, mosaic TUI framework launched, 40+ packages merged

entry.title: Week 8, 2026: OCaml 5.4.1 and 4.14.3 released with bug fixes, 67 opam packages added, OxCaml advances type system and Merlin integration.
entry.content:
Weekly Summary

New Features

  • OCaml Core OCaml 5.4.1 released by Florian Angeletti providing bug fixes to the stable OCaml 5 series (ocaml/ocaml releases)
  • OCaml Core OCaml 4.14.3 released by Florian Angeletti continuing support for the OCaml 4.14 maintenance branch with bug fixes (ocaml/ocaml releases)
  • OCaml Core Exhaustiveness checking for ocamllex regular expressions with new warning showing examples of nonmatching input when rules don't cover all inputs, controllable with -w -missing-case flag (ocaml/ocaml#14448)
  • OCaml Core Array.foldleft2 and Array.foldright2 functions added to standard library for folding over two arrays simultaneously, raising Invalid_argument if arrays have different lengths (ocaml/ocaml#14553)
  • OCaml Core Improved runtime clarity with Scannable* macros replacing all comparisons against Noscan_tag for better legibility and correctness, fixing one bug in weak.c (ocaml/ocaml#14493)
  • OCaml Core Iarray API consistency updating Iarray module to expose 'a Iarray.t in function types rather than 'a iarray, making the built-in iarray type an implementation detail (ocaml/ocaml#14576)
  • OCaml Core Improved installation time in opam by shrinking Git-generated source archives to reduce installation time (ocaml/ocaml#14152)
  • OCaml Core Fix for --disable-unix-lib build allowing ocamltest to build correctly when configured with --disable-unix-lib (ocaml/ocaml#14558)
  • OCaml Core Linux ppc64 architecture detection for Linux distros targeting ELFv1 (like Debian), correctly setting the arch configure variable (ocaml/ocaml#14573)
  • OxCaml Punned record pattern navigation in Merlin by Liam Stevenson enabling accurate locate behavior for code like let f { a; b } = ... where clicking on a now correctly navigates to the label definition (oxcaml/merlin#147)
  • OxCaml Merlin compiler upgrade to 5.2.0minus-31 bringing upstream changes including Format_doc module integration, abstract jkind support, and enhanced type system features with corresponding updates to type printing and error reporting (oxcaml/merlin#221)
  • OCaml Ecosystem 67 new packages added to opam-repository including charrua, containers, flux, frama-clang, genjsapi, grace, httpcats, hxd, ipaddr, and many others across 34 PRs (ocaml/opam-repository)
  • OCaml Ecosystem Security documentation on ocaml.org now includes direct link to SRT reports on GitHub (ocaml/ocaml.org#3516)
  • OCaml Ecosystem Planet feed sources on ocaml.org updated to disable defunct feeds (ujamjar, coq) and add Rocq Prover as new source (ocaml/ocaml.org#3514)
  • OCaml Tools OxCaml jsofocaml support in Dune for parameterised libraries enabling separate compilation by @art-w (ocaml/dune#13414)
  • OCaml Tools C stubs dependency tracking in Dune by Nicolás Ojeda Bär ensuring proper rebuilds when switching OCaml compilers through header file dependencies (ocaml/dune#13652)
  • OCaml Tools Package management depext hints in Dune now display system dependencies in space-delimited format for easy copy-paste by Ali Caglayan (ocaml/dune#13636)
  • OCaml Tools Multiple Rocq extraction stanzas in Dune now supported in a single directory by Rodolphe Lepigre, fixing ocaml/dune#8042 (ocaml/dune#13531)
  • OCaml Tools Depexts availability caching in opam implemented by @arozovyk moving system package availability checks to opam update time, eliminating redundant polling during install and show operations (ocaml/opam#6489)
  • OCaml Tools Performance improvement in opam for opam show command, reducing execution time from ~2 seconds to <0.3 seconds (ocaml/opam#4172)
  • OCaml Tools Faster Wasm operations in jsofocaml including copy operations between Wasm strings and JavaScript array buffers, and faster small string conversions by Jérôme Vouillon (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2124)
  • OCaml Tools Wasm runtime modernization in jsofocaml including standard Wasm Text format, subtyping fixes, packed array access fixes, and multiple start functions support (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2154)
  • OCaml Tools Signature help improvements in Merlin for labelled and optional parameters by Charlène_Gros, ensuring correct parameter matching when arguments are already provided (ocaml/merlin#2032)

    • Group Activity Summaries

    OCaml Ecosystem

    Active week with 67 new packages added to opam-repository and ocaml.org content infrastructure improvements

    New Features

  • charrua package added to ocaml/opam-repository by Reynir Björnsson in ocaml/opam-repository#29422
  • containers package added to ocaml/opam-repository by Simon Cruanes in ocaml/opam-repository#29372
  • flux package added to ocaml/opam-repository by Calascibetta Romain in ocaml/opam-repository#29414
  • frama-clang package added to ocaml/opam-repository by Basile Desloges in ocaml/opam-repository#29309
  • genjsapi package added to ocaml/opam-repository by Marc Lasson in ocaml/opam-repository#29403
  • grace package added to ocaml/opam-repository by Alistair in ocaml/opam-repository#29379
  • httpcats package added to ocaml/opam-repository by Calascibetta Romain in ocaml/opam-repository#29427
  • hxd package added to ocaml/opam-repository by Calascibetta Romain in ocaml/opam-repository#29419
  • ipaddr package added to ocaml/opam-repository by Hannes Mehnert in ocaml/opam-repository#29430
  • Security documentation on ocaml/ocaml.org now includes direct link to SRT reports on GitHub in ocaml/ocaml.org#3516
  • Planet feed sources on ocaml/ocaml.org updated to disable defunct feeds (ujamjar, coq) and add Rocq Prover as new source in ocaml/ocaml.org#3514

    • Overview

  • ocaml/opam-repository had 34 PRs merged adding 67 new packages with contributions from 34 community members
  • ocaml/ocaml.org focused on content infrastructure improvements including planet feed maintenance and security documentation updates
  • Hannes Mehnert contributed across both repositories with package updates in ocaml/opam-repository and security documentation improvements in ocaml/ocaml.org
  • Cuihtlauac Alvarado addressed content aggregation infrastructure issues on ocaml/ocaml.org including planet feed source cleanup in ocaml/ocaml.org#3514

    • Activity

  • Михаил opened PR for frontmatter_extractor package update in ocaml/opam-repository#29444
  • @jeromemaloberti opened ocaml/opam-repository#29448 to add obuild.0.2.2
  • Anurag Soni opened PR for kqueue package update in ocaml/opam-repository#29446
  • Romain Beauxis opened PR for mem_usage package update in ocaml/opam-repository#29445
  • Kate opened PR for opam-publish package update in ocaml/opam-repository#29443
  • Guillaume Melquiond opened PR for Rocq package update in ocaml/opam-repository#29442
  • Pau Ruiz Safont opened PR for qcow package update in ocaml/opam-repository#29420
  • Vincent Balat opened PR for eliom package update in ocaml/opam-repository#29431
  • Hannes Mehnert opened ocaml/opam-repository#29425 to add ocaml-solo5 1.2.1
  • Calascibetta Romain opened PR for mhttp package update in ocaml/opam-repository#29441
  • Jacques Garrigue opened PR for OCamlBrowser package update in ocaml/opam-repository#29438
  • @jrfondren opened PR for use package update in ocaml/opam-repository#29437
  • Markus Mottl opened PR for sqlite3 package update in ocaml/opam-repository#29436
  • Timothy Bourke opened ocaml/opam-repository#29396 for conf-eigen3 release
  • Timothy Bourke opened ocaml/opam-repository#29395 for conf-bzip2 release
  • Calascibetta Romain updated 6 packages including httpcats, mcrunch, flux in ocaml/opam-repository via ocaml/opam-repository#29427, ocaml/opam-repository#29411, ocaml/opam-repository#29414
  • Hannes Mehnert updated 5 packages including archive, ipaddr, ocaml in ocaml/opam-repository via ocaml/opam-repository#29416, ocaml/opam-repository#29417, ocaml/opam-repository#29430
  • Vincent Balat updated 2 packages including ocsigenserver, ocsigen-ppx-rpc in ocaml/opam-repository via ocaml/opam-repository#29424, ocaml/opam-repository#29432
  • @hhugo updated 2 packages including jsofocaml in ocaml/opam-repository via ocaml/opam-repository#29393, ocaml/opam-repository#29348
  • Platform newsletter for November 2025 to January 2026 opened by @sabine in ocaml/ocaml.org#3519
  • River library dependency simplification proposed by Cuihtlauac Alvarado to remove pin on aantron/river fork and use stock river 0.4 in ocaml/ocaml.org#3515
  • Automated blog post scraping merged posts from multiple sources including Tarides, Robur, OCaml Weekly News in ocaml/ocaml.org#3520, ocaml/ocaml.org#3517, ocaml/ocaml.org#3511
  • Tutorial typo correction by José Lopes in basic data types documentation via ocaml/ocaml.org#3518

    • Notable Discussions

  • UCRT64 Environment Support issue reported by 张睿 Zhang Rui in ocaml/opam-repository#29447 regarding unsupported or unrecognised environment
  • jsofocaml-compiler compilation failure reported by Kate in ocaml/opam-repository#29433 where version 5.9.1 fails to compile with OCaml 4.14.3
  • Planet scraper improvements tracked in ocaml/ocaml.org#3513 addressing two failure modes: 3-second HTTP timeout too short for several feeds (ocamlpro.com, mirage.io, robur.coop), and missing User-Agent header causing 403 errors from Cloudflare-protected sites
  • YouTube RSS feed outage documented in ocaml/ocaml.org#3512 affecting 9 video sources with platform-wide 404 errors, confirmed as upstream YouTube issue requiring no code changes
  • QCheck documentation issue ocaml/ocaml.org#3437 marked resolved with documentation now available at ocaml.org/p/qcheck-core/latest

    • Emerging Trends

  • Ecosystem growth continues with 67 new packages introduced to ocaml/opam-repository demonstrating sustained package submission activity across the community
  • Content infrastructure reliability emerging as priority on ocaml/ocaml.org with feed source cleanup in ocaml/ocaml.org#3514, scraper timeout issues in ocaml/ocaml.org#3513, and platform-wide outage tracking in ocaml/ocaml.org#3512
  • Active maintenance by core contributors with Calascibetta Romain merging 6 package updates in ocaml/opam-repository and Hannes Mehnert contributing across both repositories
  • Documentation improvements continuing across the ecosystem with security resources in ocaml/ocaml.org#3516, tutorial fixes in ocaml/ocaml.org#3518, and platform newsletter updates in ocaml/ocaml.org#3519

    • OCaml Tools

    OxCaml support advances in Dune/odoc, opam performance optimization merged, js_of_ocaml Wasm enhancements shipped

    New Features

  • OxCaml jsofocaml support in ocaml/dune for parameterised libraries enabling separate compilation by @art-w (ocaml/dune#13414)
  • C stubs dependency tracking in ocaml/dune by Nicolás Ojeda Bär ensures proper rebuilds when switching OCaml compilers through header file dependencies (ocaml/dune#13652)
  • Package management depext hints in ocaml/dune now display system dependencies in space-delimited format for easy copy-paste by Ali Caglayan (ocaml/dune#13636)
  • Multiple Rocq extraction stanzas in ocaml/dune now supported in a single directory by Rodolphe Lepigre, fixing ocaml/dune#8042 (ocaml/dune#13531)
  • Depexts availability caching in ocaml/opam implemented by @arozovyk moves system package availability checks to opam update time, eliminating redundant polling during install and show operations (ocaml/opam#6489)
  • Performance improvement in ocaml/opam for opam show command, reducing execution time from ~2 seconds to <0.3 seconds (ocaml/opam#4172)
  • Faster Wasm operations in ocsigen/jsofocaml including copy operations between Wasm strings and JavaScript array buffers, and faster small string conversions by Jérôme Vouillon (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2124)
  • Wasm runtime modernization in ocsigen/jsofocaml including standard Wasm Text format, subtyping fixes, packed array access fixes, and multiple start functions support (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2154)
  • Signature help improvements in ocaml/merlin for labelled and optional parameters by Charlène_Gros, ensuring correct parameter matching when arguments are already provided (ocaml/merlin#2032)

    • Overview

  • ocaml/dune merged OxCaml jsofocaml support, C stub dependency fixes, and Rocq extraction improvements while advancing portable lock directory work (ocaml/dune#13414, ocaml/dune#13652, ocaml/dune#13531)
  • ocaml/opam merged depexts performance optimization moving availability checks to update time, closing a 2020-era performance issue (ocaml/opam#6489, ocaml/opam#4172)
  • ocsigen/jsofocaml merged Wasm runtime optimizations and opened dynlink/toplevel support and native effects PRs (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2124, ocsigen/jsofocaml#2187, ocsigen/jsofocaml#2189)
  • ocaml/merlin merged signature help fixes and opened PRs for let..in binding improvements and region-based queries (ocaml/merlin#2032, ocaml/merlin#2036, ocaml/merlin#2029)
  • ocaml/ocaml-lsp discussed code action editor compatibility and hover functionality gaps (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1588, ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1587)
  • ocaml/odoc continued draft OxCaml integration PR development by @art-w (ocaml/odoc#1399)
  • ocaml/ocamlfind, ocaml/opam-file-format, and ocaml-dune/spawn had no activity this week

    • Activity

  • Portable lock directory refinements in ocaml/dune with Ali Caglayan proposing single-solve approach, default platform selection, and version consistency improvements (ocaml/dune#13645, ocaml/dune#13646, ocaml/dune#13647)
  • Relocatable compiler support in ocaml/dune draft PR by Ali Caglayan enabling compiler caching without toolchains (ocaml/dune#13321)
  • Rocq expected output tests in ocaml/dune by Rodolphe Lepigre enabling diff-based testing for Rocq theories (ocaml/dune#13632)
  • Melange shared cache support in ocaml/dune opened by Antonio Nuno Monteiro for cacheable targets (ocaml/dune#13655)
  • Jsoo standalone runtime sharing in ocaml/dune prototype by Jérôme Vouillon to reduce build time in separate compilation mode (ocaml/dune#13621)
  • PATH precedence preservation in ocaml/opam PR opened by Stephen Sherratt to update shell hook behavior, maintaining user-defined PATH ordering (ocaml/opam#6859)
  • Dynlink and toplevel support in ocsigen/jsofocaml PR by Jérôme Vouillon with 3601 additions across 71 files, enabling virtual filesystem for toplevel examples (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2187)
  • Wasm native effects in ocsigen/jsofocaml PR opened by Jérôme Vouillon adding 369 lines across 31 files (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2189)
  • Variable coalescing optimization in ocsigen/jsofocaml under review showing 74-91% register reduction and 10-16% compressed size reduction (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2166)
  • Let..in binding fixes in ocaml/merlin PR opened by Charlène_Gros for signature help, under review with feedback from Ulysse and Xavier Van de Woestyne (ocaml/merlin#2036)
  • Enclosing command -stop flag in ocaml/merlin by Xavier Van de Woestyne enabling region-based queries for better type annotation and locate-type functionality (ocaml/merlin#2029)
  • Custom LSP request for merlin-locate-types in ocaml/ocaml-lsp under review with Xavier Van de Woestyne addressing documentation feedback (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1584)

    • Notable Discussions

  • PATH hook behavior debate in ocaml/opam with Stephen Sherratt proposing to preserve user-defined directory precedence rather than always prepending opam switch bins, scheduled for opam dev meeting discussion (ocaml/opam#6859, ocaml/opam#6815)
  • Code action editor compatibility in ocaml/ocaml-lsp with Clément Delafargue reporting construct expression failures in Helix editor, prompting Xavier Van de Woestyne to propose rethinking client-specific command reliance (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1588)
  • Firefox stack overflow persistence in ocsigen/jsofocaml affecting herdtools7 on macOS, with Nikos Nikoleris reporting that variable coalescing improvements help on Linux but Firefox on macOS still throws exceptions (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2122, ocsigen/jsofocaml#2166)
  • V8 safepoint table improvements in ocsigen/jsofocaml noted by @jakobkummerow, suggesting Chrome 147+ may eliminate need for workaround (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2165)
  • Switch link behavior confirmation in ocaml/opam with Matthieu Sozeau reporting breakage when running opam switch link on existing _opam switches (ocaml/opam#6857, ocaml/opam#6860)

    • Emerging Trends

  • Performance through intelligent caching demonstrated in ocaml/opam depexts work (ocaml/opam#6489) and ocsigen/jsofocaml Wasm optimizations (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2124), showing commitment to reducing repetitive operations
  • OxCaml ecosystem maturation progressing across ocaml/dune, ocaml/odoc, and ocsigen/jsofocaml with coordinated support for parameterised libraries and separate compilation
  • Cross-editor LSP compatibility focus emerging in ocaml/merlin and ocaml/ocaml-lsp, addressing VSCode-specific features that fail in Helix and other editors (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1588)
  • Wasm backend advancement in ocsigen/jsofocaml with runtime modernization, toplevel support, native effects, and code size optimizations spanning multiple PRs
  • Package management UX refinement in ocaml/dune and ocaml/opam with portable lock directories, depext improvements, and shell integration enhancements
  • Rocq tooling expansion in ocaml/dune with multiple extraction stanza support and expected output testing bringing capabilities closer to OCaml ecosystem standards (ocaml/dune#13531, ocaml/dune#13632)

    • OxCaml

    Type system evolution and compiler synchronization dominated with layout polymorphism advances and backend testing expansion

    New Features

  • Punned record pattern navigation in Merlin by Liam Stevenson enables accurate locate behavior for code like let f { a; b } = ... where clicking on a now correctly navigates to the label definition rather than incorrectly reporting "already at definition" (oxcaml/merlin#147)
  • Merlin compiler upgrade to 5.2.0minus-31 brings upstream changes including Format_doc module integration, abstract jkind support, and enhanced type system features with corresponding updates to type printing and error reporting (oxcaml/merlin#221)
  • Parser attribute mechanism for punned patterns added to distinguish between pattern and label nodes in the typed tree, enabling accurate code navigation tools (oxcaml/merlin commit 0d9b939)
  • Type recovery improvements in Merlin for constructor representation handling with new test coverage ensuring correct handling of abstract types in module construction scenarios (oxcaml/merlin commit 3f78528)

    • Overview

  • Primary activity concentrated in oxcaml/oxcaml with 16 contributors merging code focused on type system evolution, backend optimizations, and upstream OCaml 5.4 merge preparation (oxcaml/oxcaml#5442, #5460, #5463)
  • Merlin development active with compiler synchronization to 5.2.0minus-31 and editor navigation improvements for punned patterns (oxcaml/merlin#221, #147)
  • Three repositories inactive with no recorded activity in oxcaml/opam-repository, oxcaml/jsofocaml, or janestreet/opam-repository during this period
  • Type system work dominates with layout polymorphism enhancements including kind any support for fields and constructor arguments (oxcaml/oxcaml#5461, #5462)
  • Backend testing infrastructure expansion with 3,000+ lines of expect_asm tests for codegen verification (oxcaml/oxcaml#5447)
  • Runtime improvements including ephemeron marking fixes and ocamldebug enhancements with CI testing (oxcaml/oxcaml#5450, #5465)

    • Activity

  • Chamelon dune integration merged by Basile Clément with nearly 2,000 line addition across 19 files enabling dune build system support for the Chamelon tool (oxcaml/oxcaml#5423)
  • Static computations framework added by Jack Rickard with 1,200+ line implementation affecting 51 files to enable compile-time optimizations (oxcaml/oxcaml#5430)
  • Backend spill optimization completed by Xavier Clerc fixing useless spills across 37 files with reproduction case (oxcaml/oxcaml#5429, #5432)
  • Morphisms work progressing with @ainageorges opening PRs for normal form morphisms and explicit comparison functions (oxcaml/oxcaml#5453, #5452)
  • Backend testing expansion by @ttebbi-janestreet with 3,000+ lines of expectasm tests for bad codegen cases following merged support for expectasm infrastructure (oxcaml/oxcaml#5447, #5350)
  • Type system refinements including redundant modality warning by @dkalinichenko-js affecting 22 files, pattern variable refactoring to inline records by Zesen Qian, and meet/join terminology regularization by @ainageorges (oxcaml/oxcaml#5373, #5437, #5451)
  • Unboxed types bug fixes with Ryan Tjoa fixing bytecode deep copying of unboxed product fields and Max Slater preventing effects duplication in %makearray_dynamic (oxcaml/oxcaml#5386, #5459)
  • Runtime improvements with Nick Barnes opening PRs for ephemeron marking fix and sizeclasses.h dependency, plus Jakub Bachurski fixing ocamldebug's debug_printers with CI test-runs (oxcaml/oxcaml#5450, #5455, #5465)
  • Compiler infrastructure cleanup including removal of thread-local dynamic bindings support by Aspen Smith, Data Flow lifted constants internalization by Guillaume Bury, and multiple documentation/tooling fixes by James Rayman (oxcaml/oxcaml#5171, #5368, #5468)
  • Performance optimizations including Zesen Qian optimizing Sort.set to avoid closure allocation and Richard Eisenberg short-circuiting common case in instancepolyfor_jkind (oxcaml/oxcaml#5443, #5406)
  • Merlin type recovery enhancement opened by Liam Stevenson to fix error handling in function applications with mismatched types, preventing discarding of typed function identifiers (oxcaml/merlin#222)
  • Ongoing draft work includes James Rayman making Stdlib mostly stateless, Vincent Laviron lowering inlined always attribute priority, and Guillaume Bury fixing Debuginfo.to_location (oxcaml/oxcaml#5458, #5439, #5444)

    • Notable Discussions

  • Test coverage expansion requested by Richard Eisenberg on Merlin compiler merge for abstract jkinds and Format_doc integration, with Liam Stevenson adding tests for constructor representation handling (oxcaml/merlin#221)
  • Upstream contribution plans discussed for Merlin's punned pattern navigation fixes, with acknowledgment that both punned record patterns and earlier punned let expression features could benefit the upstream Merlin project (oxcaml/merlin#147, #96)
  • Type variable naming behavior change analyzed in detail for Merlin compiler merge, where switching from lazy printer to eagerly-evaluated Format_doc.t changed timing of type variable name assignment, affecting test output for class declarations (oxcaml/merlin#221)
  • Internal tracking tickets created by Liam Stevenson (tickets 6599, 6600, 6601) for follow-up work on Jkind.isvaluefor_printing workarounds and other temporary solutions introduced during the compiler merge (oxcaml/merlin#221)
  • Inlining bugs identified by Vincent Laviron requiring investigation of heuristic behavior and attribute priority handling (oxcaml/oxcaml#5438, #5439)
  • Numeric conversion regression reported by Keryan Didier in fexpr parser requiring investigation (oxcaml/oxcaml#5431)

    • Emerging Trends

  • Layout polymorphism advancement with concentrated work on kind any support for fields and constructor arguments, enabling more flexible type system capabilities for unboxed and custom representations (oxcaml/oxcaml#5461, #5462)
  • Backend testing maturity reflected in comprehensive expect_asm test suite development for assembly-level verification, enabling systematic regression testing of code generation quality (oxcaml/oxcaml#5447, #5350)
  • Upstream synchronization ramping up with multiple PRs resolving OCaml 5.4 merge conflicts across compiler subsystems (utils, middle-end, backend), indicating preparation for major version integration (oxcaml/oxcaml#5442, #5460, #5463)
  • Editor integration refinements continuing in Merlin with systematic improvements to AST navigation accuracy, building on earlier punned let expression work with new punned record pattern support (oxcaml/merlin#147, #96)
  • Type system modernization through morphisms normalization, modality system refinements, and terminology regularization reflecting ongoing type theory evolution (oxcaml/oxcaml#5453, #5452, #5451)
  • Unboxed types stabilization continuing with bytecode handling fixes and effects system integration corrections as the feature matures (oxcaml/oxcaml#5386, #5459)
  • Static analysis capabilities expanding with new framework for static computations enabling compile-time optimizations and constant propagation improvements (oxcaml/oxcaml#5430)
  • Test-driven development approach evident in both Merlin and oxcaml/oxcaml with reviewers consistently requesting test coverage for new functionality and changes (oxcaml/merlin#221, oxcaml/merlin#147)

    • OCaml Core

    24 PRs merged with exhaustiveness checking for ocamllex, new Array fold functions, and GC improvements.

    New Features

  • Exhaustiveness checking for ocamllex regular expressions - If a rule does not match some input, an example of nonmatching input is shown in a warning message. The new warning can be disabled using -w -missing-case (ocaml/ocaml#14448)
  • Array.foldleft2 and Array.foldright2 functions - New standard library functions that fold over two arrays simultaneously, raising Invalid_argument if arrays have different lengths (ocaml/ocaml#14553)
  • Improved runtime clarity with Scannable* macros - Replaced all comparisons against Noscan_tag with macros for better legibility and correctness, fixing one bug in weak.c (ocaml/ocaml#14493)
  • Iarray API consistency - Updated Iarray module to expose 'a Iarray.t in function types rather than 'a iarray, making the built-in iarray type an implementation detail (ocaml/ocaml#14576)
  • Improved installation time in opam - Shrinking Git-generated source archives to reduce installation time (ocaml/ocaml#14152)
  • Fix for --disable-unix-lib build - ocamltest now builds correctly when configured with --disable-unix-lib (ocaml/ocaml#14558)
  • Linux ppc64 architecture detection - Proper detection for Linux distros targeting ELFv1 (like Debian), correctly setting the arch configure variable (ocaml/ocaml#14573)

    • Overview

  • 24 PRs merged in ocaml/ocaml with major features including exhaustiveness checking for ocamllex (ocaml/ocaml#14448), new Array functions (ocaml/ocaml#14553), and GC improvements (ocaml/ocaml#14365)
  • 18 new PRs opened covering runtime optimizations, stdlib additions, and architecture improvements in ocaml/ocaml
  • 5 new issues reported including a regression in 5.4.1 on aarch64 (ocaml/ocaml#14574) and GC pacing discussion (ocaml/ocaml#14533)
  • Documentation maintenance in ocaml/RFCs with improved contributor image rendering in Committee.md (ocaml/RFCs#61)
  • Strong community participation with contributions from Bozhidar Batsov (4 PRs), Damien Doligez (4 PRs), Tim McGilchrist (3 PRs), and Gabriel Scherer (2 PRs)

    • Activity

  • Documentation quality initiative - Multiple PRs fixing stdlib documentation with Bozhidar Batsov improving accuracy, fixing typos, and adding missing @since annotations (ocaml/ocaml#14555, ocaml/ocaml#14560, ocaml/ocaml#14561, ocaml/ocaml#14563)
  • Runtime performance work - Damien Doligez merged major GC Idle phase improvements (ocaml/ocaml#14365) and ongoing faster minor GC work (ocaml/ocaml#14571)
  • Multi-architecture support - Tim McGilchrist advanced ppc64 architecture detection (ocaml/ocaml#14573) and FreeBSD frame pointer support (ocaml/ocaml#14486, ocaml/ocaml#14530)
  • Bug fixes - Gabriel Scherer fixed Pexpstructitem regression (ocaml/ocaml#14556) and GC ephemeron marking (ocaml/ocaml#14338)
  • Build system improvements - Damien Doligez fixed --disable-unix-lib build (ocaml/ocaml#14558), increased CI timeouts (ocaml/ocaml#14565), and cleaned up tests (ocaml/ocaml#14549)
  • Type system refinements - Work on modular explicits in let rec (ocaml/ocaml#14537) and type approximation refactoring (ocaml/ocaml#14538)
  • Code modernization - Antonin Décimo adopted C2y countof usage (ocaml/ocaml#14546) and removed deprecated fatal error functions (ocaml/ocaml#14559)
  • Parser improvements - Nicolás Ojeda Bär reimplemented let open/module/exception (ocaml/ocaml#13839) and Samuel Vivien distinguished module patterns from type constraints (ocaml/ocaml#14149)

    • Notable Discussions

  • GC pacing and default parameters in 5.5 - Active discussion about performance characteristics and tuning parameters for the garbage collector in upcoming releases (ocaml/ocaml#14533)
  • Regression in 5.4.1 on aarch64 - Investigation of assembler failure with "Error: immediate out of range" when rebuilding libguestfs, traced to SELinux permissions (ocaml/ocaml#14574)
  • C API function declarations guarantees - Developer discussion about guarantees and contracts for C API function declarations (ocaml/ocaml#14516)
  • Uncaught exception with parameterised classes - Fatal error regression since 4.14.0 when using certain class patterns, under investigation (ocaml/ocaml#14557)
  • GitHub avatar image rendering - Technical discussion between Ali Caglayan and Nicolás Ojeda Bär about GitHub's inconsistent handling of size parameters for avatar images (ocaml/RFCs#61)

    • Emerging Trends

  • Documentation quality focus - Multiple PRs across the week improving stdlib documentation accuracy, with Bozhidar Batsov leading efforts to fix typos and add missing @since annotations (ocaml/ocaml#14555, ocaml/ocaml#14560, ocaml/ocaml#14561, ocaml/ocaml#14563, ocaml/ocaml#14567)
  • Runtime performance and clarity - Continued work on GC improvements with Idle phase for major GC (ocaml/ocaml#14365), faster minor GC (ocaml/ocaml#14571), and code clarity improvements with Scannable_* macros (ocaml/ocaml#14493)
  • Multi-architecture expansion - Growing support for ppc64 (ocaml/ocaml#14573), s390x (ocaml/ocaml#14524, ocaml/ocaml#14547), and aarch64 platforms with native implementations and architecture-specific fixes
  • Build system modernization - Ongoing improvements to configure scripts, dependency generation, and CI infrastructure with timeout increases (ocaml/ocaml#14565)
  • Type system refinements - Active work on modular explicits in let rec (ocaml/ocaml#14537), type approximation refactoring (ocaml/ocaml#14538), and fixing class-related edge cases (ocaml/ocaml#14557)

    • Multicore

    Focus on improving eio server robustness and file system utilities

    Overview

  • Activity concentrated in ocaml-multicore/eio with two proposals addressing server error handling and temporary directory management
  • Volker Diels-Grabsch initiated both discussions, receiving detailed feedback from Thomas Leonard on the server error handling proposal (ocaml-multicore/eio#830)
  • No activity reported in ocaml-multicore/domainslib, ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring, ocaml-multicore/meio, ocaml-multicore/saturn, ocaml-multicore/eio-trace, ocaml-multicore/picos, ocaml-multicore/kcas, or ocaml-multicore/ocaml-iomux

    • Activity

  • Volker Diels-Grabsch proposed improving error handling in Eio.Net.run_server when accept fails, including discussion of semaphore management, default max_connections values, and potential on_accept_error callback (ocaml-multicore/eio#830)
  • Volker Diels-Grabsch proposed adding temporary directory utilities including Stdenv.tmp capability and Path.open_temp_dir/Path.with_temp_dir functions for managing temporary directories (ocaml-multicore/eio#831)

    • Notable Discussions

  • Thomas Leonard responded to the run_server error handling proposal in ocaml-multicore/eio#830, noting that connection limits are inherently vulnerable to DoS attacks and suggesting that crashing and restarting may be preferable to waiting indefinitely when FD leaks occur, while supporting an optional on_accept_error callback and recommending documentation on best practices for public-facing servers

    • Emerging Trends

  • Discussion of security considerations in server error handling, particularly regarding DoS vulnerabilities and file descriptor leak management in ocaml-multicore/eio#830
  • Interest in expanding eio's file system utilities with temporary directory support (ocaml-multicore/eio#831)
entry.summary: OCaml 5.4.1 and 4.14.3 released with bug fixes, 67 opam packages added, OxCaml advances type system and Merlin integration.

entry.title: Week 7, 2026: 3 releases (dune 3.21.1, js_of_ocaml 6.3.1/6.3.2), 34 OxCaml PRs, 22+ ecosystem package releases, and meio modernization.
entry.content:
Weekly Summary

New Features

  • OCaml Core GC idle phase merged, allowing the GC to perform idle-time work ocaml/ocaml#14365
  • OCaml Core String.drop_prefix and String.drop_suffix added to the standard library ocaml/ocaml#14487
  • OCaml Core lazy v structured constant optimization delivering ~2.7x speedup for lazy values applied to constants ocaml/ocaml#13919
  • OCaml Core Improved GADT error messages for better type-error diagnostics ocaml/ocaml#14142
  • OCaml Core ocamltest conditional expressions (&&, ||, if/then/else) added for richer test scripting ocaml/ocaml#14532
  • OCaml Core ocamltest system variable added for cross-platform test conditions ocaml/ocaml#14545
  • OCaml Core Inclusion check error messages improved for module type mismatches ocaml/ocaml#14205
  • OCaml Core Haiku OS native backend added for the native-code compiler ocaml/ocaml#14138 by Anarchos
  • OCaml Core CFI (Call Frame Information) for Power architecture enabling better debugging and unwinding ocaml/ocaml#14482 by Tim McGilchrist
  • OxCaml Abstract kinds (part 2) implementation advancing the kind system in OxCaml oxcaml/oxcaml#5071
  • OxCaml SIMD indexing primitives for small integers (int8, int16) with x86 intrinsics oxcaml/oxcaml#4779 and oxcaml/oxcaml#5407
  • OxCaml ctz, clz, popcnt operations for small int types oxcaml/oxcaml#5393
  • OxCaml [%%expect_asm] test support for assembly-level testing oxcaml/oxcaml#5350
  • OxCaml chamelon run and chamelon dune subcommands extending the chamelon tooling for project management oxcaml/oxcaml#5421 and oxcaml/oxcaml#5423
  • OxCaml Manual module initialization support oxcaml/oxcaml#5395
  • OxCaml Wide vectors (vec256) on arm64 via tuple translation oxcaml/oxcaml#5291
  • OxCaml Layout-polymorphic bindings support oxcaml/oxcaml#5392
  • OxCaml GC prefetch fix improving multi-domain performance oxcaml/oxcaml#5416
  • OxCaml Fiber cache domain-affinity fix for safer concurrency oxcaml/oxcaml#5363
  • OxCaml -dfexpr-annot compiler flag for annotated Flambda expression debugging oxcaml/oxcaml#5210
  • OxCaml runtime5 in ocamlc -config output oxcaml/oxcaml#5415
  • OxCaml Merlin signature help feature ported to OxCaml's Merlin fork oxcaml/merlin#214 and oxcaml/merlin#219
  • OCaml Tools Dune sandboxing defaults enabled for tests and Melange rules ocaml/dune#13617 and ocaml/dune#13619
  • OCaml Tools odoc-config.sexp generation for cross-package documentation support ocaml/dune#13476
  • OCaml Tools Memo deadlock fix preventing dune build hangs ocaml/dune#13625
  • OCaml Tools Trace events for file writes added to dune's tracing subsystem ocaml/dune#13618
  • OCaml Tools Build-system-agnostic merlin config via $OCAMLLSP_PROJECT_ROOT and $OCAMLLSP_PROJECT_ROOT_MARKERS environment variables in ocaml-lsp ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1581
  • OCaml Tools Set.compare_cardinal_with and Set.to_list_bounded bounded Set APIs added to jsofocaml ocsigen/jsofocaml#2180
  • OCaml Tools BitSet CTZ (count-trailing-zeros) optimization for faster bit operations in jsofocaml ocsigen/jsofocaml#2179
  • OCaml Ecosystem mkernel 0.0.1 new package for OCaml kernel module development ocaml/opam-repository#29361 by Calascibetta Romain
  • OCaml Ecosystem utcp 0.0.1 new userspace TCP stack package ocaml/opam-repository#29359 by Hannes Mehnert
  • OCaml Ecosystem virtfs 1.0.0 and yocaml 3.0.0 released ocaml/opam-repository#29381 and ocaml/opam-repository#29377 by Xavier Van de Woestyne
  • OCaml Ecosystem OCaml Planet scraper restructured with scheduled scraping workflows ocaml/ocaml.org#3503 and ocaml/ocaml.org#3508
  • Multicore meio modernized with migration from Eio.Private.Ctf to Eio_runtime_events and switch from nottui to nottui-unix ocaml-multicore/meio#72

    • Group Activity Summaries

    OCaml Ecosystem

    Major package releases, large-scale opam-repository archival, and extensive ocaml.org documentation quality improvements.

    New Features

    ocaml/opam-repository

  • mkernel 0.0.1 released by Calascibetta Romain — initial public release of a unikernel with Miou providing I/O for Solo5/Unikraft targets (ocaml/opam-repository#29361)
  • utcp 0.0.1 released by Hannes Mehnert — initial public release of a pure OCaml TCP implementation (ocaml/opam-repository#29359)
  • virtfs 1.0.0 released by Xavier Van de Woestyne — first release exposing Path, Tree, and Tree.Simple modules for abstract file path and file tree representation (ocaml/opam-repository#29381)
  • yocaml 3.0.0 (14 packages) released by Xavier Van de Woestyne — major version of the YOCaml static site generator switching from int to float for time/mtime, adding Action.write_files, Data.Validation.req/opt, and improved validation error pretty-printing (ocaml/opam-repository#29377)
  • dune 3.21.1 (17 packages) released by Shon Feder — patch release fixing build issues on NetBSD and OpenBSD, fixing melange.emit package mask behavior, and stopping RPC server from starting on dune promote (ocaml/opam-repository#29374)
  • menhir 20260209 (5 packages) released by François Pottier — snapshot release fixing Windows installation issues caused by aux.ml filename in the prior 20260203 release (ocaml/opam-repository#29364, ocaml/opam-repository#29365)
  • mirage-crypto 2.0.3 (7 packages) released by Hannes Mehnert — adds mirage-crypto-rng-mkernel and PPC macros support (ocaml/opam-repository#29368)
  • trace 0.11 (4 packages) and tracy-client 0.7 released by Simon Cruanes — trace 0.11 is a major rework of the collector using an open sum type for spans, removing global state, and adding extensible metrics; tracy-client 0.7 updates to Tracy v0.13.1 (ocaml/opam-repository#29345, ocaml/opam-repository#29346)
  • grace 0.3.0 released by Alistair — diagnostics library removing base/core dependency, replacing Source.reader with Source.Reader.t, adding line breaks in large diagnostics and TTY detection (ocaml/opam-repository#29379)
  • containers 3.18 (2 packages) released by Simon Cruanes — breaking changes to CCListLabel, CCFloat.{min,max} semantics aligned with Stdlib for NaN, and CCInt.rem negative number behavior (ocaml/opam-repository#29372)
  • miou 0.5.3 and miou 0.5.4 released by Calascibetta Romain — 0.5.3 fixes signal handling and transfer to dom0; 0.5.4 fixes macOS support and the return value of poll(3P) (ocaml/opam-repository#29378, ocaml/opam-repository#29400)
  • ocp-index 1.4.1 (2 packages) released by Nathan Rebours — adds support for OCaml 5.5 (ocaml/opam-repository#29358)
