  • grenier 0.16 released by Frédéric Bour — adds is_singleton for OCaml 5.5 compatibility and rank-based element access functions (ocaml/opam-repository#29349)
  • camlzip 1.14 released by Xavier Leroy — fixes local file header errors for files > 4 GB (ocaml/opam-repository#29352)
  • symex 0.1 released by @redianthus — initial release of symbolic execution library (ocaml/opam-repository#29356)
  • smtml 0.21.0 released by @filipeom — SMT solver frontend with type-safe API for uninterpreted functions (ocaml/opam-repository#29357)
  • multipart_form 0.8.0 (5 packages) released by Calascibetta Romain — fixes eio support and updates to ocamlformat 0.28.1 (ocaml/opam-repository#29367)
  • lintcstubs-arity 0.5.1 released by Török Edwin — adds OCaml >= 5.2 support for the C binding header generator (ocaml/opam-repository#29371)
  • passage 0.3.3 released by José Nogueira — restores macOS availability (ocaml/opam-repository#29383)
  • oktree 0.2.2 released by Paul Garner — simple octree implementation for nearest-neighbor search in 3D space (ocaml/opam-repository#29376)
  • spectrum 0.7.0 released by Paul Garner — terminal color and formatting library using OCaml Format module semantic tags (ocaml/opam-repository#29382)
  • bogue 20260208 released by 珊瑚 — new version of the SDL2-based GUI library (ocaml/opam-repository#29351)
    • ocaml/ocaml.org

  • The OCaml Planet scraper gained a new Scrape_report module returning structured results (New_post, Video_update, Error) and CLI flags --commit-file/--report-file to generate descriptive PR bodies listing new posts and broken feeds (ocaml/ocaml.org#3503)
  • Scheduled scraping workflows now skip execution on repository forks via an if: github.repository == 'ocaml/ocaml.org' guard, preventing unnecessary CI failures on forks (ocaml/ocaml.org#3508)

    • Overview

  • ocaml/opam-repository saw 22+ new package releases merged, including significant releases of dune 3.21.1, menhir 20260209, yocaml 3.0.0, mirage-crypto 2.0.3, trace 0.11, and containers 3.18, along with two large archival PRs removing ~46,000 files of unmaintained packages (ocaml/opam-repository#29360, ocaml/opam-repository#29363)
  • ocaml/ocaml.org focused on documentation quality: Bozhidar Batsov fixed ~100 typos across 41 tutorial files (ocaml/ocaml.org#3491) and resolved 469 markdownlint violations (ocaml/ocaml.org#3492), alongside Planet scraper infrastructure improvements (ocaml/ocaml.org#3503)
  • Combined contributor count: 23+ unique contributors across ocaml/opam-repository and 8+ across ocaml/ocaml.org
  • Several incoming packages targeted new concurrency, networking, and formal verification domains: mkernel, utcp, symex, smtml (ocaml/opam-repository#29361, ocaml/opam-repository#29359, ocaml/opam-repository#29356, ocaml/opam-repository#29357)
  • OCaml 5.5 compatibility work was visible across multiple packages (grenier 0.16, ocp-index 1.4.1), indicating preparation for the next OCaml release (ocaml/opam-repository#29349, ocaml/opam-repository#29358)

    • Activity

    ocaml/opam-repository

  • jsofocaml 6.3.2 (8 packages) opened by @hhugo to replace ocaml/opam-repository#29388, fixing shell completion file installation and labeled "consider for merge" (ocaml/opam-repository#29393); the 6.3.0 PR (ocaml/opam-repository#29348) brought wasm number unboxing, reference unboxing, constant sinking, and JS-parser improvements but awaits resolution of compatibility issues
  • windtrap 0.1.0 new all-in-one OCaml testing framework opened by Thibaut Mattio — unifies unit, property-based, snapshot, and expect tests under a single PPX-enabled API with CLI runner, filter, and bisect_ppx coverage integration (ocaml/opam-repository#29387)
  • ortools 9.15.0 (2 packages) opened by Timothy Bourke — Google OR-Tools OCaml interface rewritten in C++ to avoid unnecessary copies, accompanied by new virtual packages conf-bzip2 (ocaml/opam-repository#29395), conf-eigen3 (ocaml/opam-repository#29396), and conf-zlib updates (ocaml/opam-repository#29394) (ocaml/opam-repository#29380)
  • Package archival — Hannes Mehnert merged two archival PRs: available: false packages (594 files, ocaml/opam-repository#29360) and x-maintenance-intent: none packages primarily tezos/octez (45,238 files across 1,197 packages, ocaml/opam-repository#29363); the broader draft archival PR ocaml/opam-repository#29058 was closed pending further policy discussion
  • Immutable policy discussion — ongoing PR by Hannes Mehnert to tighten repository immutability rules, with Marcello Seri suggesting merge and handling pin-depends separately (ocaml/opam-repository#29072)
  • Dependency compatibility fixes merged: upper bound on containers 3.18 for decoders and ppx_cstubs by Marcello Seri (ocaml/opam-repository#29391), upper bound lwt < 6.1.0 for timmy-lwt (ocaml/opam-repository#29390), and upper bounds on trace revdeps including fuseau (ocaml/opam-repository#29347, ocaml/opam-repository#29370)
  • opam custom-install compatibility issue opened by Alina Banerjee — opam-custom-install fails with opam 2.1 against a 2.2 root, identified as needing available: opam-version >= x & opam-version < y constraints (ocaml/opam-repository#29369)
  • frama-clang 0.0.19 (ocaml/opam-repository#29309) by Basile Desloges and Virgile Prevosto — ongoing work resolving conf-libclang distribution detection (opensuse vs. open-suse)
    • ocaml/ocaml.org

  • Emacs editor setup tutorial update opened by Bozhidar Batsov (ocaml/ocaml.org#3509) streamlines mode recommendations toward Eglot + ocamllsp; under active review with Cuihtlauac Alvarado
  • Pending cleanup PRs by Bozhidar Batsov: typo and lint fixes in root-level docs (ocaml/ocaml.org#3493), lint fixes across exercises including a filename correction (ocaml/ocaml.org#3494), and lint fixes across data directories (ocaml/ocaml.org#3495), all awaiting rebase after ocaml/ocaml.org#3500
  • Internationalization initiative continues: two draft/open PRs by mt_caret — foundational i18n infrastructure with language frontmatter and selector (ocaml/ocaml.org#3238) and additional Japanese translations of getting-started pages (ocaml/ocaml.org#3489)
  • Module documentation TOC feature request by Arthur Carcano — proposes clickable table of contents for functions in module documentation pages, similar to docs.rs sidebar (ocaml/ocaml.org#3506)
  • Neovim plugin instructions update (ocaml/ocaml.org#3421) by Charlène_Gros remains open with merge conflicts

    • Notable Discussions

  • jsofocaml compatibility threads (ocaml/opam-repository#29348) revealed that timmy-lwt breaks with lwt 6.1.0 and data-encoding tests fail due to NaN comparison using = instead of compare; @hhugo noted these failures are pre-existing, coordinating with Marcello Seri and Anil Madhavapeddy on the merge timeline
  • containers 3.18 breaking changes (ocaml/opam-repository#29372) prompted discussion about downstream impact: CCResult.result removal causing decoders failures, and a stack overflow in containers.pvec tests under property-based testing which Simon Cruanes fixed by addressing a size explosion in qcheck
  • Archival policy discussion around ocaml/opam-repository#29058 was closed, with Hannes Mehnert splitting the work into two less controversial PRs targeting available: false packages and packages with x-maintenance-intent: none (primarily tezos/octez), while the broader policy awaits further discussion
  • Agentic PR review workflow discussion emerged in ocaml/ocaml.org#3496: Cuihtlauac Alvarado proposed requiring one narrow category of change per PR with a machine-verifiable check script; Ulysse and Bozhidar Batsov offered different perspectives on whether per-lint-rule granularity is necessary
  • Exercise page rendering concern surfaced during the ocaml.org lint discussion (ocaml/ocaml.org#3500): Ulysse noted that ood-gen uses a regex Str.regexp {|#[ ]*Solution|} to split exercise markdown, and heading demotion could break this; Cuihtlauac Alvarado verified ## Solution still matches the unanchored regex
  • Translation sustainability debated in ocaml/ocaml.org#3238: Florian Angeletti noted translated docs go stale quickly without a dedicated translation team; mt_caret proposed periodic LLM-assisted translation updates with a human Japanese reviewer

    • Emerging Trends

  • Robur Coop / MirageOS ecosystem expansion: Calascibetta Romain published three packages — mkernel (ocaml/opam-repository#29361), miou 0.5.3 and 0.5.4 (ocaml/opam-repository#29378, ocaml/opam-repository#29400), and multipart_form 0.8.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29367) in quick succession, reflecting active development of the MirageOS/Robur toolchain
  • OCaml 5.5 compatibility preparation: multiple packages adding OCaml 5.5 support (grenier 0.16 at ocaml/opam-repository#29349, ocp-index 1.4.1 at ocaml/opam-repository#29358, lintcstubs-arity 0.5.1 at ocaml/opam-repository#29371) indicating coordinated preparation ahead of the next OCaml release
  • Breaking change coordination: several releases included breaking API changes (containers 3.18 at ocaml/opam-repository#29372, grace 0.3.0 at ocaml/opam-repository#29379, trace 0.11 at ocaml/opam-repository#29345) requiring coordinated revdep upper bound additions by maintainers
  • AI-assisted contributions are visibly increasing in ocaml/ocaml.org: the agentic-pr label was introduced by Cuihtlauac Alvarado and applied to multiple PRs (ocaml/ocaml.org#3500, ocaml/ocaml.org#3503, ocaml/ocaml.org#3508), reflecting an emerging norm of tagging AI-generated work for appropriate review handling
  • Documentation quality tooling investment: markdownlint-cli2 applied across the full ocaml.org tutorial corpus, 469 violations resolved (ocaml/ocaml.org#3492), with agentic-pr workflow established — suggesting ongoing automation of content quality checks (ocaml/ocaml.org#3491, ocaml/ocaml.org#3492)
  • Large-scale repository maintenance: the archival of ~46,000 files of unmaintained packages to ocaml/opam-repository-archive (ocaml/opam-repository#29360, ocaml/opam-repository#29363) represents a concerted effort to keep the repository focused on actively-maintained software

    • OCaml Tools

    Active week across dune, opam, ocaml-lsp, and js_of_ocaml with sandboxing expansions, LSP build-system decoupling, and two patch releases.

    New Features

  • ocaml/dune: New --no-recursive flag for dune describe workspace limits output to specified directories, useful for large monorepos (ocaml/dune#13590)
  • ocaml/dune: Dune now emits trace events for direct file writes (install files, lock files), visible in dune trace cat output (ocaml/dune#13618)
  • ocaml/dune: Melange (library ..) and (melange.emit ..) stanzas sandboxed by default from dune lang 3.22 (ocaml/dune#13619)
  • ocaml/dune: All (test), (tests), and related stanza variants sandboxed by default from dune lang 3.22 (ocaml/dune#13617)
  • ocaml/dune: Dune now writes and installs odoc-config.sexp files for packages declaring :with-doc dependencies, enabling cross-package documentation builds with odoc (ocaml/dune#13476, closes ocaml/dune#13485)
  • ocaml/dune: Fixed deadlock in the memo library when dependency cycles are detected (ocaml/dune#13625)
  • ocaml/dune: Fixed sandboxed builds of (library (stdlib (modules_before_stdlib ..))) by including implicit dependency edges in ocamldep results (ocaml/dune#13624)
  • ocaml/dune: Fixed (dir ..) field on package declarations being ignored when assigning cram tests to packages (ocaml/dune#13581)
  • ocaml/dune: Fixed dune trace cat --follow exiting prematurely on subprocess action trace events (ocaml/dune#13607)
  • ocaml/ocaml-lsp: New env var $OCAMLLSP_PROJECT_BUILD_SYSTEM allows any build system to serve merlin configuration via merlin-dot-protocol (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1581)
  • ocaml/ocaml-lsp: New $OCAMLLSP_PROJECT_ROOT env var explicitly specifies project root; $OCAMLLSP_PROJECT_ROOT_MARKERS enables automatic root detection by marker files (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1581)
  • ocsigen/jsofocaml: New Set.compare_cardinal_with provides O(min(n, k)) cardinality comparison with early-exit; new Set.to_list_bounded returns a sorted list only if the set has at most N elements (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2180)
  • ocsigen/jsofocaml: BitSet.next_free and BitSet.next_mem rewritten using count-trailing-zeros (CTZ) for word-at-a-time iteration, reducing overhead for sparse and dense bitsets (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2179)
  • ocsigen/jsofocaml: Dgraph.Make functor relaxed to accept custom SET and MAP modules instead of requiring the full standard Set.S/Map.S signatures (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2178)
  • ocsigen/jsofocaml: Shell completion files now correctly install under monorepo/workspace builds, fixing a dune regression (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2186)
  • ocaml/opam: README configure instructions corrected to distinguish ./configure from ./configure --with-vendored-deps (ocaml/opam#6858)

    • Overview

  • ocaml/dune was the most active repository with multiple merged PRs covering sandboxing expansion, trace subsystem fixes, package management improvements, and a fix for a memo deadlock (ocaml/dune#13625); 3.21.1 release preparation is underway (ocaml/dune#13557)

    • OxCaml

    34 PRs merged in oxcaml/oxcaml spanning SIMD, abstract kinds, chamelon tooling, runtime fixes, and arm64 parity; jsoo patch stack eliminated.

    New Features

  • Abstract kinds (part 2) merges basic abstract kinds and kind aliases into the type system; environment arguments are now threaded through jkind operations (oxcaml/oxcaml#5071)
  • Indexing and arraylike primitives for small integers adds %caml_bytes_geti8, %caml_bytes_geti16, and related indexed-by primitives supporting int8 and int16# indices for arrays, strings, bigstrings, and bytes (oxcaml/oxcaml#4779)
  • int16 x86 intrinsics — caml_popcnt_int16, caml_lzcnt_int16, and caml_bmi_tzcnt_int16 added to the SIMD backend; simdgen extended to support instructions with multiple legacy prefixes (oxcaml/oxcaml#5407)
  • Small int ctz, clz, popcnt primitives added for int8 and int16 unboxed types (oxcaml/oxcaml#5393)
  • [%%expect_asm] support added to expect tests, enabling verification of generated x86_64 assembly with architecture-tagged expectations (oxcaml/oxcaml#5350)
  • chamelon run subcommand introduced as the new canonical interface; old chamelon -c '...' file.ml syntax shows a deprecation warning (oxcaml/oxcaml#5421)
  • chamelon dune subcommand plus minimize-failure and minimize-stdlib Makefile targets; parses dune output to automatically minimize compilation failures (oxcaml/oxcaml#5423)
  • Manual module initialization via new -manual-module-init linker flag; caml_init_module, caml_init_module_exn, and caml_init_module_from_ocaml allow on-demand initialization with dependency tracking (oxcaml/oxcaml#5395)
  • -dfexpr-annot compiler flag dumps flambda2 fexpr representations alongside .cmx files at multiple pipeline stages (oxcaml/oxcaml#5210)
  • let poly_ and val poly_ syntax parsing support added for layout-polymorphic bindings (oxcaml/oxcaml#5392)
  • runtime5 added to ocamlc -config output so downstream tooling can detect the runtime variant (oxcaml/oxcaml#5415)
  • Wide vectors (vec256) translated to pairs on arm64 using two vec128 operations in Lambda IR, enabling most 256-bit SIMD tests on arm without AVX (oxcaml/oxcaml#5291)
  • Bit matrix for IRC interference graph selectable via -regalloc-param BIT_MATRIX_THRESHOLD:k; O(n²/8) memory with better cache locality (oxcaml/oxcaml#5296)
  • GC prefetch fix — prefetchr replaces prefetchw in the major GC, fixing exclusive cache-line locking that made multi-domain programs over 2× slower when sharing objects (oxcaml/oxcaml#5416)
  • Boxed vectors use tag 0 on amd64, matching arm64 representation and removing Abstract_tag (oxcaml/oxcaml#5410)
  • Fiber caches return fibers to the allocating domain by tracking domain_idx in stack_info (oxcaml/oxcaml#5363)
  • fexpr testsuite actions added via ocamltest integration (dump-raw-fexpr, dump-simplify-fexpr, dump-reaper-fexpr, check-fexpr-dump, run-fexpr) for middle-end testing (oxcaml/oxcaml#5413)
  • configure checks required tool versions with clear error messages for wrong OCaml, dune, or menhir versions (oxcaml/oxcaml#5348)
  • oxcaml-dev opam package simplifies development switch setup to three opam commands (oxcaml/oxcaml#5344)
  • jsofocaml opam packages (js_of_ocaml-compiler.6.0.1+ox, js_of_ocaml-ppx.6.0.1+ox) now source from the oxcaml branch of the upstream repository, eliminating 47 local patches (oxcaml/opam-repository#31)
  • Signature help stops after the last parameter in oxcaml/merlin, preventing the overlay appearing after all arguments are consumed (oxcaml/merlin#214)
  • Hover shows for all-legacy modes in oxcaml/merlin rather than an empty string (oxcaml/merlin#219)
  • Verbose kind enclosing output corrected in oxcaml/merlin via cherry-picked compiler changes from oxcaml/oxcaml#5398 (oxcaml/merlin#218)

  • Fiber cache correctness: Vesa Karvonen identified subtle liveness issues in the cross-domain fiber return implementation in oxcaml/oxcaml#5363, including a potential infinite loop in the cache-disabling path; Max Slater iterated through multiple fixes
  • GC prefetch semantics: Stephen Dolan in oxcaml/oxcaml#5416 explains that prefetchw takes an exclusive cache-line lock, serializing domains that share objects, while prefetchr avoids this; a benchmark showed over 2× slowdown with prefetchw in multi-domain shared-object scenarios
  • dynlink ABI trade-offs: In oxcaml/oxcaml#5420, David Allsopp describes how dynu_defines header entries as mangled symbol strings allow natdynlink to avoid depending on Symbol.t while preserving ocamlobjinfo compatibility

  • Preemption continuation sizing: Stephen Dolan and Aspen Smith in oxcaml/oxcaml#4881 discuss GC root scanning implications of preemptions at non-call GC points, including how continuation objects must be dynamically sized to store gc_regs

    • OCaml Core

    GC idle phase landed, String.drop_prefix/suffix added, GADT errors improved, and RFC #59 on val declarations discussed.

    New Features

  • String.drop_prefix and String.drop_suffix added to the stdlib, returning Some t when the string matches the given prefix/suffix or None otherwise (ocaml/ocaml#14487)
  • Major GC idle phase merged: adds an Idle phase allowing the GC to skip unnecessary work between cycles, addressing CPU usage regressions for OCaml 5.x workloads (ocaml/ocaml#14365)
  • Improved GADT error messages now include hints about type variables introduced by GADT equations when they appear in error output without context (e.g. $0, $1, $2) (ocaml/ocaml#14142)
  • lazy v optimization for structured constants: expressions like lazy (Cons (x, s)) are now optimized at compile time, achieving ~2.7x speedup in benchmarks vs. OCaml 5.3 (ocaml/ocaml#13919)
  • ocamltest conditionals &&, ||, and if/then/else added to the test statement language for platform-conditional test setup (ocaml/ocaml#14532)
  • ocamltest system variable introduced, exposing the configure-time system name (e.g. macosx, linux, freebsd) for use in test conditions (ocaml/ocaml#14545)
  • Inclusion check error messages improved: error messages now reference the original source file rather than ppx-generated artifacts (ocaml/ocaml#14205)
  • git-archive export-ignore merged: removes testsuite, manual, and other files from GitHub-generated source archives, shrinking opam installation archives by ~25% and saving ~100 seconds on first-time Windows installs (ocaml/ocaml#14152)
  • Scannable_* macros replace raw No_scan_tag comparisons throughout the runtime, reducing direction/equality errors and fixing a latent bug in weak.c (ocaml/ocaml#14493)
  • Load_path.remove_dir bug fixed in the toplevel: calling #remove_directory previously destroyed the auto_include_callback, causing open Str to fail after directory manipulation (ocaml/ocaml#14551)

  • Key merges in ocaml/ocaml this week include the GC idle phase (ocaml/ocaml#14365), String.drop_prefix/suffix (ocaml/ocaml#14487), lazy structured constant optimization (ocaml/ocaml#13919), and ocamltest DSL extensions (ocaml/ocaml#14532, ocaml/ocaml#14545)

  • Fun.todo API design (ocaml/ocaml#14525) generated discussion on encoding call location in the exception payload: Gabriel Scherer argued for payload inclusion for cases without backtraces, Daniel Bünzli wanted an abstract type to avoid committing to a representation, and Yawar Amin argued for a simple Todo of string with manual ~__LOC__ passing; the PR now uses an abstract todo type marked deprecated
  • GC pacing defaults in OCaml 5.5 (ocaml/ocaml#14533) discussed after Romain Beauxis reported significantly higher CPU usage than 4.14 for streaming workloads with large custom blocks; custom_major_ratio = 250 was found to restore near-4.14 behavior, and the merged GC idle phase (ocaml/ocaml#14365) is expected to help further
  • let module value restriction regression (ocaml/ocaml#14554) reported by Antonio Nuno Monteiro in OCaml 5.5 related to ocaml/ocaml#13839; Nicolás Ojeda Bär confirmed it should not break previously-typechecking code and looped in Samuel Vivien and Gabriel Scherer

    Activity this week was limited to ocaml-multicore/meio, which landed Eio 0.14+ compatibility via a migration from deprecated private APIs.

    New Features

  • Migration from Eio.Private.Ctf to Eio_runtime_events in ocaml-multicore/meio: the internal event callback system was rewritten to use the new Eio_runtime_events module and its typed event variant, replacing the older Ctf-based callback approach with a unified RE.add_callbacks call (ocaml-multicore/meio#72, 673fdbd)
  • Switch from nottui to nottui-unix in ocaml-multicore/meio: the UI event loop now uses Nottui_unix.run instead of Nottui.Ui_loop.run, reflecting an upstream split of the nottui library (ocaml-multicore/meio#72, 673fdbd)
  • New eio_name helper library for examples: a small Eio_name library extracted into example/eio_name.ml provides a name function using Eio.Private.Trace.name, replacing direct use of Eio.Private.Ctf.set_name and Eio.Private.Ctf.log in example programs (ocaml-multicore/meio#72, 673fdbd)
  • opam dependency updates: meio.opam now requires eio >= 0.14, nottui-unix (replacing nottui), and dune >= 3.10; the custom git pin-depends on a private eio fork have been removed, enabling installation from the standard opam repository (ocaml-multicore/meio#72, 673fdbd)
  • Improved task kind display: console.ml now renders task kinds using Eio_runtime_events.pp_event for unknown event types, and correctly distinguishes cancellation contexts (cc) from fibers (task) using new variant patterns from Eio_runtime_events.event (ocaml-multicore/meio#72, 673fdbd)
  • Removed Ctf.with_tracing requirement from examples: burn.ml, burn_domains.ml, main.ml, and zero.ml no longer need to wrap execution in Ctf.with_tracing, simplifying example entry points (ocaml-multicore/meio#72, 673fdbd)
  • CI updated to OCaml 5.3: the CI workflow now targets OCaml 5.3 (from 5.1.1) and uses ocaml/setup-ocaml@v3, removing custom opam repository overrides and the custom notty pin (ocaml-multicore/meio#72, 673fdbd)

    • Overview

  • Activity this week was confined to ocaml-multicore/meio; all other repositories (eio, domainslib, ocaml-uring, saturn, eio-trace, picos, kcas, ocaml-iomux) recorded no commits, PRs, or issues
  • ocaml-multicore/meio#72 landed Eio 0.14+ compatibility, bringing meio up to date with current Eio API surfaces and removing reliance on Eio.Private.Ctf internal APIs
  • Tim McGilchrist rebased Patrick Ferris's earlier work from ocaml-multicore/meio#71 and merged it as ocaml-multicore/meio#72 (22 files changed)
  • A follow-up issue ocaml-multicore/meio#73 was opened to track re-enabling screencast generation in CI, which was disabled due to a dependency on a patched notty library hardcoding terminal size

    • Activity

  • Tim McGilchrist merged ocaml-multicore/meio#72 "Eio.0.14+", a rebased version of Patrick Ferris's earlier work in ocaml-multicore/meio#71, bringing the codebase up to date with the modern Eio API surface
  • Tim McGilchrist opened ocaml-multicore/meio#73 "Re-enable the screencast generation in CI", noting that the screencast pipeline depended on a patched version of the notty library that hardcoded terminal size; the screencast steps are currently commented out in CI pending either an upstream fix or a workaround for terminal-size configuration

    • Notable Discussions

  • Patrick Ferris commented on ocaml-multicore/meio#72 thanking Tim McGilchrist for rebasing and landing the Eio 0.14+ compatibility work originally authored in ocaml-multicore/meio#71

    • Emerging Trends

  • Eio API modernisation across the group: the migration in ocaml-multicore/meio#72 from Eio.Private.Ctf to Eio_runtime_events reflects stabilisation of the runtime-events interface in Eio 0.14+; other tools in the group that still reference Eio.Private.* APIs may face similar migration work
  • CI infrastructure debt: the screencast generation pipeline in meio was disabled rather than updated (ocaml-multicore/meio#73), highlighting a recurring pattern where documentation and tooling CI falls behind library dependency evolution
entry.summary: 3 releases (dune 3.21.1, js_of_ocaml 6.3.1/6.3.2), 34 OxCaml PRs, 22+ ecosystem package releases, and meio modernization.

entry.title: Week 6, 2026: Module-dependent functions merged, js_of_ocaml 6.3.0 released, 52 dune PRs merged, 19 opam packages released, €100K security grants announced
entry.content:
Weekly Summary

New Features

  • OCaml Core Module-dependent functions (modular explicits) merged to ocaml/ocaml, enabling functions parameterized over modules using (module M : S) -> t[M] syntax as a lightweight alternative to functors (ocaml/ocaml#13275, ocaml/ocaml#14048) by Samuel Vivien and Gabriel Scherer
  • OCaml Core Lazy value optimization for structured constants eliminates need for Lazy.from_val in most cases by optimizing lazy v when v is a constant (ocaml/ocaml#13919) by Gabriel Scherer
  • OCaml Core Infix-tag bug fix in minor collector that could cause segfaults in multi-domain programs (ocaml/ocaml#14495) by Nick Barnes
  • OCaml Core Runtime_events segfault fix correcting error checking when calling mmap() (ocaml/ocaml#14519)
  • OCaml Core TSan function signature corrected to fix __tsan_func_exit() mismatch (ocaml/ocaml#14082)
  • OCaml Core Thread-safe POSIX functions adopted in libunix for better concurrency support (ocaml/ocaml#13700)
  • OCaml Core C++ compiler detection improved with proper header testing (ocaml/ocaml#14526, ocaml/ocaml#14498)
  • OCaml Core Dune build system restored after recent breakage (ocaml/ocaml#14529)
  • OxCaml New bool# unboxed boolean type with #true and #false literal syntax added to oxcaml/oxcaml, enabling efficient representation of boolean values at the bit level (oxcaml/oxcaml#5166)
  • OxCaml Borrowing support introduced in oxcaml/oxcaml uniqueness analysis system, allowing temporary borrows of unique values with proper type checking and mode analysis (oxcaml/oxcaml#5215)
  • OxCaml New -kind-verbosity compiler flag in oxcaml/oxcaml controls kind printing detail level with three modes: 0 (not verbose), 1 (expanded), and 2 (expanded with all modality bounds) (oxcaml/oxcaml#5397, oxcaml/oxcaml#5398)
  • OxCaml Format_doc module backported to oxcaml/oxcaml from upstream OCaml, providing structured document formatting with type-safe printer combinators (oxcaml/oxcaml#5357)
  • OCaml Ecosystem Lwt 6.1.0 stable release brings the promises and event-driven I/O library to production readiness after alpha and beta testing (ocaml/opam-repository#29295, ocaml/opam-repository#29336) by Raphaël Proust
  • OCaml Ecosystem Security grants announcement published with up to €100,000 available for projects strengthening OCaml ecosystem security, with proposals due March 1st, 2026 (ocaml/ocaml.org#3483)
  • OCaml Ecosystem OCaml history page restored documenting the language's evolution from Caml at INRIA in the 1980s through modern OCaml (ocaml/ocaml.org#3479)
  • OCaml Ecosystem Menhir 20260203 parser generator release across 5 packages with fixed Rocq back-end printing bug (ocaml/opam-repository#29331, ocaml/opam-repository#29332)
  • OCaml Ecosystem Camlzip 1.14 compression library fixes errors in local file headers for files larger than 4 GB (ocaml/opam-repository#29352)
  • OCaml Ecosystem Layoutz 0.0.1/0.0.2 new zero-dependency terminal layout DSL for creating structured terminal output including boxes, tables, and trees (ocaml/opam-repository#29327, ocaml/opam-repository#29328)
  • OCaml Tools ocaml/dune added markdown documentation generation via dune build @doc-markdown using odoc 3.1.0 (ocaml/dune#12581)
  • OCaml Tools OxCaml .cms files support in ocaml/dune for trimmed type information with (using oxcaml 0.1) (ocaml/dune#13397)
  • OCaml Tools Windows script execution with shebang parsing in ocaml/dune (ocaml/dune#13293)
  • OCaml Tools Windows OS detection for Cygwin/MSYS2 in ocaml/dune (ocaml/dune#13536)
  • OCaml Tools ocsigen/jsofocaml released version 6.3.0 (February 6) with constant sinking optimization moving declarations closer to usage (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2167), WASM-safe Dom_html.onload function (ocsigen/jsofocaml#1948), Js.Unsafe.runtime_value API for referencing runtime values (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2086), and eliminated unnecessary boolean conversions (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2168)
  • OCaml Tools ocaml/ocaml-lsp now applies ocamlformat to signature help for improved readability of long function signatures (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1580)

    • Group Activity Summaries

    OCaml Ecosystem

    19 package releases merged including Lwt 6.1.0, OCaml history page restored, and security grants announced with €100,000 available

    New Features

  • Lwt 6.1.0 stable release by Raphaël Proust brings the promises and event-driven I/O library to production readiness after alpha and beta testing, with version name corrections for beta packages (ocaml/opam-repository#29295, ocaml/opam-repository#29336)
  • Security grants announcement published by @sabine with up to €100,000 available for projects strengthening OCaml ecosystem security, with proposals due March 1st, 2026 (ocaml/ocaml.org#3483)
  • OCaml history page restored by Cuihtlauac Alvarado documenting the language's evolution from Caml at INRIA in the 1980s through modern OCaml, including key contributors and institutions (ocaml/ocaml.org#3479)
  • Menhir 20260203 parser generator release by François Pottier across 5 packages with fixed Rocq back-end printing bug from version 20260122 (ocaml/opam-repository#29331, ocaml/opam-repository#29332)
  • Grenier 0.16 algorithm library by Frédéric Bour adds is_singleton function for OCaml 5.5 compatibility and rank-based element access functions in Balmap (ocaml/opam-repository#29349)
  • Camlzip 1.14 compression library by Xavier Leroy fixes errors in local file headers for files larger than 4 GB (ocaml/opam-repository#29352)
  • Layoutz 0.0.1/0.0.2 new zero-dependency terminal layout DSL by Matthieu Court for creating structured terminal output including boxes, tables, and trees (ocaml/opam-repository#29327, ocaml/opam-repository#29328)
  • Dune-release 2.2.0 announcement added by @sabine documenting compatibility with cmdliner 2.0.0 and removal of prefix-matching for command options (ocaml/ocaml.org#3486)

    • Overview

  • 19 package releases merged in ocaml/opam-repository including production-ready Lwt 6.1.0, Menhir parser generator updates, and multiple new testing libraries (ocaml/opam-repository#29295)
  • ocaml/ocaml.org focused on content restoration, internationalization progress with Japanese translations, and security ecosystem growth announcements (ocaml/ocaml.org#3479, ocaml/ocaml.org#3489)
  • Multiple library updates targeting OCaml 5.5 compatibility and platform tooling improvements across both repositories
  • Active community engagement with 22+ contributors in opam-repository and sustained Tarides team contributions to ocaml.org infrastructure

    • Activity

  • Jsofocaml 6.3.0 opened by @hhugo with 8 packages bringing WASM optimizations including number unboxing, reference unboxing, constant sinking pass, shell completion scripts, improved NaN handling, and numerous DOM/WebGL binding fixes (ocaml/opam-repository#29348)
  • Testcontainers-OCaml library submission by Sachin Beniwal adding Docker container support for integration tests with 11 packages covering PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch, Memcached, LocalStack, and MockServer modules (ocaml/opam-repository#29340)
  • Trace 0.11 tracing library rework by Simon Cruanes with lighter collector using open sum types, extensible metrics, removal of global state, and poly variants for userdata/spanflavor (ocaml/opam-repository#29345)
  • Japanese translation work continued by mt_caret with draft PR containing 2,493 additions across 86 files (ocaml/ocaml.org#3489)
  • Scraper infrastructure improvements by @sabine to fix incorrect OCaml Platform release titles and implement filtering of ignored platform releases (ocaml/ocaml.org#3485, ocaml/ocaml.org#3482)
  • Historic platform releases backfilled by @sabine adding missing November and December 2025 releases for dune, mdx, merlin, ocaml-lsp, ocamlformat, opam-publish, opam, and ppxlib (ocaml/ocaml.org#3444)

    • Notable Discussions

  • Lwt version ordering issue raised by Kate regarding lwt.6.0.0-beta01 being sorted after lwt.6.0.0 instead of before, fixed by renaming to use tilde separator (6.0.0~beta01) for proper semantic versioning (ocaml/opam-repository#29334)
  • Testcontainers CI testing discussion between Sachin Beniwal and Jan Midtgaard about handling Docker-requiring tests in opam-repository CI, exploring options including disabling runtest, commenting out network tests, or adding x-ci-accept-failures entries (ocaml/opam-repository#29340)
  • OCaml Planet feed discussion by Puneeth Chaganti requesting full blog post content instead of snippets for better offline reading and UX, comparing to Python, Haskell, and other language planets (ocaml/ocaml.org#3459)
  • Governance page visibility raised by Nicolás Ojeda Bär suggesting it should be a top-level navbar section rather than only in footer, comparing to Rust's governance page placement (ocaml/ocaml.org#3466)
  • Broken redirection from caml.inria.fr/about/history.en.html reported by Alan Schmitt, leading to restoration of historic OCaml history page at ocaml.org/history with redirection now live (ocaml/ocaml.org#3476)

    • Emerging Trends

  • Library maturation cycle visible through Lwt's progression from alpha/beta to stable 6.1.0 release in ocaml/opam-repository, showing careful testing and version naming corrections before production deployment (ocaml/opam-repository#29295)
  • Testing infrastructure expansion with testcontainers-ocaml introducing Docker-based integration testing patterns to OCaml ecosystem, raising CI policy questions about packages requiring external services (ocaml/opam-repository#29340)
  • WASM compilation improvements continuing in jsofocaml with number unboxing, reference unboxing, and constant sinking optimizations (ocaml/opam-repository#29348)
  • Security ecosystem growth signaled by €100,000 grants announcement on ocaml/ocaml.org targeting projects strengthening OCaml ecosystem security (ocaml/ocaml.org#3483)
  • Internationalization expansion with sustained Japanese translation work spanning 86 files demonstrating commitment to global OCaml community (ocaml/ocaml.org#3489)
  • OCaml 5.5 compatibility focus with multiple packages adding compatibility improvements (grenier, others) as ecosystem prepares for upcoming release (ocaml/opam-repository#29349)
  • Cross-platform packaging refinements addressing platform-specific depext issues for Alpine, Debian, Ubuntu, and Windows across multiple packages (ocaml/opam-repository#29323)

    • OCaml Tools

    High-velocity week with dune's 52 merged PRs, js_of_ocaml 6.3.0 release, and coordinated OCaml 5.5 planning across tools

    New Features

  • ocaml/dune added markdown documentation generation via dune build @doc-markdown using odoc 3.1.0 (ocaml/dune#12581), OxCaml .cms files support for trimmed type information with (using oxcaml 0.1) (ocaml/dune#13397), Windows script execution with shebang parsing (ocaml/dune#13293), Windows OS detection for Cygwin/MSYS2 (ocaml/dune#13536), sandbox tracing events for debugging (ocaml/dune#13538, ocaml/dune#13541, ocaml/dune#13544), and patch_back_source_tree sandboxing mode for safer linter integration (ocaml/dune#13495)
  • ocsigen/jsofocaml released version 6.3.0 (February 6) with constant sinking optimization moving declarations closer to usage (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2167), WASM-safe Dom_html.onload function (ocsigen/jsofocaml#1948), Js.Unsafe.runtime_value API for referencing runtime values (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2086), eliminated unnecessary boolean conversions (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2168), and fixed multiple DOM binding types
  • ocaml/ocaml-lsp now applies ocamlformat to signature help for improved readability of long function signatures (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1580)
  • ocaml/opam documentation now explicitly mentions raw field syntax for opam list --columns, allowing arbitrary field queries like license: (ocaml/opam#6846)

    • Overview

  • ocaml/dune led activity with 52 merged PRs including Rudi Grinberg's extensive RPC refactoring (14+ PRs), Ali Caglayan's 22+ PRs across CI/testing/fixes, Windows support advances by Puneeth Chaganti, and preparation for 3.21.1 release (ocaml/dune#13557)
  • ocsigen/jsofocaml shipped version 6.3.0 with 67 commits including compiler optimizations, correctness fixes, and DOM binding improvements by @hhugo and Jérôme Vouillon
  • ocaml/opam merged documentation improvements by Raphaël Proust (ocaml/opam#6846) and active discussions on cmdliner upgrade with PowerShell completion support (ocaml/opam#6853, ocaml/opam#6849)
  • ocaml/merlin had two PRs under review improving signature help (ocaml/merlin#2032) and fixing declaration navigation (ocaml/merlin#2034), plus OCamlformat upgrade reverted after same-day merge (ocaml/merlin#2031)
  • ocaml/ocaml-lsp merged signature formatting feature by Charlène_Gros (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1580) with bug reports on type navigation (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1586) and error persistence (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1585)
  • ocaml/odoc had Kate open OCaml 5.5 support request (ocaml/odoc#1401) and Jon Ludlam continuing bug fix work (ocaml/odoc#1400)
  • ocaml/ocamlfind, ocaml/opam-file-format, and ocaml-dune/spawn had no recorded activity this week

    • Activity

  • ocaml/dune underwent extensive RPC system refactoring by Rudi Grinberg reorganizing csexp_rpc into separate modules (ocaml/dune#13550, ocaml/dune#13548), introducing abstract method names (ocaml/dune#13578), and breaking changes in write/close operations (ocaml/dune#13569); path system improvements removing Path.exists and Path.is_directory (ocaml/dune#13583, ocaml/dune#13582); Melange support with package flag respecting (ocaml/dune#13522); and BSD platform support via ocaml-lmdb bump (ocaml/dune#13560)
  • ocsigen/jsofocaml focused on compiler correctness fixing parallel renaming bug (ocsigen/jsofocaml@9cf9411), Globalflow monotonicity (ocsigen/jsof_ocaml@61b2c25), and invalid simplifications; DOM binding accuracy with type fixes across submitEvent, mediaQueryListEvent, element properties; and example/documentation improvements across 12 demo applications
  • ocaml/merlin has Charlène_Gros improving signature help for labelled parameters with detailed feedback from Ulysse (ocaml/merlin#2032) and Tim ats adding test case for declaration finding bug (ocaml/merlin#2034)
  • ocaml/opam has R. Boujbel opening draft PR to expand opam list test coverage (ocaml/opam#6855) and Robin Bate Boerop proposing MAINTAINERS file addition (ocaml/opam#6845)

    • Notable Discussions

  • Cmdliner vendor update planning in ocaml/opam with Josh Berdine reporting missing upstream fixes (ocaml/opam#6849), team confirming backports for 2.6 milestone and future vendoring of cmdliner 2.1, while Daniel Bünzli and Brian Ward discussed completion improvements including switch-aware package suggestions
  • PowerShell completion support proposed by Brian Ward for Windows users by bumping vendored cmdliner while preserving opam's prefix behavior (ocaml/opam#6853)
  • OCaml 5.5 support planning between Kate and Ulysse in ocaml/merlin#2024, with team planning to start upgrade work this week after modular explicit merged upstream
  • LSP error persistence discussed by Juan J. Martínez reporting ocamllsp sometimes fails to clear errors after successful dune build --watch, requiring file re-saving or restart (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1585)
  • Repository origin display identified by Kate as UI improvement needed when packages exist in multiple repositories (ocaml/opam#6852)

    • Emerging Trends

  • Internal code quality focus with Rudi Grinberg leading systematic refactoring across ocaml/dune RPC and path systems, reorganizing over 2000 lines while reducing duplication, paralleled by ocsigen/jsofocaml's compiler correctness work fixing edge cases in optimization passes
  • Windows ecosystem maturation accelerating with ocaml/dune adding script execution (ocaml/dune#13293) and OS detection (ocaml/dune#13536), ocaml/opam discussing PowerShell completion (ocaml/opam#6853), and user reports showing growing Windows adoption
  • OCaml 5.5 coordination beginning across the tools ecosystem with Kate driving support requests in ocaml/odoc#1401 and ocaml/merlin#2024, indicating coordinated upgrade cycle
  • Editor tooling polish with Charlène_Gros improving signature help across ocaml/merlin and ocaml/ocaml-lsp, addressing user experience details for labelled parameters and formatting
  • OxCaml compiler integration expanding in ocaml/dune with .cms file support (ocaml/dune#13397) and compatibility fixes (ocaml/dune#13562), indicating growing adoption of the new compiler variant
  • Testing culture strengthening across repositories with reproduction cases added before fixes in ocaml/dune, version-agnostic tests (ocaml/dune#13534), and comprehensive test suites for new features

    • OxCaml

    Type system enhancements with bool# primitives, borrowing support, and Format_doc API in oxcaml/oxcaml

    New Features

  • New bool# unboxed boolean type with #true and #false literal syntax added to oxcaml/oxcaml, enabling efficient representation of boolean values at the bit level (oxcaml/oxcaml#5166)
  • Borrowing support introduced in oxcaml/oxcaml uniqueness analysis system by Zesen Qian, allowing temporary borrows of unique values with proper type checking and mode analysis (oxcaml/oxcaml#5215)
  • New -kind-verbosity compiler flag in oxcaml/oxcaml by Liam Stevenson controls kind printing detail level with three modes: 0 (not verbose), 1 (expanded), and 2 (expanded with all modality bounds) (oxcaml/oxcaml#5397, oxcaml/oxcaml#5398)
  • Format_doc module backported to oxcaml/oxcaml from upstream OCaml by Simon Spies, providing structured document formatting with type-safe printer combinators (oxcaml/oxcaml#5357)
  • Type representation syntax repr_ added to oxcaml/oxcaml source syntax with Ptyp_repr and Ttyp_repr AST nodes for explicit type representation annotations (oxcaml/oxcaml#5068)
  • Runtime optimization in oxcaml/oxcaml eliminating stack switches on noalloc C calls, improving performance for FFI boundaries (oxcaml/oxcaml#5224)
  • Interference graph extracted to dedicated module Regalloc_interf_graph in oxcaml/oxcaml register allocator by Xavier Clerc with cleaner API and degree tracking (oxcaml/oxcaml#5237)
  • x86 binary emitter fix in oxcaml/oxcaml for shift instructions with memory destination and CL register preventing incorrect code generation (oxcaml/oxcaml#5369)

    • Overview

  • All activity concentrated in oxcaml/oxcaml with 33 contributors merging type system enhancements, upstream backports, and compiler optimizations
  • oxcaml/opam-repository, oxcaml/merlin, oxcaml/jsofocaml, and janestreet/opam-repository had no recorded activity this week
  • 21 new PRs opened in oxcaml/oxcaml covering functors with modalities, manual initialization, bytecode optimizations, and small int operations
  • Type system work focused on modality refinement with multiple PRs addressing redundant warnings, imprecise annotations, and functor support by @dkalinichenko-js (oxcaml/oxcaml#5371, oxcaml/oxcaml#5372, oxcaml/oxcaml#5373, oxcaml/oxcaml#5362, oxcaml/oxcaml#5364)
  • Upstream synchronization progressed with Format_doc backport affecting 253 files and array runtime function renaming by Simon Spies (oxcaml/oxcaml#5357, oxcaml/oxcaml#5339)
  • CFG backend hardening by Xavier Clerc with liveness validation, invariant checking, and terminator arity tests (oxcaml/oxcaml#5375, oxcaml/oxcaml#5389, oxcaml/oxcaml#5390, oxcaml/oxcaml#5388)
  • Flambda2 optimizer improvements by Nathanaëlle Courant fixing reaper issues with exception handler parameters and rebuild checks (oxcaml/oxcaml#5377, oxcaml/oxcaml#5374, oxcaml/oxcaml#5379)

    • Activity

  • 21 new PRs opened in oxcaml/oxcaml including @dkalinichenko-js work on functors with modalities (oxcaml/oxcaml#5371), Mark Shinwell manual module initialization (oxcaml/oxcaml#5395), Ryan Tjoa bytecode deep copy of product fields (oxcaml/oxcaml#5386), James Rayman small int ctz/clz/popcnt (oxcaml/oxcaml#5393), @ttebbi-janestreet expect_asm support (oxcaml/oxcaml#5350), and Zesen Qian parsing for let poly_ and val poly_ syntax (oxcaml/oxcaml#5392)
  • Upstream backports in oxcaml/oxcaml progressed with Simon Spies merging Formatdoc introduction (oxcaml/oxcaml#5357) plus opening three additional Formatdoc refinement PRs (oxcaml/oxcaml#5378, oxcaml/oxcaml#5380, oxcaml/oxcaml#5381) and build system conflict resolution (oxcaml/oxcaml#5376)
  • Flambda2 reaper improvements in oxcaml/oxcaml by Nathanaëlle Courant with exception handler parameter fix preventing incorrect unboxing (oxcaml/oxcaml#5377), overzealous rebuild check fix (oxcaml/oxcaml#5374), and dead code removal (oxcaml/oxcaml#5379)
  • CFG backend work in oxcaml/oxcaml by Xavier Clerc merging simplify terminator bug fix (oxcaml/oxcaml#5389) and opening liveness checking at function entry (oxcaml/oxcaml#5375), basic invariant validation (oxcaml/oxcaml#5390), and additional arity tests for terminators (oxcaml/oxcaml#5388)
  • Match-in-match optimization fix in oxcaml/oxcaml by Guillaume Bury for over-applications in specialized handlers merged after 8+ weeks (oxcaml/oxcaml#5119), with follow-up flow analysis cleanup (oxcaml/oxcaml#5370) and ongoing data flow constant handling (oxcaml/oxcaml#5368)
  • Chamelon build tool enhanced in oxcaml/oxcaml by Basile Clément with consistent ocamlformat config merged (oxcaml/oxcaml#5387), module minimization in progress (oxcaml/oxcaml#5356), and reaper constant type rewriting opened (oxcaml/oxcaml#5391)
  • Type system and modalities work in oxcaml/oxcaml by @dkalinichenko-js including internal ticket fix merged (oxcaml/oxcaml#5372), redundant modality warning (oxcaml/oxcaml#5373), imprecise kind annotation warnings (oxcaml/oxcaml#5362), and modules aliased many requirement (oxcaml/oxcaml#5364)
  • Dissector fixes in oxcaml/oxcaml by Mark Shinwell removing overzealous AS check (oxcaml/oxcaml#5396), ehframehdr section removal (oxcaml/oxcaml#5394), and eh_frame cleanup (oxcaml/oxcaml#5384)
  • Runtime and tooling improvements in oxcaml/oxcaml including Max Slater fiber return to allocating domain (oxcaml/oxcaml#5363) and ARM test enablement (oxcaml/oxcaml#5385), Zesen Qian printtyp modalities exception fix (oxcaml/oxcaml#5382), @tkoukpari local annotations (oxcaml/oxcaml#5366)
  • Classic mode inlining fallback heuristic disabled in oxcaml/oxcaml by Mark Shinwell to improve optimization behavior (oxcaml/oxcaml#5383)
  • Address review skill tool implementation merged in oxcaml/oxcaml providing automated PR review response workflow (oxcaml/oxcaml#5367)

    • Emerging Trends

  • Unboxed types expansion continues in oxcaml/oxcaml with bool# type (oxcaml/oxcaml#5166) joining existing bits8/float32 primitives as OXCaml extends beyond OCaml's value kind system
  • Modality and mode system maturation showing sustained activity in oxcaml/oxcaml across multiple contributors working on functors (oxcaml/oxcaml#5371), aliased many requirements (oxcaml/oxcaml#5364), redundant warnings (oxcaml/oxcaml#5373), and cross-module interactions
  • Upstream OCaml 5.4 integration accelerating in oxcaml/oxcaml with Format_doc backport affecting 253 files (oxcaml/oxcaml#5357) and array runtime changes (oxcaml/oxcaml#5339) representing continued synchronization effort
  • Borrowing semantics introduction in oxcaml/oxcaml marks evolution of uniqueness analysis beyond simple ownership to support temporary borrows (oxcaml/oxcaml#5215), bringing Rust-like capabilities to OCaml's type system
  • CFG backend hardening in oxcaml/oxcaml with Xavier Clerc's systematic work on invariant checking (oxcaml/oxcaml#5390), liveness validation (oxcaml/oxcaml#5375), and terminator arity tests (oxcaml/oxcaml#5388) showing maturation toward production stability
  • Flambda2 optimization refinement in oxcaml/oxcaml through reaper fixes (oxcaml/oxcaml#5377, oxcaml/oxcaml#5374), match-in-match improvements (oxcaml/oxcaml#5119), and inlining heuristic tuning (oxcaml/oxcaml#5383)
  • Build system evolution in oxcaml/oxcaml through Chamelon module minimization (oxcaml/oxcaml#5356) and ocamlformat consistency improvements (oxcaml/oxcaml#5387) supporting better developer experience
  • Type representation at syntax level in oxcaml/oxcaml with repr_ additions (oxcaml/oxcaml#5068) enabling more explicit control over memory layout and representation choices

    • OCaml Core

    Module-dependent functions merged, 20 new PRs opened covering platform support and stdlib additions

    New Features

  • Module-dependent functions (modular explicits) merged to ocaml/ocaml, allowing functions parameterized over modules using (module M : S) -> t[M] syntax as a lightweight alternative to functors (ocaml/ocaml#13275, ocaml/ocaml#14048) by Samuel Vivien and Gabriel Scherer
  • Lazy value optimization for structured constants eliminates need for Lazy.from_val in most cases by optimizing lazy v when v is a constant (ocaml/ocaml#13919) by Gabriel Scherer
  • Infix-tag bug fix in minor collector that could cause segfaults in multi-domain programs (ocaml/ocaml#14495) by Nick Barnes
  • Runtime_events segfault fix correcting error checking when calling mmap() (ocaml/ocaml#14519) by Mark Elvers
  • TSan function signature corrected to fix __tsan_func_exit() mismatch (ocaml/ocaml#14082) by Hari Hara Naveen S
  • Thread-safe POSIX functions adopted in libunix for better concurrency support (ocaml/ocaml#13700) by Antonin Décimo
  • C++ compiler detection improved with proper header testing (ocaml/ocaml#14526, ocaml/ocaml#14498) by Antonin Décimo and David Allsopp
  • Dune build system restored after recent breakage (ocaml/ocaml#14529) by David Allsopp
  • Opcode synchronization cleaned up between ocamlrun and ocamlc by eliminating jumptbl.h and opnames.h (ocaml/ocaml#14488, ocaml/ocaml#14528) by David Allsopp
  • Ptype_external printing fixed in AST output (ocaml/ocaml#14518) by Patrick Ferris
  • Shell script portability improved for CI infrastructure (ocaml/ocaml#14520) by Damien Doligez
  • Documentation terminology updated replacing "redefine" with "redeclare" in C interface docs (ocaml/ocaml#14521) by Antonin Décimo
  • Flat-float-array test split for better testsuite organization (ocaml/ocaml#14523) by Florian Angeletti
  • OCAMLTEST manual rewritten from Org format to AsciiDoc (ocaml/ocaml#14510) by Sacha Ayoun

    • Activity

  • Type system proposals opened including locally abstract types in recursive let bindings by Alistair (ocaml/ocaml#14517), unlimited non-constant constructors by Vincent Laviron (ocaml/ocaml#14507), nested record definitions by David Sancho (ocaml/ocaml#14527), pure functors by Samuel Vivien (ocaml/ocaml#13905), and Merlin typing recovery integration by Xavier Van de Woestyne (ocaml/ocaml#14241)
  • Standard library additions proposed including Fun.todo with code location by Olivier Nicole and Pavlo Khrystenko (ocaml/ocaml#14525, ocaml/ocaml#13101), List.append_map and List.rev_append_map by Sylvain Boilard (ocaml/ocaml#13554), String.drop_prefix and String.drop_suffix by Michael Neumann (ocaml/ocaml#14487), and Atomic.modify/Atomic.modify_get operations by Gabriel Scherer (ocaml/ocaml#10798)
  • s390x architecture support progressing with shared library crash fix by Zane Hambly (ocaml/ocaml#14514), native atomic fetch-add implementation (ocaml/ocaml#14524), and CFI information fixes by Tim McGilchrist (ocaml/ocaml#14500)
  • POWER architecture work advancing with TSan shadow stack fixes by Olivier Nicole (ocaml/ocaml#14302), CFI support by Tim McGilchrist (ocaml/ocaml#14482), and frame pointer implementation (ocaml/ocaml#14505)
  • Additional platform improvements including RISC-V frame pointer support by Tim McGilchrist (ocaml/ocaml#14506), FreeBSD frame pointer testsuite updates (ocaml/ocaml#14530), and AMD64 endbr64 emission optimization by Zane Hambly (ocaml/ocaml#14515)
  • Runtime and memory management enhancements with slow domain join fix by Damien Doligez (ocaml/ocaml#13026), gradual minor heap address reservation by Gabriel Scherer (ocaml/ocaml#14162), thread-local storage improvements (ocaml/ocaml#13355), missing minor heap allocations fix by Tim McGilchrist (ocaml/ocaml#14522), runtime events cleanup on SIGINT by Stephen Sherratt (ocaml/ocaml#14470), ephemark minor fix (ocaml/ocaml#14338), mutex-protected lazy thunks (ocaml/ocaml#14393), Noscan_tag macro replacements by Nick Barnes (ocaml/ocaml#14493), and Obj.dup closure fix (ocaml/ocaml#14492)
  • Tooling improvements with warning 16 (unerasable-optional-argument) check enhancements by Alistair (ocaml/ocaml#14512), ocp-indent check addition (ocaml/ocaml#14485), and Dune build dependency improvements for opcodes sanity by Gabriel Scherer (ocaml/ocaml#14509)

    • Emerging Trends

  • Cross-platform architecture support intensifying with parallel work on s390x (ocaml/ocaml#14514, ocaml/ocaml#14524, ocaml/ocaml#14500), POWER (ocaml/ocaml#14302, ocaml/ocaml#14482, ocaml/ocaml#14505), RISC-V (ocaml/ocaml#14506), and AMD64 (ocaml/ocaml#14515) covering CFI information, frame pointers, atomic operations, and TSan compatibility
  • Module system evolution continuing with module-dependent functions now merged (ocaml/ocaml#13275) and pure functors proposed (ocaml/ocaml#13905), suggesting ongoing work to make the module system more flexible
  • Standard library expansion with concurrent proposals for Fun module additions (ocaml/ocaml#14525, ocaml/ocaml#13101), String utilities (ocaml/ocaml#14487), List operations (ocaml/ocaml#13554), and Atomic enhancements (ocaml/ocaml#10798)
  • Type system refinements in progress including locally abstract types in recursive bindings (ocaml/ocaml#14517), unlimited non-constant constructors (ocaml/ocaml#14507), nested record definitions (ocaml/ocaml#14527), and Merlin typing recovery integration (ocaml/ocaml#14241)
  • Runtime reliability improvements addressing multi-domain issues (ocaml/ocaml#14495), memory management (ocaml/ocaml#13026, ocaml/ocaml#14162, ocaml/ocaml#14522), and profiling tools (ocaml/ocaml#14519, ocaml/ocaml#14470)

    • Multicore

    Minimal activity with OCaml 5.5 compatibility work and one closed MacOS support PR

    Overview

  • Limited activity across the multicore group this week, with only 2 of 9 repositories showing any changes
  • ocaml-multicore/picos received one PR for OCaml 5.5 compatibility (ocaml-multicore/picos#387)
  • ocaml-multicore/eio had one PR closed without merging for MacOS block device support (ocaml-multicore/eio#827)
  • No activity in ocaml-multicore/domainslib, ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring, ocaml-multicore/meio, ocaml-multicore/saturn, ocaml-multicore/eio-trace, ocaml-multicore/kcas, or ocaml-multicore/ocaml-iomux

    • Activity

  • Kate opened OCaml 5.5 compatibility PR in ocaml-multicore/picos (ocaml-multicore/picos#387) to prepare for the upcoming compiler release, addressing changes detailed in ocaml/ocaml#14224
  • Aaron Eline's PR in ocaml-multicore/eio to support writing to block devices on MacOS was closed without merging (ocaml-multicore/eio#827), which addressed POLLNVAL handling for block devices to resolve ocaml-multicore/eio#757

    • Emerging Trends

  • Preparation for OCaml 5.5 compatibility beginning in the multicore ecosystem with ocaml-multicore/picos#387 targeting upstream changes from ocaml/ocaml#14224
entry.summary: Module-dependent functions merged, js_of_ocaml 6.3.0 released, 52 dune PRs merged, 19 opam packages released, €100K security grants announced

entry.title: Week 5, 2026: Testing infrastructure modernized, ARM64 binary emitter shipped, LSP custom requests expanded, 48 package releases merged
entry.content:
Weekly Summary

New Features

  • OCaml Core Fixed string operation miscompilation affecting liveness analysis in native code generation, backported to 5.4 branch (ocaml/ocaml#14010)
  • OCaml Core ocamltest negation syntax added allowing not to negate predicate-like actions in test specifications (ocaml/ocaml#14502)
  • OCaml Core ocamltest legacy syntax removed including the old tree syntax with *** and the -translate option (ocaml/ocaml#14499)
  • OCaml Core stdlib design guidelines added in GUIDELINES.md covering scope, consistency, pragmatism, ergonomics, generality, naming, and stability principles for standard library development (ocaml/ocaml#14459)
  • OCaml Core C++ API compatibility testing improved with GCC and MSVC SARIF diagnostics, refactored bigarray.h C++ support to suppress warnings in strict mode (ocaml/ocaml#14421, ocaml/ocaml#14496)
  • OCaml Core Public header testing hardened with pedantic compilation checks for each header individually, added include guard to sizeclasses.h, and consistent macro usage for promoted header checks (ocaml/ocaml#14498, ocaml/ocaml#14494)
  • OCaml Core ocamltest actions added for compiler type detection including msvc, clang, has-cxx actions and exposed cxx and ccomp_type variables (ocaml/ocaml#14502, ocaml/ocaml#14421)
  • OCaml Core ocamltest self-testing infrastructure added allowing ocamltest to test itself with new ocamltest action (ocaml/ocaml#13317)
  • OxCaml Binary machine code emitter for ARM64 architecture by Mark Shinwell, replacing text-based assembly generation with direct binary output for JIT compilation (oxcaml/oxcaml#5177, oxcaml/oxcaml#5340, oxcaml/oxcaml#5188)
  • OxCaml Binary emitter verification infrastructure with new -verify-binary-emitter flag that compares generated binary output against system assembler for correctness validation (oxcaml/oxcaml#5198, oxcaml/oxcaml#5345)
  • OxCaml New kind-enclosing query command as jkind analogue of type-enclosing hovers, enabling developers to view kinds at cursor position (oxcaml/merlin#208)
  • OxCaml Unboxed unit literal syntax #() added for zero-sized unboxed tuple representation (oxcaml/oxcaml#5156)
  • OxCaml Abstract unit# type of kind void mod everything introduced as unboxed unit variant created with %unbox_unit primitive (oxcaml/oxcaml#5151)
  • OxCaml New %domain_index primitive implements Domain.self_index directly in the compiler for efficient domain identification (oxcaml/oxcaml#5312)
  • OxCaml New opam-core 2.5.0+ox package with patches by @art-w to fix locality type conversion issues where fn : _ @ local -> _ expressions now work with explicit lambda wrappers (fun x -> fn x) for proper @ global casting (oxcaml/opam-repository#33)
  • OxCaml Improved Gc.stat and Gc.quick_stat reporting with runtime 5 support for heap_chunks field and better documentation of cost differences between functions (oxcaml/oxcaml#5226)
  • OxCaml Support for arrays of unboxed pairs of vec128s enabling vec128 & vec128 and vec128 & vec128 & vec128 & vec128 array types for SIMD operations (oxcaml/oxcaml#5239)
  • OxCaml Enhanced verbosity control for kind-enclosing query with override_verbosity option allowing custom verbosity levels independent of main Mconfig settings (oxcaml/merlin#208)
  • OxCaml 64-bit EH frame support for dissector with new -dissector-assume-lld-without-64-bit-eh-frames command-line flags (oxcaml/oxcaml#5303)
  • OxCaml Fixed record field autocompletion cherry-picking upstream changes addressing completion issues (oxcaml/merlin#209, ocaml/merlin#2028)
  • OxCaml Enhanced locate-types command to include variables in results and properly handle optional function parameters by stripping option types (oxcaml/merlin#207, ocaml/merlin#2025, ocaml/merlin#2027)
  • OCaml Ecosystem Environment variables documentation added to HACKING.md detailing all OCAMLORG_* configuration options including HTTP port, documentation server URL, repository paths, and cache settings in ocaml/ocaml.org#3470
  • OCaml Ecosystem Performance timing instrumentation for opam package processing operations, including timing for dependency calculation, reverse dependency computation, publication date fetching, and package info generation in ocaml/ocaml.org#3464
  • OCaml Ecosystem New UI icons added to the icon library: bug_ant for issue tracking and globe_europe_africa for internationalization features in 127d60bb
  • OCaml Ecosystem Governance team contacts enhancement with new tracker icon support for issue-based team contacts in ocaml/ocaml.org#3460
  • OCaml Ecosystem Modern terminal UI framework mosaic with React-inspired hooks by Thibaut Mattio in ocaml/opam-repository#29312
  • OCaml Ecosystem OCaml SDK for pxshot screenshot API by Lucas Vieira in ocaml/opam-repository#29320
  • OCaml Ecosystem menhir-lsp 0.2.1 adding selection ranges and code actions by @dalps in ocaml/opam-repository#29318
  • OCaml Ecosystem ambient-context 0.1.1 for thread-local storage by Simon Cruanes in ocaml/opam-repository#29248
  • OCaml Ecosystem domainpc 0.2 for domain-per-core spawning by Hichem R. A. in ocaml/opam-repository#29317
  • OCaml Tools Dune sandboxing now enabled by default for test execution starting from dune 3.22 (ocaml/dune#13510) and MDX tests from version 0.5 (ocaml/dune#13504), plus sandbox cleanup improvements (ocaml/dune#13511) and fixed sandboxed action promotions (ocaml/dune#13520)
  • OCaml Tools Dune package management gained new --pkg CLI flag enabling or disabling package management from command line with --pkg=enabled and --pkg=disabled options (ocaml/dune#13458)
  • OCaml Tools Dune OxCaml workspace support allowing (using oxcaml 0.1) stanza in workspace files (ocaml/dune#13395)
  • OCaml Tools Dune promotion fixes allowing promotion into non-existent directories (ocaml/dune#13493) and promoting files over directories when cram tests change formats (ocaml/dune#13516)
  • OCaml Tools LSP destruct custom request (ocamllsp/destruct) enables case analysis to generate or complete pattern matchings via new API endpoint (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1583)
  • OCaml Tools Merlin signature help now stops after the last parameter instead of looping back to the first, fixing confusing behavior with too many arguments (ocaml/merlin#2023)
  • OCaml Tools Merlin locate-types now includes an Other variant for type expressions that don't fit other categories (ocaml/merlin#2025) and strips wrapping option type from optional parameters (ocaml/merlin#2027)
  • OCaml Tools jsofocaml runtime eval now uses indirect eval with optional chaining (eval?.()) and prepends "use strict" directive for improved security and performance (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2108)
  • OCaml Tools jsofocaml parser gained support for decorators in class and method syntax (21da6678) and HTML comments in scripts (87b7ae83)
  • OCaml Tools jsofocaml loop miscompilation fixed for loops at start of exception handlers (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2151)

    • Group Activity Summaries

    OCaml Ecosystem

    48 package releases merged with OCaml 5.4.0 compatibility work, plus governance updates and documentation infrastructure improvements

    New Features

  • Environment variables documentation added to HACKING.md detailing all OCAMLORG_* configuration options including HTTP port, documentation server URL, repository paths, and cache settings in ocaml/ocaml.org#3470
  • External services documentation explaining the package documentation pipeline, including the relationship with ocaml-docs-ci and the sage.ci.dev server in ocaml/ocaml.org#3470
  • Performance timing instrumentation for opam package processing operations, including timing for dependency calculation, reverse dependency computation, publication date fetching, and package info generation in ocaml/ocaml.org#3464
  • New UI icons added to the icon library: bug_ant for issue tracking and globe_europe_africa for internationalization features in 127d60bb
  • Governance team contacts enhancement with new tracker icon support for issue-based team contacts in ocaml/ocaml.org#3460
  • Modern terminal UI framework mosaic with React-inspired hooks by Thibaut Mattio in ocaml/opam-repository#29312
  • OCaml SDK for pxshot screenshot API by Lucas Vieira in ocaml/opam-repository#29320
  • menhir-lsp 0.2.1 adding selection ranges and code actions by @dalps in ocaml/opam-repository#29318
  • ambient-context 0.1.1 for thread-local storage by Simon Cruanes in ocaml/opam-repository#29248
  • domainpc 0.2 for domain-per-core spawning by Hichem R. A. in ocaml/opam-repository#29317
  • react-rules-of-hooks-ppx 1.0.0 validating React hooks by David Sancho in ocaml/opam-repository#29289
  • intel_hex 0.2 and 0.3 for embedded systems by Михаил in ocaml/opam-repository#29315 and ocaml/opam-repository#29321
  • mset 0.1.0 for small multisets using bitmaps by Jean-Christophe Filliatre in ocaml/opam-repository#29285

    • Overview

  • 48 merged PRs in ocaml/opam-repository delivered new package releases and extensive OCaml 5.4.0 compatibility work
  • Package ecosystem growth with diverse new packages spanning terminal UI frameworks, web APIs, embedded systems, React hooks validation, and data structures
  • Compatibility management prioritized with multiple upper bounds added for OCaml 5.4.0 and cmdliner 2.0.0 transitions across the ecosystem
  • Documentation infrastructure improvements in ocaml/ocaml.org with environment variables documentation, performance timing, and governance transparency enhancements
  • Policy discussions initiated on opam-2.0 deprecation and OCaml compiler version support with input from maintainers
  • Missing package documentation reported by multiple users, with consensus to migrate issues to ocaml-docs-ci repository

    • Activity

  • Lwt ecosystem updates with 6.1.0 release proposed by Raphaël Proust in ocaml/opam-repository#29295 addressing bugs from 5.9.2, while lwt_ppx 5.9.3 already merged in ocaml/opam-repository#29298 and inotify compatibility fixes completed in ocaml/opam-repository#29305
  • Menhir parser generator version 20260122 merged after extensive revdeps work by François Pottier in ocaml/opam-repository#29263
  • Package releases delivered including dune-release 2.2.0 with cmdliner 2.0.0 update in ocaml/opam-repository#29307, capnp-rpc 2.1.1 with cmdliner compatibility in ocaml/opam-repository#29277, miou 0.5.2 concurrency library in ocaml/opam-repository#29282, git-kv 0.2.1 storage backend in ocaml/opam-repository#29287, and qcow 0.12.3 fixing cache crashes in ocaml/opam-repository#29302
  • OCaml 5.4.0 compatibility enforcement through upper bounds added by Jan Midtgaard for MlFront_Cli in ocaml/opam-repository#29316, fstar versions 2025.06.20-2025.09.04 in ocaml/opam-repository#29314, libsail 0.15-0.20.1 in ocaml/opam-repository#29299, and ocamlformat-mlx-lib 0.26.2.0-0.28.1.1 in ocaml/opam-repository#29304 due to AST changes
  • Constraint management work continued with odoc upper bounds for gospel 0.2.0 and 0.3.0 in ocaml/opam-repository#29313, ocp-indent bounds for ocamlformat tests in ocaml/opam-repository#29311, and resolution of pplumbing package inconsistencies by Mathieu Barbin in ocaml/opam-repository#29303
  • Major version updates with nine volgo VCS packages reaching 0.0.22 in ocaml/opam-repository#29310, catala 1.1.0 with new output formats in ocaml/opam-repository#29294, fstar 2025.12.15 switching to source packages in ocaml/opam-repository#29099, and frama-c-metacsl 0.10 formal verification tool in ocaml/opam-repository#29308
  • Governance pages updated with current team membership by Nicolás Ojeda Bär adding Language Committee, Security Team, and Standard Library Team details in ocaml/ocaml.org#3460, maintainer list refreshed by Florian Angeletti to reflect January 2026 status in ocaml/ocaml.org#3467, and security team contacts improved by Hannes Mehnert in ocaml/ocaml.org#3462
  • Three new PRs opened on ocaml.org include improved documentation generation UX by Cuihtlauac Alvarado in ocaml/ocaml.org#3471, build system refactoring replacing ood-gen with data-packer and data-scrape tools in ocaml/ocaml.org#3463, and platform releases backlog covering November-December 2025 by sabine in ocaml/ocaml.org#3444
  • Content updates included Outreachy June 2025 internship information by Patrick Ferris in ocaml/ocaml.org#3473 and automated blog post and video scraping in ocaml/ocaml.org#3465, ocaml/ocaml.org#3468, ocaml/ocaml.org#3469, ocaml/ocaml.org#3472, and ocaml/ocaml.org#3474

    • Notable Discussions

  • CI infrastructure issue resolved in ocaml/opam-repository where Docker manifest inspection timeouts caused "No job variant" errors across multiple workflows in ocaml/opam-repository#29296, explained by Mark Elvers as 504 Gateway Timeouts during periodic SHA polling
  • opam-2.0 deprecation discussion ongoing with Hannes Mehnert and Anil Madhavapeddy noting the team is moving toward deprecating opam 2.0.x in favor of 2.1+ in ocaml/opam-repository#28952 and discuss.ocaml.org
  • OCaml compiler support policy discussion initiated by Hannes Mehnert proposing to narrow supported versions to OCaml 4.14+ and 5.3+ from current 4.08.1-5.4.0 range in ocaml/opam-repository#29059, with Anil Madhavapeddy noting Debian 11 LTS support ending August 2026 (OCaml 4.11.1) as reasonable minimum floor
  • Missing package documentation reported by multiple users including Raphaël Proust for lwt6 in ocaml/ocaml.org#3451, Alina Banerjee for eio and domainslib in ocaml/ocaml.org#3461, and ongoing discussion about QCheck 0.90/0.91 documentation in ocaml/ocaml.org#3437, with consensus to migrate issues to ocaml-docs-ci repository
  • Governance page visibility discussed by Nicolás Ojeda Bär proposing to make it a top-level navigation item in ocaml/ocaml.org#3466, with Cuihtlauac Alvarado suggesting it fits better under the Community section
  • OCaml Planet RSS feed enhancement requested by Puneeth Chaganti to include full blog post content instead of snippets in ocaml/ocaml.org#3459, referencing Yawar Amin's previous request in ocaml/ocaml.org#3125 for improved offline reading support

    • Emerging Trends

  • OCaml 5.4.0 preparation intensifying with multiple upper bound additions in ocaml/opam-repository indicating breaking AST changes, particularly affecting Longident types and parser-related packages requiring coordination across the ecosystem in ocaml/opam-repository#29316, ocaml/opam-repository#29314, ocaml/opam-repository#29299, and ocaml/opam-repository#29304
  • cmdliner 2.0.0 migration progressing with major packages like dune-release 2.2.0 in ocaml/opam-repository#29307 and capnp-rpc 2.1.1 in ocaml/opam-repository#29277 updating to support the new API, signaling broader ecosystem transition
  • Terminal UI development gaining traction with new framework mosaic providing React-inspired hooks and The Elm Architecture in ocaml/opam-repository#29312, alongside domainpc for multicore programming in ocaml/opam-repository#29317, indicating growing interest in modern UI patterns
  • Async I/O ecosystem evolution continuing with Lwt 6.1.0 addressing bugs in ocaml/opam-repository#29295, compatibility fixes for inotify in ocaml/opam-repository#29305, and related package updates showing active maintenance of concurrent programming infrastructure
  • Parser and formal methods tooling advancing with menhir 20260122 release in ocaml/opam-repository#29263, menhir-lsp improvements in ocaml/opam-repository#29318, fstar source package distribution in ocaml/opam-repository#29099, and frama-c updates demonstrating ongoing investment in verification tools
  • Package constraint management becoming more sophisticated with proactive compatibility work by maintainers, particularly Jan Midtgaard addressing version conflicts before they impact users in ocaml/opam-repository#29316, ocaml/opam-repository#29314, and ocaml/opam-repository#29313
  • Documentation infrastructure improvements becoming a priority in ocaml/ocaml.org with work on explaining external documentation generation in ocaml/ocaml.org#3470, improving error messages for missing docs in ocaml/ocaml.org#3471, and establishing clear issue reporting paths to ocaml-docs-ci
  • Governance transparency being enhanced through comprehensive team listings in ocaml/ocaml.org#3460 and ocaml/ocaml.org#3467, improved contact information in ocaml/ocaml.org#3462, and discussions about making governance information more discoverable in ocaml/ocaml.org#3466
  • Build system optimization efforts with the proposed replacement of ood-gen code generation (119MB of generated OCaml) with binary serialization via data-packer (17MB binary), promising 2.5x CPU reduction in ocaml/ocaml.org#3463

    • OCaml Tools

    Dune sandboxing rollout, LSP custom request expansion, js_of_ocaml parser improvements, and OxCaml integration progressing

    New Features

  • Dune sandboxing now enabled by default for test execution starting from dune 3.22 (ocaml/dune#13510) and MDX tests from version 0.5 (ocaml/dune#13504), plus sandbox cleanup improvements (ocaml/dune#13511) and fixed sandboxed action promotions (ocaml/dune#13520) by Rudi Grinberg
  • Dune package management gained new --pkg CLI flag enabling or disabling package management from command line with --pkg=enabled and --pkg=disabled options (ocaml/dune#13458) by Ambre Austen Suhamy
  • Dune OxCaml workspace support allowing (using oxcaml 0.1) stanza in workspace files (ocaml/dune#13395) by Simon Spies
  • Dune promotion fixes allowing promotion into non-existent directories (ocaml/dune#13493) and promoting files over directories when cram tests change formats (ocaml/dune#13516) by Rudi Grinberg
  • LSP destruct custom request (ocamllsp/destruct) enables case analysis to generate or complete pattern matchings via new API endpoint (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1583) by Xavier Van de Woestyne
  • Merlin signature help now stops after the last parameter instead of looping back to the first, fixing confusing behavior with too many arguments (ocaml/merlin#2023) by Charlène_Gros
  • Merlin locate-types now includes an Other variant for type expressions that don't fit other categories (ocaml/merlin#2025) and strips wrapping option type from optional parameters (ocaml/merlin#2027)
  • Merlin record field autocompletion fixed to properly suggest field names when completing record expressions (ocaml/merlin#2028)
  • jsofocaml runtime eval now uses indirect eval with optional chaining (eval?.()) and prepends "use strict" directive for improved security and performance (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2108) by Jérôme Vouillon
  • jsofocaml parser gained support for decorators in class and method syntax (21da6678) and HTML comments in scripts (87b7ae83) by Jérôme Vouillon
  • jsofocaml loop miscompilation fixed for loops at start of exception handlers (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2151) by Jérôme Vouillon
  • Odoc dune version requirement updated from 3.18 to 3.21 with cram test renaming to comply with empty alias requirement (ocaml/odoc#1398)

    • Overview

  • Dune led group activity with sandboxing rollout, package management CLI improvements, promotion system refactoring, and extensive OxCaml integration work (ocaml/dune#13510, ocaml/dune#13458, ocaml/dune#13395)
  • ocaml-lsp and Merlin expanded custom request APIs and improved type system tooling with destruct, locate types, and signature help enhancements (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1583, ocaml/merlin#2023)
  • jsofocaml focused on parser modernization with ECMAScript feature support, runtime security improvements, comprehensive manual rewrite, and version 6.3 release preparation (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2108, ocsigen/jsofocaml#2150)
  • opam worked on cmdliner 2.0 compatibility and new user onboarding experience refinement (ocaml/opam#6854, ocaml/opam#6851)
  • odoc integrated OxCaml compiler support and fixed type substitution and URL remapping bugs (ocaml/odoc#1399, ocaml/odoc#1400)
  • ocamlfind, opam-file-format, and spawn had no recorded activity this week

    • Activity

  • OxCaml compiler integration progressing across multiple tools with Dune workspace support merged (ocaml/dune#13395), ongoing jsofocaml support for parameterized libraries (ocaml/dune#13414) by Antonio Nuno Monteiro, and odoc upstreaming PR opened (ocaml/odoc#1399) leveraging dune 3.21's new %{ocaml-config:ox} variable by @art-w rebasing Luke Maurer's patches
  • Dune promotion system refactoring with extensive cleanup moving display logic to command line (ocaml/dune#13473, ocaml/dune#13482, ocaml/dune#13483), removing unnecessary scheduler uses (ocaml/dune#13479), and making promotion database abstract (ocaml/dune#13459) by Rudi Grinberg
  • Dune sandboxing infrastructure refactoring making sandbox arguments explicit in dependency evaluation (ocaml/dune#13508, ocaml/dune#13509, ocaml/dune#13503) and using direct API for test rule creation (ocaml/dune#13505) by Rudi Grinberg
  • Dune package management enhancements with PR to remove obsolete --ignore-lock-dir flag (ocaml/dune#13498) by Marek Kubica and ongoing odoc configuration file generation work (ocaml/dune#13476)
  • LSP custom request expansion with new PR for locate types functionality (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1584) by Xavier Van de Woestyne, signature help readability improvements (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1580) by Charlène_Gros, and merlin configuration server flexibility for custom build systems (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1581) by Andrey Popp
  • Merlin test coverage expansion with Charlène_Gros adding reproduction cases for historical issues confirming that ocaml/merlin#1214 and ocaml/merlin#1763 have been resolved (ocaml/merlin#2022, ocaml/merlin#2021, ocaml/merlin#2020)
  • Merlin region-based selection proposal with new -stop flag for enclosing command to support region-based selections rather than just point positions (ocaml/merlin#2029) by Xavier Van de Woestyne
  • opam cmdliner 2.0 compatibility PR opened enabling future upgrades while maintaining vendored version 1.3.0 (ocaml/opam#6854) by Brian Ward with PowerShell completion support opportunities (ocaml/opam#6853)
  • opam init workflow improvements with draft PR to improve opam switch create guidance when init fails (ocaml/opam#6851) by Kate and license field support continued development (ocaml/opam#6841) by Raphaël Proust
  • Odoc bug fixes with type substitution crash fix addressing ocaml/odoc#930 which caused Invalid_argument("List.fold_left2") crashes (ocaml/odoc#1400) and URL remapping bug fix for page references (ocaml/odoc#1395) by Jon Ludlam
  • jsofocaml documentation rewrite with comprehensive manual restructuring including quickstart guide, JavaScript interop consolidation, syntax reference, and error handling documentation (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2150) by @hhugo
  • jsofocaml release preparation for version 6.3 opened addressing pending PRs and runtime value re-export (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2152) by @hhugo
