  • jsofocaml parser testing infrastructure enhanced with tc39/test262 integration for standards compliance (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2149) and static evaluation experiment PR opened (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2153) by Jérôme Vouillon

    • Notable Discussions

  • Dune package management flag consolidation debated merging --ignore-lock-dir into --pkg flag (ocaml/dune#13468, ocaml/dune#13469, ocaml/dune#13472) considering options like --pkg=autolocking versus removing the flag entirely, led by Ambre Austen Suhamy and Marek Kubica
  • Dune sandbox promotion mechanism discussion on revived patch_back_source_tree feature (ocaml/dune#13495) for actions that modify dependencies with debate about naming and whether to use mode versus sandbox parameter, featuring Antonio Nuno Monteiro and Rudi Grinberg
  • Dune odoc configuration discussion on generating odoc-config.sexp files (ocaml/dune#13485) with implementation work in ocaml/dune#13476 addressing :with-doc dependencies and :post dependency handling
  • LSP type representation API discussed between Ulysse and Xavier Van de Woestyne regarding whether compact set field provides value or adds unnecessary protocol complexity in locate types (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1584)
  • Merlin region-based code selection discussion around proposed -stop flag for enclosing command, with Xavier Van de Woestyne explaining that LSP's point-based positions are insufficient for OCaml's expression-heavy structure (ocaml/merlin#2029)
  • opam cmdliner upgrade path discussed across multiple issues with Josh Berdine requesting upstream fixes (ocaml/opam#6849), Daniel Bünzli suggesting vendoring cmdliner 2.0 with legacy prefix patch, and Brian Ward volunteering to handle upgrade work including PowerShell completion support (ocaml/opam#6853)
  • opam first-time user experience extensively debated after @przemmeq0 reported that opam init silently exits when default switch creation fails (ocaml/opam#6848), with detailed analysis showing unclear note message and incorrect command suggestions
  • Odoc cppo conditional preprocessing challenges noted by @art-w where cppo only accepts integer values in conditionals but dune's %{ocaml-config:ox} returns boolean with no casting mechanism (ocaml/odoc#1399)

    • Emerging Trends

  • Sandboxing expansion across toolchain with Dune enabling test sandboxing by default from 3.22 (ocaml/dune#13510), MDX sandboxing from 0.5 (ocaml/dune#13504), and extensive infrastructure refactoring (ocaml/dune#13508, ocaml/dune#13509)
  • OxCaml compiler integration coordinated effort bringing experimental compiler support into mainstream tools through Dune, odoc, and jsofocaml with conditional compilation and AST version handling (ocaml/dune#13395, ocaml/odoc#1399, ocaml/dune#13414)
  • Custom LSP request expansion continuing trend of exposing Merlin capabilities directly through ocaml-lsp custom requests rather than code actions, with destruct and locate-types following earlier patterns (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1583, ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1584)
  • Package management UX refinement across Dune and opam with command-line controls (ocaml/dune#13458), flag consolidation discussions (ocaml/dune#13498), and improved initialization guidance (ocaml/opam#6851)
  • Documentation quality focus with jsofocaml comprehensive manual rewrite (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2150) and Dune tracing documentation improvements (ocaml/dune#13488)
  • Standards compliance emphasis through jsofocaml's tc39/test262 integration for ECMAScript validation (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2149) and parser modernization with decorator and HTML comment support
  • Test infrastructure modernization with Dune's Nix-based reverse dependency testing (ocaml/dune#13222) and Merlin's systematic historical issue reproduction (ocaml/merlin#2022, ocaml/merlin#2021)
  • Platform compatibility improvements with opam Windows SSL troubleshooting (ocaml/opam#6847), PowerShell completion work (ocaml/opam#6853), and relocatable compiler support (ocaml/dune#13229)

    • OxCaml

    ARM64 binary emitter shipped with verification tooling, editor hover improvements, and locality type system integration

    New Features

  • Binary machine code emitter for ARM64 architecture by Mark Shinwell in oxcaml/oxcaml, replacing text-based assembly generation with direct binary output for JIT compilation (oxcaml/oxcaml#5177, oxcaml/oxcaml#5340, oxcaml/oxcaml#5188)
  • Binary emitter verification infrastructure by Mark Shinwell in oxcaml/oxcaml with new -verify-binary-emitter flag that compares generated binary output against system assembler for correctness validation (oxcaml/oxcaml#5198, oxcaml/oxcaml#5345)
  • New kind-enclosing query command in oxcaml/merlin by Liam Stevenson as jkind analogue of type-enclosing hovers, enabling developers to view kinds at cursor position (oxcaml/merlin#208)
  • Unboxed unit literal syntax #() added to oxcaml/oxcaml by Nailen Matschke for zero-sized unboxed tuple representation (oxcaml/oxcaml#5156)
  • Abstract unit# type of kind void mod everything introduced in oxcaml/oxcaml by Ryan Tjoa as unboxed unit variant created with %unbox_unit primitive (oxcaml/oxcaml#5151)
  • New %domain_index primitive in oxcaml/oxcaml by Max Slater implements Domain.self_index directly in the compiler for efficient domain identification (oxcaml/oxcaml#5312)
  • New opam-core 2.5.0+ox package in oxcaml/opam-repository with patches by @art-w to fix locality type conversion issues where fn : _ @ local -> _ expressions now work with explicit lambda wrappers (fun x -> fn x) for proper @ global casting (oxcaml/opam-repository#33)
  • New opam-format 2.5.0+ox package added to oxcaml/opam-repository as dependency for opam tooling, enabling proper format library support for opam 2.5 under OxCaml (oxcaml/opam-repository#33)
  • Improved Gc.stat and Gc.quick_stat reporting in oxcaml/oxcaml by Nick Barnes with runtime 5 support for heap_chunks field and better documentation of cost differences between functions (oxcaml/oxcaml#5226)
  • Support for arrays of unboxed pairs of vec128s in oxcaml/oxcaml by Max Slater enabling vec128 & vec128 and vec128 & vec128 & vec128 & vec128 array types for SIMD operations (oxcaml/oxcaml#5239)
  • Enhanced verbosity control in oxcaml/merlin for kind-enclosing query with override_verbosity option allowing custom verbosity levels independent of main Mconfig settings (oxcaml/merlin#208)
  • 64-bit EH frame support for dissector in oxcaml/oxcaml by Mark Shinwell with new -dissector-assume-lld-without-64-bit-eh-frames command-line flags (oxcaml/oxcaml#5303)
  • Fixed record field autocompletion in oxcaml/merlin by Kostia Balytskyi cherry-picking upstream changes addressing completion issues (oxcaml/merlin#209, ocaml/merlin#2028)
  • Enhanced locate-types command in oxcaml/merlin by Liam Stevenson to include variables in results and properly handle optional function parameters by stripping option types (oxcaml/merlin#207, ocaml/merlin#2025, ocaml/merlin#2027)
  • CI testing expanded in oxcaml/opam-repository to include odoc and sherlodoc packages in the automated installation verification workflow by mt_caret (oxcaml/opam-repository#34)

    • Activity

  • Jakub Bachurski opened six new PRs in oxcaml/oxcaml for metaprogramming improvements including module pack annotations (oxcaml/oxcaml#5320), quote and splice typing fixes (oxcaml/oxcaml#5323), lazy substitution construction (oxcaml/oxcaml#5347), empty Tpoly handling (oxcaml/oxcaml#5336), test installation paths (oxcaml/oxcaml#5314), and revert consideration (oxcaml/oxcaml#5317)
  • Ryan Tjoa opened four new PRs in oxcaml/oxcaml advancing kind system with box_ type operator (oxcaml/oxcaml#5342), box_kind constructor (oxcaml/oxcaml#5343), block index optimization (oxcaml/oxcaml#5328), and [@flatten_floats] attribute requirement (oxcaml/oxcaml#5329)
  • Liam Stevenson opened mode-enclosing query PR in oxcaml/merlin as mode analogue of type hovers (oxcaml/merlin#210)
  • Simon Spies opened upstream merge PR in oxcaml/oxcaml for OCaml 5.4 integration (oxcaml/oxcaml#5325) and runtime array function rename backport (oxcaml/oxcaml#5339)
  • David Allsopp opened two infrastructure PRs in oxcaml/oxcaml for tool version checking in configure (oxcaml/oxcaml#5348) and simpler development opam switch management (oxcaml/oxcaml#5344)
  • OxCaml 5.2.0minus-29 merge completed in oxcaml/merlin by Liam Stevenson importing compiler changes including typing system refactoring, jkind simplification, mode system restructuring, and environment handling updates (oxcaml/merlin#212)
  • Locality type conversion patches applied in oxcaml/opam-repository to opam-core 2.5.0+ox addressing compilation failures where locality-annotated functions (_ @ local -> _) were not automatically cast to global context (_ @ global -> _), requiring explicit lambda wrappers by @art-w (oxcaml/opam-repository#33)
  • Build and CI improvements merged in oxcaml/oxcaml including toplevel .depend file removal by Simon Spies (oxcaml/oxcaml#5333), test installation fixes by Jakub Bachurski (oxcaml/oxcaml#5316), macOS test enablement (oxcaml/oxcaml#5337), and merge_group CI triggers (oxcaml/oxcaml#5321, oxcaml/oxcaml#5322)
  • Charlène_Gros opened signature help refinement PR in oxcaml/merlin to prevent signature help appearing on function names (oxcaml/merlin#206)

    • Emerging Trends

  • ARM64 backend maturation in oxcaml/oxcaml with Mark Shinwell delivering production-ready binary emitter infrastructure replacing assembly text generation, including comprehensive verification tooling and EH frame support (oxcaml/oxcaml#5177, oxcaml/oxcaml#5198, oxcaml/oxcaml#5303, oxcaml/oxcaml#5340, oxcaml/oxcaml#5345, oxcaml/oxcaml#5188)
  • Unboxed type system expansion across oxcaml/oxcaml with new unit# type by Ryan Tjoa (oxcaml/oxcaml#5151), #() syntax by Nailen Matschke (oxcaml/oxcaml#5156), block index optimizations (oxcaml/oxcaml#5324), and ongoing kind system work with box_ operators (oxcaml/oxcaml#5342, oxcaml/oxcaml#5343)
  • Metaprogramming quote system development in oxcaml/oxcaml by Jakub Bachurski with polymorphic application type inspection (oxcaml/oxcaml#5154), comprehensive testing (oxcaml/oxcaml#5214), and six new PRs addressing module packs (oxcaml/oxcaml#5320), typing fixes (oxcaml/oxcaml#5323), and type system refinements (oxcaml/oxcaml#5336, oxcaml/oxcaml#5347)
  • Editor tooling enhancements in oxcaml/merlin focused on hover capabilities with new kind-enclosing (oxcaml/merlin#208) and planned mode-enclosing (oxcaml/merlin#210) queries providing more type system information at cursor position, plus improved locate-types results (oxcaml/merlin#207)
  • Locality type system integration continuing across oxcaml/opam-repository requiring patches for ecosystem packages, with opam-core joining the growing list of packages needing explicit type conversion workarounds for functions with locality annotations (oxcaml/opam-repository#33)
  • Upstream contribution opportunities emerging as OxCaml-specific fixes could benefit the broader OCaml ecosystem when generalized, following the pattern established with the dune project (ocaml/dune#13342), as suggested by Anil Madhavapeddy for locality fixes in oxcaml/opam-repository#33
  • SIMD and vector type support growing in oxcaml/oxcaml with vec128 pair arrays by Max Slater (oxcaml/oxcaml#5239) and bigstring safety refactoring (oxcaml/oxcaml#5307) for ARM translation requirements

    • OCaml Core

    Testing infrastructure modernization, architecture support expansion, and stdlib guidelines

    New Features

  • Fixed string operation miscompilation affecting liveness analysis in native code generation, backported to 5.4 branch (ocaml/ocaml#14010)
  • ocamltest negation syntax added allowing not to negate predicate-like actions in test specifications (ocaml/ocaml#14502)
  • ocamltest legacy syntax removed including the old tree syntax with *** and the -translate option that converted from this syntax (ocaml/ocaml#14499)
  • stdlib design guidelines added in GUIDELINES.md covering scope, consistency, pragmatism, ergonomics, generality, naming, and stability principles for standard library development (ocaml/ocaml#14459)
  • C++ API compatibility testing improved with GCC and MSVC SARIF diagnostics, refactored bigarray.h C++ support to suppress warnings in strict mode (ocaml/ocaml#14421, ocaml/ocaml#14496)
  • Public header testing hardened with pedantic compilation checks for each header individually, added include guard to sizeclasses.h, and consistent macro usage for promoted header checks (ocaml/ocaml#14498, ocaml/ocaml#14494)
  • ocamltest actions added for compiler type detection including msvc, clang, has-cxx actions and exposed cxx and ccomp_type variables (ocaml/ocaml#14502, ocaml/ocaml#14421)
  • ocamltest self-testing infrastructure added allowing ocamltest to test itself with new ocamltest action (ocaml/ocaml#13317)

    • Overview

  • ocaml/ocaml focused on testing infrastructure modernization with four ocamltest PRs merged by Gabriel Scherer (ocaml/ocaml#14502, ocaml/ocaml#14501, ocaml/ocaml#14499, ocaml/ocaml#13317)
  • Architecture support expansion with three new PRs for frame pointer support on RiscV and POWER platforms by Tim McGilchrist (ocaml/ocaml#14506, ocaml/ocaml#14505) and Zane Hambly (ocaml/ocaml#14504), plus CFI information fixes for s390x (ocaml/ocaml#14500)
  • Runtime and GC improvements with four PRs from Nick Barnes addressing minor GC bugs and memory management issues (ocaml/ocaml#14495, ocaml/ocaml#14493, ocaml/ocaml#14492, ocaml/ocaml#14494)
  • Stdlib governance formalization through documented design guidelines merged from Nicolás Ojeda Bär (ocaml/ocaml#14459)
  • ocaml/RFCs had no activity this week

    • Activity

  • Eight new PRs opened this week including frame pointer support for RiscV by Tim McGilchrist (ocaml/ocaml#14506) and Zane Hambly (ocaml/ocaml#14504), frame pointer support for POWER by Tim McGilchrist (ocaml/ocaml#14505), CFI information fix for s390x by Tim McGilchrist (ocaml/ocaml#14500), multidomain minor-GC infix tag bug fix by Nick Barnes (ocaml/ocaml#14495), No_scan_tag replacement with Scannable_* macros by Nick Barnes (ocaml/ocaml#14493), Obj.dup fix on closures by Nick Barnes (ocaml/ocaml#14492), and header include ordering changes by Raphaël Proust (ocaml/ocaml#14491)
  • ocamltest modernization completed with four PRs merged by Gabriel Scherer including negation syntax (ocaml/ocaml#14502), internal refactoring with new tslprinter and tslquery modules (ocaml/ocaml#14501), removal of legacy tree syntax (ocaml/ocaml#14499), and self-testing capability (ocaml/ocaml#13317)
  • Testing infrastructure improved through hardened public header testing by David Allsopp (ocaml/ocaml#14498), consistent promoted header macro usage by Nick Barnes (ocaml/ocaml#14494), and partial type instantiation test by Florian Angeletti (ocaml/ocaml#14497)
  • C++ compatibility enhanced through API compatibility testing by Antonin Décimo (ocaml/ocaml#14421) and bigarray.h warning suppression by David Allsopp (ocaml/ocaml#14496)
  • Compiler bug fix for string operation miscompilation merged from Mark Shinwell after extended review period (ocaml/ocaml#14010)
  • Two PRs closed without merging including field getter syntax proposal by Malek Ben Romdhane (ocaml/ocaml#14042) and earlier ocamltest negation draft by Gabriel Scherer superseded by ocaml/ocaml#14502 (ocaml/ocaml#13315)

    • Emerging Trends

  • Architecture support expansion with three new PRs for frame pointer support targeting RiscV and POWER platforms plus CFI information fixes for s390x (ocaml/ocaml#14506, ocaml/ocaml#14504, ocaml/ocaml#14505, ocaml/ocaml#14500)
  • Testing infrastructure receiving substantial attention with ocamltest modernization, public header hardening, and C++ API compatibility testing improvements (ocaml/ocaml#14502, ocaml/ocaml#14501, ocaml/ocaml#14499, ocaml/ocaml#13317, ocaml/ocaml#14498, ocaml/ocaml#14421)
  • GC and runtime improvements continuing with multiple PRs addressing minor GC bugs and memory management issues (ocaml/ocaml#14495, ocaml/ocaml#14493, ocaml/ocaml#14492)
  • C++ interoperability emphasis with improved testing and header compatibility work (ocaml/ocaml#14421, ocaml/ocaml#14496)
  • Stdlib governance formalization through documented design guidelines establishing principles for future development (ocaml/ocaml#14459)

    • Multicore

    Limited activity this week focused on MacOS block device support in Eio with thread-based implementation

    Overview

  • Activity was concentrated in a single repository (ocaml-multicore/eio) this week
  • Aaron Eline advanced MacOS platform compatibility work with a new implementation approach
  • The remaining 8 repositories in the multicore group had no recorded activity during this period

    • Activity

  • Aaron Eline continued development on MacOS block device support in ocaml-multicore/eio#827, implementing a new thread-based approach to handle block devices that report POLLNVAL on MacOS, addressing ocaml-multicore/eio#757
entry.summary: Testing infrastructure modernized, ARM64 binary emitter shipped, LSP custom requests expanded, 48 package releases merged

entry.title: Week 4, 2026: Core stdlib enhancements merged, persistent compiler RFC proposed, oxcaml advanced Flambda2 and ARM64 work, tools saw code modernization
entry.content:
Weekly Summary

New Features

  • OCaml Core String module enhancements with split_first, split_last, split_all, and rsplit_all for splitting by separator in ocaml/ocaml#14437 plus replace_first, replace_last, and replace_all for substring replacement in ocaml/ocaml#14436 by Daniel Bünzli
  • OCaml Core Gc.Tweak module providing named GC parameters via Gc.Tweak.set "foo" 42 or OCAMLRUNPARAM='Xfoo=42' for GC experimentation in ocaml/ocaml#14367 by Stephen Dolan and Nick Barnes
  • OCaml Core FreeBSD frame pointer support for AMD64 and ARM64 platforms enabling profiling with pmcstat and dtrace in ocaml/ocaml#14486 by Tim McGilchrist
  • OCaml Core Deterministic compilation restoring reproducibility by resetting type ID and level counters between compilations in ocaml/ocaml#14483 by David Allsopp
  • OCaml Core Windows minimum version explicitly set to Windows 8/Server 2012 via _WIN32_WINNT macro in ocaml/ocaml#14484 by Antonin Décimo
  • OCaml Core AI contribution guidelines added in AI.md and CONTRIBUTING.md requiring disclosure of substantial AI authorship in ocaml/ocaml#14052 and ocaml/ocaml#14383 by Gabriel Scherer and Mark Shinwell
  • OxCaml Optimized Obj primitives with Obj.raw_field and Obj.set_raw_field as OCaml functions rather than externals in oxcaml/oxcaml#5241 by James Rayman
  • OxCaml Native expect tests via expect.opt tool using native toplevel instead of bytecode in oxcaml/oxcaml#5245 by James Rayman
  • OxCaml Mode error formatting using Format's print-box for proper indentation of nested "because" clauses in oxcaml/oxcaml#5275 by Zesen Qian
  • OxCaml Chamelon minimizer enhanced with stub minimizer and better submodule support in oxcaml/oxcaml#5292, oxcaml/oxcaml#5293, oxcaml/oxcaml#5294 by Basile Clément
  • OxCaml Platform-independent JIT refactored to work with ARM64 by Mark Shinwell in oxcaml/oxcaml#5186
  • OxCaml Locality documentation updated to clarify stack allocation is not guaranteed in oxcaml/oxcaml#5274
  • OxCaml Flambda2 optimizations encyclopedia documenting CPS conversion, canonicalization, unboxing, variant unboxing, and match optimizations in oxcaml/oxcaml#5082
  • OxCaml Merlin locate-type-multi command enables tree-based navigation of complex type definitions in oxcaml/merlin#148 by Liam Stevenson
  • Multicore Picos dependency upgrade updating multicore-magic from 2.3.0 to 2.3.2 across all packages in ocaml-multicore/picos#386
  • OCaml Ecosystem opam-repomin 1.0.0 minimizes opam overlays into unified repos using opam-0install solver in ocaml/opam-repository#29274 by Anil Madhavapeddy
  • OCaml Ecosystem csexp-query 0.1.0 query tool for canonical s-expressions in ocaml/opam-repository#29273 by Josh Berdine
  • OCaml Ecosystem ortools 9.14.0 OCaml bindings for Google OR-Tools in ocaml/opam-repository#29159 by Timothy Bourke
  • OCaml Ecosystem domainpc 0.1 spawns OCaml domains ensuring they run on separate cores in ocaml/opam-repository#29223 by Hichem R. A.
  • OCaml Ecosystem Dune 3.21.0 release announcement documenting experimental OxCaml library parameters, horizontal scrolling in TUI, improved cram test error messages, copy-on-write file copying, and Tangled ATproto support in ocaml/ocaml.org#3453
  • OCaml Ecosystem restricted 1.2.0 Linux filesystem sandboxing via landlock(7) with semantic versioning in ocaml/opam-repository#29233 by @stopusingghpls
  • OCaml Ecosystem slipshow 0.8.0 presentation tool with mirror mode for dual displays in ocaml/opam-repository#29249 by Paul-Elliot Anglès d'Auriac
  • OCaml Tools Git commit hash locking when locking git repositories for improved reproducibility in ocaml/dune#13297 by Marek Kubica
  • OCaml Tools Select field evaluation fix for MirageOS unikernels after lwt 6.0.0 in ocaml/dune#13389 by Antonio Nuno Monteiro
  • OCaml Tools File descriptor leak fix adding missing O_CLOEXEC to redirect files in ocaml/dune#13385 by Rudi Grinberg
  • OCaml Tools Option to skip test dependencies when building packages in ocaml/dune#13298 by Sudha Parimala
  • OCaml Tools Windows PATH handling improvements using Env_path helper in ocaml/dune#13405 by Puneeth Chaganti
  • OCaml Tools Relocatable compiler support for OCaml 5.5 by resolving symlinks in ocaml/dune#13239 by Ali Caglayan
  • OCaml Tools Enhanced tracing including diff category tags, thread spawning events, and process queue information in ocaml/dune#13451, ocaml/dune#13445, ocaml/dune#13444 by Rudi Grinberg
  • OCaml Tools Merlin locate-types now includes Other variant for non-navigable types in ocaml/merlin#2025 by Liam Stevenson
  • OCaml Tools Optional parameter handling improved by stripping option wrapper in locate-types in ocaml/merlin#2027 by Liam Stevenson
  • OCaml Tools Record field autocompletion fixed by adding for_completion to reader cache fingerprint in ocaml/merlin#2028 by Kostia Balytskyi
  • OCaml Tools JavaScript parser now supports using and await using resource management in ocsigen/jsofocaml#2143 by @hhugo
  • OCaml Tools Import attributes added with import and export statements via with clause syntax by @hhugo
  • OCaml Tools Import defer syntax for deferred namespace imports in ocsigen/jsofocaml#2147 by @hhugo
  • OCaml Tools Contextual keywords yield and await properly handled via virtual token feedback in ocsigen/jsofocaml#2148 by @hhugo

    • Group Activity Summaries

    OCaml Ecosystem

    Active package releases with 29 merges including new tools, Dune 3.21 announcement published, and three OCaml tooling tutorials opened

    New Features

  • opam-repomin 1.0.0 by Anil Madhavapeddy: Minimizes opam repository overlays into unified repos using opam-0install solver to determine minimum package sets (ocaml/opam-repository#29274)
  • csexp-query 0.1.0 by Josh Berdine: Query tool for canonical s-expressions with field, index, each, pipe, cat, and this operations (ocaml/opam-repository#29273)
  • ortools 9.14.0 by Timothy Bourke: OCaml bindings for Google OR-Tools models and CP-SAT solver, initial release with incomplete interface (ocaml/opam-repository#29159)
  • domainpc 0.1 by Hichem R. A.: Spawns OCaml domains ensuring they run on separate cores for better multicore performance (ocaml/opam-repository#29223)
  • deadcodeanalyzer 1.1.0 by Corentin De Souza: LexiFi's dead code analyzer for OCaml projects (ocaml/opam-repository#29262)
  • Dune 3.21.0 release announcement published documenting experimental OxCaml library parameters, horizontal scrolling in TUI, improved cram test error messages with shell commands, copy-on-write file copying on Linux, and support for Tangled ATproto repositories (ocaml/ocaml.org#3453)
  • qdrant 0.2.0 by Jeong-Sik Yun: OCaml client library for Qdrant vector database (ocaml/opam-repository#29267)
  • restricted 1.2.0 by @stopusingghpls: Linux filesystem sandboxing via landlock(7), added semantic versioning, tested on x86_64-openbsd and Linux with Landlock ABI v7 (ocaml/opam-repository#29233)
  • slipshow 0.8.0 by Paul-Elliot Anglès d'Auriac: Presentation tool with mirror mode for dual displays, external file support, and documentation rework (ocaml/opam-repository#29249)
  • lmdb 1.1 by @madroach: Fixed bad allocation pattern causing segfaults, deprecated old iterators, added Map.close and Map.to_dispenser iterator implementation (ocaml/opam-repository#29212)
  • liquidsoap 2.4.2 by Romain Beauxis: Savonet audio streaming tool update covering liquidsoap, liquidsoap-js, liquidsoap-lang, and liquidsoap-mode packages (ocaml/opam-repository#29235)
  • multicore-magic 2.3.2 by Vesa Karvonen: Low-level multicore utilities with unboxed Atomic_array support on OCaml 5.4 (ocaml/opam-repository#29241)

    • Overview

  • opam-repository merged 29 packages this week including new tools (opam-repomin, csexp-query, ortools, domainpc) and updates to liquidsoap, menhir ecosystem, and multicore utilities (ocaml/opam-repository#29274, ocaml/opam-repository#29273, ocaml/opam-repository#29159, ocaml/opam-repository#29223)

  • ocaml/dune: Git repository locking now records commit hashes when locking git repositories, improving build reproducibility (#13297) by Marek Kubica

  • ocaml/dune: Option to skip test dependencies when building packages, avoiding unnecessary test dependency compilation (#13298, #12658) by Sudha Parimala

  • ocaml/dune: Relocatable compiler support for OCaml 5.5 by resolving symlinks from install actions, enabling better caching (#13239, #13229) by Ali Caglayan
  • ocaml/dune: Enhanced tracing capabilities including diff category tags, thread spawning events, promotion registration events, process queue information, and metrics for digesting/reading/directories (#13451, #13445, #13444, #13446, #13382, #13387) by Rudi Grinberg

  • Platform support expansion with FreeBSD profiling infrastructure in ocaml/ocaml (ocaml/ocaml#14486), Power backend CFI support (ocaml/ocaml#14482), Windows version requirements clarification (ocaml/ocaml#14484), and cross-compilation toolchain discussions (ocaml/ocaml#14478)
  • Build system integration emerging as central design consideration with references to Buck2 and Bazel worker protocols informing the persistent compiler RFC design in ocaml/RFCs (ocaml/RFCs#60)
  • Determinism and reproducibility improvements addressing compilation output consistency in ocaml/ocaml (ocaml/ocaml#14483) and build system simplification (ocaml/ocaml#14488), with reproducibility concerns also raised in persistent compiler RFC discussions (ocaml/RFCs#60)
  • Type system soundness receiving attention with polymorphic pattern bug fixes in ocaml/ocaml (ocaml/ocaml#14480, ocaml/ocaml#14479) and shape occurrence handling (ocaml/ocaml#14476), while RFC discussions increasingly consider interaction with existing features and typechecker complexity (ocaml/RFCs#57)
  • Performance versus complexity trade-offs continuing to shape RFC discussions in ocaml/RFCs, with proposals requiring demonstration of concrete benefits sufficient to justify implementation and maintenance costs (ocaml/RFCs#60, ocaml/RFCs#57)
  • Modern C standards adoption with C2y _Countof operator usage in ocaml/ocaml (ocaml/ocaml#14413) and C++ compatibility improvements (ocaml/ocaml#14490)
  • AI contribution policies established with clear disclosure requirements and contributor responsibility guidelines in ocaml/ocaml (ocaml/ocaml#14052, ocaml/ocaml#14383)

    • Multicore

    Picos dependency upgrade and ongoing Eio MacOS support work; most repositories remained quiet this week

    New Features

  • Picos dependency upgrade: Updated multicore-magic from 2.3.0 to 2.3.2 across all Picos packages including picosaux, picosio, picosmeta, picosmux, and picos_std (ocaml-multicore/picos#386)

    • Overview

  • Activity concentrated in 2 of 9 repositories: ocaml-multicore/eio and ocaml-multicore/picos
  • 1 merged PR upgrading dependencies in ocaml-multicore/picos#386
  • 1 ongoing PR addressing MacOS block device I/O in ocaml-multicore/eio#827
  • 1 draft PR continuing experimental lock-free hash table work in ocaml-multicore/picos#382
  • 1 issue discussion about Fmt convenience functions closed in ocaml-multicore/eio#829
  • No activity reported in ocaml-multicore/domainslib, ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring, ocaml-multicore/meio, ocaml-multicore/saturn, ocaml-multicore/eio-trace, ocaml-multicore/kcas, or ocaml-multicore/ocaml-iomux

    • Activity

  • MacOS platform support: Aaron Eline continued work on handling POLLNVAL events when writing to block devices on MacOS, addressing device I/O limitations in ocaml-multicore/eio#827
  • Experimental lock-free hash table: Vesa Karvonen continued development of lock-free hash table with incremental resizing in draft PR with 823 lines added across 8 files in ocaml-multicore/picos#382
  • API ergonomics discussion: Volker Diels-Grabsch raised discussion about adding Fmt convenience functions to Flow and Buf_write for easier formatted output in production code without requiring traceln or Log frameworks, which was closed in ocaml-multicore/eio#829

    • Notable Discussions

  • Eio formatted output API: Discussion about adding Fmt convenience functions to ocaml-multicore/eio for production code output formatting was opened and closed by Volker Diels-Grabsch in ocaml-multicore/eio#829

    • Emerging Trends

  • Platform-specific I/O handling: Continued focus on MacOS-specific device I/O edge cases in ocaml-multicore/eio#827
  • Dependency maintenance: Regular updates to shared dependencies like multicore-magic across the Picos package ecosystem in ocaml-multicore/picos#386
  • Experimental data structures: Ongoing development of advanced concurrent data structures with lock-free hash table work in ocaml-multicore/picos#382
entry.summary: Core stdlib enhancements merged, persistent compiler RFC proposed, oxcaml advanced Flambda2 and ARM64 work, tools saw code modernization

entry.title: Week 3, 2026: Dune 3.21.0 released with tracing infrastructure, oxcaml advanced ARM64 backend and mode system, 11 new packages added to ecosystem
entry.content:
Weekly Summary

New Features

  • OCaml Core Array.stablesortsub function added to sort subarrays in-place using stable sorting algorithm by François Pottier in ocaml/ocaml#13343
  • OCaml Core String.includes function added to test if substring occurs anywhere in string by Daniel Bünzli in ocaml/ocaml#14439
  • OCaml Core Seq.delay function added to enable proper lazy evaluation in recursive sequence constructors by Gabriel Scherer in ocaml/ocaml#10177
  • OCaml Core Raw identifier syntax documented in manual allowing #keyword to use keywords as regular identifiers by Nicolás Ojeda Bär in ocaml/ocaml#14468
  • OCaml Core Effect keyword added to manual's keyword list with documentation on -keywords flag for modifying available keywords in ocaml/ocaml#14468
  • OCaml Core Windows socketpair race condition fixed preventing address-in-use errors during concurrent socketpair creation by Jessie Grosen in ocaml/ocaml#14461
  • OCaml Core Substring search micro-optimization in stdlib improving string matching performance by Florian Angeletti in ocaml/ocaml#14463
  • OxCaml ARM64 typed DSL with constraints enforced by OCaml's type system, improving type safety for instruction generation by Mark Shinwell in oxcaml/oxcaml#5193
  • OxCaml Native expect test infrastructure with expect.opt tool for native toplevel testing in oxcaml/oxcaml#5245, [%%expect.ignore_echo] directive in oxcaml/oxcaml#5244, and spacing consistency improvements in oxcaml/oxcaml#5243 by James Rayman
  • OxCaml Mode system improvements including functor currying properly constraining modes for soundness in oxcaml/oxcaml#5230, mode solver commutativity bug fixed in oxcaml/oxcaml#5233, and separability merged into layouts extension enabling zero-alloc Array.get in oxcaml/oxcaml#5231 by @dkalinichenko-js
  • OxCaml Sys.iobuffersize constant exposed in stdlib providing access to IO buffer size used by runtime system and Unix library primitives in oxcaml/oxcaml#5078
  • OxCaml Chamelon test minimizer gained new capabilities transforming single-pattern matches into lets and reducing match branches in oxcaml/oxcaml#5212 by Basile Clément
  • OxCaml Switch optimization fix for constant lookup tables preventing quadratic code size growth under -Oclassic -inline 20 by Vincent Laviron in oxcaml/oxcaml#5200
  • OxCaml Dune 3.21.0+ox packages added with complete build toolchain by Anil Madhavapeddy in oxcaml/opam-repository#29
  • OxCaml Lwt 6.0.0+ox packages including lwt, lwtdirect, lwtppx, and lwtruntimeevents in oxcaml/opam-repository#30, partially upstreamed to ocsigen/lwt#1096
  • OxCaml Compiler build concurrency optimization achieved 2x speedup from 32 to 14 minutes by unsetting INSIDE_DUNE environment variable by Sudha Parimala in oxcaml/opam-repository#25
  • Multicore Hash table resize bug fix in picos_aux.htbl properly handling pending resize operations, preventing race conditions during concurrent resizing in ocaml-multicore/picos#384
  • Multicore Lwt 6.0.0 integration upgraded in ocaml-multicore/picos with safer notification handling using option types instead of sentinel values in ocaml-multicore/picos#383
  • OCaml Ecosystem Dune 3.21.0 released across 17 packages by Shon Feder in ocaml/opam-repository#29216
  • OCaml Ecosystem Lwt 6.0.0 concurrent programming library released with 4 packages by Raphaël Proust in ocaml/opam-repository#29184
  • OCaml Ecosystem menhir-lsp 0.2 language server protocol implementation for Menhir parser generator added by @dalps in ocaml/opam-repository#29203
  • OCaml Ecosystem qcaml 0.1.7 quantum computing library added by Elias in ocaml/opam-repository#29229
  • OCaml Ecosystem proven 0.9.0 formally verified safety primitives library opened by Jonathan D.A. Jewell in ocaml/opam-repository#29228
  • OCaml Ecosystem passe 0.1.0 password hashing library added by Syaiful Bahri in ocaml/opam-repository#29209
  • OCaml Ecosystem intel_hex 0.1 parser for Intel HEX binary format added by Михаил in ocaml/opam-repository#29180
  • OCaml Ecosystem containers 3.17 data structures library released by Simon Cruanes in ocaml/opam-repository#29217
  • OCaml Ecosystem multicore-magic 2.3.2 data structures for multicore OCaml released by Vesa Karvonen in ocaml/opam-repository#29241
  • OCaml Tools dune-action-trace public library released enabling custom actions to emit trace events in ocaml/dune#13348
  • OCaml Tools dune trace command suite for trace file analysis with --follow mode enabling real-time monitoring in ocaml/dune#13183
  • OCaml Tools Virtual library installation fix resolved bug causing errors when virtual libraries had public modules in ocaml/dune#13345
  • OCaml Tools Shell completion installation for jsofocaml and wasmofocaml commands via cmdliner 1.3.0 in ocsigen/jsofocaml#2140
  • OCaml Tools Wasm runtime bug fix in compressed data unmarshalling that incorrectly read data size from wrong header location in ocsigen/jsofocaml#2141

    • Group Activity Summaries

    OCaml Ecosystem

    Active week with Dune 3.21.0 and Lwt 6.0.0 releases across repositories, 11 new packages in opam-repository, and website content updates

    New Features

  • Dune 3.21.0 released across 17 packages in ocaml/opam-repository by Shon Feder (ocaml/opam-repository#29216), with release announcement opened for ocaml/ocaml.org (ocaml/ocaml.org#3453)
  • Lwt 6.0.0 concurrent programming library released with 4 packages by Raphaël Proust (ocaml/opam-repository#29184), with compatibility constraints addressed by Hannes Mehnert (ocaml/opam-repository#29219)
  • menhir-lsp 0.2 language server protocol implementation for Menhir parser generator added by @dalps (ocaml/opam-repository#29203)
  • qcaml 0.1.7 quantum computing library added by Elias (ocaml/opam-repository#29229)
  • proven 0.9.0 formally verified safety primitives library opened by Jonathan D.A. Jewell (ocaml/opam-repository#29228)
  • passe 0.1.0 password hashing library added by Syaiful Bahri (ocaml/opam-repository#29209)
  • intel_hex 0.1 parser for Intel HEX binary format added by Михаил (ocaml/opam-repository#29180)
  • binsec 0.11.0 binary analysis platform released by Frédéric Recoules (ocaml/opam-repository#29193)
  • containers 3.17 data structures library released by Simon Cruanes (ocaml/opam-repository#29217)
  • multicore-magic 2.3.2 data structures for multicore OCaml released by Vesa Karvonen (ocaml/opam-repository#29241)
  • testo 0.3.4 testing framework released across 4 packages by Martin Jambon (ocaml/opam-repository#29239)
  • ufind 0.2.0 union-find data structure library added by 珊瑚 (ocaml/opam-repository#29240)
  • Tutorial spelling correction fixed "feets" to "feet" in ocaml/ocaml.org by Jørgen Boganes (ocaml/ocaml.org#3452)
  • Security team page update added GitHub ID for Boning Dong to OCaml Security Response Team page by Hannes Mehnert (ocaml/ocaml.org#3450)

    • Overview

  • Package ecosystem growth with 11 new packages added to ocaml/opam-repository including developer tooling (menhir-lsp), formally verified libraries (proven), quantum computing (qcaml), and web frameworks (passe)
  • Major release coordination with Dune 3.21.0 spanning 17 packages in ocaml/opam-repository (ocaml/opam-repository#29216) and release announcement prepared for ocaml/ocaml.org (ocaml/ocaml.org#3453)
  • Website content updates in ocaml/ocaml.org including tutorial corrections, security team information, and community blog aggregation from OCaml Weekly News
  • Version compatibility work following Lwt 6.0.0 release with conflict resolution between lwt and mirage-runtime (ocaml/opam-repository#29219)
  • Infrastructure challenges with documentation build failure for Lwt 6.0.0 traced to opamh compilation issues (ocaml/ocaml.org#3451)

    • Activity

  • Version compatibility management included upper bound on OCaml 5.4 for F* 2025.10.06 (ocaml/opam-repository#29230), removing ppxlib upper bound for ppx_make (ocaml/opam-repository#29236), adding Dune 3.21 upper bound to opam-dune-lint (ocaml/opam-repository#29213), and marking kind2 packages incompatible with Menhir 20260112 (ocaml/opam-repository#29225)
  • Platform releases maintenance with backfill of missing November and December 2025 releases by sabine covering Dune alpha releases, mdx 2.5.1, Merlin updates, ocaml-lsp 1.25.0, ocamlformat 0.28.x, opam-publish 2.7.1, opam 2.5 RC and final, and ppxlib 0.37.0 (ocaml/ocaml.org#3444)
  • Newly opened PRs including styled-ppx 0.61.0 CSS-in-JS preprocessor (ocaml/opam-repository#29227), LLVM bindings for versions 20 and 21 (ocaml/opam-repository#29110), markdown_monolith 0.1.1 parser (ocaml/opam-repository#29218), domainpc 0.1 domain-local promises library (ocaml/opam-repository#29223), and raga 0.1.1 API gateway framework (ocaml/opam-repository#29197)
  • Additional package releases including miou 0.5.1 concurrency library (ocaml/opam-repository#29210), art 0.3.0 adaptive radix tree (ocaml/opam-repository#29208), lambda-term 3.3.3 terminal manipulation library (ocaml/opam-repository#29221), server-reason-react 0.4.1 server-side React rendering (ocaml/opam-repository#29220), and 10 packages from ocurrent 0.7.3 CI/CD framework (ocaml/opam-repository#29191)
  • Menhir ecosystem updates with 5 packages from Menhir 20260112 release (ocaml/opam-repository#29211)
  • OCaml compiler improvements with corrected OCaml 5.5.0 compiler variable generation for relocatable installations (ocaml/opam-repository#29224, ocaml/opam-repository#29085)
  • Maintenance policy proposal to set default x-maintenance-intent to "(latest)" (ocaml/opam-repository#29074)
  • Community content aggregation with OCaml Weekly News for January 13, 2026 and five blog posts from Tunbury covering OCaml on Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W, opam 2.5 migration, and ARM64 updates (ocaml/ocaml.org#3454, ocaml/ocaml.org#3449, ocaml/ocaml.org#3448)

    • Notable Discussions

  • Maintenance policy discussion on setting default x-maintenance-intent to "(latest)" proposed in ocaml/opam-repository affecting repository-wide package lifecycle management (ocaml/opam-repository#29060, ocaml/opam-repository#29074)
  • passe 0.1.0 package structure generated extended discussion with 7 comments around dependency requirements and package design (ocaml/opam-repository#29209)
  • Dune 3.21.0 release discussion with 4 comments covering the 17-package update and compatibility impacts across ecosystem (ocaml/opam-repository#29216)
  • Documentation build failure for Lwt 6.0.0 reported by Raphaël Proust on ocaml/ocaml.org, traced to unrelated opamh compilation error due to missing OpamStd.String.starts_with function (ocaml/ocaml.org#3451)
  • styled-ppx 0.61.0 discussion with 4 comments on CSS-in-JS preprocessor updates (ocaml/opam-repository#29227)
  • CI testing policy issue requesting ocaml/opam-repository stop running dune runtest in CI with 2 comments by Romain Beauxis (ocaml/opam-repository#29166)
  • Syntax highlighting bug in ocaml/ocaml.org tutorial code samples where comment styling incorrectly applied to non-comment content remains under investigation (ocaml/ocaml.org#3037)

    • Emerging Trends

  • Version bound management emerged as key theme with multiple PRs in ocaml/opam-repository adjusting upper and lower bounds following Dune 3.21.0 release (ocaml/opam-repository#29213, ocaml/opam-repository#29230, ocaml/opam-repository#29236) and Menhir 20260112 incompatibility (ocaml/opam-repository#29225)
  • OCaml 5.x compiler ecosystem maturation with relocatable OCaml improvements for 5.5.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29224), upper bounds for F* on OCaml 5.4 (ocaml/opam-repository#29230), and ongoing LLVM 20/21 support work (ocaml/opam-repository#29110)
  • Multicore and concurrency libraries with releases of multicore-magic 2.3.2 (ocaml/opam-repository#29241), miou 0.5.1 (ocaml/opam-repository#29210), Lwt 6.0.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29184), and domainpc 0.1 (ocaml/opam-repository#29223)
  • Formal verification and type safety focus with proven 0.9.0 formally verified safety primitives (ocaml/opam-repository#29228), restricted 1.2.0 refinement types (ocaml/opam-repository#29233), and binsec 0.11.0 binary analysis (ocaml/opam-repository#29193)
  • Web and frontend tooling with server-reason-react 0.4.1 (ocaml/opam-repository#29220) and styled-ppx 0.61.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29227) demonstrating continued React and CSS-in-JS ecosystem development
  • Testing and developer experience improvements with testo 0.3.4 testing framework updates (ocaml/opam-repository#29239), menhir-lsp 0.2 language server (ocaml/opam-repository#29203), and discussion around CI testing practices (ocaml/opam-repository#29166)
  • Infrastructure reliability focus across both repositories with documentation generation pipeline attention on ocaml/ocaml.org (ocaml/ocaml.org#3451) and package maintenance policy evolution in ocaml/opam-repository (ocaml/opam-repository#29060)
  • Content quality and completeness with tutorial corrections (ocaml/ocaml.org#3452), security team information updates (ocaml/ocaml.org#3450), and platform release backlog addressing (ocaml/ocaml.org#3444)

    • OCaml Tools

    Dune action tracing infrastructure released, Melange single-context work advanced, signature help improvements across editor tooling

    New Features

  • ocaml/dune: Released dune-action-trace public library enabling custom actions to emit trace events, new dune trace command suite for trace file analysis, and DUNEACTIONTRACE_DIR environment variable support
  • ocaml/dune: Fixed virtual library installation bug #10635 that caused errors when virtual libraries had public modules
  • ocaml/dune: Added nanosecond precision timestamps to trace events, %{pkg-self:build-id} variable for package build identifiers, and --target-exec flag for execution targeting
  • ocsigen/jsofocaml: Added shell completion installation for jsofocaml and wasmofocaml commands via cmdliner 1.3.0, with enhanced autocompletion for optimization and debug flags
  • ocsigen/jsofocaml: Fixed Wasm runtime bug in compressed data unmarshalling that incorrectly read data size from wrong header location

    • Activity

  • Melange compilation architecture in ocaml/dune: Antonio Nuno Monteiro advanced single-context compilation with 9 merged PRs making compilation modes first-class throughout the codebase (ocaml/dune#13368, ocaml/dune#13356, ocaml/dune#13355, ocaml/dune#13354, ocaml/dune#13352, ocaml/dune#13350, ocaml/dune#13346)
  • Test suite reorganization in ocaml/dune: Rudi Grinberg systematically moved tests into topic-specific subdirectories (ocaml/dune#13367, ocaml/dune#13363, ocaml/dune#13361, ocaml/dune#13359, ocaml/dune#13360, ocaml/dune#13343)
  • Build system refactoring in ocaml/dune: Rudi Grinberg defunctionalized action builder and merged configuration modules (ocaml/dune#13344, ocaml/dune#13362, ocaml/dune#13358, ocaml/dune#13339, ocaml/dune#13335)
  • Signature help enhancements: Charlène_Gros worked on improvements across ocaml/merlin#2023 (behavior fix to prevent parameter looping) and ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1580 (applying ocamlformat to function signatures), with code review from Ulysse
  • Test coverage expansion in ocaml/merlin: Charlène_Gros added reproduction cases for historical bugs (ocaml/merlin#2021, ocaml/merlin#2020, ocaml/merlin#2022)
  • Package management features in ocaml/opam: Raphaël Proust opened PR to add license field to opam list with documentation and test improvements
  • JavaScript parser modernization in ocsigen/jsofocaml: @hhugo opened PR #2143 to align parser with ECMAScript spec and fix arrow function parsing, and created OCaml trunk support tracking issue

    • Notable Discussions

  • 0install solver behavior: @tobil4sk reported that builtin-0install solver incorrectly resolves multiple mingw architectures (both i686 and x8664) for conf-zlib and conf-libpcre2-8, while builtin-mccs+glpk correctly selects only x8664 variants in ocaml/opam
  • Package tag discoverability: @jrfondren proposed improvements to opam package tag visibility with analysis showing 126 org:mirage tags and 729 singleton tags, suggesting tag cloud visualization; R. Boujbel demonstrated existing column syntax and opened companion opam2web issue
  • Configure script robustness: Community member reported configure script failures in Rocky Linux 8 minimal containers lacking pre-installed findutils, extending Kate's configure hardening PR to additional Linux distributions in ocaml/ocamlfind
  • Symbolic link path resolution: Andrew Helwer reported LSP navigation issues with symlinked directories where go-to-definition and find-all-references fail when ~/src symlinks to /mnt/data/src, causing inconsistent path prefix resolution
  • JavaScript parser limitations: Spotandjake discovered jsofocaml parser fails on arrow functions in for loop variable definitions, a valid ES6 pattern encountered when linking libbinaryen

    • Emerging Trends

  • Action tracing maturation in ocaml/dune: Infrastructure becoming production-ready with public library release, command-line tooling, environment variable support, and nanosecond precision timestamps enabling comprehensive build performance analysis (ocaml/dune#13366, ocaml/dune#13357, ocaml/dune#13348, ocaml/dune#13330, ocaml/dune#13183)
  • Melange compilation architecture evolution: Extensive refactoring in ocaml/dune making compilation modes first-class throughout codebase, affecting Lib_info, module paths, object directories, and dependency resolution (ocaml/dune#13368, ocaml/dune#13356, ocaml/dune#13355, ocaml/dune#13354, ocaml/dune#13352, ocaml/dune#13350)
  • Developer experience improvements: Shell completion support added to ocsigen/jsofocaml (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2140), signature help enhanced across ocaml/merlin and ocaml/ocaml-lsp, and opam list gaining license field display (ocaml/opam#6841)
  • WebAssembly runtime stabilization: Continued bug fixes in ocsigen/jsofocaml for data unmarshalling (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2141) alongside ongoing work on stack switching effects (ocsigen/jsofocaml#1832) and WASI runtime (ocsigen/jsofocaml#1831)
  • Test organization initiatives: Systematic reorganization in ocaml/dune moving tests into topic-specific subdirectories (ocaml/dune#13367, ocaml/dune#13363, ocaml/dune#13361) and expansion of historical bug test coverage in ocaml/merlin (ocaml/merlin#2021, ocaml/merlin#2020, ocaml/merlin#2022)

    • OxCaml

    ARM64 backend maturation, mode system refinements, package ecosystem updates, and tooling improvements

    New Features

  • ARM64 backend now uses typed DSL with constraints enforced by OCaml's type system, improving type safety for instruction generation in oxcaml/oxcaml#5193 by Mark Shinwell
  • Native expect test infrastructure with expect.opt tool for native toplevel testing in oxcaml/oxcaml#5245, [%%expect.ignore_echo] directive in oxcaml/oxcaml#5244, and spacing consistency improvements in oxcaml/oxcaml#5243 by James Rayman
  • Mode system improvements: functor currying now properly constrains modes for soundness in oxcaml/oxcaml#5230, mode solver commutativity bug fixed in oxcaml/oxcaml#5233, and separability merged into layouts extension enabling zero-alloc Array.get in oxcaml/oxcaml#5231 by @dkalinichenko-js
  • Exposed Sys.io_buffer_size constant in stdlib providing access to IO buffer size used by runtime system and Unix library primitives in oxcaml/oxcaml#5078
  • Chamelon test minimizer gained new capabilities: transforms single-pattern matches into lets and adds reduce-pat minimizer for removing match branches in oxcaml/oxcaml#5212 by Basile Clément
  • Fixed switch optimization for constant lookup tables that previously caused quadratic code size growth under -Oclassic -inline 20 in oxcaml/oxcaml#5200 by Vincent Laviron
  • Dune 3.21.0+ox packages added with complete build toolchain in oxcaml/opam-repository#29 by Anil Madhavapeddy
  • Lwt 6.0.0+ox packages including lwt, lwtdirect, lwtppx, and lwtruntimeevents in oxcaml/opam-repository#30, partially upstreamed to ocsigen/lwt#1096
  • Compiler build concurrency optimization achieved 2x speedup (32 to 14 minutes) by unsetting INSIDE_DUNE environment variable in oxcaml/opam-repository#25 by Sudha Parimala
  • Effect primitives refactored to eliminate Must_not_enter_gc special case handling in oxcaml/oxcaml#4901
  • Fixed Sys.getenv_opt to preserve backtraces instead of discarding them in oxcaml/oxcaml#5076
  • Added Invalid construct through Flambda → Cmm → Cfg → Linear pipeline, avoiding special case handling in oxcaml/oxcaml#5208 by Vesa Karvonen

    • Overview

  • Core compiler focus: Significant progress on ARM64 backend with typed DSL foundation in oxcaml/oxcaml#5193, mode system refinements across multiple PRs (oxcaml/oxcaml#5230, oxcaml/oxcaml#5233, oxcaml/oxcaml#5231), and layout polymorphism groundwork in oxcaml/oxcaml#5238 and oxcaml/oxcaml#5148
  • Testing infrastructure expansion: Native expect tests introduced via oxcaml/oxcaml#5245, oxcaml/oxcaml#5244, and oxcaml/oxcaml#5243, with chamelon minimizer enhancements in oxcaml/oxcaml#5212
  • Package ecosystem updates: Over 100 Jane Street packages updated to v0.18~preview.130.83+317 in oxcaml/opam-repository, Dune 3.21.0+ox packages added in oxcaml/opam-repository#29, and Lwt 6.0.0+ox packages in oxcaml/opam-repository#30
  • Build performance improvements: Compiler build time reduced by 2x through concurrency optimization in oxcaml/opam-repository#25
  • Editor integration: Merlin signature help refinements for labelled arguments in oxcaml/merlin#205 and function name triggering in oxcaml/merlin#206
  • Active development: 15+ merged PRs in oxcaml/oxcaml, 3+ merged PRs in oxcaml/opam-repository, multiple ongoing initiatives including SIMD vectors, Flambda2 improvements, and mode documentation

    • Activity

  • SIMD vector development by Max Slater continues with support for arrays of unboxed vec128 pairs in oxcaml/oxcaml#5239 and translation of wide vectors to tuples on ARM in oxcaml/oxcaml#5240
  • Layout polymorphism progressing through Jack Rickard merging Pmakemixedblock into Pmakeblock in oxcaml/oxcaml#5238 and adding slambda constructors in oxcaml/oxcaml#5148
  • Mode/modality typedtree annotations under active development by Liam Stevenson with extensive design discussions in oxcaml/oxcaml#5218
  • Runtime improvements include Nick Barnes improving Gc.stat and Gc.quick_stat accuracy for runtime 5 in oxcaml/oxcaml#5226
  • Xavier Clerc extracted interference graph to standalone module for register allocator reuse in oxcaml/oxcaml#5237
  • Flambda2 work by Basile Clément and Nathanaëlle Courant addressing reaper issues in oxcaml/oxcaml#5157, oxcaml/oxcaml#5134, oxcaml/oxcaml#5140, and oxcaml/oxcaml#5125, plus inlining heuristics in oxcaml/oxcaml#5108 and oxcaml/oxcaml#5093
  • Long-running PRs seeing continued activity: modality documentation by Richard Eisenberg in oxcaml/oxcaml#4074, stdlib stateless annotations in oxcaml/oxcaml#4839, and Lambda.layout usage in transl_exp in oxcaml/oxcaml#4582
  • Package version synchronization with over 100 Jane Street library packages updated from v0.18~preview.130.76+222 to v0.18~preview.130.83+317 in oxcaml/opam-repository including abstractalgebra, accessor family, async family, bonsai family, core family, ecaml, ppx* preprocessors, and supporting libraries
  • New libraries added to oxcaml/opam-repository: handledeffect.v0.18~preview.130.83+317 (renamed from oxcamleffect), memtrace, oxcamlintrinsics, unboxeddatatypes, and hardcaml-related packages
  • jsofocaml-toplevel build fix by removing obsolete [%%if] patch in oxcaml/opam-repository#26 by @art-w
  • Merlin signature help improvements by Charlène_Gros from Tarides: preventing signature help from appearing on function names in oxcaml/merlin#206 and adding test coverage for labelled arguments in oxcaml/merlin#205

    • Notable Discussions

  • Extensive design iteration on mode/modality typedtree representation between Zesen Qian and Liam Stevenson covering whether to use lists vs records, naming conventions, and correspondence with parsetree structures in oxcaml/oxcaml#5218
  • ARM64 typed DSL implementation review with detailed feedback from Xavier Clerc and Max Slater on register type handling, logical immediate encoding return types, and assertion helpers in oxcaml/oxcaml#5193
  • Discussion on base non-value kinds crossing externality by Nailen Matschke and Richard Eisenberg weighing UX improvements through implications against consistency with modal bounds in oxcaml/oxcaml#5162
  • Debate over usefulness of [%%expect.ignore_echo] directive with Richard Eisenberg questioning whether thrown-away information is valuable for verification in oxcaml/oxcaml#5244
  • Vesa Karvonen questioned marking operations using physical equality as stateful/observing, discussing implications for atomics and locks in oxcaml/oxcaml#4839

    • Emerging Trends

  • ARM64 backend maturation: Typed DSL foundation in oxcaml/oxcaml#5193, SIMD vector array support in oxcaml/oxcaml#5239 and oxcaml/oxcaml#5240, and comprehensive logical immediate testing demonstrate sustained focus on ARM64 performance and correctness
  • Type system refinements: Coordinated improvements across modes (functor currying in oxcaml/oxcaml#5230, solver fixes in oxcaml/oxcaml#5233), jkinds (separability merge in oxcaml/oxcaml#5231, externality crossing in oxcaml/oxcaml#5162), and layout polymorphism foundation work in oxcaml/oxcaml#5238 and oxcaml/oxcaml#5148
  • Testing infrastructure expansion: Native expect tests in oxcaml/oxcaml#5245, chamelon minimizer improvements in oxcaml/oxcaml#5212, and CI additions demonstrate investment in test tooling quality
  • Build performance optimization: Compiler build time improvement from 32 to 14 minutes in oxcaml/opam-repository#25 and backend optimizations like switch improvements in oxcaml/oxcaml#5200 show focus on developer experience
  • Flambda2 bug fixes: Multiple reaper-related fixes in oxcaml/oxcaml#5134, oxcaml/oxcaml#5140, and oxcaml/oxcaml#5125 plus inlining decision improvements in oxcaml/oxcaml#5093 indicate ongoing stabilization efforts
  • Upstream contribution pattern: Patches being upstreamed to lwt, jsofocaml, and other projects reduces long-term maintenance burden and benefits the broader OCaml ecosystem
  • Jane Street v0.18 preview development: Version 130.83+317 package updates across ecosystem represent active development of effect handlers and related features with coordinated release management

    • OCaml Core

    Standard library expanded with three new functions, documentation improved, Windows bugs fixed, and RFC discussion on tuple projections

    New Features

  • Array.stablesortsub function added to sort subarrays in-place using stable sorting algorithm (ocaml/ocaml#13343) by François Pottier
  • String.includes function added to test if a substring occurs anywhere in a string (ocaml/ocaml#14439) by Daniel Bünzli
  • Seq.delay function added to enable proper lazy evaluation in recursive sequence constructors (ocaml/ocaml#10177) by Gabriel Scherer
  • Raw identifier syntax documented in manual allowing #keyword to use keywords as regular identifiers (ocaml/ocaml#14468) by Nicolás Ojeda Bär
  • Effect keyword added to manual's keyword list with documentation on -keywords flag for modifying available keywords (ocaml/ocaml#14468)
  • Windows socketpair race condition fixed preventing address-in-use errors during concurrent socketpair creation (ocaml/ocaml#14461) by Jessie Grosen
  • Substring search micro-optimization in stdlib improving string matching performance (ocaml/ocaml#14463) by Florian Angeletti

    • Overview

  • 10 PRs merged in ocaml/ocaml with standard library additions, documentation improvements, Windows platform fixes, and tooling enhancements
  • 4 new PRs opened in ocaml/ocaml covering continuation optimization (ocaml/ocaml#14469), workflow automation (ocaml/ocaml#14467), runtime events cleanup (ocaml/ocaml#14470), and stdlib design guidelines (ocaml/ocaml#14459)
  • Active RFC discussion in ocaml/RFCs on labeled tuple projections (ocaml/RFCs#57) with Jacques Garrigue providing detailed technical analysis of polymorphic index projection approach

    • Activity

  • Continuation optimization proposed by KC Sivaramakrishnan to improve continuation size handling (ocaml/ocaml#14469)
  • Workflow automation for stdlib PR labeling proposed by @redianthus to streamline contribution process (ocaml/ocaml#14467)
  • Runtime events cleanup on SIGINT addressed by Stephen Sherratt (ocaml/ocaml#14470)
  • Stdlib design guidelines proposed by Nicolás Ojeda Bär to formalize API design principles (ocaml/ocaml#14459)
  • Tooling improvements merged with Ulysse associating UIDs to items without concrete definitions for better IDE support (ocaml/ocaml#14120)
  • Testing quality improved through Olivier Nicole fixing TSan test references (ocaml/ocaml#14466) and Sidharth Kshatriya enhancing debugger printer tests (ocaml/ocaml#14464)
  • Documentation corrections merged by Boning fixing typo in local opens documentation (ocaml/ocaml#14471)

    • Notable Discussions

  • Polymorphic tuple projections debated in ocaml/RFCs#57 with Jacques Garrigue analyzing polymorphic index projection versus labeled projection, discussing type system implications, principality requirements for label ordering, and tradeoffs between ML-style polymorphism versus type propagation approaches
  • Raw identifier syntax and effect keyword documentation generated substantial discussion in ocaml/ocaml#14468 with 10 comments reviewing the syntax specification and manual clarity
  • String.includes function underwent detailed API design review in ocaml/ocaml#14439 with 8 comments discussing naming conventions and partial application efficiency
  • Seq.delay implementation received thorough examination in ocaml/ocaml#10177 with 9 comments from reviewers analyzing lazy evaluation semantics and use cases
  • Array.stablesortsub reviewed extensively in ocaml/ocaml#13343 with 9 comments covering algorithm correctness and API design
  • Windows socketpair race condition discussed with 7 comments in ocaml/ocaml#14461 analyzing TOCTOU race conditions and testing approaches

    • Emerging Trends

  • Standard library string functions receiving significant attention with multiple contributions from Daniel Bünzli including String.includes merged in ocaml/ocaml#14439 this week and related functions like split, replace, and find in adjacent PRs
  • Documentation quality improvements focusing on language features previously under-documented, particularly the effect keyword and raw identifier syntax in ocaml/ocaml#14468
  • Platform-specific bug fixes addressing Windows-specific issues like the socketpair race condition in ocaml/ocaml#14461
  • Tooling infrastructure being enhanced for IDE support with better shape indexing for items without concrete definitions in ocaml/ocaml#14120
  • Process automation proposed with workflow for automatic labeling of stdlib PRs in ocaml/ocaml#14467
  • Type system extensions under discussion with RFC on tuple projections exploring polymorphic access patterns in ocaml/RFCs#57

    • Multicore

    Light week with Picos hash table improvements and Eio API discussions for ergonomics and MacOS support

    New Features

  • Fixed picos_aux.htbl size adjustment during resize to properly handle pending resize operations, preventing race conditions during concurrent resizing (ocaml-multicore/picos#384)
  • Upgraded Lwt integration in ocaml-multicore/picos to version 6.0.0 with safer notification handling using option types instead of sentinel values (ocaml-multicore/picos#383)
  • Added new fill1m benchmark for hash table performance testing with 250,000 operations per domain in ocaml-multicore/picos (ocaml-multicore/picos#385)

    • Overview

  • Light activity week with only 2 of 9 repositories showing changes
  • ocaml-multicore/picos led activity with 3 merged PRs (hash table fixes, Lwt upgrade, benchmark) and 1 draft PR for experimental lock-free hash table by Vesa Karvonen
  • ocaml-multicore/eio saw 1 ongoing PR for MacOS block device support (ocaml-multicore/eio#827) and 2 feature requests focused on API ergonomics (ocaml-multicore/eio#828, ocaml-multicore/eio#829)
  • No activity in ocaml-multicore/domainslib, ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring, ocaml-multicore/meio, ocaml-multicore/saturn, ocaml-multicore/eio-trace, ocaml-multicore/kcas, or ocaml-multicore/ocaml-iomux
  • Four contributors active: Vesa Karvonen driving Picos development, Volker Diels-Grabsch raising API enhancement requests, Thomas Leonard providing maintainer feedback, and Aaron Eline continuing MacOS compatibility work

    • Activity

  • Draft PR opened in ocaml-multicore/picos for experimental lock-free hash table with incremental resizing by Vesa Karvonen, adding 797 lines across 10 files (ocaml-multicore/picos#382)
  • MacOS block device support PR in ocaml-multicore/eio by Aaron Eline remains under review with discussion about switching from poll() to select() for handling POLLNVAL on block devices (ocaml-multicore/eio#827, originally addressing ocaml-multicore/eio#757)
  • Volker Diels-Grabsch opened feature request in ocaml-multicore/eio to add missing_ok parameter to Eio.Path.unlink similar to rmtree, with Thomas Leonard indicating the request seems reasonable (ocaml-multicore/eio#828)
  • Volker Diels-Grabsch requested Fmt convenience functions in ocaml-multicore/eio Flow and/or Buf_write for easier formatted output, which Thomas Leonard pointed out is already available via Buf_write.printf (ocaml-multicore/eio#829)

    • Notable Discussions

  • File deletion API enhancement discussion in ocaml-multicore/eio where Volker Diels-Grabsch proposed adding an optional missing_ok parameter to Eio.Path.unlink to allow deletion without requiring file existence, with Thomas Leonard suggesting adding the case to the existing exception handler (ocaml-multicore/eio#828)
  • Formatted output convenience discussion in ocaml-multicore/eio where Volker Diels-Grabsch sought easier integration with Fmt for production code output, leading to discovery that Buf_write.printf already provides this functionality (ocaml-multicore/eio#829)
  • MacOS platform compatibility discussion on ocaml-multicore/eio#827 exploring implementation approaches (switching from poll() to select() globally vs maintaining separate thread) for handling block devices that report POLLNVAL on MacOS

    • Emerging Trends

  • API convenience improvements theme emerging in ocaml-multicore/eio with requests for more ergonomic interfaces around existing functionality (ocaml-multicore/eio#828, ocaml-multicore/eio#829)
  • Lock-free data structures development continuing in ocaml-multicore/picos with experimental hash table implementation featuring incremental resizing for better concurrency (ocaml-multicore/picos#382)
  • Type safety improvements in ocaml-multicore/picos Lwt integration replacing sentinel integer values with explicit option types for notification IDs (ocaml-multicore/picos#383)
  • Platform-specific I/O challenges continuing to surface in ocaml-multicore/eio, particularly around MacOS compatibility with block devices requiring different polling strategies (ocaml-multicore/eio#827, ocaml-multicore/eio#757)
  • Documentation discovery pattern in ocaml-multicore/eio where users request features that already exist, suggesting potential for improved API discoverability (ocaml-multicore/eio#829)
entry.summary: Dune 3.21.0 released with tracing infrastructure, oxcaml advanced ARM64 backend and mode system, 11 new packages added to ecosystem

entry.title: Week 2, 2026: Dune 3.21.0_alpha5 released with extensive tracing work, oxcaml upgraded to OCaml 5.4.0 with new implicit kinds and ARM64 advances
entry.content:
Weekly Summary

New Features

  • OCaml Core String search functions added to String module including find_first_index, find_last_index, find_first, find_last, find_all, and rfind_all for efficient substring and character pattern matching in ocaml/ocaml#14381
  • OCaml Core Division operations extended across Int, Int32, Int64, and Nativeint modules with fdiv (floor division), cdiv (ceil division), ediv (Euclidean division), and erem (Euclidean remainder) in ocaml/ocaml#14432
  • OCaml Core Bit counting functions added to Int, Int32, Int64, and Nativeint modules including popcount, leading_zeros, leading_sign_bits, trailing_zeros, unsigned_bitsize, and signed_bitsize for binary operations in ocaml/ocaml#14433
  • OCaml Core Spellchecking hints for module error messages when signature mismatches are likely caused by typos, improving developer experience during module type checking in ocaml/ocaml#14330
  • OxCaml Implicit kind declarations in oxcaml/oxcaml#4285 allow type variable names to have implicit kinds in signatures using [@@@implicit_kind: ('elt : word)] syntax, eliminating repetitive kind annotations
  • OxCaml Format module unicode support in fdc8de29f adds pp_print_substring, pp_print_substring_as, and utf_8_scalar_width functions for accurate width calculation of unicode text
  • OxCaml Functors with non-legacy modes in oxcaml/oxcaml#5107 enable input and output at non-legacy modes for portable and unique module-level operations
  • OxCaml Simpler borrowing syntax in oxcaml/oxcaml#5215 introduces borrow_ syntax for unique references without relying on finer regionality
  • OCaml Tools Process start events now tracked in ocaml/dune traces with comprehensive metadata including PID, directory, program, arguments, and timeout information in ocaml/dune#13261
  • OCaml Tools Resource usage tracking (rusage) added to completed process events in ocaml/dune traces, enabling performance analysis in ocaml/dune#13241
  • OCaml Tools Custom action tracing implemented in ocaml/dune to track custom build actions with start and finish events in ocaml/dune#13265
  • OCaml Tools Multiple identical opam pins on local packages in ocaml/dune now correctly merged instead of causing errors in ocaml/dune#13232
  • OCaml Tools macOS SIGCHLD handling fixed in ocaml/dune to correctly wait for child processes without race conditions in ocaml/dune#13268
  • OCaml Ecosystem Qdrant vector database client introduced as pure OCaml implementation with REST API support, collection management, and async I/O capabilities by Jeong-Sik Yun in ocaml/opam-repository#29194
  • OCaml Ecosystem Merlin 5.6.1-504 released with fixes for C code compilation issues on Windows, improved signature help with documentation formatting, completion enhancements, and optimized buffer indexing by Ulysse in ocaml/opam-repository#29117

    • Group Activity Summaries

    OCaml Ecosystem

    Package ecosystem expansion with new database clients, developer tooling, and platform release automation improvements

    New Features

  • Qdrant vector database client introduced as pure OCaml implementation with REST API support, collection management, and async I/O capabilities by Jeong-Sik Yun (ocaml/opam-repository#29194)
  • Merlin 5.6.1-504 released with fixes for C code compilation issues on Windows, improved signature help with documentation formatting, completion enhancements, and optimized buffer indexing by Ulysse (ocaml/opam-repository#29117)
  • expr 0.7.0 released with breaking change allowing names to bind float, boolean, or string values (previously only functions), improving variable binding flexibility by Christian Lindig (ocaml/opam-repository#29198)
  • quickjs 0.4.2 renamed API functions for consistency: RegExp.lastIndex → RegExp.last_index and RegExp.setLastIndex → RegExp.set_last_index by David Sancho (ocaml/opam-repository#29200)
  • smtml 0.19.0 improved SMT solver frontend performance with optimizations and enhancements by @filipeom (ocaml/opam-repository#29188)
  • trace 0.10.1 added at_exit support in trace_tef and tldrs modules, plus fuchsia bound check fixes by Simon Cruanes (ocaml/opam-repository#29205)
  • rizzo 0.3.0 fixed heap-related bug affecting garbage collection by @tjobi (ocaml/opam-repository#29181)
  • Platform releases scraper fixed to properly add data files when detecting new OCaml Platform releases, ensuring automated notifications work correctly (ocaml/ocaml.org#3443)
  • Workflow configuration added for automated scraping of OCaml Platform releases on a daily schedule (43f6077)
  • Fixed page title capitalization in security documentation from "Ocaml" to "OCaml" (ocaml/ocaml.org#3440)

    • Overview

  • Package ecosystem activity: 12 new PRs opened in ocaml/opam-repository including Liquidsoap 2.4.1 (#29207), Lwt 6.0.0 (#29184), Dune 3.21.0~alpha5 (#29189), and Menhir LSP 0.2 language server (#29203)
  • Major library updates: FFmpeg bindings 1.2.8 covering 8 packages merged (ocaml/opam-repository#29163), POSIX bindings 4.0.1 with 14 packages released (ocaml/opam-repository#29206), and OCurrent 0.7.3 with 10 packages updated (ocaml/opam-repository#29191)
  • Platform tooling improvements: Platform releases scraper fixed in ocaml/ocaml.org to properly commit new release data (ocaml/ocaml.org#3443), with backfill PR for missing November/December releases (ocaml/ocaml.org#3444)
  • Content and documentation: FUN OCaml 2025 conference data added (ocaml/ocaml.org#3411), Chris Armstrong's OCaml blog integrated into Planet (ocaml/ocaml.org#3428), and new cookbook recipe for measuring elapsed time (ocaml/ocaml.org#3447)
  • CI testing philosophy debate: Discussion in ocaml/opam-repository#29166 about whether opam-repo-ci should run dune runtest, with proposals for dune-level solutions to specify test inclusion in opam files

    • Activity

  • Twelve PRs opened in ocaml/opam-repository including Liquidsoap 2.4.1 by Romain Beauxis (#29207), Lwt 6.0.0 upgrade by Raphaël Proust (#29184), Dune 3.21.0~alpha5 with fixes by Shon Feder (#29189), ART 0.3.0 Adaptive Radix Tree by Calascibetta Romain (#29208), relocatable OCaml updates by David Allsopp (#29085), Menhir LSP 0.2 language server by @dalps (#29203), conf-dwarfutils package by Austin Theriault (#29202), Canary 0.0.4 exception reporting by Marc (#29199), intel_hex 0.1 for embedded systems by Михаил (#29180), Raga 0.1.1 static site generator by Kaustubh Maske Patil (#29197), BINSEC 0.11.0 binary analysis by Frédéric Recoules (#29193), and LLVM 20/21 releases by Alan (#29110)
  • FFmpeg bindings 1.2.8 merged with 8 packages covering avcodec, avdevice, avfilter, avutil, swresample, and swscale by Romain Beauxis (ocaml/opam-repository#29163)
  • POSIX bindings 4.0.1 released with 14 packages including base, errno, getopt, math2, resource, signal, socket, stat, time2, types, uname, and unistd by Romain Beauxis, superseding 4.0.0 with FreeBSD fix (ocaml/opam-repository#29206)
  • OCurrent 0.7.3 updated with 10 packages for pipeline language and plugins (docker, git, github, gitlab, rpc, slack, ssh, web) by Mark Elvers (ocaml/opam-repository#29191)
  • Package maintenance in ocaml/opam-repository included rfsm 2.3 StateChart toolset by @jserot (#29204), fit 1.4.1 configuration improvements by Christian Lindig (#29201), simple_httpd 1.0.1 timing fix by Christophe Raffalli (#29174), alice 0.4.0 by Stephen Sherratt (#29187), metadata 0.3.2 file format reader by Romain Beauxis (#29183), and memcpy 0.3.0 with Windows constraints by Jeremy Yallop (#29144)
  • Compatibility fixes in ocaml/opam-repository addressed server-reason-react ppxlib bounds by Raphaël Proust (#29186), kinetic-client 0.0.1 build failures (#29156), lwt ocamlfind version constraint (#29195), camlp4 5.4 macOS/Windows requirements (#29192), cca package CI errors (#29155), rocq-prover metapackage versioning by Pierre Roux (#29190), restricted 1.1 setup fix by @stopusingghpls (#29182), and osc 0.1.4 version removal by Raphaël Proust (#29185)
  • New cookbook recipe opened in ocaml/ocaml.org by Adam adding "Measure Elapsed Time" example using Unix.gettimeofday for the Date and Time section (#3447)
  • Missing platform releases PR opened in ocaml/ocaml.org by @sabine to backfill November and December releases for Dune, Merlin, OCaml-LSP, OCamlFormat, and other tools after the scraper was broken for several months (#3444)
  • Planet blog aggregation completed in ocaml/ocaml.org with Chris Armstrong's OCaml-focused blog added to sources (#3428), bringing in posts on dead code elimination, PPX libraries, cross-compilation, serverless readiness, and AWS SDK development
  • Conference data updated in ocaml/ocaml.org with FUN OCaml 2025 event information merged by @sabine (#3411)

    • Notable Discussions

  • CI testing philosophy debated in ocaml/opam-repository#29166 opened by Romain Beauxis requesting opam-repo-ci stop running dune runtest, arguing tests are for project internal consumption and create maintenance burden leading to anti-patterns where maintainers move tests outside dune runtest framework
  • Proposed solutions in ocaml/opam-repository#29166 include Raphaël Proust suggesting marking tests for different contexts using dune profiles/env or separating dev-tests from release-tests, while David Allsopp notes users can install with --with-test flag so opam-repo-ci validates package metadata health, proposing dune-level solution to specify whether @runtest should be added to opam files
  • Dune 3.21.0~alpha5 CI challenges discussed in ocaml/opam-repository#29189 covering bitwuzla-cxx failures, opam-dune-lint issues, decompress failures, and GCC 14 compatibility with extensive community troubleshooting
  • Lwt 6.0.0 dependency management ongoing in ocaml/opam-repository#29184 examining distinction between dev and with-dev-setup dependency specifications
  • Alpha release filtering requested by Shon Feder in ocaml/ocaml.org#3444, noting Dune alpha releases should be filtered from platform announcements as they are pre-release candidates rather than stable releases

    • Emerging Trends

  • Multimedia and systems bindings seeing coordinated updates in ocaml/opam-repository with FFmpeg 1.2.8 covering 8 packages (#29163) and POSIX bindings 4.0.1 spanning 14 packages (#29206), indicating ecosystem-wide efforts to maintain up-to-date system interface layers
  • Developer tooling advancement evident through Merlin 5.6.1-504 improvements (ocaml/opam-repository#29117), Menhir LSP 0.2 language server (ocaml/opam-repository#29203), Dune 3.21.0~alpha5 development (ocaml/opam-repository#29189), and platform releases scraper fixes (ocaml/ocaml.org#3443), highlighting continued investment in IDE support and build system capabilities
  • Database and infrastructure clients expanding with Qdrant vector database client (ocaml/opam-repository#29194) joining ecosystem, reflecting OCaml's growing presence in modern data infrastructure tooling
  • CI and testing methodology under active discussion with ocaml/opam-repository#29166 debate about dune runtest in opam-repo-ci potentially leading to ecosystem-wide changes in how packages structure and expose their test suites
  • Cross-platform compatibility receiving focused attention through camlp4 macOS/Windows constraints (ocaml/opam-repository#29192), memcpy Windows build issues (ocaml/opam-repository#29144), and POSIX bindings FreeBSD fixes (ocaml/opam-repository#29206)
  • Platform automation improvements evident in ocaml/ocaml.org with scraper fixes (#3443) and backfill of missing releases (#3444), ensuring better tracking of tool releases from ocaml/opam-repository

    • OCaml Tools

    Dune tracing infrastructure and Melange optimizations led tools group activity with additional work on LSP and Merlin

    New Features

  • Process start events now tracked in ocaml/dune traces with comprehensive metadata including PID, directory, program, arguments, and timeout information (ocaml/dune#13261)
  • Resource usage tracking (rusage) added to completed process events in ocaml/dune traces, enabling performance analysis (ocaml/dune#13241)
  • Custom action tracing implemented in ocaml/dune to track custom build actions with start and finish events (ocaml/dune#13265)
  • Buffered event writes added to ocaml/dune tracing system for improved performance with optional buffering parameter (ocaml/dune#13285)
  • Select field fix for Melange libraries in ocaml/dune - now correctly skips select form files without dialect extensions, eliminating false positive "no solution" errors (ocaml/dune#13272)
  • Multiple identical opam pins on local packages in ocaml/dune now correctly merged instead of causing errors (ocaml/dune#13232)
  • macOS SIGCHLD handling fixed in ocaml/dune to correctly wait for child processes without race conditions (ocaml/dune#13268)
  • PID race conditions in ocaml/dune scheduler resolved, preventing attempts to kill already-reaped processes (ocaml/dune#13245)
  • Pin error reporting improved in ocaml/dune to show location only once instead of duplicating it (ocaml/dune#13224)
  • Documentation warning added to ocaml/dune dune-site manual clarifying that dependence on dune-site forces linkall compilation flag (ocaml/dune#13109)
  • OCaml 5.4.0 development environment updated in ocaml/ocaml-lsp Makefile, enabling contributors to test with the latest OCaml compiler version (0d2f5d1)

    • Overview

  • ocaml/dune led activity with extensive tracing infrastructure additions by Rudi Grinberg (ocaml/dune#13261, ocaml/dune#13241, ocaml/dune#13265, ocaml/dune#13285), systematic scheduler refactoring (ocaml/dune#13215, ocaml/dune#13220), and Melange test suite optimization by Antonio Nuno Monteiro (ocaml/dune#13283, ocaml/dune#13273)
