  • ocaml/merlin focused on test coverage with Charlène_Gros opening signature help fix (ocaml/merlin#2023) and three bug reproduction test cases receiving review from Ulysse (ocaml/merlin#2020, ocaml/merlin#2021, ocaml/merlin#2022)
  • ocaml/ocaml-lsp saw new PRs for configurable Merlin server by Andrey Popp (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1581) and signature help formatting by Charlène_Gros (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1580)
  • ocaml/odoc had crash bug reported by Luke Maurer affecting redundant type constraints (ocaml/odoc#1397)
  • ocaml/opam saw ongoing review of license field PR by Raphaël Proust (ocaml/opam#6841) and solver behavior issue reported by @tobil4sk (ocaml/opam#6843)
  • ocaml/ocamlfind, ocaml/opam-file-format, ocaml-dune/spawn, and ocsigen/jsofocaml had no activity this week

    • Activity

  • Action Tracing feature (ocaml/dune#13267) remains in progress by Rudi Grinberg, building on merged tracing improvements
  • Progress display enhancements with counters and elapsed time (ocaml/dune#13263) drafted by Javier Chávarri
  • Scheduler architecture modernization in ocaml/dune through systematic refactoring by Rudi Grinberg consolidating dune_async_io, dune_scheduler, and dune_thread_pool (ocaml/dune#13215, ocaml/dune#13220), making thread pool lazy (ocaml/dune#13258), and simplifying threading API (ocaml/dune#13247, ocaml/dune#13248, ocaml/dune#13249)
  • Melange test suite optimization in ocaml/dune completed by Antonio Nuno Monteiro with merged PRs speeding up tests using melange.node (ocaml/dune#13283, ocaml/dune#13273), removing unnecessary preprocessing (ocaml/dune#13284), and adding test coverage (ocaml/dune#13287, ocaml/dune#13286)
  • Package management API improvements in ocaml/dune by Marek Kubica made Resolved_package API consistently take OpamFile.OPAM.t (ocaml/dune#13216), renamed pinning code for clarity (ocaml/dune#13219), and added test for duplicate pins (ocaml/dune#13236)
  • RPC subsystem cleanup in ocaml/dune by Rudi Grinberg merged dune_rules_rpc and dune_rpc_impl (ocaml/dune#13257), removed unused imports (ocaml/dune#13256), and removed useless signatures (ocaml/dune#13255)
  • Test infrastructure enhancements in ocaml/dune including shellcheck integration (ocaml/dune#13233, ocaml/dune#13238), unused library checking (ocaml/dune#13242), and test organization (ocaml/dune#13266)
  • Multi-context cram tests in ocaml/dune enabled by Sudha Parimala for per-context builds (ocaml/dune#13231)
  • Test case development in ocaml/merlin for historical bugs with Ulysse identifying deeper environment initialization issue in ocaml/merlin#1987 reproduction (ocaml/merlin#2020)
  • Configurable Merlin server RFC in ocaml/ocaml-lsp by Andrey Popp allowing alternative build systems through environment variables (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1581)
  • License field documentation improvements in ocaml/opam with Kate reviewing PR by Raphaël Proust (ocaml/opam#6841)

    • Notable Discussions

  • @tobil4sk reported in ocaml/opam that the default builtin-0install solver resolves both i686 and x8664 variants of mingw packages, while builtin-mccs+glpk resolves only x8664 (ocaml/opam#6843), creating unintended multi-architecture installations in CI environments
  • Correnson Loïc provided minimal reproduction case in ocaml/ocaml-lsp for document symbols bug affecting optional arguments, showing incorrect parent-child relationships with invalid position data (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1560)
  • Ulysse identified in ocaml/merlin that ocaml/merlin#1987 reproduction reveals broader issue with Merlin's environment being empty before first structure item ends (ocaml/merlin#2020)
  • Kate reviewed ocaml/opam license field PR noting that raw field syntax license: already works but isn't well documented (ocaml/opam#6841)
  • Andrey Popp questioned in ocaml/ocaml-lsp whether Merlin config file path has meaningful use beyond debug output (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1581)

    • Emerging Trends

  • Tracing infrastructure expansion accelerating in ocaml/dune with multiple coordinated PRs adding process events, resource usage, custom actions, and buffered writes to support broader Action Tracing feature (ocaml/dune#13267, ocaml/dune#13261, ocaml/dune#13241, ocaml/dune#13265, ocaml/dune#13285)
  • Melange support enhancements concentrated in ocaml/dune with test optimization, bug fixes for dialect extensions (ocaml/dune#13272), and single-context-universal refactoring (ocaml/dune#13275, ocaml/dune#13276)
  • Test coverage expansion across multiple repositories with ocaml/dune adding shellcheck and unused library detection (ocaml/dune#13233, ocaml/dune#13242) and ocaml/merlin systematically reproducing historical bug reports (ocaml/merlin#2020, ocaml/merlin#2021, ocaml/merlin#2022)
  • Alternative build system support being explored in ocaml/ocaml-lsp through configurable Merlin server setup enabling systems beyond Dune (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1581)
  • User experience improvements focused on formatting and readability in ocaml/ocaml-lsp and ocaml/merlin with signature help enhancements and progress display proposals (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1580, ocaml/merlin#2023, ocaml/dune#13263)

    • OxCaml

    Major compiler upgrade to OCaml 5.4.0 with new type system features and enhanced debugging infrastructure

    New Features

  • Implicit kind declarations in oxcaml/oxcaml#4285 allow type variable names to have implicit kinds in signatures using [@@@implicit_kind: ('elt : word)] syntax, eliminating repetitive kind annotations
  • Format module unicode support in fdc8de29f adds pp_print_substring, pp_print_substring_as, and utf_8_scalar_width functions for accurate width calculation of unicode text
  • Functors with non-legacy modes in oxcaml/oxcaml#5107 enable input and output at non-legacy modes for portable and unique module-level operations
  • Simpler borrowing syntax in oxcaml/oxcaml#5215 introduces borrow_ syntax for unique references without relying on finer regionality
  • Pattern redundancy warning control in oxcaml/oxcaml#5202 via attribute [@alert "-redundant-case"] to disable warnings on specific match patterns
  • SSE register optimization in oxcaml/oxcaml#5136 adds fourth register class caml_call_gc variant for when no SIMD registers are live
  • Doubly-linked lists in oxcaml/oxcaml#4973 replace arrays for x86 instruction storage, improving backend performance
  • Record and variant disambiguation in oxcaml/oxcaml#5094 ensures quoted code properly resolves ambiguous constructors
  • Stage checks in oxcaml/oxcaml#5158 for record and unboxed record labels prevent improper cross-stage usage

    • Overview

  • oxcaml/oxcaml repository upgraded to OCaml 5.4.0 with 18 new PRs focused on type system enhancements, ARM64 platform support, and debugging infrastructure by Simon Spies, Zesen Qian, Mark Shinwell, Basile Clément, and 13 other contributors
  • Major compiler features shipped including implicit kinds (oxcaml/oxcaml#4285), functors with non-legacy modes (oxcaml/oxcaml#5107), and Format stdlib unicode width support (fdc8de29f)
  • Active development on ARM64 JIT and assembler infrastructure with 7 PRs by Mark Shinwell (oxcaml/oxcaml#5186, oxcaml/oxcaml#5193, oxcaml/oxcaml#5185)
  • oxcaml/merlin saw minimal activity with one draft PR addressing signature help for labelled arguments by Charlène_Gros (oxcaml/merlin#204)
  • No activity recorded for oxcaml/opam-repository, oxcaml/jsofocaml, and janestreet/opam-repository

    • Activity

  • OCaml 5.4.0 upgrade completed by Simon Spies in oxcaml/oxcaml#5036 with documentation updates (oxcaml/oxcaml#5216, oxcaml/oxcaml#5211) and ocamlformat 0.28.1 upgrade (oxcaml/oxcaml#5180)
  • ARM64 platform work advanced with platform-independent ocaml-jit (oxcaml/oxcaml#5186), typed DSL rewrite (oxcaml/oxcaml#5193), improved label/symbol typing (oxcaml/oxcaml#5185), binary emitter experiments (oxcaml/oxcaml#5198, oxcaml/oxcaml#5188, oxcaml/oxcaml#5192), and logical immediate tests (oxcaml/oxcaml#5201) by Mark Shinwell
  • Debug information improvements by Simon Spies with increased fidelity levels (oxcaml/oxcaml#5199), performance enhancements (oxcaml/oxcaml#5124), named binders for shapes (oxcaml/oxcaml#5111), layout improvements (oxcaml/oxcaml#4916), shape constructors (oxcaml/oxcaml#4928), and function sections support (oxcaml/oxcaml#4934)
  • Chamelon bug reducer enhancements by Basile Clément including CMT printing validation (oxcaml/oxcaml#5220), improved match minimizers (oxcaml/oxcaml#5212), value binding fixes (oxcaml/oxcaml#5222), and -dfexpr-annot flag (oxcaml/oxcaml#5210)
  • Metaprogramming work includes type inspection annotation handling for polymorphic applications by Jakub Bachurski (oxcaml/oxcaml#5154, oxcaml/oxcaml#5214) and translquote review by Jack Rickard (oxcaml/oxcaml#4981)
  • Type system enhancements with layout-polymorphic types by Andrej Ivašković (oxcaml/oxcaml#5068), slambda constructors by Jack Rickard (oxcaml/oxcaml#5148), ikinds by @julesjacobs (oxcaml/oxcaml#5159), and typedtree mode/modality tracking by Liam Stevenson (oxcaml/oxcaml#5218)
  • Backend improvements include CMM/CFG preservation by Vesa Karvonen (oxcaml/oxcaml#5208), fexpr primitive representation rework by Keryan Didier (oxcaml/oxcaml#5221), name mangling scheme by Tim McGilchrist (oxcaml/oxcaml#5099), and constant switch optimization by Vincent Laviron (oxcaml/oxcaml#5200)
  • Mode system maturity through better error messages with hints by Zesen Qian (oxcaml/oxcaml#5183, oxcaml/oxcaml#5190, oxcaml/oxcaml#5034) and jkind refinements by Ryan Tjoa (oxcaml/oxcaml#5178, oxcaml/oxcaml#5187)
  • Effects and preemption continued by Aspen Smith on initial preemption implementation (oxcaml/oxcaml#4881) and effect primitive refactoring (oxcaml/oxcaml#4901)

    • Notable Discussions

  • Error message wording in oxcaml/oxcaml#5207 with Natasha Murashkina highlighting ambiguity in "is expected to be" phrasing for portability and contention expectations, and Zesen Qian noting the need to emphasize usage sites over definition sites
  • Inlining and lookup tables investigation in oxcaml/oxcaml#5197 by Jack Rickard documenting quadratic code size under -inline 20 when match-based lookup tables get inlined and lose optimization, with Vincent Laviron proposing fix in oxcaml/oxcaml#5200

    • Emerging Trends

  • Compiler infrastructure modernization with upgrade to OCaml 5.4.0 (oxcaml/oxcaml#5036), ocamlformat 0.28.1 (oxcaml/oxcaml#5180), Nix configurations (oxcaml/oxcaml#5205, oxcaml/oxcaml#5194), and build system improvements (oxcaml/oxcaml#5213, oxcaml/oxcaml#5206)
  • Type system expressiveness through implicit kinds (oxcaml/oxcaml#4285), functors with non-legacy modes (oxcaml/oxcaml#5107), layout polymorphism (oxcaml/oxcaml#5068), ikinds (oxcaml/oxcaml#5159), and borrowing syntax (oxcaml/oxcaml#5215)
  • Debugging and tooling infrastructure with DWARF improvements (oxcaml/oxcaml#5199, oxcaml/oxcaml#5124, oxcaml/oxcaml#5111), name mangling (oxcaml/oxcaml#5099), and Chamelon bug minimizer enhancements (oxcaml/oxcaml#5220, oxcaml/oxcaml#5212, oxcaml/oxcaml#5222)
  • ARM64 platform maturity with typed DSL (oxcaml/oxcaml#5193), binary emitter (oxcaml/oxcaml#5198, oxcaml/oxcaml#5188, oxcaml/oxcaml#5192), JIT support (oxcaml/oxcaml#5186), and assembler infrastructure (oxcaml/oxcaml#5185)
  • Metaprogramming foundations advancing with quotation improvements (oxcaml/oxcaml#5094, oxcaml/oxcaml#5154, oxcaml/oxcaml#5214), stage checks (oxcaml/oxcaml#5158), and translquote refinement (oxcaml/oxcaml#4981)
  • Mode system maturity through better error messages with hints (oxcaml/oxcaml#5183, oxcaml/oxcaml#5190, oxcaml/oxcaml#5034), functor support (oxcaml/oxcaml#5107), borrowing (oxcaml/oxcaml#5215), and jkind refinements (oxcaml/oxcaml#5178, oxcaml/oxcaml#5187)

    • OCaml Core

    Stdlib extensions for string search, numeric operations, and bit counting merged alongside improved module error messages with spellchecking

    New Features

  • String search functions added to String module including find_first_index, find_last_index, find_first, find_last, find_all, and rfind_all for efficient substring and character pattern matching in ocaml/ocaml#14381
  • Division operations extended across Int, Int32, Int64, and Nativeint modules with fdiv (floor division), cdiv (ceil division), ediv (Euclidean division), and erem (Euclidean remainder) in ocaml/ocaml#14432
  • Bit counting functions added to Int, Int32, Int64, and Nativeint modules including popcount, leading_zeros, leading_sign_bits, trailing_zeros, unsigned_bitsize, and signed_bitsize for binary operations in ocaml/ocaml#14433
  • Spellchecking hints for module error messages when signature mismatches are likely caused by typos, improving developer experience during module type checking in ocaml/ocaml#14330
  • Random module documentation clarified to make explicit the use of MD5 for seeding, improving transparency of cryptographic properties in ocaml/ocaml#14462

    • Overview

  • All activity centered on ocaml/ocaml repository with 17 new PRs and 13 merges focusing on stdlib extensions, tooling improvements, and type system enhancements
  • ocaml/RFCs repository had no activity during this period
  • Five new user-facing features merged including comprehensive string search functions, extended division operations, bit counting primitives, and improved error messages
  • Active stdlib design discussions with Nicolás Ojeda Bär proposing guidelines in ocaml/ocaml#14459 alongside multiple string manipulation proposals
  • Multiple type system proposals in progress including modular explicits, polymorphic annotations, and name retention, with soundness concerns raised in ocaml/ocaml#14434

    • Activity

  • Jessie Grosen opened PR for Windows socket reliability fix addressing racy socketpair implementation in ocaml/ocaml#14461, David Allsopp proposed trunk compiler support in ocaml-system opam package in ocaml/ocaml#14354, Mark Shinwell added AI policy documentation in ocaml/ocaml#14383
  • Daniel Bünzli opened three PRs extending String module with replace_{first,last,all} in ocaml/ocaml#14436, includes predicate in ocaml/ocaml#14439, and split_{first,last,all} plus rsplit_all functions in ocaml/ocaml#14437
  • Nicolás Ojeda Bär proposed stdlib design guidelines in ocaml/ocaml#14459, Martin Jambon added exhaustiveness checking for ocamllex regular expressions in ocaml/ocaml#14448
  • Richard Eisenberg continued work on name retention system in ocaml/ocaml#13328, Vincent Laviron proposed get_singleton functions for Set and Map modules in ocaml/ocaml#14121
  • Samuel Vivien opened PRs for modular explicits in ocaml/ocaml#13275 and unify result handling to return results rather than raise exceptions in ocaml/ocaml#14425
  • Alistair proposed three PRs including unstable features annotation [@@unstable] in ocaml/ocaml#14430, polymorphic annotations in typing in ocaml/ocaml#14427, and opened issue about polymorphic parameters soundness bug in ocaml/ocaml#14434
  • Florian Angeletti opened PR to silence duplicated alert messages in auxiliary typechecker functions in ocaml/ocaml#14453
  • Antonin Décimo opened PRs for C++ API compatibility testing using GCC and MSVC SARIF diagnostics in ocaml/ocaml#14421 and using C2y countof operator in ocaml/ocaml#14413
  • Vincent Laviron merged PR rewriting pack prefixes to replace dots with appropriate separators in ocaml/ocaml#14417
  • David Allsopp merged opam scripts modernization changing scripts to plain .ml files with explicit variable passing and unified structure in ocaml/ocaml#14250
  • Basile Clément fixed untypeast to handle Tpat_open patterns in ocaml/ocaml#14457
  • Gabriel Scherer improved testsuite stability to avoid churn when Stdlib changes in ocaml/ocaml#14441, Florian Angeletti updated dune file following module error message changes in ocaml/ocaml#14456
  • Simon Cruanes closed PR for tail-rec-mod-cons List.flatten after benchmarking showed performance concerns in ocaml/ocaml#14460

    • Notable Discussions

  • String module design discussed across multiple PRs with Daniel Bünzli proposing comprehensive string manipulation functions while Nicolás Ojeda Bär opened guidelines PR to establish stdlib design principles in ocaml/ocaml#14436, ocaml/ocaml#14437, ocaml/ocaml#14439, ocaml/ocaml#14459
  • Tail recursion optimization for List.flatten sparked performance discussion with Gabriel Scherer requesting benchmarks, leading Simon Cruanes to close PR after measurements revealed concerns in ocaml/ocaml#14460
  • Type system soundness raised by Alistair regarding polymorphic parameters bug in ocaml/ocaml#14434 and Richard Eisenberg regarding constraint instance issue with polymorphic variants in ocaml/ocaml#13369
  • Cross-compiler file extensions issue opened by Stephen Sherratt noting executables have extensions for target rather than host platform in ocaml/ocaml#14458
  • Module subtyping error messages discussion continued with @cgensoul closing issue about erroneous functor signature inclusion errors in ocaml/ocaml#14449 and older issue about confusing error messages remaining open in ocaml/ocaml#11937

    • Emerging Trends

  • Standard library expansion accelerating with coordinated additions to String module by Daniel Bünzli and mathematical operations across numeric modules by Xavier Leroy, alongside proposals for design guidelines in ocaml/ocaml#14381, ocaml/ocaml#14432, ocaml/ocaml#14433, ocaml/ocaml#14436, ocaml/ocaml#14437, ocaml/ocaml#14439, ocaml/ocaml#14459
  • Developer experience improvements through better error messages with spellchecking hints in ocaml/ocaml#14330, alert message deduplication in ocaml/ocaml#14453, and testsuite stability enhancements in ocaml/ocaml#14441
  • Type system evolution with multiple proposals for advanced features including modular explicits in ocaml/ocaml#13275, polymorphic annotations in ocaml/ocaml#14427, unstable feature marking in ocaml/ocaml#14430, and name retention in ocaml/ocaml#13328
  • Tooling modernization with opam scripts converted to plain .ml files in ocaml/ocaml#14250, C++ API compatibility testing automation in ocaml/ocaml#14421, and ocamllex exhaustiveness checking in ocaml/ocaml#14448
  • Platform compatibility focus on Windows socket fixes in ocaml/ocaml#14461, cross-compiler executable naming in ocaml/ocaml#14458, and POSIX thread-safe function adoption in ocaml/ocaml#14454

    • Multicore

    Focused work on Eio process handling improvements and MacOS platform compatibility

    Overview

  • Activity concentrated in ocaml-multicore/eio repository this week, with no reported activity in other multicore group repositories
  • Focus on platform compatibility, particularly MacOS block device handling via ocaml-multicore/eio#827
  • Process environment management improvements through ongoing work on Eio_unix.Stdenv.with_env in ocaml-multicore/eio#823
  • Clarification of file descriptor inheritance semantics in fork operations via ocaml-multicore/eio#826

    • Activity

  • Aaron Eline opened ocaml-multicore/eio#827 to support writing to block devices on MacOS by handling POLLNVAL events, addressing ocaml-multicore/eio#757
  • Patrick Ferris continues work on ocaml-multicore/eio#823 to add Eio_unix.Stdenv.with_env for capability-style environment modifications (ongoing since November 2025)
  • Patrick Ferris reported and Thomas Leonard resolved ocaml-multicore/eio#826 regarding file descriptor inheritance ordering in fork actions, clarifying that current behavior prevents unintended FD conflicts

    • Notable Discussions

  • Thomas Leonard provided detailed explanation of FD inheritance behavior in ocaml-multicore/eio#826, clarifying how current ordering prevents accidental FD conflicts when child processes inherit parent FDs, with workaround demonstrated for shell-like imperative semantics
  • Discussion in ocaml-multicore/eio#827 about MacOS POLLNVAL behavior for block devices, with Thomas Leonard suggesting potential switch to select on MacOS with _DARWIN_UNLIMITED_SELECT to avoid polling issues and performance concerns
  • Conversation in ocaml-multicore/eio#823 about API naming for environment updates (with_env vs override vs like) and broader question of reconsidering object-oriented API design for Eio resources post-1.0 release

    • Emerging Trends

  • Growing adoption of environment-as-capability pattern where programs define custom environment types as subtypes of Eio_unix.Stdenv.t, passing around comprehensive environment objects rather than individual capabilities as discussed in ocaml-multicore/eio#823
  • Platform-specific compatibility work focusing on MacOS edge cases, particularly around polling and block device handling via ocaml-multicore/eio#827 and ocaml-multicore/eio#757
  • API ergonomics discussions about whether to revisit object-oriented design decisions for Eio resources after 1.0 release, with community feedback requested in ocaml-multicore/eio#823
entry.summary: Dune 3.21.0_alpha5 released with extensive tracing work, oxcaml upgraded to OCaml 5.4.0 with new implicit kinds and ARM64 advances

entry.title: Week 1, 2026: Focused oxcaml week with dissector pass merged, arm64 maturation, 110 Dune PRs merged resolving 5+ year old bugs, 21 ecosystem packages
entry.content:
Weekly Summary

New Features

  • OxCaml Dissector pass for linking large executables exceeding 2GB using small code model without text section changes, enabled via -dissector flag with partition size control via -dissector-partition-size and debug flags -ddissector, -ddissector-sizes, -ddissector-verbose, -ddissector-partitions, and -ddissector-inputs by Mark Shinwell in oxcaml/oxcaml#5146
  • OxCaml Debug tracking improvements for name mangling with new enter_anonymous_module function and location tracking in enter_anonymous_function by Tim McGilchrist in oxcaml/oxcaml#5098
  • OxCaml Type inspection infrastructure with Texp_inspected_type and Tpat_inspected_type nodes for passing disambiguation information in quotes by Jakub Bachurski in oxcaml/oxcaml#5090
  • OxCaml Arm64 AST reorganization moving arm64 AST into dedicated library in backend/arm64/ast/ to support upcoming binary emitter by Mark Shinwell in oxcaml/oxcaml#5184
  • OxCaml OCamlformat preparation with formatting fixes to support upgrade to version 0.28.1 by Simon Spies in oxcaml/oxcaml#5181 and oxcaml/oxcaml#5189
  • OCaml Tools Dynamic (modules ..) expansion for parser generators (ocamllex, ocamlyacc, menhir) supporting special forms like (:include ..) and %{read-lines:..} by Antonio Nuno Monteiro in ocaml/dune#13105, ocaml/dune#13135, ocaml/dune#13157
  • OCaml Tools Sandboxed ocamllex and ocamlyacc actions for improved build isolation in ocaml/dune#13098
  • OCaml Tools Cram test command timing providing performance metrics for every command executed in cram tests by Rudi Grinberg in ocaml/dune#13092
  • OCaml Tools Trace follow mode with $ dune trace cat --follow enabling real-time trace monitoring by Rudi Grinberg in ocaml/dune#13133
  • OCaml Tools Signal tracing events added to trace output for debugging signal handling in ocaml/dune#13193
  • OCaml Tools Canonical s-expression trace format improving performance and consistency, supporting --chrome-trace for perfetto and --sexp for interactive usage in ocaml/dune#13059
  • OCaml Tools Package-level enabled_if field in dune-project files allowing conditional package masking with conversion to opam available expressions (unreleased, requires Dune 3.22+) by Rudi Grinberg in ocaml/dune#12905
  • OCaml Tools Fixed menhir parser compilation in subdirectories with (include_subdirs qualified) in ocaml/dune#13118, closing ocaml/dune#11119 from 2024
  • OCaml Tools Fixed (select ..) field handling with (include_subdirs ..) parsing paths relative to module group root in ocaml/dune#13175, closing ocaml/dune#4383 from 2019 and ocaml/dune#12450
  • OCaml Tools Fixed delayed module path evaluation for include_subdirs qualified in ocaml/dune#13156, closing ocaml/dune#7628 and ocaml/dune#7605 from 2020
  • OCaml Tools Improved include_subdirs documentation with comprehensive usage examples and troubleshooting in ocaml/dune#13200
  • OCaml Ecosystem Cryptokit 1.21.1 by Xavier Leroy adds Paillier homomorphic public-key encryption, elliptic-curve cryptography (ECDSA, ECDH), SHA512/256 and SHA512/224 hash functions, and key derivation functions with breaking change introducing distinct RSA types for public/private keys in ocaml/opam-repository#29162
  • OCaml Ecosystem neo4j_bolt 0.3.0 by Jeong-Sik Yun introduces TLS/SSL support with bolt+s://, bolts://, and bolt+ssc:// URI schemes, plus URI-based connection configuration in ocaml/opam-repository#29175
  • OCaml Ecosystem shakuhachi 0.1.0 by @EruEri provides music collection management and tagging capabilities in ocaml/opam-repository#29136
  • OCaml Ecosystem polymarket 0.2.0 by Richard Haut offers OCaml client for Polymarket prediction market API in ocaml/opam-repository#29164
  • OCaml Ecosystem intel_hex 0.1 by Михаил provides Intel HEX file manipulation for embedded systems in ocaml/opam-repository#29180
  • OCaml Ecosystem restricted 1.1 by @stopusingghpls enables restricting system operations and filesystem view, implementing OpenBSD-style security controls in ocaml/opam-repository#29182
  • OCaml Ecosystem reason-react-day-picker 0.1 by Brian Kaplan adds Melange bindings for react-day-picker in ReasonML in ocaml/opam-repository#29172
  • OCaml Ecosystem raylib-callbacks 1.6.0 by Tobias Mock introduces callback APIs for raylib with ctypes-foreign dependency, exposing ModelAnimation.t name field in ocaml/opam-repository#29008
  • OCaml Ecosystem ocamlformat-mlx 0.28.1.1 by @mlx-automation updates Odoc parser to 3.0, adds letop-punning option and unnamed functor parameter support, sets OCaml 5.4 as default version in ocaml/opam-repository#29169
  • OCaml Ecosystem jupyter 3.0.1 by Eugene Lykhovyd brings OCaml 5 support with legitimate maintainer handover from akabe in ocaml/opam-repository#29142
  • OCaml Ecosystem rpclib 10.0.0 by Pau Ruiz Safont adds Python 3 support, drops Python 2, removes deprecated rpc virtual package, and makes rpclib-async OCaml 5.3+ only while other libraries support 4.14+ in ocaml/opam-repository#29075
  • OCaml Ecosystem simple_httpd 1.0 by Christophe Raffalli fixes bugs related to bytecode and 32-bit architectures, reaching first stable release in ocaml/opam-repository#29154
  • OCaml Ecosystem menhir-lsp 0.1.2 by @dalps fixes completion entries not showing due to special characters, reduces verbose document symbols, and improves documentation messages in ocaml/opam-repository#29151
  • OCaml Ecosystem reason-react 0.17.0 by Antonio Nuno Monteiro upgrades ppxlib lower bound to 0.36 in ocaml/opam-repository#29132
  • OCaml Ecosystem Windows installation documentation streamlined by removing deprecated DkML instructions following its sunsetting announcement in ocaml/ocaml.org#3425
  • OCaml Ecosystem HTTP client improvements for scraping infrastructure including User-Agent header added to prevent blocking and optional random delay parameter to avoid rate limiting in ocaml/ocaml.org#3434 and ocaml/ocaml.org#3435
  • OCaml Ecosystem YouTube scraping enhancements with randomized source processing order and configurable delay (up to 180 seconds) between requests to prevent blocking in ocaml/ocaml.org#3435

    • Group Activity Summaries

    OCaml Ecosystem

    Documentation infrastructure and package ecosystem updates: 21 packages merged, DkML instructions removed, documentation generation issues resolved

    New Features

  • Cryptokit 1.21.1 by Xavier Leroy adds Paillier homomorphic public-key encryption, elliptic-curve cryptography (ECDSA, ECDH), SHA512/256 and SHA512/224 hash functions, and key derivation functions; introduces breaking change with distinct RSA types for public/private keys (ocaml/opam-repository#29162)
  • neo4j_bolt 0.3.0 by Jeong-Sik Yun introduces TLS/SSL support with bolt+s://, bolts://, and bolt+ssc:// URI schemes, plus URI-based connection configuration (ocaml/opam-repository#29175)
  • shakuhachi 0.1.0 by @EruEri provides music collection management and tagging capabilities (ocaml/opam-repository#29136)
  • polymarket 0.2.0 by Richard Haut offers OCaml client for Polymarket prediction market API (ocaml/opam-repository#29164)
  • intel_hex 0.1 by Михаил provides Intel HEX file manipulation for embedded systems (ocaml/opam-repository#29180)
  • restricted 1.1 by @stopusingghpls enables restricting system operations and filesystem view, implementing OpenBSD-style security controls (ocaml/opam-repository#29182)
  • reason-react-day-picker 0.1 by Brian Kaplan adds Melange bindings for react-day-picker in ReasonML (ocaml/opam-repository#29172)
  • raylib-callbacks 1.6.0 by Tobias Mock introduces callback APIs for raylib with ctypes-foreign dependency, exposing ModelAnimation.t name field (ocaml/opam-repository#29008)
  • ocamlformat-mlx 0.28.1.1 by @mlx-automation updates Odoc parser to 3.0, adds letop-punning option and unnamed functor parameter support, sets OCaml 5.4 as default version (ocaml/opam-repository#29169)
  • jupyter 3.0.1 by Eugene Lykhovyd brings OCaml 5 support with legitimate maintainer handover from akabe (ocaml/opam-repository#29142)
  • rpclib 10.0.0 by Pau Ruiz Safont adds Python 3 support, drops Python 2, removes deprecated rpc virtual package, and makes rpclib-async OCaml 5.3+ only while other libraries support 4.14+ (ocaml/opam-repository#29075)
  • simple_httpd 1.0 by Christophe Raffalli fixes bugs related to bytecode and 32-bit architectures, reaching first stable release (ocaml/opam-repository#29154)
  • menhir-lsp 0.1.2 by @dalps fixes completion entries not showing due to special characters, reduces verbose document symbols, and improves documentation messages (ocaml/opam-repository#29151)
  • reason-react 0.17.0 by Antonio Nuno Monteiro upgrades ppxlib lower bound to 0.36 (ocaml/opam-repository#29132)
  • Windows installation documentation streamlined by removing deprecated DkML instructions following its sunsetting announcement, simplifying the Windows setup guide to focus on opam, Docker, and WSL2 (ocaml/ocaml.org#3425)
  • HTTP client improvements for scraping infrastructure including User-Agent header added to prevent blocking and optional random delay parameter to avoid rate limiting (ocaml/ocaml.org#3434, ocaml/ocaml.org#3435)
  • YouTube scraping enhancements with randomized source processing order and configurable delay (up to 180 seconds) between requests to prevent blocking (ocaml/ocaml.org#3435)

    • Overview

  • Package ecosystem activity in ocaml/opam-repository with 21 packages merged, spanning cryptography (Cryptokit 1.21.1 ocaml/opam-repository#29162), database clients (neo4jbolt ocaml/opam-repository#29175), embedded systems (intelhex ocaml/opam-repository#29180), music management (shakuhachi ocaml/opam-repository#29136), and security controls (restricted ocaml/opam-repository#29182)
  • Documentation infrastructure improvements across both repositories with ocaml/ocaml.org enhancing HTTP scraping reliability (ocaml/ocaml.org#3434, ocaml/ocaml.org#3435) and addressing documentation generation failures caused by opam 2.5.0 compatibility issues (ocaml/ocaml.org#3437)
  • Platform compatibility focus in ocaml/opam-repository addressing Alpine/musl, FreeBSD, Windows, and s390x issues through targeted fixes and dependency updates (ocaml/opam-repository#29161, ocaml/opam-repository#29165, ocaml/opam-repository#29158, ocaml/opam-repository#29148)
  • Ecosystem coordination demonstrated through careful management of breaking changes in Cryptokit (ocaml/opam-repository#29162) requiring gapi-ocaml constraint updates (ocaml/opam-repository#29168), and lwt 6.0.0 withdrawal (ocaml/opam-repository#29147) to address downstream failures
  • OCaml 5.x adoption continuing with jupyter 3.0.1 (ocaml/opam-repository#29142), rpclib-async 10.0.0 requiring OCaml 5.3+ (ocaml/opam-repository#29075), and ocamlformat-mlx 0.28.1.1 setting OCaml 5.4 as default (ocaml/opam-repository#29169)

    • Activity

  • Eight new PRs opened in ocaml/opam-repository include FFmpeg 1.2.8 bindings (ocaml/opam-repository#29163) by Romain Beauxis, POSIX 4.0.0 with 14 packages (ocaml/opam-repository#29165) by Romain Beauxis iterating on FreeBSD compatibility, simple_httpd 1.0.1 (ocaml/opam-repository#29174) by Christophe Raffalli, LLVM 20 and 21 (ocaml/opam-repository#29110) by Alan, metadata 0.3.2 (ocaml/opam-repository#29183) by Romain Beauxis, rizzo 0.3.0 FRP library (ocaml/opam-repository#29181) by @tjobi fixing heap garbage collection bug, ortools 9.14.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29159) by Timothy Bourke, and memcpy 0.3.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29144) by Jeremy Yallop addressing Windows CI failures
  • Dependency constraint management in ocaml/opam-repository saw extensive work with Jan Midtgaard adding missing ppxlib upper bounds in reason-react-ppx 0.13.0 and 0.14.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29177), Anil Madhavapeddy adding more reason-react-ppx upper bounds (ocaml/opam-repository#29178) and constraining gapi-ocaml to cryptokit < 1.21 (ocaml/opam-repository#29168) due to breaking RSA type changes, and Raphaël Proust fixing otel-cohttp-lwt compatibility with cohttp 6.2.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29157)
  • Platform-specific compatibility fixes in ocaml/opam-repository delivered by Jan Midtgaard adding zlib-dev dependency for conf-taglibc.2 on Alpine (ocaml/opam-repository#29161), Romain Beauxis addressing FreeBSD _PC2_SYMLINKS issues in POSIX bindings, and Raphaël Proust fixing kinetic-client.0.0.1 build failures (ocaml/opam-repository#29156) and cca packages (ocaml/opam-repository#29155)
  • Withdrawn PRs in ocaml/opam-repository include lwt 6.0.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29147) by Raphaël Proust due to cohttp-server-lwt-unix and inotify failures with plans to re-release, Cryptokit 1.21 (ocaml/opam-repository#29148) superseded by 1.21.1 to fix endian-dependent SHA512/224 bug on s390x, and POSIX 3.1.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29128) withdrawn to implement larger changes resulting in 4.0.0 submission
  • Additional package updates merged in ocaml/opam-repository include smtml 0.18.0 SMT solver frontend (ocaml/opam-repository#29143) by @filipeom, alice 0.3.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29145) by Stephen Sherratt, gapi-ocaml 0.4.8 (ocaml/opam-repository#29176) by Alessandro Strada, and shellwords 1.0.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29126) by Daniel Fichtinger
  • Tutorial internationalization in ocaml/ocaml.org continues as draft PR by mt_caret with initial framework for I18n affecting 77 files (ocaml/ocaml.org#3238)
  • Automated content updates merged throughout the week in ocaml/ocaml.org including OCaml Weekly News from December 30 and a blog post about multi-domain OCaml on Raspberry Pi Pico 2 microcontroller (ocaml/ocaml.org#3439, ocaml/ocaml.org#3438, ocaml/ocaml.org#3436, ocaml/ocaml.org#3431)
  • Workflow dependency updates in ocaml/ocaml.org with GitHub Actions peter-evans/create-pull-request bumped from version 7 to 8 for Node 24 support (ocaml/ocaml.org#3418)

    • Notable Discussions

  • CI testing philosophy sparked debate in ocaml/opam-repository where Romain Beauxis requested stopping dune runtest in opam-repo CI, arguing it creates anti-patterns where maintainers avoid dune testing framework; Shon Feder countered that ecosystem-level integration tests catch regressions constantly and provide reverse dependency validation; Anil Madhavapeddy proposed standardizing test aliases in dune for different test types (unit, network/storage, end-to-end, benchmarks, fuzztests) as part of a three-tiered approach (ocaml/opam-repository#29166)
  • Archiving policy clarification requested in ocaml/opam-repository by Martin Jambon about defining "archiving" and "maintaining" in x-maintenance-intent field; @filipeom explained that archiving means moved to opam-repository-archive and no longer available through default remote, with criteria requiring package must be buildable, maintained, or depended upon (ocaml/opam-repository#29106)
  • Documentation toolchain maintenance highlighted by systematic failures in ocaml/ocaml.org documentation generation for recent package releases, revealing dependency on external tools that broke with opam 2.5.0 release; Jan Midtgaard identified the root cause and opened fix PR in upstream repository (ocaml/ocaml.org#3437)
  • Windows CI behavior issue raised in ocaml/opam-repository by Raphaël Proust noting Windows actions build avoid-version packages unlike occurent-based CI (ocaml/opam-repository#29158)
  • FreeBSD conf-mesa breakage reported in ocaml/opam-repository by Tobias Mock where conf-mesa.1 fails on FreeBSD with pkg-config gl errors, though it worked on FreeBSD 12 (ocaml/opam-repository#29152)
  • Maintainer transition discussion around jupyter 3.0.1 in ocaml/opam-repository demonstrated proper handover process from akabe to Eugene Lykhovyd, providing model for legitimate maintainer transitions (ocaml/opam-repository#29142)
  • Devcontainer build issues discussed in ocaml/ocaml.org by Sacha Ayoun regarding outdated Dockerfile leading to incompatible versions of lsp and yojson libraries, with ongoing investigation into why this doesn't affect CI or other developers (ocaml/ocaml.org#3304)

    • Emerging Trends

  • OCaml 5.x adoption accelerating in ocaml/opam-repository with jupyter 3.0.1 adding OCaml 5 support (ocaml/opam-repository#29142), rpclib-async 10.0.0 requiring OCaml 5.3+ (ocaml/opam-repository#29075), and ocamlformat-mlx 0.28.1.1 setting OCaml 5.4 as default version (ocaml/opam-repository#29169)
  • Breaking changes managed carefully through ecosystem coordination, demonstrated in ocaml/opam-repository by Cryptokit 1.21.1 RSA type split (ocaml/opam-repository#29162) requiring gapi-ocaml constraint update (ocaml/opam-repository#29168), and lwt 6.0.0 withdrawal (ocaml/opam-repository#29147) to rework socket option changes that caused cohttp and inotify failures
  • Platform-specific compatibility receiving attention across Alpine/musl with zlib dependency fixes (ocaml/opam-repository#29161), FreeBSD with PC2_SYMLINKS issues (ocaml/opam-repository#29165) and conf-mesa breakage (ocaml/opam-repository#29152), Windows CI challenges with avoid-version packages (ocaml/opam-repository#29158) and memcpy failures (ocaml/opam-repository#29144), and s390x endianness in Cryptokit (ocaml/opam-repository#29148)
  • Ecosystem diversity expanding with new packages spanning embedded systems (intelhex ocaml/opam-repository#29180), database clients (neo4jbolt ocaml/opam-repository#29175), music management (shakuhachi ocaml/opam-repository#29136), prediction markets (polymarket ocaml/opam-repository#29164), and security (restricted ocaml/opam-repository#29182)
  • Test infrastructure evolving with discussion around separating unit tests from integration tests (ocaml/opam-repository#29166), proposal for standardized dune test aliases, and decisions to disable tests in POSIX 4.0.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29165) compared to 3.1.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29128)
  • Dependency constraint precision improving in ocaml/opam-repository through proactive upper bound additions for ppxlib in reason-react-ppx (ocaml/opam-repository#29177, ocaml/opam-repository#29178), cryptokit in gapi-ocaml (ocaml/opam-repository#29168), and cohttp in otel-cohttp-lwt (ocaml/opam-repository#29157)
  • Infrastructure robustness focus in ocaml/ocaml.org with improvements to HTTP scraping tools to handle rate limiting and blocking through User-Agent headers, randomization, and delays preventing service disruptions (ocaml/ocaml.org#3434, ocaml/ocaml.org#3435)
  • Platform simplification evident in ocaml/ocaml.org with removal of DkML installation instructions, consolidating Windows installation options following the sunsetting of that distribution (ocaml/ocaml.org#3425)

    • OCaml Tools

    Highly active week with 110 PRs merged in Dune resolving long-standing include_subdirs issues and advancing tracing

    New Features

  • Dynamic (modules ..) expansion for parser generators (ocamllex, ocamlyacc, menhir) in ocaml/dune supporting special forms like (:include ..) and %{read-lines:..} by Antonio Nuno Monteiro (ocaml/dune#13105, ocaml/dune#13135, ocaml/dune#13157)
  • Sandboxed ocamllex and ocamlyacc actions in ocaml/dune for improved build isolation (ocaml/dune#13098)
  • Cram test command timing in ocaml/dune providing performance metrics for every command executed in cram tests by Rudi Grinberg (ocaml/dune#13092)
  • Trace follow mode in ocaml/dune with $ dune trace cat --follow enabling real-time trace monitoring by Rudi Grinberg (ocaml/dune#13133)
  • Signal tracing events in ocaml/dune added to trace output for debugging signal handling (ocaml/dune#13193)
  • Canonical s-expression trace format in ocaml/dune improving performance and consistency, supporting --chrome-trace for perfetto and --sexp for interactive usage (ocaml/dune#13059)
  • Package-level enabled_if field in ocaml/dune dune-project files allowing conditional package masking with conversion to opam available expressions (unreleased, requires Dune 3.22+) by Rudi Grinberg (ocaml/dune#12905)
  • Fixed menhir parser compilation in ocaml/dune in subdirectories with (include_subdirs qualified) (ocaml/dune#13118, fixes ocaml/dune#11119)
  • Fixed (select ..) field handling in ocaml/dune with (include_subdirs ..) parsing paths relative to module group root (ocaml/dune#13175, fixes ocaml/dune#4383, ocaml/dune#12450)
  • Fixed delayed module path evaluation in ocaml/dune for include_subdirs qualified (ocaml/dune#13156, fixes ocaml/dune#7628, ocaml/dune#7605)
  • Improved include_subdirs documentation in ocaml/dune with comprehensive usage examples and troubleshooting (ocaml/dune#13200)

    • Overview

  • ocaml/dune led group activity with 110 PRs merged, resolving multiple long-standing issues (5+ years old) related to include_subdirs qualified functionality (ocaml/dune#4381, ocaml/dune#4383, ocaml/dune#7628, ocaml/dune#11119, ocaml/dune#12450)
  • Major infrastructure work in ocaml/dune focused on observability with comprehensive tracing enhancements including real-time monitoring, performance analysis tools, and command timing (ocaml/dune#13059, ocaml/dune#13092, ocaml/dune#13116, ocaml/dune#13133, ocaml/dune#13193, ocaml/dune#13203)
  • Package management evolution in ocaml/dune and ocaml/opam with vendoring utility development, improved git pinning, and license field support (ocaml/dune#13097, ocaml/dune#13176, ocaml/opam#6841)
  • Test infrastructure improvements across ocaml/dune (bash integration and cram test enhancements) and ocaml/merlin (systematic bug reproduction test cases) (ocaml/dune#13132, ocaml/dune#13137, ocaml/merlin#2020, ocaml/merlin#2021, ocaml/merlin#2022)
  • ocaml/ocaml-lsp received automated Nix flake dependency updates (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1437)
  • No activity recorded for ocaml/ocamlfind, ocaml/odoc, ocaml/opam-file-format, ocaml-dune/spawn, and ocsigen/jsofocaml during this week

    • Activity

  • Include_subdirs qualified maturity in ocaml/dune with 57 PRs merged by Antonio Nuno Monteiro implementing comprehensive improvements including dynamic module expansion for parser generators, select field fixes, module path evaluation improvements, and extensive test coverage (ocaml/dune#13105, ocaml/dune#13118, ocaml/dune#13135, ocaml/dune#13156, ocaml/dune#13157, ocaml/dune#13160, ocaml/dune#13167, ocaml/dune#13175, ocaml/dune#13185, ocaml/dune#13187, ocaml/dune#13189, ocaml/dune#13195, ocaml/dune#13198)
  • Dune scheduler refactoring by Rudi Grinberg extracting scheduler into dedicated library with nine modularization PRs improving code organization (ocaml/dune#13191, ocaml/dune#13207, ocaml/dune#13208, ocaml/dune#13209, ocaml/dune#13210, ocaml/dune#13211, ocaml/dune#13212, ocaml/dune#13213, ocaml/dune#13214)
  • Tracing infrastructure enhancements in ocaml/dune with atomic event writing (ocaml/dune#13116), thread safety improvements (ocaml/dune#13151), signal tracking (ocaml/dune#13193), cram test event naming (ocaml/dune#13197), and jq function for analyzing slow commands (ocaml/dune#13203)
  • Cram test bash integration completed in ocaml/dune with bash shell support (ocaml/dune#13137), safety options including errexit and pipefail (ocaml/dune#13132), undefined variable detection (ocaml/dune#13161), bash script syntax checking (ocaml/dune#13186), improved unreachable output extraction (ocaml/dune#13164), and evaluation fixes (ocaml/dune#13150)
  • Package management work in ocaml/dune with nested dune executable resolution fix closing 2-year-old issue (ocaml/dune#12902, fixes ocaml/dune#10019), pinning function renaming for clarity (ocaml/dune#13178), pin stanza behavior documentation (ocaml/dune#13106, ocaml/dune#13126, ocaml/dune#13127), and active discussions on git pinning (ocaml/dune#13176) and vendoring utility (ocaml/dune#13097)
  • Test coverage expansion in ocaml/merlin with Charlène_Gros from Tarides opening four reproduction test case PRs for historical bug reports (ocaml/merlin#2020 for ocaml/merlin#1987, ocaml/merlin#2021 for ocaml/merlin#1763, ocaml/merlin#2022 for ocaml/merlin#1214, ocaml/merlin#2017 for ocaml/merlin#1980)
  • License field support in ocaml/opam with Raphaël Proust opening PR to add license as field for opam list command, receiving code review feedback from Kate requesting use of assoc_opt and tests (ocaml/opam#6841)
  • Ten new PRs opened in ocaml/dune including OCaml vendoring utility by Ali Caglayan (ocaml/dune#13097), cross-compilation --target-exec implementation by Romain Beauxis (ocaml/dune#13112), git repository pinning improvements by Marek Kubica (ocaml/dune#13176), dune init src directory default by Etienne (ocaml/dune#13192), vendoring test for data-only directories by Sudha Parimala (ocaml/dune#13129), dune-site linkall warning by Raphaël Proust (ocaml/dune#13109), CI opam dependency caching by Antonio Nuno Monteiro (ocaml/dune#13177), and trace commands enhancement by Rudi Grinberg (ocaml/dune#13183)
  • CI and test infrastructure improvements in ocaml/dune by Ali Caglayan including multi-repo-build depext auto-installation (ocaml/dune#13111), display configuration (ocaml/dune#13124), configurable steps (ocaml/dune#13125), unique cache prefix enforcement (ocaml/dune#13091), opam cache optimization (ocaml/dune#13115), building @install instead of @all in tests (ocaml/dune#13206), and removing --display short from odoc tests (ocaml/dune#13204)

    • Notable Discussions

  • Executable organization documentation debate in ocaml/dune with 29 comments by @jrfondren discussing dune init defaults and project layout conventions, leading to good first issue for howto guide (ocaml/dune#13142, ocaml/dune#13181)
  • Vendoring utility design discussions in ocaml/dune with 20 comments by Ali Caglayan covering implementation approach for OCaml package vendoring (ocaml/dune#13097)
  • Git repository pinning enhancement in ocaml/dune with 18 comments by Marek Kubica proposing git_repo usage for package pinning (ocaml/dune#13176)
  • Select field fix in ocaml/dune with 18 comments by Antonio Nuno Monteiro addressing path handling with include_subdirs through thorough review process (ocaml/dune#13175)
  • Tag visibility improvements in ocaml/opam with detailed issue by @jrfondren analyzing tag usage across 729 singleton tags and proposing tag cloud, dedicated search, and columns option for opam list (ocaml/opam#6842)
  • Windows CI path handling discussion in ocaml/merlin where Charlène_Gros seeks input from Ulysse and Xavier Van de Woestyne on test output normalization for cross-platform compatibility (ocaml/merlin#2017)
  • Trace atomic writes implementation in ocaml/dune with 14 comments by Rudi Grinberg covering technical details of event writing improvements (ocaml/dune#13116)
  • Trace follow mode feature in ocaml/dune with 12 comments by Rudi Grinberg regarding real-time trace monitoring capabilities (ocaml/dune#13133)

    • Emerging Trends

  • Technical debt reduction with resolution of multiple historical issues spanning 5-7 years in ocaml/dune including include_subdirs bugs (ocaml/dune#4381, ocaml/dune#4383, ocaml/dune#7628) and runtest module selection (ocaml/dune#870 via ocaml/dune#13064)
  • Observability focus in ocaml/dune with comprehensive tracing enhancements including performance analysis tools, real-time monitoring, and command timing providing deeper build insights (ocaml/dune#13059, ocaml/dune#13092, ocaml/dune#13116, ocaml/dune#13133, ocaml/dune#13193, ocaml/dune#13203)
  • Package management modernization across ocaml/dune and ocaml/opam with vendoring utility development, improved git pinning, license field support, and tag visibility improvements (ocaml/dune#13097, ocaml/dune#13176, ocaml/opam#6841, ocaml/opam#6842)
  • Code health initiatives in ocaml/dune with scheduler modularization into dedicated library improving maintainability (ocaml/dune#13191, ocaml/dune#13207 through ocaml/dune#13214)
  • Cross-platform testing attention in ocaml/merlin addressing Windows CI path handling differences requiring platform-specific test output normalization (ocaml/merlin#2017)
  • Test infrastructure improvements across multiple repositories with ocaml/dune establishing comprehensive bash integration for cram tests (ocaml/dune#13132, ocaml/dune#13137, ocaml/dune#13186) and ocaml/merlin systematically adding reproduction tests for historical bugs (ocaml/merlin#2020, ocaml/merlin#2021, ocaml/merlin#2022)

    • OxCaml

    Dissector pass merged for large executables, arm64 platform support advancing, modes system refinements continuing

    New Features

  • Dissector pass for linking large executables (>2GB) using small code model without text section changes, enabled via -dissector flag with partition size control via -dissector-partition-size and debug flags -ddissector, -ddissector-sizes, -ddissector-verbose, -ddissector-partitions, and -ddissector-inputs by Mark Shinwell in oxcaml/oxcaml#5146
  • Debug tracking improvements for name mangling with new enter_anonymous_module function and location tracking in enter_anonymous_function by Tim McGilchrist in oxcaml/oxcaml#5098
  • Type inspection infrastructure with Texp_inspected_type and Tpat_inspected_type nodes for passing disambiguation information in quotes by Jakub Bachurski in oxcaml/oxcaml#5090
  • Arm64 AST reorganization moving arm64 AST into dedicated library in backend/arm64/ast/ to support upcoming binary emitter by Mark Shinwell in oxcaml/oxcaml#5184
  • OCamlformat preparation with formatting fixes to support upgrade to version 0.28.1 by Simon Spies in oxcaml/oxcaml#5181 and oxcaml/oxcaml#5189

    • Overview

  • All activity concentrated in oxcaml/oxcaml with 17 new PRs opened and 5 PRs merged this week
  • Mark Shinwell merged dissector pass enabling large executable linking via oxcaml/oxcaml#5146 and opened 7 PRs advancing arm64 binary emitter infrastructure
  • Zesen Qian and Ryan Tjoa continued modes system refinements with PRs for modality hints, scannable axes, and or_null precision
  • Simon Spies prepared for OCaml 5.4 upgrade with ocamlformat version bump via oxcaml/oxcaml#5180
  • No activity in oxcaml/opam-repository, oxcaml/merlin, oxcaml/jsofocaml, or janestreet/opam-repository during this week

    • Activity

  • Arm64 binary emitter work progressing with infrastructure improvements including typed DSL rewrite in oxcaml/oxcaml#5193, improved label/symbol typing in oxcaml/oxcaml#5185, extra owee functionality in oxcaml/oxcaml#5188, and binary emitter itself in draft form via oxcaml/oxcaml#5177 by Mark Shinwell
  • Modes system refinements with Zesen Qian working on modality hints in oxcaml/oxcaml#5183, explicit valmodalities application in oxcaml/oxcaml#5190, and module mode hints in oxcaml/oxcaml#5034, while Ryan Tjoa addresses scannable axes behavior in oxcaml/oxcaml#5187 and oxcaml/oxcaml#5169, and ornull layout precision in oxcaml/oxcaml#5176 and oxcaml/oxcaml#5178
  • Zero-alloc checker improvements by Xavier Clerc preventing Widen exception escapes in oxcaml/oxcaml#5179 and synchronizing destruction point checks in oxcaml/oxcaml#5182
  • Dissector refinements following merge with stack overflow fix in oxcaml/oxcaml#5191 and test simplification in oxcaml/oxcaml#5195 by Simon Spies and Mark Shinwell
  • Metaprogramming features advancing with quote disambiguation work by Jakub Bachurski for records/variants in oxcaml/oxcaml#5094 and polymorphic applications in oxcaml/oxcaml#5154
  • OCaml 5.4 upgrade preparations continuing by Simon Spies with ocamlformat version bump in oxcaml/oxcaml#5180 and Nix flake update by Jacob Van Buren in oxcaml/oxcaml#5194 as part of broader upgrade effort tracked in oxcaml/oxcaml#5036
  • Platform-independent JIT support being added to ocaml-jit by Mark Shinwell in oxcaml/oxcaml#5186 to enable metaprogramming support alongside arm64 work
  • Logical immediate refactoring for arm64 improving bitwise immediate encoding by Mark Shinwell in oxcaml/oxcaml#5192

    • Notable Discussions

  • Ikinds representation discussion by @julesjacobs exploring minus24 encoding with over 160 comments addressing layout computation, mutual recursion handling, and integration strategy in oxcaml/oxcaml#5159
  • Arm64 binary emitter architecture refinement by Mark Shinwell discussing verification flags, improved typing for labels/symbols, and integration with ocaml-jit for metaprogramming support in oxcaml/oxcaml#5177
  • Scannable axes semantics debate between Ryan Tjoa and reviewers regarding backwards compatibility for mod syntax behavior with nonfloat and nullability modifiers, balancing immediate needs against future ppxtemplate improvements in oxcaml/oxcaml#5187
  • Ornull layout precision technical discussion by Ryan Tjoa examining separability computation edge cases and dead code identification in typejkind in oxcaml/oxcaml#5178
  • Preemption implementation review by Aspen Smith with detailed feedback on SSE register handling in garbage collection interface in oxcaml/oxcaml#5136 and oxcaml/oxcaml#4881

    • Emerging Trends

  • Arm64 platform maturation with comprehensive work spanning typed DSL rewrite, binary emitter implementation, platform-independent JIT support, and improved label/symbol typing across 7+ PRs by Mark Shinwell in oxcaml/oxcaml#5193, oxcaml/oxcaml#5192, oxcaml/oxcaml#5191, oxcaml/oxcaml#5188, oxcaml/oxcaml#5186, oxcaml/oxcaml#5185, oxcaml/oxcaml#5184, and oxcaml/oxcaml#5177
  • Modes system refinement through multiple coordinated PRs addressing modality hints, valmodalities application, scannable axes semantics, and ornull precision by Zesen Qian and Ryan Tjoa in oxcaml/oxcaml#5183, oxcaml/oxcaml#5190, oxcaml/oxcaml#5187, oxcaml/oxcaml#5176, oxcaml/oxcaml#5178, oxcaml/oxcaml#5169, and oxcaml/oxcaml#5034
  • Tooling modernization with OCaml 5.4 upgrade preparations including ocamlformat 0.28.1 bump and Nix flake updates in oxcaml/oxcaml#5180, oxcaml/oxcaml#5194, and oxcaml/oxcaml#5036
  • Metaprogramming infrastructure development with type inspection framework and quote disambiguation features by Jakub Bachurski in oxcaml/oxcaml#5090, oxcaml/oxcaml#5094, and oxcaml/oxcaml#5154
  • Large-scale compilation support with dissector pass enabling 2GB+ executables using small code model without recompilation by Mark Shinwell in oxcaml/oxcaml#5146

    • OCaml Core

    Multicore
entry.summary: Focused oxcaml week with dissector pass merged, arm64 maturation, 110 Dune PRs merged resolving 5+ year old bugs, 21 ecosystem packages

entry.title: Week 52, 2025: Holiday week with String module expansion, jkind error fixes, Dune 3.22 released, 11 new packages added
entry.content:
Weekly Summary

New Features

  • OCaml Core String.of_char function converts a single character to a string with clearer intent than String.make 1 c in ocaml/ocaml#14440 by Daniel Bünzli
  • OCaml Core String.is_empty predicate checks if a string is empty in ocaml/ocaml#14438 by Daniel Bünzli
  • OCaml Core DragonFly BSD native backend enabled, making ocamlopt available on DragonFly BSD x86_64 systems in ocaml/ocaml#14431 by Michael Neumann
  • OCaml Core Testsuite not-root action allows tests to be skipped when running as superuser in ocaml/ocaml#14435 by Kate
  • OxCaml Fixed environment scoping in jkind error messages to ensure proper type variable printing with correct context in oxcaml/oxcaml#5173 by Liam Stevenson
  • OxCaml Enhanced jkind printing comments for better code clarity and maintainability in oxcaml/oxcaml#5175 by Liam Stevenson
  • OxCaml Fixed CFG simplify terminator pass to guard transformations that could render control flow graphs irreducible in oxcaml/oxcaml#5174 by Xavier Clerc
  • OxCaml Updated scannable axes documentation with comprehensive coverage of kind system extensions in oxcaml/oxcaml#5170 by Ryan Tjoa
  • Multicore Improved comment formatting in picosmuxthread.ml for better signal handler documentation in ocaml-multicore/picos#380
  • OCaml Ecosystem New package menhir-lsp 0.1.1 providing Language Server Protocol implementation for Menhir and ocamllex with navigation and completion features in ocaml/opam-repository#29137
  • OCaml Ecosystem New package polymarket 0.1.0 providing OCaml client library for Polymarket prediction market API in ocaml/opam-repository#29133
  • OCaml Ecosystem New package shellwords 1.0.0 implementing POSIX shell command word parsing and quoting utilities in ocaml/opam-repository#29126
  • OCaml Ecosystem New package frontmatter_extractor 0.1 for extracting front-matter sections from text files in ocaml/opam-repository#29129
  • OCaml Ecosystem QCheck 0.91 released with compatibility updates across qcheck packages in ocaml/opam-repository#29123
  • OCaml Ecosystem Sail 0.20.1 bugfix release with loop syntax improvements in ocaml/opam-repository#29124
  • OCaml Ecosystem MLX 0.11 updated with OCaml 5.4 support and Windows fixes in ocaml/opam-repository#29134
  • OCaml Ecosystem opam-check-npm-deps 4.1.0 now supports opam 2.5 in ocaml/opam-repository#29131
  • OCaml Ecosystem Improved error handling in ocaml.org YouTube feed scraper with exception logging in ocaml/ocaml.org#3433
  • OCaml Tools Dune 3.22 released with new dune trace cat subcommand for viewing trace files in ocaml/dune#13055, cram stanza shell customization allowing bash in ocaml/dune#13083, structured logging implementation in ocaml/dune#13015, and file watching events in traces in ocaml/dune#13038
  • OCaml Tools Dune install path fixes for handling relative paths outside workspace in ocaml/dune#12993 and directory target digesting in ocaml/dune#13045
  • OCaml Tools Dune platform fixes including macOS compatibility by reverting copyfile change in ocaml/dune#13069 and updated ocaml-lmdb fixing BSD builds in ocaml/dune#13074
  • OCaml Tools Fixed format upgrade lock handling on Windows in opam by reusing global lock file descriptor in ocaml/opam#6839
  • OCaml Tools Fixed -short-paths configuration for Merlin in ocaml-lsp by removing incorrect default in ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1579

    • Group Activity Summaries

    OCaml Ecosystem

    Package ecosystem expanded with 11 new packages while ocaml.org improved reliability with error logging and uptime fixes

    New Features

  • New package menhir-lsp.0.1.1 providing Language Server Protocol implementation for Menhir and ocamllex with navigation and completion features (ocaml/opam-repository#29137)
  • New package polymarket.0.1.0 providing OCaml client library for Polymarket prediction market API with market data retrieval and order management (ocaml/opam-repository#29133)
  • New package shellwords.1.0.0 implementing POSIX shell command word parsing and quoting utilities, compatible with Rust shell-words crate (ocaml/opam-repository#29126)
  • New package frontmatter_extractor.0.1 for extracting front-matter sections from text files with YAML support (ocaml/opam-repository#29129)
  • QCheck 0.91 released with compatibility updates across qcheck, qcheck-core, qcheck-alcotest, and qcheck-ounit packages (ocaml/opam-repository#29123)
  • Sail 0.20.1 bugfix release with loop syntax improvements and unification of bit type with bits(1) type (ocaml/opam-repository#29124)
  • MLX 0.11 updated with OCaml 5.4 support and Windows fixes (ocaml/opam-repository#29134)
  • opam-check-npm-deps 4.1.0 now supports opam 2.5 and removes most vendored code (ocaml/opam-repository#29131)
  • Pacomb 1.4.1 parser combinator library adds not charset combinator and compatibility with latest OCaml and ppxlib (ocaml/opam-repository#29122)
  • Expr 0.6.0 adds string parsing and comparison capabilities (ocaml/opam-repository#29138)
  • QuickJS 0.4.1 updated to remove uutf dependency (ocaml/opam-repository#29125)
  • conf-taglib_c.2 extended with Debian 13+ support (ocaml/opam-repository#29141)
  • Improved error handling in ocaml.org YouTube feed scraper with exception logging that reports source name, URL, and error details when feeds cannot be fetched (ocaml/ocaml.org#3433)

    • Overview

  • Package ecosystem growth with 11 new packages merged to ocaml/opam-repository including Language Server Protocol support for Menhir, API client libraries, and utility packages (ocaml/opam-repository#29137, ocaml/opam-repository#29133, ocaml/opam-repository#29126, ocaml/opam-repository#29129)
  • Major package updates across testing frameworks (QCheck 0.91), specification languages (Sail 0.20.1), and platform support libraries (MLX 0.11) with OCaml 5.4 compatibility improvements (ocaml/opam-repository#29123, ocaml/opam-repository#29124, ocaml/opam-repository#29134)
  • Website stability maintained for ocaml/ocaml.org with December 26 downtime quickly resolved and error logging improvements for better diagnostics (ocaml/ocaml.org#3432, ocaml/ocaml.org#3433)
  • Active PR pipeline with 4 new package submissions in opam-repository including major version updates for rpclib, reason-react, posix packages, and jupyter (ocaml/opam-repository#29075, ocaml/opam-repository#29132, ocaml/opam-repository#29128, ocaml/opam-repository#29142)
  • Content expansion on ocaml.org with automated scraping adding new blog posts and videos, plus proposal for new blog source from chrisarmstrong.dev (ocaml/ocaml.org#3429, ocaml/ocaml.org#3430, ocaml/ocaml.org#3431, ocaml/ocaml.org#3428)

    • Activity

  • synchronizer 0.2 merged to opam-repository with updated package metadata (ocaml/opam-repository#29113)
  • New PR opened for shakuhachi.0.1.0 music collection manager and tagger by @EruEri encountering CI feedback on conf-taglib_c failures and dependency bounds (ocaml/opam-repository#29136)
  • New PR opened for jupyter.3.0.1 OCaml kernel for Jupyter notebooks by Eugene Lykhovyd, superseding previous version due to OCaml 5.4 compatibility issues (ocaml/opam-repository#29142)
  • New PR opened for rpclib 10.0.0 (6 packages) by Pau Ruiz Safont adding Python3 support, dropping Python2, with ongoing investigation of riscv64 test failures (ocaml/opam-repository#29075)
  • New PR opened for reason-react 0.17.0 (2 packages) by Antonio Nuno Monteiro upgrading ppxlib to 0.36, encountering reverse dependency failures requiring additional bounds (ocaml/opam-repository#29132)
  • posix packages 3.1.0 (10 packages) under active iteration by Romain Beauxis addressing BSD compatibility and network sandboxing issues in tests (ocaml/opam-repository#29128)
  • New blog source proposed by Chris Armstrong to add OCaml-related posts from chrisarmstrong.dev to the ocaml.org planet feed (ocaml/ocaml.org#3428)
  • Automated content scraping merged three PRs adding new OCaml blog posts and videos to the planet on ocaml.org (ocaml/ocaml.org#3429, ocaml/ocaml.org#3430, ocaml/ocaml.org#3431)
  • Website downtime on December 26 reported by Daniel Bünzli with connections timing out, resolved by Mark Elvers (ocaml/ocaml.org#3432)
  • Jan Midtgaard provided extensive CI review and feedback across multiple opam-repository PRs including lower bounds issues, dependency failures, and platform-specific build problems (ocaml/opam-repository#29136, ocaml/opam-repository#29131, ocaml/opam-repository#29123, ocaml/opam-repository#29122, ocaml/opam-repository#29124, ocaml/opam-repository#29125, ocaml/opam-repository#29137, ocaml/opam-repository#29138, ocaml/opam-repository#29133, ocaml/opam-repository#29134)

    • Emerging Trends

  • OCaml 5.4 compatibility becoming priority across ecosystem with multiple packages updating to support latest compiler version, including MLX and jupyter packages (ocaml/opam-repository#29134, ocaml/opam-repository#29142)
  • Dependency lower bounds receiving increased attention from CI review process catching compatibility issues early across package submissions (ocaml/opam-repository#29131, ocaml/opam-repository#29136, ocaml/opam-repository#29122)
  • Language Server Protocol support expanding with menhir-lsp providing editor integration for parser development, continuing trend of improved developer tooling (ocaml/opam-repository#29137)
  • Cross-language compatibility patterns emerging with packages like shellwords targeting behavior compatibility with implementations in other languages (ocaml/opam-repository#29126)
  • Platform-specific testing improvements with sandboxing and architecture-specific issues being identified and addressed, particularly for BSD compatibility and riscv64 support (ocaml/opam-repository#29128, ocaml/opam-repository#29075)
  • Operational visibility improvements through better error logging and diagnostics, exemplified by YouTube feed scraper exception reporting on ocaml.org (ocaml/ocaml.org#3433)
  • Configuration package maintenance continuing with updates for newer distribution versions, ensuring ecosystem compatibility with evolving Linux distributions (ocaml/opam-repository#29141)

    • OCaml Tools

    Dune 3.22 released with trace improvements and cram customization while opam fixed Windows lock handling

    New Features

  • ocaml/dune: Version 3.22 released with new dune trace cat subcommand for viewing trace files (ocaml/dune#13055), cram stanza shell customization allowing bash instead of default sh (ocaml/dune#13083), structured logging implementation (ocaml/dune#13015), file watching and diagnostic events in traces (ocaml/dune#13038, ocaml/dune#13041)
  • ocaml/dune: Fixed dune install --prefix to handle relative paths outside workspace like ../foo (ocaml/dune#12993), directory target digesting for use as dependencies (ocaml/dune#13045), compiler pin propagation to dev tool solver (ocaml/dune#13033), and Melange runtime dependencies with directory targets (ocaml/dune#13042)
  • ocaml/dune: Platform fixes including macOS compatibility by reverting copyfile change (ocaml/dune#13069) and updated ocaml-lmdb fixing OpenBSD/NetBSD builds (ocaml/dune#13074)
  • ocaml/opam: Fixed format upgrade lock handling on Windows by reusing global lock file descriptor instead of reopening, preventing failures during switch and repository format upgrades (ocaml/opam#6839)
  • ocaml/ocaml-lsp: Fixed -short-paths configuration for Merlin by removing incorrect real_paths = false default (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1579)

    • Overview

  • ocaml/dune released version 3.22 with trace infrastructure improvements, cram testing enhancements, and install path fixes while continuing parser generator refactoring and test suite reorganization
  • ocaml/opam merged Windows lock handling fix for format upgrades with ongoing work on nushell support, source caching optimization, and repository configuration redesign
  • ocaml/ocaml-lsp fixed Merlin -short-paths configuration handling in ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1579
  • ocaml/merlin received bug report about Reason syntax output regression in OCaml 5.3+ (ocaml/merlin#2019)
  • ocsigen/jsofocaml had JavaScript parser bug reported for arrow functions in for loops (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2139) with ongoing WebAssembly effects implementation (ocsigen/jsofocaml#1832)
  • ocaml/ocamlfind, ocaml/odoc, ocaml/opam-file-format, and ocaml-dune/spawn had no activity this week

    • Activity

  • ocaml/dune: Rudi Grinberg leading trace infrastructure modernization with csexp format migration PR (ocaml/dune#13059), trace format refactoring (ocaml/dune#13056, ocaml/dune#13050), and cram command timing (ocaml/dune#13092)
  • ocaml/dune: Antonio Nuno Monteiro completing parser generator refactoring by porting ocamllex and ocamlyacc to standalone stanzas (ocaml/dune#13075, ocaml/dune#13061), refactoring install entry handling (ocaml/dune#13058, ocaml/dune#13068), and opening concurrent install entries PR (ocaml/dune#13054)
  • ocaml/dune: Ali Caglayan implementing runtest for tests stanza closing seven-year-old ocaml/dune#870 (ocaml/dune#13064) and opening RPC locking fix (ocaml/dune#12979)
  • ocaml/dune: Marek Kubica advancing package management with internal sed implementation for pkg tests (ocaml/dune#13040, ocaml/dune#13035), nested dune call fix (ocaml/dune#12902), and lock normalization (ocaml/dune#13034)
  • ocaml/dune: Test suite reorganization moving ocamllex and ocamlyacc tests to dedicated directories (ocaml/dune#13086, ocaml/dune#13093) with extensive coverage of edge cases (ocaml/dune#13094, ocaml/dune#13090, ocaml/dune#13087)
  • ocaml/dune: Large odoc v3 rules rewrite remains in draft by Jon Ludlam with over 5400 lines added (ocaml/dune#12995)
  • ocaml/opam: Benjamin Voisin working on nushell shell support to enable opam env with JSON output format (ocaml/opam#6330, ocaml/opam#6649)
  • ocaml/opam: Kate developing source caching optimization to save disk space by only caching dev packages (ocaml/opam#6440)
  • ocaml/opam: R. Boujbel redesigning internal repository configuration format with labeled section fields (ocaml/opam#6393)
  • ocaml/ocaml-lsp: Gaëtan Gilbert opened PR fixing -short-paths configuration for Merlin (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1579 addressing ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1395)
  • ocsigen/jsofocaml: Jérôme Vouillon continuing WebAssembly effects implementation based on Stack Switching proposal (ocsigen/jsofocaml#1832)

    • Notable Discussions

  • File timestamp preservation regression in ocaml/opam ≥ 2.2 discussed by Mark Elvers where source files lose timestamps when copied to build directory, triggering unnecessary automake regeneration and exposing missing dependencies (ocaml/opam#6693, caused by ocaml/opam#4823)
  • OCaml version conflict reported by @10takla between ocamlformat-mlx (requires ocaml < "5.4") and ocaml/ocaml-lsp server (requires ocaml >= "5.4") (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1578)

    • Emerging Trends

  • Trace and observability infrastructure receiving focused development in ocaml/dune with structured logging migration (ocaml/dune#13015), new trace subcommands (ocaml/dune#13055), csexp format migration (ocaml/dune#13059), and enriched event coverage (ocaml/dune#13038, ocaml/dune#13041)
  • Platform compatibility improvements across build and package management tools: ocaml/dune fixing macOS exec format errors (ocaml/dune#13069) and BSD builds (ocaml/dune#13074), ocaml/opam addressing Windows lock handling (ocaml/opam#6839) and improving alternative shell support (ocaml/opam#6330)
  • Test infrastructure quality emphasis in ocaml/dune through systematic test suite reorganization (ocaml/dune#13086, ocaml/dune#13093), comprehensive edge case coverage (ocaml/dune#13094, ocaml/dune#13090), cram testing enhancements (ocaml/dune#13083, ocaml/dune#13092), and jq integration (ocaml/dune#13067)
  • Parser generator refactoring in ocaml/dune moving ocamllex and ocamlyacc from legacy Rule_conf to standalone stanzas for cleaner architecture (ocaml/dune#13075, ocaml/dune#13061)
  • Package management optimization initiatives in ocaml/opam focusing on disk space efficiency through selective source caching (ocaml/opam#6440) and internal configuration improvements (ocaml/opam#6393)
  • Documentation generation evolution with large odoc v3 rules rewrite in ocaml/dune (ocaml/dune#12995) preparing for next generation documentation tooling

    • OxCaml

    Type system refinements with jkind error improvements, CFG backend fixes, and ongoing work on `or_null` types and ARM64 support

    New Features

  • Fixed environment scoping in jkind error messages to ensure proper type variable printing with correct context in oxcaml/oxcaml#5173 by Liam Stevenson
  • Enhanced jkind printing comments for better code clarity and maintainability in oxcaml/oxcaml#5175 by Liam Stevenson
  • Fixed simplify terminator pass in CFG backend to guard transformations that could render control flow graphs irreducible, ensuring loop information remains valid in oxcaml/oxcaml#5174 by Xavier Clerc
  • Updated scannable axes documentation with comprehensive coverage of kind system extensions including non_pointer, non_null, and separability features in oxcaml/oxcaml#5170 by Ryan Tjoa

    • Overview

  • Activity concentrated in oxcaml/oxcaml with 4 merged PRs addressing jkind error reporting and CFG backend correctness
  • New PRs opened for or_null type handling improvements in oxcaml/oxcaml#5178 and oxcaml/oxcaml#5176
  • ARM64 machine code emitter introduced in oxcaml/oxcaml#5177 to make ocaml-jit library architecture-independent
  • Unboxed keywords proposal in oxcaml/oxcaml#5167 adding syntax variants for unit# and bool#
  • No activity recorded in oxcaml/opam-repository, oxcaml/merlin, oxcaml/jsofocaml, or janestreet/opam-repository

    • Activity

  • or_null type refinement with new PRs addressing imprecise separability in type_jkind (oxcaml/oxcaml#5178) and improved layout estimation for or_null instances (oxcaml/oxcaml#5176) by Ryan Tjoa
  • ARM64 binary emitter introduced by Mark Shinwell as typed DSL-based machine code emitter for ARM64 architecture in oxcaml/oxcaml#5177
  • Unboxed keywords feature proposed by Nailen Matschke adding #;, #if, #assert, #while, #for, #when, and #<- variants for unboxed types in oxcaml/oxcaml#5167
  • Quotation system improvements with type inspection infrastructure merged in oxcaml/oxcaml#5090 and record/variant disambiguation work in oxcaml/oxcaml#5094 by Jakub Bachurski
  • Stage checking for record labels progressing in oxcaml/oxcaml#5158 by Andrej Ivašković with review from Zesen Qian
  • Effects and preemption work advancing with preemption implementation (oxcaml/oxcaml#4881), effect primitives refactoring (oxcaml/oxcaml#4901), and Dynamic stdlib implementation (oxcaml/oxcaml#5172) by Aspen Smith
  • Backend optimizations including dissector pass for 2GB+ executables in oxcaml/oxcaml#5146 by Mark Shinwell and ARM64 large stack offsets fix in oxcaml/oxcaml#5130 by Xavier Clerc
  • Type system enhancements with implicit kinds work in oxcaml/oxcaml#4285 by @dkalinichenko-js and base kinds externality changes in oxcaml/oxcaml#5162 by Nailen Matschke
  • Layout polymorphism infrastructure advancing with slambda constructors in oxcaml/oxcaml#5148 by Jack Rickard and functors with non-legacy modes in oxcaml/oxcaml#5107 by Zesen Qian
  • CI improvements with Nix installation reliability fix in oxcaml/oxcaml#5168 by George Shammas

    • Emerging Trends

  • or_null type system refinement emerging with multiple PRs improving jkind separability analysis (oxcaml/oxcaml#5178), layout estimation (oxcaml/oxcaml#5176), and scannable axes preparation (oxcaml/oxcaml#5169)
  • Unboxed type usability improving through new keyword syntax proposal (oxcaml/oxcaml#5167) and expanded documentation (oxcaml/oxcaml#5170)
  • Effects-based preemption maturing with runtime infrastructure refactoring in oxcaml/oxcaml#4881, oxcaml/oxcaml#4901, and oxcaml/oxcaml#5171
  • ARM64 backend development expanding with binary emitter (oxcaml/oxcaml#5177) and stack handling improvements (oxcaml/oxcaml#5130)
  • Quotation system rigor increasing with stage checking enforcement in oxcaml/oxcaml#5158 and disambiguation work in oxcaml/oxcaml#5094
  • Large executable support developing through dissector pass enabling 2GB+ binaries in oxcaml/oxcaml#5146

    • OCaml Core

    String module additions and DragonFly BSD native backend support merged in ocaml/ocaml

    New Features

  • String.of_char function converts a single character to a string, providing clearer intent than String.make 1 c in ocaml/ocaml#14440 by Daniel Bünzli
  • String.is_empty predicate checks if a string is empty in ocaml/ocaml#14438 by Daniel Bünzli
  • DragonFly BSD native backend enabled, making ocamlopt available on DragonFly BSD x86_64 systems in ocaml/ocaml#14431 by Michael Neumann
  • Testsuite enhancement with new not-root builtin action allowing tests to be skipped when running as superuser in ocaml/ocaml#14435 by Kate

    • Overview

  • Single active repository: All activity this week occurred in ocaml/ocaml with no commits in ocaml/RFCs
  • Four features merged: String.ofchar, String.isempty, DragonFly BSD native backend, and testsuite not-root action
  • Seven new PRs opened: String module enhancements (ocaml/ocaml#14381, ocaml/ocaml#14436, ocaml/ocaml#14437, ocaml/ocaml#14439), numeric stdlib additions (ocaml/ocaml#14433, ocaml/ocaml#14432), and testsuite improvements (ocaml/ocaml#14441)
  • Standard library modernization focus: Daniel Bünzli and Xavier Leroy driving systematic stdlib API expansion across String and numeric modules

    • Activity

  • String module expansion continues with Daniel Bünzli proposing comprehensive string processing capabilities in ocaml/ocaml#14137, including search primitives with find_{first,last} and find_all in ocaml/ocaml#14381, substring replacement with replace_{first,last,all} in ocaml/ocaml#14436, string splitting with split_{first,last,all} in ocaml/ocaml#14437, and affix checking with String.includes in ocaml/ocaml#14439
  • Bit manipulation functions proposed by Xavier Leroy adding popcount, nlz, ntz, nls, and related bit counting functions to Int, Int32, Int64, and Nativeint modules using pure OCaml implementations based on Hacker's Delight algorithms in ocaml/ocaml#14433
  • Integer division operations introduced by Xavier Leroy with fdiv (floor division), cdiv (ceil division), ediv (Euclidean division), and emod (Euclidean remainder) providing non-negative remainders suitable for modulo arithmetic in ocaml/ocaml#14432
  • Unstable feature annotation mechanism proposed by Alistair with [@@unstable] attributes allowing experimental APIs to be marked and gated behind -Z flags or local [@@@unstable_feature] attributes in ocaml/ocaml#14430
  • Platform support work continues with Anarchos activating native backend for Haiku OS in ocaml/ocaml#14138
  • Testsuite resilience improvements proposed by Gabriel Scherer in ocaml/ocaml#14441
  • Format_string module proposal by Florian Angeletti introducing dedicated module for format string functions to reduce stdlib dependency on CamlinternalFormat in ocaml/ocaml#12670
  • Option.value_or PR by @hirrolot remains under committee discussion with concerns about naming and API design in ocaml/ocaml#13937

    • Notable Discussions

  • String module API design extensively discussed in ocaml/ocaml#14137 with Daniel Bünzli proposing naming conventions using first, last, and all keywords for search-based operations, balancing readability with consistency across find, replace, and split functions
  • Unstable features mechanism debated in ocaml/ocaml#14430 with Alistair arguing for Rust-style unstable attributes to enable faster stdlib evolution, while Daniel Bünzli and Sacha Ayoun expressing concerns about ecosystem fragmentation and design responsibility
  • Polymorphic parameters soundness discussed in ocaml/ocaml#14434 where Alistair reported segfault with pattern matching on polymorphic parameters, with Gabriel Scherer identifying exhaustiveness checking failure in Parmatch

    • Emerging Trends
