  • String module modernization gaining momentum with Daniel Bünzli systematically adding search (ocaml/ocaml#14381), replace (ocaml/ocaml#14436), split (ocaml/ocaml#14437), empty check (ocaml/ocaml#14438), affix check (ocaml/ocaml#14439), and char conversion (ocaml/ocaml#14440) functions addressing long-standing gaps in string processing
  • Stdlib API expansion continuing with mathematical functions by Xavier Leroy adding bit manipulation (ocaml/ocaml#14433) and division operations (ocaml/ocaml#14432) that match capabilities found in libraries like Zarith
  • Stdlib evolution process under examination with proposals for unstable features in ocaml/ocaml#14430 and Format_string module in ocaml/ocaml#12670 reflecting broader discussion about balancing stability with faster feature delivery
  • Platform support expansion with DragonFly BSD (ocaml/ocaml#14431) and Haiku OS (ocaml/ocaml#14138) native backends being enabled

    • Multicore

    Light holiday week with scheduler fairness work in Picos and API pattern discussions in Eio

    New Features

  • Improved comment formatting in picos_mux_thread.ml for better readability of signal handler documentation in ocaml-multicore/picos (ocaml-multicore/picos#380)

    • Activity

  • Vesa Karvonen opened draft PR for fair fifo-thread scheduler in ocaml-multicore/picos implementing weakly fair scheduling using effects and system threads to prevent infinite loops from blocking other fibers (ocaml-multicore/picos#379)
  • Multififo optimizations draft PR opened in ocaml-multicore/picos tweaking the implementation for better performance (ocaml-multicore/picos#381)
  • Volker Diels-Grabsch opened issue in ocaml-multicore/eio proposing Exn.with_context helper to reduce exception handling boilerplate (ocaml-multicore/eio#825), closed after Thomas Leonard explained backtrace preservation tradeoffs
  • Nested Fiber.any race condition issue in ocaml-multicore/eio reported by Adam Cholewiński was closed (ocaml-multicore/eio#805) following the merge of earlier PR that prioritizes returning fiber values over quick cancellation (ocaml-multicore/eio#806)
  • Volker Diels-Grabsch commented on io_uring security discussion in ocaml-multicore/eio about test suite compatibility issues with ZFS filesystems (ocaml-multicore/eio#797)

    • Notable Discussions

  • Exception context helper debate in ocaml-multicore/eio#825 where Volker Diels-Grabsch proposed Exn.with_context to reduce try-catch boilerplate, and Thomas Leonard explained the backtrace preservation tradeoff that makes the manual pattern necessary
  • Fiber.any cancellation semantics clarified in ocaml-multicore/eio#805 where nested fiber behavior was initially unexpected by Adam Cholewiński, resolved by earlier changes in ocaml-multicore/eio#806 that improved value return prioritization
  • Scheduler fairness development in ocaml-multicore/picos with draft PR addressing fiber starvation scenarios through weakly fair scheduling (ocaml-multicore/picos#379)

    • Emerging Trends

  • Scheduler fairness guarantees receiving focused attention in ocaml-multicore/picos with new fair fifo-thread scheduler implementation to prevent fiber starvation (ocaml-multicore/picos#379)
  • API design discussions in ocaml-multicore/eio exploring the tradeoffs between ergonomics and runtime behavior, particularly around exception handling patterns (ocaml-multicore/eio#825) and fiber cancellation semantics (ocaml-multicore/eio#805)
  • Continued performance tuning of core data structures with multififo optimizations in ocaml-multicore/picos (ocaml-multicore/picos#381)
entry.summary: Holiday week with String module expansion, jkind error fixes, Dune 3.22 released, 11 new packages added

entry.title: Week 51, 2025: Four releases delivered including LSP 1.25.0, Merlin 5.6.1 and 4.7.1, Dune 3.21.0 alpha 4, with Windows improvements and syntax debates
entry.content:
Weekly Summary

New Features

  • OCaml Tools LSP 1.25.0 released with three custom requests: ocamllsp/typeExpression for querying expression types, ocamllsp/locate for searching identifiers with optional prefix, and ocamllsp/phrase for navigating top-level definitions, plus .mlx file support and configurable code-lens by Xavier Van de Woestyne in ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1576
  • OCaml Tools Merlin 5.6.1-504 released with C code fixes, signature help improvements, completion for inlined record labels, buffer indexing optimizations, and short-paths performance enhancements in ocaml/merlin
  • OCaml Tools Merlin 4.7.1-413 emergency release fixing OCaml 4.13.1 build failures despite EOL status, supporting CodeSignal testing infrastructure by Ulysse in ocaml/merlin#2016 and ocaml/merlin#2018
  • OCaml Tools Dune 3.21.0~alpha4 released with fixes for include_subdirs qualified module resolution, improved error messages for invalid version formats, horizontal scrolling in TUI, and conflict marker detection in cram tests in ocaml/dune
  • OCaml Core Relocatable OCaml installations now supported through generated opam .install file and relocation support script, enabling OCaml to be moved after installation by David Allsopp in ocaml/ocaml#14246
  • OCaml Core Native Windows concurrency primitives replace winpthreads dependency with direct WinAPI implementation, removing external dependency and improving Windows platform support by David Allsopp in ocaml/ocaml#13416
  • OCaml Core Thread-safe POSIX functions adopted in libunix using getgrnam_r, getgrgid_r, getpwnam_r, getpwuid_r, gmtime_r, localtime_r, and getlogin_r for improved thread safety by Antonin Décimo in ocaml/ocaml#13700
  • OCaml Core Spawned domains inherit backtrace settings from parent domain, improving debugging experience across domain boundaries by Nathan Taylor in ocaml/ocaml#14416
  • OCaml Core Fixed packed modules on case-insensitive filesystems (macOS) by rewriting pack prefixes to use appropriate separators in ocaml/ocaml#14417
  • OCaml Core Improved thread naming on Windows with fixed SetThreadDescription detection on 32-bit platforms, enabling Thread.set_current_thread_name functionality in ocaml/ocaml#14423
  • OCaml Core Enhanced Dynarray type safety using opaque abstract type for with_dummy, future-proofing against compiler optimizations in ocaml/ocaml#14084
  • OxCaml New debugging flags including -dfexpr-after to dump fexpr representation after specific passes, -locs/-no-locs for location tracking control, and -dprofile-output for profiling output control in oxcaml/oxcaml and oxcaml/merlin
  • OxCaml Unboxed types expansion with bool# type for better performance in layout polymorphism by Nailen Matschke in oxcaml/oxcaml#5166 and abstract unit# type with void kind by Ryan Tjoa in oxcaml/oxcaml#5151
  • OxCaml Extended stdlib type annotations across Array and Bigarray modules with layout modality constraints (value_or_null mod separable) in oxcaml/oxcaml
  • OCaml Ecosystem menhir-lsp 0.0.1 - Language server protocol implementation for Menhir parser generator by Eike Plack in ocaml/opam-repository#29108
  • OCaml Ecosystem regl 0.1.0 - ReasonML bindings for WebGL providing functional graphics programming interface by Yiming Xiang in ocaml/opam-repository#29120
  • OCaml Ecosystem Security team membership tracking implemented with former members section on ocaml.org by Hannes Mehnert in ocaml/ocaml.org#3427
  • OCaml Ecosystem OCaml Planet feed expansion with Terrateam Blog added as content source by @joshpollara in ocaml/ocaml.org#3424

    • Group Activity Summaries

    OCaml Ecosystem

    Two new packages, coordinated multi-package releases, DkML project sunset, and ocaml.org content expansion

    New Features

  • New package: menhir-lsp 0.0.1 - Language server protocol implementation for Menhir parser generator by Eike Plack (ocaml/opam-repository#29108)

  • Configure script improvements merged including autoconf test caching for faster re-configuration (ocaml/ocaml#13705), Windows-specific fixes (ocaml/ocaml#13711), and unnecessary header guards removal (ocaml/ocaml#14426)
  • Labeled tuple projection syntax debate continued on ocaml/RFCs#57 with Alistair and Gabriel Scherer discussing whether e.l or e.~l is more appropriate, ultimately favoring e.~l to avoid confusing error messages when type information is ambiguous, though Alistair discovered e.~l conflicts with MetaOCaml's escape syntax
  • Runtime system code clarity improved through barrier and spin macro refactoring using delayed expansion and C99 booleans (ocaml/ocaml#13224)
  • Testsuite robustness enhanced with CRLF checkout fixes affecting multiple test files including native-debugger, mnemonics, wc, and ocamltex (ocaml/ocaml#14428)
  • Type checker refactoring merged by Samuel Vivien moving match outside if statement in typetexp for cleaner code (ocaml/ocaml#14422)
  • CI infrastructure updates merged including Cygwin version unpinning on AppVeyor (ocaml/ocaml#14420) and opam testing in CI (ocaml/ocaml#14246)
  • C++ compatibility fix for atomic_int missing std:: namespace in unixsupport.h merged (ocaml/ocaml#14429)

    • Notable Discussions

  • Unmarshaling memory issue in OCaml 5.x reported by Török Edwin where unmarshaling loops can fail with out-of-memory errors, with Gabriel Scherer proposing caml_request_major_slice fix for GC pacing (ocaml/ocaml#14419)
  • Labeled tuple projection syntax sparked detailed debate in ocaml/RFCs#57 weighing e.l (consistent with record syntax and type-disambiguated features) against e.~l (clearer errors but conflicts with MetaOCaml), with Gabriel Scherer prioritizing error message quality for beginners using nominal records over convenience for labeled tuple users
  • Module signature type inference discussion by @Alex1005a requesting ability to omit type declarations in structures when present in signatures, with Florian Angeletti suggesting _ placeholder approach for importing declarations (ocaml/ocaml#14418)
  • Int.repr function feature request by Nathanaëlle Courant for Patricia tree operations, requesting function to expose tagged integer representation as nativeint for bitwise operations efficiency (ocaml/ocaml#13685)
  • Windows socketpair TOCTOU race investigation by Nathan Taylor identifying possible time-of-check-time-of-use vulnerability in socketpair implementation with temp file deletion (ocaml/ocaml#14372)
  • Error message quality concerns raised by Gabriel Scherer in ocaml/RFCs#57 regarding how e.l syntax defaults to record projection when type information is unknown, potentially creating confusing errors that mention advanced OCaml features unfamiliar to users
  • Feature complexity perception discussed with Andrey Popp noting labeled tuples feel similar in complexity to labeled arguments based on OCaml 5.4 usage experience, though Alistair and Gabriel Scherer agreed they are less commonly used than nominal records (ocaml/RFCs#57)

    • Emerging Trends

  • Windows platform improvements concentrated this week with removal of winpthreads dependency (ocaml/ocaml#13416), native WinAPI concurrency primitives, configure fixes (ocaml/ocaml#13711), thread naming fixes (ocaml/ocaml#14423), and CRLF testsuite handling (ocaml/ocaml#14428), representing renewed focus on Windows ecosystem quality
  • Long-standing PR completions with several PRs from mid-2024 finally merged this week, indicating backlog reduction and completion of previously-started infrastructure work in ocaml/ocaml
  • Build system modernization through dependency computation optimizations (ocaml/ocaml#14424), configure script caching (ocaml/ocaml#13705), and CI infrastructure updates suggesting ongoing effort to improve developer experience
  • Thread safety focus across both Windows (native primitives in ocaml/ocaml#13416) and Unix (POSIX thread-safe functions in ocaml/ocaml#13700) platforms indicating attention to multicore OCaml requirements
  • Type system enhancements with polymorphic annotations proposal (ocaml/ocaml#14427), type checker refactoring (ocaml/ocaml#14422, ocaml/ocaml#14425), and labeled tuple syntax refinement (ocaml/RFCs#57) showing continued evolution of OCaml's type system capabilities

    • Multicore

    Picos scheduler work advances with draft PR for weakly fair FIFO-thread implementation

    Overview

  • Week 51 saw minimal activity across the multicore group with only the ocaml-multicore/picos repository showing development work
  • A single draft PR was opened exploring scheduler fairness guarantees through a hybrid effects and system threads approach
  • The remaining 8 repositories (eio, domainslib, ocaml-uring, meio, saturn, eio-trace, kcas, ocaml-iomux) had no recorded activity during this period

    • Activity

  • Vesa Karvonen opened draft ocaml-multicore/picos#379 for weakly fair FIFO-thread scheduler that combines effects and system threads to guarantee no fiber can starve others, even with infinite loops that never perform effects (341 additions across 8 files)

    • Emerging Trends

  • Focus on scheduler fairness in ocaml-multicore/picos with exploration of hybrid approaches combining effects-based and system thread-based scheduling via ocaml-multicore/picos#379
  • Quiet period across the broader multicore ecosystem during the holiday week, with most repositories showing no commits, PRs, or issues
entry.summary: Four releases delivered including LSP 1.25.0, Merlin 5.6.1 and 4.7.1, Dune 3.21.0 alpha 4, with Windows improvements and syntax debates

entry.title: Week 50, 2025: Relocatable OCaml merged with runtime search, transparent module ascription RFC approved, Dune 3.21.0 alpha releases, ecosystem governance discussions
entry.content:
Weekly Summary

New Features

  • OCaml Core Relocatable OCaml implementation by David Allsopp allows runtime and compilers to locate the Standard Library relative to binary installation locations via new --with-relative-libdir configure option, removing embedded absolute paths in ocaml/ocaml#14244, with corresponding RFC merged in ocaml/RFCs#53
  • OCaml Core Runtime IDs and filename mangling system introduced for harmonious coexistence of different runtime configurations and versions on a single system, with mangled names for ocamlrun variants, DLL runtimes, and stub libraries in ocaml/ocaml#14245
  • OCaml Core Runtime search capabilities for bytecode executables via new -runtime-search flag (disable/fallback/enable modes) and -launch-method option (exe/sh/custom interpreter path) allowing flexible interpreter location in ocaml/ocaml#14245
  • OCaml Core Domain backtrace inheritance feature ensures spawned domains record backtraces when parent domain has enabled it, implemented by Nathan Taylor in ocaml/ocaml#14416
  • OCaml Core Transparent ascription and static aliases RFC merged in ocaml/RFCs#54 introducing transparent signatures module X : (= P :> S) to preserve module identities and type equalities, splitting module aliases into static (absent, used with -no-alias-deps) and dynamic (present) variants, enabling transparent ascription for functor parameters and applications
  • OCaml Core Unix socket address length handling improvements by Anarchos enhance Haiku compatibility in ocaml/ocaml#14406
  • OCaml Core New compiler flags including -set-runtime-default for overriding default Standard Library location in ocaml/ocaml#14244 and -dllib-suffixed for recording mangled C shared library names with Runtime ID in ocaml/ocaml#14245
  • OCaml Core Enhanced ocamlobjinfo now displays runtime invoked by bytecode executables through RNTM section analysis or shebang line parsing in ocaml/ocaml#14245
  • OCaml Core CMT file stripping now always removes typing environment with removal of OCAML_BINANNOT_WITHENV environment variable by Florian Angeletti in ocaml/ocaml#14373
  • OCaml Core Breaking change removing support for let rec (module M : S) = e1 in e2 syntax by Alistair in ocaml/ocaml#14388
  • OCaml Tools Dune 3.21.0~alpha3 released on 2025-12-11 with fixes for include_subdirs qualified module resolution, improved error messages for invalid version formats, horizontal scrolling in TUI, conflict marker detection in cram tests, and improved variable expansion in ocaml/dune#3.21.0_alpha3
  • OCaml Tools Dune 3.21.0~alpha2 released on 2025-12-08 with OxCaml library_parameter stanza, dune describe tests command, %{cmt:...} variables, unused-libs alias, and Rocq language support in ocaml/dune#3.21.0_alpha2
  • OCaml Tools Dune 3.21.0~alpha1 released on 2025-12-08 marking the start of the 3.21 alpha series in ocaml/dune#3.21.0_alpha1
  • OCaml Ecosystem Windows CI improvements in ocaml/opam-repository including clarified build/host/target environments in ocaml/opam-repository#29036, disabled workflow on merge pushes to avoid duplicate runs in ocaml/opam-repository#29078 and ocaml/opam-repository#29086, and better MSYS2 documentation by Antonin Décimo and Jan Midtgaard
  • OCaml Ecosystem Compiler metadata automation in ocaml/opam-repository with OCaml compiler package metadata now retrieved directly from ocaml/ocaml repository in ocaml/opam-repository#29082 and updated URLs for extra-source files in ocaml/opam-repository#29080 by David Allsopp
  • OCaml Ecosystem Melange 6.0.1 released in ocaml/opam-repository with constraint update requiring OCaml > 5.1.1 (commit bbafe5e0) alongside melange-testing-library 0.2.0 in ocaml/opam-repository#29030, melange-webapi 0.22.0 in ocaml/opam-repository#29028, and melange-jest 0.2.0 in ocaml/opam-repository#29029 by Antonio Nuno Monteiro
  • OCaml Ecosystem Lwt 6.0.0-beta01 merged to ocaml/opam-repository with 4 packages from ocsigen/lwt in ocaml/opam-repository#28894 by Raphaël Proust
  • OCaml Ecosystem LexiFi job listing refreshed on ocaml/ocaml.org with updated publication date (2025-12-10) and clarified location (Paris, France) by Nicolás Ojeda Bär in ocaml/ocaml.org#3413

    • Group Activity Summaries

    OCaml Ecosystem

    Repository governance discussions, Melange 6.0.1, Lwt 6.0 beta, Windows CI improvements, and community content growth

    New Features

  • Windows CI improvements in ocaml/opam-repository including clarified build/host/target environments (ocaml/opam-repository#29036), disabled workflow on merge pushes to avoid duplicate runs (ocaml/opam-repository#29078, ocaml/opam-repository#29086), and better MSYS2 documentation by Antonin Décimo and Jan Midtgaard
  • Compiler metadata automation in ocaml/opam-repository with OCaml compiler package metadata now retrieved directly from ocaml/ocaml repository (ocaml/opam-repository#29082) and updated URLs for extra-source files (ocaml/opam-repository#29080) by David Allsopp
  • Melange 6.0.1 released in ocaml/opam-repository with constraint update requiring OCaml > 5.1.1 (bbafe5e0) alongside melange-testing-library 0.2.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29030), melange-webapi 0.22.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29028), and melange-jest 0.2.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29029) by Antonio Nuno Monteiro
  • Lwt 6.0.0-beta01 merged to ocaml/opam-repository with 4 packages from ocsigen/lwt (ocaml/opam-repository#28894) by Raphaël Proust
  • LexiFi job listing refreshed on ocaml/ocaml.org with updated publication date (2025-12-10) and clarified location (Paris, France) by Nicolás Ojeda Bär (ocaml/ocaml.org#3413)
  • Sanitizer configuration fixes in ocaml/opam-repository correcting mismatched descriptions of leak and address sanitizers in package metadata (ocaml/opam-repository#29091) by Antonin Décimo
  • Reason toolchain in ocaml/opam-repository now supports cmdliner 2.x (ocaml/opam-repository#29090) enabling compatibility with newer command-line parsing library

    • Overview

  • ocaml/opam-repository merged 50 PRs with repository governance discussions on archival policies (ocaml/opam-repository#29060, ocaml/opam-repository#29061, ocaml/opam-repository#29058), infrastructure improvements including Windows CI (ocaml/opam-repository#29036, ocaml/opam-repository#29078, ocaml/opam-repository#29086) and compiler automation (ocaml/opam-repository#29082, ocaml/opam-repository#29080), and releases including Melange ecosystem updates (ocaml/opam-repository#29001, ocaml/opam-repository#29028, ocaml/opam-repository#29029, ocaml/opam-repository#29030), Lwt 6.0 beta (ocaml/opam-repository#28894), and new packages including serialport, cairn, kot, and mazeppa
  • ocaml/ocaml.org merged 4 PRs with automated content additions bringing 19 new blog posts including the complete Advent of OCaml 2025 series (ocaml/ocaml.org#3412, ocaml/ocaml.org#3414, ocaml/ocaml.org#3415), OCaml Weekly News, technical articles on SVG rendering, email search webapps, Albatross, OCamlNvim, and Advent of Code, plus an updated LexiFi job listing (ocaml/ocaml.org#3413)

    • Activity

  • Package releases across ocaml/opam-repository including new packages serialport 0.1 for serial communication (ocaml/opam-repository#29087), cairn 2.1 graph library (ocaml/opam-repository#29088), kot 20251212 parser toolkit (ocaml/opam-repository#29081) by François Pottier, and mazeppa 0.7.2 (ocaml/opam-repository#29026)
  • Package updates in ocaml/opam-repository including elpi 3.4.4 and 3.4.5 (ocaml/opam-repository#29066, ocaml/opam-repository#29076) by Enrico Tassi, json-data-encoding 1.1.1 with 3 packages (ocaml/opam-repository#29067), purl 1.0.0 URL parser (ocaml/opam-repository#29065) by Hannes Mehnert, prometheus 1.3 with 2 packages (ocaml/opam-repository#29035), charrua 3.0.0 DHCP library with 4 packages (ocaml/opam-repository#29044), Frama-C 32.0-Germanium (ocaml/opam-repository#29023), and htmlofjsx 0.0.7 (ocaml/opam-repository#29032)
  • Newly opened PRs in ocaml/opam-repository include OCaml 5.5 compiler option synchronization (ocaml/opam-repository#29089) by Kate, atd toolchain 3.0.1 release with 10 packages (ocaml/opam-repository#29055), Codex semantics library 1.0-rc4 (ocaml/opam-repository#29092), secp256k1 0.5.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29095), and relocatable OCaml updates for 5.5 packages (ocaml/opam-repository#29085) by David Allsopp
  • Build tooling updates in ocaml/opam-repository with tyre 1.0 reverse dependency fixes (ocaml/opam-repository#29037), GitHub Actions bumps for actions/cache 4 to 5 (ocaml/opam-repository#29079) and actions/github-script 7 to 8 (ocaml/opam-repository#29062), and github-unix compatibility marking for yojson 3.0.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29064)
  • Maintenance work in ocaml/opam-repository including x-maintenance-intent field syntax fixes (ocaml/opam-repository#29034) and additions to mirage-kv (ocaml/opam-repository#29043) and ssh-agent (ocaml/opam-repository#29038) by Hannes Mehnert, plus Jane Street package upperbound fixes (ocaml/opam-repository#29040)
  • Community content additions to ocaml/ocaml.org through automated scraping runs brought 19 new blog posts including the complete Advent of OCaml 2025 series with 13 posts covering Base32 Crockford, JSON Feed, XDG filesystem paths, ClaudeIO, BytesRW-Eio adapters, YAML 1.2, JSON/YAML conversion, Sortal contacts CLI, Bonsai TUI, and Mosaic TUI (ocaml/ocaml.org#3412, ocaml/ocaml.org#3414, ocaml/ocaml.org#3415), plus OCaml Weekly News, technical articles on SVG rendering and email search webapps as unikernels, Albatross server management, OCamlNvim LSP integration, OCaml November roundup, and Advent of Code 2025

    • Notable Discussions

  • Package archival policy discussions in ocaml/opam-repository including default value for x-maintenance-intent field (ocaml/opam-repository#29060) resolved in favor of (latest) with proposed implementation (ocaml/opam-repository#29074) by Hannes Mehnert, immutability policy proposal (ocaml/opam-repository#29061) suggesting stricter rules (ocaml/opam-repository#29072), deprecation warnings support for archival-eligible packages (ocaml/opam-repository#29071), and draft archival process scheduled for January 1st 2026 merge (ocaml/opam-repository#29058)
  • OCaml compiler support discussion (ocaml/opam-repository#29059) by Hannes Mehnert regarding supported compiler versions and maintenance policies in ocaml/opam-repository
  • Package preservation debate (ocaml/opam-repository#28065) in ocaml/opam-repository requesting retention of old Dune versions, ongoing discussion about archival policies
  • Windows installation issues reported (ocaml/opam-repository#29093) in ocaml/opam-repository following ocaml/ocaml.org installation instructions with multiple warnings on Windows 11 Home
  • Documentation bug reported (ocaml/ocaml.org#3416) by Ali Caglayan regarding broken documentation links on the versions page in ocaml/ocaml.org

    • Emerging Trends

  • Repository maintenance governance initiatives in ocaml/opam-repository gaining momentum with multiple policy proposals including stricter immutability rules (ocaml/opam-repository#29072), standardized maintenance-intent fields (ocaml/opam-repository#29060, ocaml/opam-repository#29074), and scheduled archival processes (ocaml/opam-repository#29058), reflecting community focus on long-term sustainability
  • Melange ecosystem maturation with coordinated releases across multiple packages in ocaml/opam-repository (melange 6.0.1, melange-webapi 0.22.0, melange-testing-library 0.2.0, melange-jest 0.2.0) by Antonio Nuno Monteiro (ocaml/opam-repository#29001, ocaml/opam-repository#29028, ocaml/opam-repository#29029, ocaml/opam-repository#29030), demonstrating active JavaScript backend development
  • OCaml compiler package automation in ocaml/opam-repository with infrastructure improvements to retrieve metadata and sources directly from upstream ocaml/ocaml repository (ocaml/opam-repository#29082, ocaml/opam-repository#29080), reducing manual maintenance burden
  • Windows platform improvements with enhanced CI workflows in ocaml/opam-repository, clearer documentation, and better cross-platform testing by Antonin Décimo and Jan Midtgaard (ocaml/opam-repository#29036, ocaml/opam-repository#29078, ocaml/opam-repository#29086), addressing Windows-specific build concerns
  • Community content growth through automated blog post aggregation in ocaml/ocaml.org with 19 new posts including Advent of OCaml 2025 series (ocaml/ocaml.org#3412, ocaml/ocaml.org#3414, ocaml/ocaml.org#3415), showcasing seasonal community engagement and educational content
  • Parser and formal verification tooling updates in ocaml/opam-repository including elpi releases (ocaml/opam-repository#29066, ocaml/opam-repository#29076), kot parser toolkit (ocaml/opam-repository#29081), Frama-C 32.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#29023), and Codex semantics library (ocaml/opam-repository#29092), showing continued investment in language tooling infrastructure

    • OCaml Tools

    OxCaml

    OCaml Core

    Relocatable OCaml merged with runtime search and module system RFC approved

    New Features

  • Relocatable OCaml implementation by David Allsopp allows runtime and compilers to locate the Standard Library relative to binary installation locations via new --with-relative-libdir configure option, removing embedded absolute paths in ocaml/ocaml#14244, with corresponding RFC merged in ocaml/RFCs#53
  • Runtime IDs and filename mangling system introduced for harmonious coexistence of different runtime configurations and versions on a single system, with mangled names for ocamlrun variants, DLL runtimes, and stub libraries in ocaml/ocaml#14245
  • Runtime search capabilities for bytecode executables via new -runtime-search flag (disable/fallback/enable modes) and -launch-method option (exe/sh/custom interpreter path) allowing flexible interpreter location in ocaml/ocaml#14245
  • Domain backtrace inheritance feature ensures spawned domains record backtraces when parent domain has enabled it, implemented by Nathan Taylor in ocaml/ocaml#14416
  • Transparent ascription and static aliases RFC merged in ocaml/RFCs#54 introducing transparent signatures module X : (= P :> S) to preserve module identities and type equalities, splitting module aliases into static (absent, used with -no-alias-deps) and dynamic (present) variants, enabling transparent ascription for functor parameters and applications
  • Unix socket address length handling improvements by Anarchos enhance Haiku compatibility in ocaml/ocaml#14406
  • New compiler flags including -set-runtime-default for overriding default Standard Library location (ocaml/ocaml#14244) and -dllib-suffixed for recording mangled C shared library names with Runtime ID (ocaml/ocaml#14245)
  • Enhanced ocamlobjinfo now displays runtime invoked by bytecode executables through RNTM section analysis or shebang line parsing in ocaml/ocaml#14245
  • CMT file stripping now always removes typing environment with removal of OCAML_BINANNOT_WITHENV environment variable by Florian Angeletti in ocaml/ocaml#14373
  • Breaking change removing support for let rec (module M : S) = e1 in e2 syntax by Alistair in ocaml/ocaml#14388

    • Overview

  • David Allsopp delivered the relocatable OCaml implementation in ocaml/ocaml#14244 and ocaml/ocaml#14245, with RFC approved in ocaml/RFCs#53, enabling flexible compiler installations and runtime search capabilities
  • Module system advances with Clément Blaudeau's transparent ascription RFC merged in ocaml/RFCs#54, introducing static aliases and transparent signatures preserving type equalities
  • Runtime improvements delivered including domain backtrace inheritance by Nathan Taylor in ocaml/ocaml#14416 and Unix socket enhancements for Haiku compatibility in ocaml/ocaml#14406
  • Type system refinement continues with removal of experimental let rec module syntax in ocaml/ocaml#14388 and CMT environment stripping in ocaml/ocaml#14373
  • New proposals include atomic arrays implementation in ocaml/ocaml#14380, concurrent blocking lazy evaluation in ocaml/ocaml#14393, and named GC parameters in ocaml/ocaml#14367

    • Activity

  • Relocatable OCaml continuation work progressing with ocaml/ocaml#14246 targeting opam integration generating 19 comments of active discussion, and source archive shrinking in ocaml/ocaml#14152 remaining open
  • Standard Library proposals under review including atomic arrays by @clef-men in ocaml/ocaml#14380, concurrent blocking lazy evaluation by Gabriel Scherer in ocaml/ocaml#14393, and named GC parameters by Stephen Dolan in ocaml/ocaml#14367
  • Tooling improvements advancing with Merlin typing recovery by Xavier Van de Woestyne in ocaml/ocaml#14241 and Dune build system refinements by Ali Caglayan in ocaml/ocaml#14408
  • Platform compatibility work continuing with MSVC AddressSanitizer progress by Antonin Décimo in ocaml/ocaml#14414 and Windows locale settings from 2021 still open in ocaml/ocaml#10258
  • Type system initiatives progressing with long-standing modular explicits work dating to July 2024 in ocaml/ocaml#13275 and always-keep-names proposal in ocaml/ocaml#13328
  • Documentation and testing enhanced through AsciiDoc improvements in ocaml/ocaml#14392, relaxed value restriction explanation in ocaml/ocaml#14407, and test refactoring in ocaml/ocaml#14409

    • Notable Discussions

  • Unix socket address length calculation discussed by Anarchos regarding improved handling and Haiku compatibility in ocaml/ocaml#14406 with related discussion thread in ocaml/ocaml#14401
  • __FUNCTION__ behavior actively discussed with 18 comments on ocaml/ocaml#14412 regarding documentation of functionality for non-function contexts, prompted by issue ocaml/ocaml#14376
  • Relocatable OCaml to opam integration generating 19 comments on ocaml/ocaml#14246 discussing deployment and distribution strategies for package management

    • Emerging Trends

  • RFC process maturation visible through two RFCs merged this week after thorough review, implementation validation (ocaml/RFCs#53), and stakeholder consensus (ocaml/RFCs#54), demonstrating formal design validation before implementation
  • Infrastructure modernization focus with relocatable installation architecture through comprehensive runtime search capabilities, relative library paths, and mangled runtime IDs enabling flexible deployment scenarios across platforms in ocaml/ocaml#14244 and ocaml/ocaml#14245
  • Platform compatibility emphasis visible through Windows improvements (MSVC AddressSanitizer ocaml/ocaml#14414, locale settings ocaml/ocaml#10258), Haiku Unix socket support (ocaml/ocaml#14406), and cross-platform bytecode launching mechanisms
  • Module system evolution continues with formal RFC process validating designs that enhance expressiveness while maintaining soundness, as seen with transparent ascription in ocaml/RFCs#54 building on prior work around module aliases and type-level sharing
  • Runtime system enhancements addressing domain behavior (backtrace inheritance ocaml/ocaml#14416), memory management (shared heap free lists ocaml/ocaml#13616), and dynamic loading (runtime IDs ocaml/ocaml#14245)
  • Standard library evolution discussions around new primitives (atomic arrays ocaml/ocaml#14380, concurrent lazy ocaml/ocaml#14393) and API refinements (named GC parameters ocaml/ocaml#14367)
  • Type system refinement continuing with removal of experimental features (let rec module ocaml/ocaml#14388), ongoing modular explicits work (ocaml/ocaml#13275), and typing recovery for tooling (ocaml/ocaml#14241)

    • Multicore

entry.title: Week 49, 2025: Dune 3.21.0-alpha0 released; core compiler advances with let expressions and RFC discussions; OxCaml delivers extensive optimizations
entry.content:
Weekly Summary

New Features

  • OCaml Tools Dune 3.21.0-alpha0 released by Shon Feder delivering the first alpha of the 3.21 series with package management maturation and developer experience improvements ocaml/dune#3.21.0_alpha0
  • OCaml Core Arbitrary structure items in let expressions now supported in ocaml/ocaml, enabling let module rec, let exception, let open, let type, and let class syntax within expression contexts ocaml/ocaml#14040
  • OCaml Core Toplevel -init flag compatibility with -e flag fixed, allowing initialization files to load properly during script execution ocaml/ocaml#14190
  • OCaml Core Iarray documentation expansion with examples for constructing immutable arrays from array literals and additions to core library documentation ocaml/ocaml#14397
  • OxCaml Immutable arrays of unboxed products in oxcaml/oxcaml enable creation of iarrays containing unboxed product types, expanding support for layout-polymorphic immutable collections oxcaml/oxcaml#5026
  • OxCaml Arrays of GC-ignorable values in oxcaml/oxcaml introduce Pgcignorableaddrarray kind for arrays containing pointers that do not need GC scanning, improving memory efficiency oxcaml/oxcaml#4963
  • OxCaml AVX2 gather intrinsics in oxcaml/oxcaml add support for vectorized memory gather operations with semi-new addressing mode reg + vec[..] * scale + displ, enabling efficient scattered memory access patterns oxcaml/oxcaml#5040
  • OxCaml Profiling output control in oxcaml/oxcaml via new -dprofile-output flag allows redirecting profiling data to specific files instead of stdout oxcaml/oxcaml#5074
  • OxCaml Debug metrics file control in oxcaml/oxcaml through -ddwarf-metrics-output-file flag enables custom output location for DWARF debug metrics oxcaml/oxcaml#5074
  • OxCaml No-locs compiler flag in oxcaml/oxcaml adds -no-locs option for suppressing location information in output, useful for deterministic test outputs oxcaml/oxcaml#5072
  • OxCaml Type hovers for jkind abbreviations in oxcaml/merlin enable developers to see expanded forms when hovering over jkind annotations, including support for non-value kinds like bit32 and void, forall annotations, and type annotations oxcaml/merlin#200
  • OxCaml Expanded compiler flag support in oxcaml/merlin adds ~30 previously unrecognized OCaml compiler flags to Merlin's ignored flags list, preventing errors when Merlin is invoked with the same flags as the compiler oxcaml/merlin#202
  • OCaml Ecosystem rizzo 0.1.0 - randomness testing library by @tjobi ocaml/opam-repository#29013
  • OCaml Ecosystem alice 0.2.0 - library for creating turn-based games by Stephen Sherratt ocaml/opam-repository#29009
  • OCaml Ecosystem xdge 1.0.0 - XDG Base Directory specification support by Anil Madhavapeddy ocaml/opam-repository#28998
  • OCaml Ecosystem otp 0.2.2 - one-time password library by A.G. ocaml/opam-repository#29004
  • OCaml Ecosystem checked_oint 1.0.1 - checked OCaml integer operations by @hirrolot ocaml/opam-repository#29003
  • OCaml Ecosystem mazeppa 0.7.2 - modern supercompiler for call-by-value functional languages by @hirrolot ocaml/opam-repository#29026

    • Group Activity Summaries

    OCaml Ecosystem

    Package ecosystem expansion with 6 new packages and infrastructure documentation improvements

    New Features

  • rizzo 0.1.0 - randomness testing library by @tjobi (ocaml/opam-repository#29013)
  • alice 0.2.0 - library for creating turn-based games by Stephen Sherratt (ocaml/opam-repository#29009)
  • xdge 1.0.0 - XDG Base Directory specification support by Anil Madhavapeddy (ocaml/opam-repository#28998)
  • otp 0.2.2 - one-time password library by A.G. (ocaml/opam-repository#29004)
  • checked_oint 1.0.1 - checked OCaml integer operations by @hirrolot (ocaml/opam-repository#29003)

  • Language syntax expansion evident across multiple efforts including merged arbitrary structure items in let expressions (ocaml/ocaml#14040), proposed val declarations RFC (ocaml/RFCs#59), and removal of let rec (module M) (ocaml/ocaml#14388)
  • Platform portability focus with contributions targeting BSD systems (ocaml/ocaml#14398), Haiku OS (ocaml/ocaml#14138, ocaml/ocaml#14406), Android Termux (ocaml/ocaml#14382), and Windows (ocaml/ocaml#13711)
  • Documentation quality improvements across multiple PRs including Iarray examples (ocaml/ocaml#14397), AsciiDoc enhancements (ocaml/ocaml#14392), man page corrections (ocaml/ocaml#14400), and value restriction explanations (ocaml/ocaml#14407)
  • Compiler tooling evolution with work on relocatable OCaml (ocaml/ocaml#14244), Dune integration improvements (ocaml/ocaml#14408), and bytecode optimization for WebAssembly targets (ocaml/ocaml#13438)

    • Multicore
entry.summary: Dune 3.21.0-alpha0 released; core compiler advances with let expressions and RFC discussions; OxCaml delivers extensive optimizations

entry.title: Week 48, 2025: opam 2.5.0 released, atomic record fields merged, String module enhanced, compiler backend optimized with 10 x86 improvements
entry.content:
Weekly Summary

New Features

  • OCaml Ecosystem opam 2.5.0 package manager released with 8 component packages (opam-client, opam-core, opam-devel, opam-format, opam-installer, opam-repository, opam-solver, opam-state) by Kate in ocaml/opam-repository#28978, featuring performance optimizations in version comparison and cache loading ocaml/opam#6515, improved error handling for opam init --config ocaml/opam#5979, and enhanced repository handling ocaml/opam#6813
  • OCaml Core String predicate functions added including String.{drop,take,cut}_{first,last}_while for predicate-based string splitting in both String and StringLabels modules by Daniel Bünzli in ocaml/ocaml#14362
  • OCaml Core Atomic record fields implementation enabling lock-free concurrent programming with per-field atomic operations by @clef-men in ocaml/ocaml#13404
  • OCaml Core Relocatable OCaml installations with explicit relative paths in ld.conf where paths like . and .. now resolve relative to the ld.conf directory by David Allsopp in ocaml/ocaml#14243, including multiple ld.conf loading from $OCAMLLIB/ld.conf, $CAMLLIB/ld.conf, and standard_library_default/ld.conf and --with-additional-stublibsdir configure option
  • OCaml Core Native dynlink cleanup to call dlclose on dynamically loaded objects when errors occur, preventing resource leaks by David Allsopp in ocaml/ocaml#14391
  • OCaml Core Debugger error messages enhanced to display specific information about incorrect or missing magic numbers rather than generic errors in ocaml/ocaml#14375
  • OCaml Core External types documentation added with new manual chapter explaining external types for FFI-populated values with examples for predefined types like float, string, and array by Gabriel Scherer in ocaml/ocaml#13994
  • OCaml Core Transparency policy for conflicts of interest added to the OCaml Language Committee governance, requiring members to disclose conflicts when they belong to the same institution as proposal submitters or have financial ties by Florian Angeletti in ocaml/RFCs#55
  • OxCaml Manifest file support via -I-manifest and -H-manifest flags allowing specification of available files directly rather than entire directories in oxcaml/oxcaml#4986
  • OxCaml 128-bit integer arithmetic intrinsics including add_int128, sub_int128, mul_int64 operations compiling to efficient add/adc, sub/sbb, and imul/mul instructions in oxcaml/oxcaml#5025
  • OxCaml BMI/BMI2 intrinsics implementation with POPCNT, LZCNT support and multiple return registers in simdgen in oxcaml/oxcaml#5065
  • OxCaml Jkind hover expansion via Jkind.format_expanded function enabling displaying full expanded forms of jkind types in oxcaml/merlin#201
  • OxCaml SIMD float16 vector types including float16x8, float16x16, and float16x32 variants added to Predef module in oxcaml/merlin#201
  • OxCaml Unboxed elements at module top-level now allowed after fixing cross-module inlining behavior by James Rayman in oxcaml/oxcaml#5064
  • OxCaml Jkind normalization fuel optimization runs out of fuel only once per jkind, reusing fuel cache when normalizing with additional types in oxcaml/oxcaml#5047 and oxcaml/oxcaml#5009
  • OxCaml Eio compatibility fix for eio.1.3+ox with explicit currying function application in eio_mock by Sudha Parimala in oxcaml/opam-repository#24
  • OCaml Tools Rocq Prover build language via (lang rocq) for Rocq 9.0 and later with Coq mode deprecated in ocaml/dune#12035 and ocaml/dune#12793
  • OCaml Tools Dune promotion preview command dune promotion show to preview corrected files before promotion in ocaml/dune#12669
  • OCaml Tools Dune compiler warning defaults changed for language 3.21+ to match OCaml compiler defaults with %{dune-warnings} variable for stricter warnings in ocaml/dune#12766
  • OCaml Tools LSP .merlin fallback automatically using .merlin configuration when no dune-project file exists by David Sancho in ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1563
  • OCaml Ecosystem cmdliner 2.1.0 command-line interface library added by Daniel Bünzli in ocaml/opam-repository#28962
  • OCaml Ecosystem conf-libclang versions 19 and 21 support added using generic configure script by Marcello Seri and Jan Midtgaard in ocaml/opam-repository#28968 and ocaml/opam-repository#28950
  • OCaml Ecosystem Email protocol stack updates from Calascibetta Romain covering SMTP (colombe 0.12.1), MIME (mrmime 0.7.1), DKIM (dkim 0.9.0), DMARC (dmarc 0.0.1), ARC (arc 0.0.1), and SPF (uspf 0.2.0) libraries in ocaml/opam-repository#28992, ocaml/opam-repository#28991, ocaml/opam-repository#28982, ocaml/opam-repository#28995, ocaml/opam-repository#28996, ocaml/opam-repository#28980

    • Group Activity Summaries

    OCaml Ecosystem

    Package ecosystem growth with opam 2.5.0 release, email protocol stack updates, and OCaml 5.4 compatibility work

    New Features

  • opam 2.5.0 package manager released with 8 component packages by Kate (ocaml/opam-repository#28978)
  • cmdliner 2.1.0 command-line interface library added by Daniel Bünzli (ocaml/opam-repository#28962)
  • conf-libclang versions 19 and 21 support added using generic configure script by Marcello Seri and Jan Midtgaard (ocaml/opam-repository#28968, ocaml/opam-repository#28950)
  • OCaml 5.4.0 compatibility bounds added for bogue, why3, and boltzgen packages by Jan Midtgaard (ocaml/opam-repository#28974, ocaml/opam-repository#28973, ocaml/opam-repository#28971)
  • MSys2 support improvements with fixed side-conditions for conf-packages by Jan Midtgaard (ocaml/opam-repository#28944)
  • Cross-platform build tools with opam-build and opam-test 0.3.0 releases by Kate (ocaml/opam-repository#28967)
  • Fixed typos in OCaml.org tutorial documentation for Maps and Sets modules by Rong "Mantle" Bao (ocaml/ocaml.org#3399)
  • Updated CI workflow to use actions/checkout@v6 across all GitHub Actions workflows by Dependabot (ocaml/ocaml.org#3401)

    • Overview

  • Package ecosystem expansion with comprehensive email protocol stack updates from Calascibetta Romain covering SMTP, MIME, DKIM, DMARC, ARC, and SPF libraries (ocaml/opam-repository#28992, ocaml/opam-repository#28991, ocaml/opam-repository#28982, ocaml/opam-repository#28995, ocaml/opam-repository#28980, ocaml/opam-repository#28996)
  • Major tooling releases including opam 2.5.0 by Kate (ocaml/opam-repository#28978) and cmdliner 2.1.0 by Daniel Bünzli (ocaml/opam-repository#28962)
  • OCaml 5.4.0 preparation accelerating with compatibility bounds and dependency fixes by Jan Midtgaard (ocaml/opam-repository#28974, ocaml/opam-repository#28973, ocaml/opam-repository#28971)
  • Melange ecosystem activity with open PRs for Melange 6.0.1, reason 3.17.2, and melange-fetch updates by Antonio Nuno Monteiro and David Sancho (ocaml/opam-repository#29001, ocaml/opam-repository#28999, ocaml/opam-repository#28990)
  • OCaml.org content updates with five new blog posts added to OCaml Planet and tutorial documentation improvements (ocaml/ocaml.org#3400, ocaml/ocaml.org#3402, ocaml/ocaml.org#3403, ocaml/ocaml.org#3404, ocaml/ocaml.org#3399)
  • Cross-platform configuration improvements with MSys2 fixes, new conf-libclang versions, and distribution-specific depext refinements by Jan Midtgaard (ocaml/opam-repository#28944, ocaml/opam-repository#28968, ocaml/opam-repository#28976, ocaml/opam-repository#28989)

    • Activity

  • Newly opened PRs include dns 10.2.3 (13 packages) by Hannes Mehnert, Melange 6.0.1 by Antonio Nuno Monteiro, reason 3.17.2 by Antonio Nuno Monteiro, repr 0.8.0 (4 packages) by Thomas Gazagnaire, raylib/raygui 1.6.0 by Tobias Mock, server-reason-react 0.4.0 and quickjs 0.2.0 by David Sancho
  • Email and network protocol stack saw comprehensive updates from Calascibetta Romain with releases of colombe 0.12.1 for SMTP (ocaml/opam-repository#28992), mrmime 0.7.1 for MIME (ocaml/opam-repository#28991), dkim 0.9.0 for email authentication (ocaml/opam-repository#28982), dmarc 0.0.1 for policy enforcement (ocaml/opam-repository#28995), uspf 0.2.0 for SPF validation (ocaml/opam-repository#28980), arc 0.0.1 for authenticated chains (ocaml/opam-repository#28996)
  • Package ecosystem growth with goblint 2.7.1 static analyzer by Simmo Saan (ocaml/opam-repository#28979), slipshow 0.7.0 presentation tool by Paul-Elliot Anglès d'Auriac (ocaml/opam-repository#28970), ocaml-protoc 4.0 by Simon Cruanes (ocaml/opam-repository#28902), dream-html 3.11.2 by Yawar Amin (ocaml/opam-repository#28954), mirage 4.10.4 by Reynir Björnsson (ocaml/opam-repository#28942)
  • Platform and tooling updates with ocamlmig 5.4-20251020 migration tool (ocaml/opam-repository#28965), ocaml-solo5 1.2.0 unikernel runtime by Hannes Mehnert (ocaml/opam-repository#28964), soupault 5.2.0 static site generator by Daniil Baturin (ocaml/opam-repository#28926)
  • Compatibility and build fixes from Jan Midtgaard including ppxrepr upper bound for ppxirmin (ocaml/opam-repository#28993), conf-libpcre failure messages for Centos 10 and OpenSUSE (ocaml/opam-repository#28989), conf-age epel-release depext for Centos (ocaml/opam-repository#28976), cmdliner 2.0.0 upper bound for runtimeeventtools (ocaml/opam-repository#28972), plus Kate fixing shcaml compatibility (ocaml/opam-repository#28959)
  • OCaml Planet blog aggregation added five new posts throughout the week covering collective knowledge systems, OCaml Weekly News, Jane Street's FPGA Advent challenge, Emacs LSP server integration, and OCaml 5.4 ARM32 support (ocaml/ocaml.org#3400, ocaml/ocaml.org#3402, ocaml/ocaml.org#3403, ocaml/ocaml.org#3404)

    • Notable Discussions

  • Periodic archival run planning discussed by Hannes Mehnert for December snapshot with archival tool run, PR preparation, and testing repository until January deadline (ocaml/opam-repository#28489)
  • rocq-prover versioning confusion raised by Ralf Jung where rocq-prover.9.0.0 package actually installs Rocq 9.1 due to unpinned dependencies (ocaml/opam-repository#28994)
  • CI source fetching failures investigated by Jan Midtgaard for alt-ergo.1.01 and cmdliner.2.0.0 with curl exit code 6 errors on opam-ci workers affecting self-hosted packages (ocaml/opam-repository#28966)
  • Distribution wiki documentation enhancement requested by Jan Midtgaard to add NixOS, Rocky Linux, and Linux Mint distribution entries plus correct Ubuntu os-family value (ocaml/opam-repository#28930)
  • Windows mingw-w64-shims installation issue resolved and closed by Lukasz Stafiniak after intermittent permission errors stopped occurring (ocaml/opam-repository#27717)

    • Emerging Trends

  • Email and authentication protocol stack reaching production maturity with coordinated releases of DKIM, DMARC, ARC, SPF validation, and SMTP/MIME libraries forming comprehensive email infrastructure from Calascibetta Romain (ocaml/opam-repository#28982, ocaml/opam-repository#28995, ocaml/opam-repository#28996, ocaml/opam-repository#28980, ocaml/opam-repository#28992, ocaml/opam-repository#28991)
  • OCaml 5.4.0 ecosystem preparation accelerating with proactive upper bound additions and dependency fixes ensuring smooth transition by Jan Midtgaard (ocaml/opam-repository#28974, ocaml/opam-repository#28973, ocaml/opam-repository#28971)
  • Cross-platform configuration improvements continuing with MSys2 side-condition fixes, new conf-libclang versions supporting LLVM 19 and 21, and distribution-specific depext refinements by Jan Midtgaard and Marcello Seri (ocaml/opam-repository#28944, ocaml/opam-repository#28968, ocaml/opam-repository#28950, ocaml/opam-repository#28976, ocaml/opam-repository#28989)
  • Melange ecosystem growth with new releases of melange-fetch, quickjs bindings, server-reason-react, and upcoming Melange 6.0.1 by Antonio Nuno Monteiro and David Sancho (ocaml/opam-repository#28990, ocaml/opam-repository#29000, ocaml/opam-repository#29006, ocaml/opam-repository#29001)
  • Package maintenance infrastructure discussions around archival process, versioning clarity, and CI reliability improvements reflecting repository maturity (ocaml/opam-repository#28489, ocaml/opam-repository#28994, ocaml/opam-repository#28966)
  • Automated content aggregation maintaining steady flow of community blog posts to OCaml.org Planet covering technical topics and ecosystem developments (ocaml/ocaml.org#3400, ocaml/ocaml.org#3402, ocaml/ocaml.org#3403, ocaml/ocaml.org#3404)

    • OCaml Tools

    Dune package management maturation, opam 2.5.0 release, Rocq Prover integration, and LSP editor improvements

    New Features

  • Rocq Prover build language in ocaml/dune via (lang rocq) for Rocq 9.0 and later, with Coq mode deprecated (ocaml/dune#12035, ocaml/dune#12793)
  • Dune promotion preview command dune promotion show to preview corrected files before promotion (ocaml/dune#12669)
  • Dune compiler warning defaults changed for language 3.21+ to match OCaml compiler defaults, with %{dune-warnings} variable for stricter warnings (ocaml/dune#12766)
  • Dune dev-tool lock directory variable %{dev-tool-lock-dir} and relocation to hidden .dune/dev-tools-locks/ folder (ocaml/dune#12779, ocaml/dune#12671)
  • Dune SSH repository URLs documentation for Git-based package repositories (ocaml/dune#12790)
  • opam 2.5.0 final release with performance optimizations in version comparison and cache loading, plus improved error handling for opam init --config (ocaml/opam#6813, ocaml/opam#5979, ocaml/opam#6515)
  • LSP .merlin fallback automatically using .merlin configuration when no dune-project file exists, improving non-Dune project support (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1563)
  • LSP Dune package management installation documentation with dune tools install ocamllsp guidance (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1573)
  • odoc documentation restructuring renaming main file from odoc.mld to index.mld and removing obsolete symlinks blocking Dune package management (ocaml/odoc#1392)

    • Overview

  • Major releases and integrations: ocaml/opam shipped version 2.5.0 (ocaml/opam#6813), ocaml/dune integrated Rocq Prover language support across 687 files (ocaml/dune#12035)
  • Package management focus: ocaml/dune focused on UX improvements with 12 new package management issues opened including CLI enhancements (ocaml/dune#12819), dependency notifications (ocaml/dune#12828), and better error messages (ocaml/dune#12802)
  • Editor integration improvements: ocaml/merlin refined signature help behavior (ocaml/merlin#1997), ocaml/ocaml-lsp added natural .merlin fallback (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1563)
  • Build system maintenance: ocaml/odoc removed Windows-incompatible symlinks (ocaml/odoc#1392), ocaml/opam optimized version comparison to be allocation-free (ocaml/opam#6515)
  • Runtime platform expansion: ocsigen/jsofocaml added runtime improvements preparing for Deno support (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2132)
  • No activity: ocaml/ocamlfind, ocaml/opam-file-format, and ocaml-dune/spawn had no changes this week

    • Activity

  • Dune package management expansion with 17 new PRs opened including delayed URL resolution (ocaml/dune#12829), improved error messages for (pkg enabled) (ocaml/dune#12802), network caps tracking (ocaml/dune#12787), and OxCaml project documentation (ocaml/dune#12780)
  • opam environment management refinement discussions about env_hook PATH behavior (ocaml/opam#6815), shell completion variables PR (ocaml/opam#6812), and opam show I/O optimization (ocaml/opam#6818)
  • opam platform compatibility issues with AppArmor on KDE Neon affecting sandboxing (ocaml/opam#6820), MSYS2 build failures (ocaml/opam#6803)
  • LSP Stdune dependency removal with three refactoring PRs merged eliminating Stdune.List (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1480), Stdune.Io (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1404), and code generator cleanup (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1400)
  • LSP OCaml 4.14 backport opened by David Sancho including Yojson 3 compatibility, hover fixes, and configurable code-lens (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1574)
  • Merlin signature help refinements preventing unwanted triggers on function names (ocaml/merlin#1997) and draft support for let ... in bindings (ocaml/merlin#2009)
  • Merlin C code quality improvements for BSD socket handling and Windows error reporting (ocaml/merlin#1998)
  • jsofocaml Deno preparation with runtime improvements across 7 files (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2132)

    • Notable Discussions

  • OxCaml project setup in ocaml/dune generated 43 comments on best practices for Dune pkg configuration (ocaml/dune#12780)
  • opam env_hook aggressiveness raised by Shon Feder about PROMPT_COMMAND forcing opam paths to dominate $PATH, preventing user overrides (ocaml/opam#6815)
  • Package management error messaging with 22 comments debating appropriate messages when (pkg enabled) appears in wrong files (ocaml/dune#12802)
  • Non-ASCII version handling with 23 comments on improving error messages for Unicode in dune-project files (ocaml/dune#12794)
  • DUNECACHEHOME variable long-running discussion from April with 24 comments on cache directory configuration (ocaml/dune#11612)
  • Compiler warning defaults with 13 comments discussing impact of reverting to OCaml defaults (ocaml/dune#12766)
  • opam sandboxing on KDE Neon with bwrap loopback errors resolved by removing AppArmor profile (ocaml/opam#6820)
  • Missing repository warnings suggestion to warn when creating switches without default repository (ocaml/opam#6816)

    • Emerging Trends

  • Package management maturation across the ecosystem with ocaml/dune seeing 12 new package management issues focused on UX (ocaml/dune#12819, ocaml/dune#12828), ocaml/opam 2.5.0 release with performance improvements (ocaml/opam#6515), and ocaml/odoc removing compatibility blockers (ocaml/odoc#1392)
  • Documentation expansion with 6 new documentation requests in ocaml/dune covering workflows (ocaml/dune#12761), environment variables (ocaml/dune#12792), and repository URLs (ocaml/dune#12790), plus installation guides in ocaml/ocaml-lsp (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1573)
  • Environment management refinement emerging in ocaml/opam with env_hook behavior concerns (ocaml/opam#6815), shell completion variables (ocaml/opam#6812), and stale variable cleanup (ocaml/opam#6455)
  • Dependency reduction initiatives in ocaml/ocaml-lsp systematically removing Stdune (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1480, ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1404), ocaml/dune removing experimental libraries (ocaml/dune#12765)
  • Editor integration improvements across ocaml/merlin signature help (ocaml/merlin#1997) and ocaml/ocaml-lsp .merlin fallback (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1563) for better developer experience
  • Platform compatibility focus with ocaml/opam addressing KDE Neon AppArmor (ocaml/opam#6820) and MSYS2 issues (ocaml/opam#6803), ocaml/merlin BSD and Windows fixes (ocaml/merlin#1998), ocaml/odoc Windows symlink removal (ocaml/odoc#1392)
  • Proof system transition in ocaml/dune from Coq to Rocq with comprehensive language support (ocaml/dune#12035) and formal Coq deprecation (ocaml/dune#12793)
  • Performance optimization continuing in ocaml/opam with allocation-free comparisons (ocaml/opam#6515), I/O reduction (ocaml/opam#6818), and HTTP repository redesign work (ocaml/opam#6625)

    • OxCaml

    Compiler backend surge with 10 x86 optimizations, type system improvements, Merlin sync to 5.2.0minus-24, and ecosystem compatibility work

    New Features

  • Manifest file support in oxcaml/oxcaml via -I-manifest and -H-manifest flags allows specification of available files directly rather than entire directories (oxcaml/oxcaml#4986)
  • 128-bit integer arithmetic intrinsics in oxcaml/oxcaml including add_int128, sub_int128, mul_int64 operations compiling to efficient add/adc, sub/sbb, and imul/mul instructions (oxcaml/oxcaml#5025)
  • BMI/BMI2 intrinsics implementation in oxcaml/oxcaml with POPCNT, LZCNT support and multiple return registers in simdgen (oxcaml/oxcaml#5065)
  • Jkind hover expansion in oxcaml/merlin via Jkind.format_expanded function enables displaying full expanded forms of jkind types rather than abbreviations (oxcaml/merlin#201)
  • SIMD float16 vector types in oxcaml/merlin including float16x8, float16x16, and float16x32 variants added to Predef module (oxcaml/merlin#201)
  • Runtime_metaprogramming language extension at Alpha maturity level added to oxcaml/merlin extending experimental OCaml features (oxcaml/merlin#201)
  • Lazy type representation in oxcaml/merlin with new find_value_by_name_lazy, find_module_by_name_lazy, find_modtype_by_name_lazy functions and fold_modules_lazy/fold_modtypes_lazy for efficient traversal (oxcaml/merlin#201)
  • Unboxed elements at module top-level in oxcaml/oxcaml now allowed after fixing cross-module inlining behavior (oxcaml/oxcaml#5064)
  • Jkind normalization fuel optimization in oxcaml/oxcaml runs out of fuel only once per jkind, reusing fuel cache when normalizing with additional types (oxcaml/oxcaml#5047, oxcaml/oxcaml#5009)
  • Eio compatibility fix in oxcaml/opam-repository for eio.1.3+ox with oxcaml by explicitly currying function application in eio_mock (oxcaml/opam-repository#24)
  • New Jane Street packages in oxcaml/opam-repository including capsule, currentexe, curlasync, portablelockfreehtbl, heterogeneouslist, ppxint63literal, sexptype, unsafeclear, and bonsaiterm family (c66cb66)
  • Sedlex 3.6+ox package added to oxcaml/opam-repository providing Unicode lexer generator with ppx syntax extension support (c66cb66)
  • Skip mode hints in oxcaml/oxcaml added in several missing locations to improve mode error diagnostics (oxcaml/oxcaml#5053)
  • Chamelon minimization Ctrl-C support in oxcaml/oxcaml by replacing Sys.command with Unix module calls (oxcaml/oxcaml#5061)
  • Documentation lookup fix in oxcaml/merlin where .cms files were incorrectly prioritized over .cmti files, causing wrong documentation to be displayed for stdlib modules (55ec2f4)

    • Activity

  • X86 backend optimization surge led by Xavier Clerc in oxcaml/oxcaml with 10 merged PRs implementing peephole rules for redundant comparison removal (oxcaml/oxcaml#5028), MOV-to-LEA rewriting (oxcaml/oxcaml#5018), MOV-to-XCHG optimization (oxcaml/oxcaml#5016), useless move deletion (oxcaml/oxcaml#4985), MOV chain optimization (oxcaml/oxcaml#4977), infrastructure refactoring (oxcaml/oxcaml#5032, oxcaml/oxcaml#4975), CI testing (oxcaml/oxcaml#4976), and IRC refactoring (oxcaml/oxcaml#4594)
  • Type system evolution in oxcaml/oxcaml with Liam Stevenson optimizing environment fold operations (oxcaml/oxcaml#5066), Zesen Qian adding staticity checking (oxcaml/oxcaml#5054) and removing extension.escape (oxcaml/oxcaml#5055), Vincent Laviron fixing classic mode approximations (oxcaml/oxcaml#5058)
  • Merlin compiler sync with Liam Stevenson merging OCaml 5.2.0minus-24 changes through 23 commits in oxcaml/merlin#201, resolving conflicts from parameterized module changes, fixing type errors from lazy type representation improvements, and updating mode system and closure lock handling
  • Flambda2 cleanup in oxcaml/oxcaml with Basile Clément removing 3-year-old disabled code age relation join (oxcaml/oxcaml#5051), Nathanaëlle Courant refactoring reaper code (oxcaml/oxcaml#5049, oxcaml/oxcaml#5038)
  • Dune package management compatibility in oxcaml/opam-repository with Sudha Parimala opening patches for ocamlbuild to address symlink limitation (oxcaml/opam-repository#21, referencing ocaml/dune#12736) and odoc-parser (oxcaml/opam-repository#22, related to ocaml/odoc#1392)
  • Major package version bump in oxcaml/opam-repository across 200+ Jane Street packages from v0.18~preview.130.55+197 to v0.18~preview.130.76+222 (c66cb66)
  • Ongoing work in oxcaml/oxcaml includes abstract kinds preparation by Chris Casinghino (oxcaml/oxcaml#5070), typed ARM64 DSL by Mark Shinwell (oxcaml/oxcaml#5037), separability axis work by Zack Eisbach (oxcaml/oxcaml#5031), register allocation affinity by Xavier Clerc (oxcaml/oxcaml#5059, oxcaml/oxcaml#5063), reaper type rewriting by Nathanaëlle Courant (oxcaml/oxcaml#5043), GADT with-bounds by Liam Stevenson (oxcaml/oxcaml#5046), debugging improvements by Simon Spies (oxcaml/oxcaml#4916, oxcaml/oxcaml#4961, oxcaml/oxcaml#4928), and untagged int arrays by James Rayman (oxcaml/oxcaml#4779, oxcaml/oxcaml#4643, oxcaml/oxcaml#4936)
  • Repository cleanup in oxcaml/oxcaml with Jacob Van Buren removing boot directory saving 5% of repo size (oxcaml/oxcaml#5067), Liam Stevenson ignoring .vscode directory (oxcaml/oxcaml#4186)
  • Jkind hover support opened by Liam Stevenson in oxcaml/merlin#200 to display expanded jkind abbreviations when hovering over type expressions

    • Emerging Trends

  • Backend optimization momentum in oxcaml/oxcaml with systematic x86 peephole work establishing patterns for instruction-level optimization including flag liveness analysis, pseudo-liveness tracking, and comprehensive CI testing (oxcaml/oxcaml#5028, oxcaml/oxcaml#5018, oxcaml/oxcaml#5016, oxcaml/oxcaml#4985, oxcaml/oxcaml#4977)
  • Type system maturation across oxcaml/oxcaml and oxcaml/merlin through jkind normalization improvements (oxcaml/oxcaml#5047), mode system refinements (oxcaml/oxcaml#5053, oxcaml/oxcaml#5058), preparation for abstract kinds (oxcaml/oxcaml#5070), and tooling enhancements (oxcaml/merlin#200)
  • Lazy evaluation paradigm spreading throughout codebase with lazy type representation in oxcaml/merlin via Subst.Lazy module (oxcaml/merlin#201), lazy environment lookups, and deferred substitution operations to improve performance with complex type signatures
  • Intrinsics library expansion in oxcaml/oxcaml targeting both x86 (BMI/BMI2) and ARM64 platforms with focus on efficient compilation of low-level operations (oxcaml/oxcaml#5025, oxcaml/oxcaml#5065), and ongoing ARM64 intrinsics work (oxcaml/oxcaml#5024)
  • Flambda2 consolidation in oxcaml/oxcaml removing long-disabled features (oxcaml/oxcaml#5051), refactoring for clarity (oxcaml/oxcaml#5049, oxcaml/oxcaml#5038), while preparing for type rewriting capabilities (oxcaml/oxcaml#5043, oxcaml/oxcaml#5050)
  • Dune package management compatibility emerging as priority in oxcaml/opam-repository with patches addressing symlink limitations and ensuring packages build with both systems (oxcaml/opam-repository#21, oxcaml/opam-repository#22), coordinating with upstream ocaml/dune#12736 and ocaml/odoc#1392
  • Cross-module optimization work in oxcaml/oxcaml addressing mixed module blocks and classic mode approximation issues to improve inlining behavior (oxcaml/oxcaml#5058, oxcaml/oxcaml#5064)
  • Developer experience focus with repository cleanup (oxcaml/oxcaml#5067), tooling improvements (oxcaml/oxcaml#4986), build system fixes (oxcaml/oxcaml#5010), and debugging enhancements (oxcaml/oxcaml#5062, oxcaml/oxcaml#4916)
  • Regular preview releases in oxcaml/opam-repository with version bump pattern v0.18~preview.130.76+222 indicating active development and testing cycle for Jane Street packages (c66cb66)

    • OCaml Core

    Seven PRs merged with relocatable installations, atomic record fields, and String enhancements; active RFC discussions on val declarations

    New Features

  • Added String.{drop,take,cut}{first,last}while functions for predicate-based string splitting operations in both String and StringLabels modules (ocaml/ocaml#14362)
  • Implemented atomic record fields enabling lock-free concurrent programming with per-field atomic operations (ocaml/ocaml#13404)
  • Enhanced native dynlink to call dlclose on dynamically loaded objects when errors occur, preventing resource leaks (ocaml/ocaml#14391)
  • Improved debugger error messages to display specific information about incorrect or missing magic numbers rather than generic errors (ocaml/ocaml#14375)
  • Introduced relocatable OCaml installations with explicit relative paths in ld.conf - paths like . and .. now resolve relative to the ld.conf directory, and the default ld.conf uses relative rather than absolute paths (ocaml/ocaml#14243)
  • Added --with-additional-stublibsdir configure option to prepend custom directories to ld.conf, and stublibs subdirectory is no longer created when building with --disable-shared (ocaml/ocaml#14243)
  • Implemented multiple ld.conf loading - the runtime now loads from all of $OCAMLLIB/ld.conf, $CAMLLIB/ld.conf, and standardlibrarydefault/ld.conf rather than just the first found (ocaml/ocaml#14243)
  • Added external types documentation - new manual chapter explaining external types for FFI-populated values with examples for predefined types like float, string, and array (ocaml/ocaml#13994)
  • Updated GADT tutorial in manual to avoid using abstract types as indices, demonstrating proper usage with external types (ocaml/ocaml#13994)
  • Enhanced ld.conf parsing robustness - now handles CRLF line endings consistently on both Windows and Unix, and ocamlc uses the same C primitive-based parser as the runtime (ocaml/ocaml#14243)
  • Documented Ptype_external in parsetree.mli to clarify the AST representation of external type declarations (ocaml/ocaml#13994)
  • Transparency policy for conflicts of interest added to the OCaml Language Committee governance, requiring members to disclose conflicts when they belong to the same institution as proposal submitters or have financial ties, and establishing that conflicted members cannot serve as shepherds (ocaml/RFCs#55)
  • Affiliation field added to the committee member table, documenting institutional affiliations including Inria Paris, Jane Street, LexiFi, Meta, and University of Cambridge (ocaml/RFCs#55)

    • Activity

  • Relocatable OCaml initiative by David Allsopp with merged foundation (ocaml/ocaml#14243) and four follow-up PRs for --with-relative-libdir (ocaml/ocaml#14244), searching and suffixing (ocaml/ocaml#14245), opam integration (ocaml/ocaml#14246), and switch management (ocaml/ocaml#14247)
  • Atomic operations expansion including merged atomic record fields by @clef-men (ocaml/ocaml#13404), open atomic arrays PR (ocaml/ocaml#14380), and Gabriel Scherer working on Atomic.modify/modifyget (ocaml/ocaml#10798), concurrent lazy thunks with Lazy.Atomicrepeating (ocaml/ocaml#14043) and Lazy.Concurrent_blocking (ocaml/ocaml#14393)
  • String module enhancements by Daniel Bünzli with merged predicate-based functions (ocaml/ocaml#14362) and open PR adding find{first,last}index and related search functions (ocaml/ocaml#14381)
  • Compiler tooling improvements including Florian Angeletti advancing structured diagnostics (ocaml/ocaml#13766), spellchecking hints for module errors (ocaml/ocaml#14330), and cmt file environment stripping (ocaml/ocaml#14373)
  • Type system enhancements with Alistair refactoring typelet into separate nonrec/rec functions (ocaml/ocaml#14394) and removing let rec module support (ocaml/ocaml#14388), plus Vincent Laviron adding Set/Map.S.getsingleton (ocaml/ocaml#14121)
  • Pattern matching improvements by @Alex1005a fixing exhaustiveness checking for GADTs indexed by non-overlapping polymorphic variants (ocaml/ocaml#14379)
  • Developer experience with Mark Shinwell adding AI.md guidelines (ocaml/ocaml#14383), David Allsopp improving Git source archives (ocaml/ocaml#14152), and Xavier Van de Woestyne integrating Merlin typing recovery (ocaml/ocaml#14241)
  • Runtime and GC work including Nick Barnes using memprof status field for minimal sampling (ocaml/ocaml#14384), Gabriel Scherer updating young-pointers after barrier (ocaml/ocaml#14306), and Stephen Dolan adding named GC parameters mechanism (ocaml/ocaml#14367)
  • Platform compatibility with Antonin Décimo fixing Windows socketpair AF_UNIX emulation (ocaml/ocaml#13450) and improving AsciiDoc documentation (ocaml/ocaml#14392), Hannes Mehnert updating shell scripts to use /usr/bin/env bash (ocaml/ocaml#14398), and Samuel Bronson checking getentropy declaration (ocaml/ocaml#14382)
  • New RFC for val declarations in structures opened by Gabriel Scherer proposing syntax to write type signatures alongside definitions, similar to Haskell-style type annotations, sparking extensive discussion about forward declarations, scoping semantics, and integration with mutual recursion (ocaml/RFCs#59)
  • Tuple projections RFC continues with active debate between Alistair and maintainers about whether unlabeled numeric projections should require tuple polymorphism or rely on known type information, with consensus favoring polymorphic approach for unlabeled projections (ocaml/RFCs#57)
  • Atomic record fields RFC updated with note about atomic arrays implementation, cross-referencing ocaml/ocaml#14380 (ocaml/RFCs#39)

    • Notable Discussions

  • Forward declarations vs. type ascriptions debated extensively for val declarations RFC, with Jeremy Yallop proposing an alternative interpretation where val serves as forward declarations to introduce recursion (similar to Agda), enabling recursive bindings between different kinds of items like types and modules, while Gabriel Scherer proposed that val should primarily serve as type ascriptions that don't introduce recursion (ocaml/RFCs#59)
  • Scoping semantics for val bindings discussed with Kate proposing that forward declarations should be removed from scope in the next definition to avoid unintended recursive references, while others debated whether this creates confusing semantics (ocaml/RFCs#59)
  • Syntax placement preferences emerged with Xavier Leroy advocating for val declarations to immediately precede their corresponding let or and bindings rather than being grouped at the top, viewing this as syntactic sugar for type constraints that improves code legibility (ocaml/RFCs#59)
  • Alternative syntaxes proposed including Leo White's val rec keyword to explicitly mark forward declarations that introduce recursion, and Richard Eisenberg's unordered and-joined blocks mixing val, let, and let rec declarations (ocaml/RFCs#59)
  • Locally abstract types in signatures questioned by Richard Eisenberg regarding scoping across val and let boundaries, expressing concerns about "spooky action at a distance" similar to Haskell's deprecated -XScopedTypeVariables extension (ocaml/RFCs#59)
  • Tuple polymorphism implementation challenges raised by Chris Casinghino questioning how runtime projection would work for flexible tuples with labeled and unlabeled fields, asking whether canonical ordering or dynamic lookup would be required (ocaml/RFCs#57)
  • Type inference complexity debated with Alistair arguing that tuple polymorphism would be invasive to the type checker and preferring improvements to known-type-information propagation instead, while maintainers indicated numeric projections without polymorphism are non-intuitive (ocaml/RFCs#57)
  • String module enhancement proposal by Daniel Bünzli discussing comprehensive improvements to the String API, which led to merged PRs ocaml/ocaml#14362 and ongoing work in ocaml/ocaml#14381 (ocaml/ocaml#14137)

    • Emerging Trends

  • Relocatable OCaml becoming a major focus with comprehensive work spanning build system, installation, and package management to enable portable OCaml installations across different directory structures (ocaml/ocaml#14243, ocaml/ocaml#14244, ocaml/ocaml#14245, ocaml/ocaml#14246, ocaml/ocaml#14247)
  • Concurrent programming primitives expanding with atomic record fields merged in ocaml/ocaml#13404, atomic arrays in development via ocaml/ocaml#14380, and multiple concurrent lazy evaluation strategies being explored for lock-free data structures (ocaml/ocaml#14043, ocaml/ocaml#14393, ocaml/ocaml#10798)
  • Standard library ergonomics improving with systematic additions to String module for common text processing operations via ocaml/ocaml#14362 and ocaml/ocaml#14381, reflecting broader effort discussed in ocaml/ocaml#14137 to make standard library more practical
  • Developer experience focus with structured diagnostics (ocaml/ocaml#13766), better error messages, spellchecking hints (ocaml/ocaml#14330), and IDE integration improvements via ocaml/ocaml#14241 making the compiler more helpful and approachable
  • Type system expressiveness features gaining momentum with proposals for val declarations in ocaml/RFCs#59, tuple projections in ocaml/RFCs#57, and atomic record fields in ocaml/RFCs#39 all aiming to make OCaml's type system more expressive while maintaining backward compatibility and ergonomic syntax
  • Governance transparency improvements formalized with the conflict-of-interest policy in ocaml/RFCs#55 reflecting the committee's effort to balance community representation while being explicit about institutional affiliations and potential biases
  • Documentation completeness addressing gaps in manual coverage of language features, particularly around external types via ocaml/ocaml#13994, GADTs, and newer additions like immutable arrays (ocaml/ocaml#14397, ocaml/ocaml#14386)
  • AI-assisted contribution guidelines emerging with dedicated documentation in ocaml/ocaml#14383 to help contributors use AI tools effectively while maintaining code quality standards
  • Cross-language inspiration evident in RFCs with Haskell, Agda, and SML design patterns being referenced as both positive examples and cautionary tales for OCaml language evolution in discussions around ocaml/RFCs#59 and ocaml/RFCs#57

    • Multicore
entry.summary: opam 2.5.0 released, atomic record fields merged, String module enhanced, compiler backend optimized with 10 x86 improvements

entry.title: Week 47, 2025: Format/Printf heterogeneous lists merged in core, OxCaml released mixed modules and SIMD extensions, opam 2.5.0-rc1 published
entry.content:
Weekly Summary

New Features

  • OCaml Core New Format and Printf functions accepting heterogeneous lists as arguments (lfprintf, lprintf, leprintf, lasprintf, ldprintf and Printf equivalents) with improved type error messages and compile-time argument checking by Leonardo Santos in ocaml/ocaml#13372
  • OCaml Core Domain.join now preserves backtraces when re-raising exceptions from exceptionally terminated domains, improving debugging experience for concurrent programs by KC Sivaramakrishnan in ocaml/ocaml#14363
  • OCaml Core Fixed C++ header compatibility issues in unixsupport.h and made internal by Antonin Décimo in ocaml/ocaml#14370
  • OCaml Core Fixed compiler bug where Simplif was incorrectly substituting under letrec lambdas by Stephen Dolan in ocaml/ocaml#14368
  • OCaml Core Fixed data race in weak pointers runtime with TSan-compliant relaxed atomic writes for ephemeron data by Gabriel Scherer and Damien Doligez in ocaml/ocaml#14210
  • OCaml Core Fixed memory model issue in Weak.set operations by Damien Doligez in ocaml/ocaml#14209
  • OCaml Core Improved GC pacing by resetting major GC's pacing clock after any synchronous GC work by Nick Barnes in ocaml/ocaml#13736
  • OxCaml Mixed module support enables unboxed elements at top-level of modules through Module_mixed representation with mixed block shapes, allowing modules to contain both values and unboxed primitives in oxcaml/oxcaml#4020
  • OxCaml Jkind expansion API adds format_expanded function for Merlin to display fully-expanded jkinds on hover in oxcaml/oxcaml#5041
  • OxCaml Architecture compile-time constants via %arch_amd64 and %arch_arm64 builtins plus Sys.architecture for runtime detection in oxcaml/oxcaml#4972
  • OxCaml CFG value propagation extended to float values (Const_float and Const_float32) with terminator simplification improvements in oxcaml/oxcaml#4879 and oxcaml/oxcaml#4807
  • OxCaml Fiber error handling raises Effect.Out_of_fibers exception instead of Out_of_memory when mmap stack allocation fails in oxcaml/oxcaml#5021
  • OxCaml Fiber cache limit via -Xcache_stacks_per_class= GC parameter to prevent unbounded memory growth in oxcaml/oxcaml#5017
  • OxCaml Merlin outline functionality now includes items from include statements, enabling editor users (particularly Emacs imenu) to navigate to definitions within included modules, benefiting ppx_template users in oxcaml/merlin#199
  • OCaml Ecosystem opam 2.5.0-rc1 published with binaries for all supported platforms in ocaml/opam#6800 by Kate, with announcement added to ocaml.org in ocaml/ocaml.org#3395
  • OCaml Ecosystem MSys2 platform support massively improved with side-condition fixes across 20+ conf-packages including cairo, freetype, gtk2, gtk3, postgresql, SDL2, sqlite3, zlib, and zstd by Jan Midtgaard in ocaml/opam-repository#28939 and ocaml/opam-repository#28945
  • OCaml Tools OxCaml parameterised library instantiation merged in ocaml/dune#12561 by @art-w, enabling instantiation of parameterised libraries with arguments using syntax like (foo bar qux) or (foo bar qux :as new_name) with automatic parameter inheritance
  • OCaml Tools Persistent KaTeX macros in odoc HTML backend merged in ocaml/odoc#1391 by Dorian Lesbre, allowing macros defined with \gdef to persist across multiple math blocks
  • OCaml Tools Better archive extraction error messages in ocaml/dune#12683 by Sudha Parimala, explicitly reporting when tools like unzip are missing from PATH

    • Group Activity Summaries

    OCaml Ecosystem

    opam 2.5.0-rc1 published with 36 packages merged; documentation improvements and Windows platform support expanded

    New Features

  • opam 2.5.0 release candidate published in ocaml/opam-repository#28928 with updated client library for testing, and announcement added to ocaml.org in ocaml/ocaml.org#3395 with installation instructions and change highlights
  • avro-simple 0.1 provides pure OCaml Apache Avro implementation with codec-based design, schema evolution support, and container file format (ocaml/opam-repository#28910)
