  • salto-analyzer 0.2 introduces OCaml static analyzer based on abstract interpretation for inferring output values and exceptions (ocaml/opam-repository#28917)
  • expr 1.0.0 new package for parsing and evaluating arithmetic expressions (ocaml/opam-repository#28905)
  • alice 0.1.1 new package added to repository (ocaml/opam-repository#28941)
  • yocaml 2.7.0 static site generator gains Liquid templating language support across 14 packages (ocaml/opam-repository#28919)
  • ocaml-protoc 4.0 brings better parsing, validation code generation, and presence semantics handling for Protocol Buffers (ocaml/opam-repository#28902)
  • crowbar 0.2.2 QuickCheck-style property testing library enhanced with afl-fuzz integration (ocaml/opam-repository#28907)
  • qcow 0.12.2 adds support for Qcow2 image format with upstream diet package integration (ocaml/opam-repository#28936)
  • goblint-cil 2.0.9 C front-end updated with __loop_condition labels support (ocaml/opam-repository#28929)
  • bstr 0.0.3 bigstring library resolves SIGSEGV issues and improves encoding functionality (ocaml/opam-repository#28933)
  • msvs-detect 0.8.0 adds Visual Studio 2026 support for Windows developers (ocaml/opam-repository#28940)
  • hol2dk 2.1.0 translator updated for HOL-Light to Dedukti/Lambdapi and Rocq conversion (ocaml/opam-repository#28937)
  • albatross 2.6.1 MirageOS unikernel orchestration system updated (ocaml/opam-repository#28915)
  • ca-certs-nss 3.118 Mozilla NSS certificate bundle updated to latest version (ocaml/opam-repository#28924)
  • lun 0.0.2 optics library for OCaml released across 2 packages (ocaml/opam-repository#28927)
  • Unison 2.53.8 file synchronization tool updated (ocaml/opam-repository#28851)
  • smtml 0.14.0 SMT solver frontend released (ocaml/opam-repository#28913)
  • fit 1.4.0 gains 32-bit architecture support (ocaml/opam-repository#28904)
  • query-json 0.5.52 jq implementation in OCaml updated (ocaml/opam-repository#28909)
  • opam-publish 2.7.1 tool for publishing to opam-repository updated (ocaml/opam-repository#28920)
  • crypt 2.1 cryptography package updated (ocaml/opam-repository#28906)
  • css 0.4.0 CSS parsing library updated (ocaml/opam-repository#28870)
  • ojs_base 0.9.0 base library for OCaml web applications updated across 6 packages (ocaml/opam-repository#28882)
  • MSys2 platform support massively improved with side-condition fixes across 20+ conf-packages including cairo, freetype, gtk2, gtk3, postgresql, SDL2, sqlite3, zlib, and zstd (ocaml/opam-repository#28939, ocaml/opam-repository#28945)
  • Rocky Linux 9 support added for conf-openblas package installation (ocaml/opam-repository#28925)
  • NixOS support fixed for conf-oniguruma package (ocaml/opam-repository#28921)
  • lablgtk3 Windows hotfixes applied for better Windows platform support (ocaml/opam-repository#28918)
  • Archiving policy documentation enhanced with summary section clarifying maintenance requirements: packages must have available sources, be installable on at least one platform with OCaml 4.08+, and have maintenance intent metadata (ocaml/opam-repository#28922)
  • Package metadata improvements with x-maintenance-intent fields added across 57 packages (ocaml/opam-repository#28908)
  • GitHub Actions upgraded from actions/checkout v5 to v6 in opam-repository (ocaml/opam-repository#28943)
  • Documentation generation tutorial enhancement on ocaml.org with new dune ocaml doc command shortcut that automatically builds and opens documentation in the browser (ocaml/ocaml.org#3391)
  • Video scraper buffer fix on ocaml.org addressing YAML serialization failures when processing large numbers of videos by increasing output buffer from 256KB to 2MB, accommodating growth to ~1500 videos (ocaml/ocaml.org#3392)

    • Overview

  • opam 2.5.0 release candidate published across both repositories with Kate releasing the package in ocaml/opam-repository#28928 and adding the changelog announcement to ocaml.org in ocaml/ocaml.org#3395
  • 36 packages merged into ocaml/opam-repository including new implementations for Apache Avro, static analysis, templating engines, and numerous library updates
  • Windows and cross-platform support significantly expanded with Jan Midtgaard leading MSys2 fixes across 20+ conf-packages (ocaml/opam-repository#28939, ocaml/opam-repository#28945), plus Rocky Linux 9 and NixOS support additions
  • Documentation and infrastructure improvements on ocaml/ocaml.org with sabine enhancing the documentation generation tutorial (ocaml/ocaml.org#3391) and fixing video scraper reliability issues (ocaml/ocaml.org#3392)
  • Automated content aggregation brought in 13 new blog posts and videos covering OCaml developments across the ecosystem (ocaml/ocaml.org#3398, ocaml/ocaml.org#3397)
  • Repository maintenance advanced with archiving policy documentation clarifications (ocaml/opam-repository#28922) and x-maintenance-intent metadata added to 57 packages (ocaml/opam-repository#28908)

    • Activity

  • New package submissions to ocaml/opam-repository include Ben Faerber by Ben Faerber implementing Shopify's Liquid templating language across 5 packages (ocaml/opam-repository#28951), Reynir Björnsson by Reynir Björnsson for MirageOS library OS (ocaml/opam-repository#28942), Yawar Amin HTML generator eDSL by Yawar Amin (ocaml/opam-repository#28954), mazeppa 0.7.0 template engine (ocaml/opam-repository#28949), Morten Knaack by Morten Knaack (ocaml/opam-repository#28938), François Bobot C library stub by François Bobot (ocaml/opam-repository#28935), and David Sancho requiring OCaml 5.0+ with effect handlers by David Sancho (ocaml/opam-repository#28955)
  • Major version updates in progress in ocaml/opam-repository include Raphaël Proust promises and event-driven I/O library by Raphaël Proust across 4 packages (ocaml/opam-repository#28894) and Thibaut Mattio ML ecosystem with NumPy-compatible features by Thibaut Mattio spanning 11 packages (ocaml/opam-repository#28827)
  • Platform and distribution support continues in ocaml/opam-repository with Jan Midtgaard submitting part 2 of MSys2 conf-package fixes (ocaml/opam-repository#28944), adding generic configure script for conf-libclang.21 (ocaml/opam-repository#28950), and Ryan Gibb fixing lmdb depext on NixOS (ocaml/opam-repository#28931)
  • Frama-C ecosystem development continues in ocaml/opam-repository with Frama-CI Bot dealing with conf-libclang version compatibility (ocaml/opam-repository#28843) and Frama-CI Bot plugin (ocaml/opam-repository#28841)
  • OCaml 5.0 compatibility work in ocaml/opam-repository includes François Bobot by François Bobot (ocaml/opam-repository#28849)
  • Windows compatibility addressed in ocaml/opam-repository with diffast 0.3.6 AST differencing tool working through platform-specific issues (ocaml/opam-repository#28911)
  • Package releases withdrawn from ocaml/opam-repository include Antonio Nuno Monteiro by Antonio Nuno Monteiro closed for re-release with OCaml 4.08 support (ocaml/opam-repository#28867), Antonio Nuno Monteiro by Antonio Nuno Monteiro withdrawn due to discovered regression (ocaml/opam-repository#28866), mazeppa version iterations with 0.6.1, 0.6.2, and 0.6.3 closed and superseded by 0.7.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#28946, ocaml/opam-repository#28947, ocaml/opam-repository#28948), and Daniil Baturin by Daniil Baturin held back due to checksum mismatch (ocaml/opam-repository#28926)
  • Dependency constraint fixes in ocaml/opam-repository include Jan Midtgaard adding missing cmdliner.2.0.0 upper bound on carton.0.4.3 (ocaml/opam-repository#28923), Juneyoung Lee setting upperbound of camlp5 version for HOL Light (ocaml/opam-repository#28916)
  • New PR opened on ocaml/ocaml.org by Rong "Mantle" Bao fixing three typos in language tutorials (ocaml/ocaml.org#3399)
  • Content aggregation on ocaml/ocaml.org through automated scraping brought in 13 new blog posts and videos from the OCaml community, including posts on OCaml containers in Azure, UK/India AI Summit, compiler news, priority queue testing with Monolith, opam repository security, MirageOS unikernel developments (ocaml/ocaml.org#3398, ocaml/ocaml.org#3397)
  • GitHub Actions dependency update on ocaml/ocaml.org bumping DavidAnson/markdownlint-cli2-action from version 20 to 21, updating markdownlint-cli2 to v0.19.0 and markdownlint to v0.39.0 (ocaml/ocaml.org#3396)

    • Notable Discussions

  • Archiving policy refinement in ocaml/opam-repository resolved with Stephen Dolan and maintainers agreeing that packages can retain commented-out code sections (ocaml/opam-repository#24501) and establishing available: false as the mechanism for marking non-functional packages for archival (ocaml/opam-repository#23697), with summary documentation added to policies (ocaml/opam-repository#28922)
  • System package installation behavior discussed in ocaml/opam-repository by Jan Midtgaard regarding differences between Debian and Centos/OpenSuse in handling missing depexts constraints (ocaml/opam-repository#28953)
  • MSys2 compilation issues identified in ocaml/opam-repository with Jan Midtgaard reporting topkg.1.1.0 failure related to findlib package (ocaml/opam-repository#28636)
  • Distribution documentation expansion requested in ocaml/opam-repository by Jan Midtgaard to include NixOS, Rocky, and Mint in wiki table (ocaml/opam-repository#28930)
  • Periodic archival scheduling considered in ocaml/opam-repository by Hannes Mehnert with discussion of minimal OCaml version requirements (ocaml/opam-repository#28489)
  • opam 2.0 workflow issues documented in ocaml/opam-repository by Jan Midtgaard regarding timeouts and cyclic dependency errors (ocaml/opam-repository#28952)

    • Emerging Trends

  • Windows platform support intensification in ocaml/opam-repository with Jan Midtgaard leading systematic MSys2 side-condition fixes across 20+ conf-packages (ocaml/opam-repository#28939, ocaml/opam-repository#28944, ocaml/opam-repository#28945), David Allsopp adding Visual Studio 2026 support (ocaml/opam-repository#28940) and lablgtk3 hotfixes (ocaml/opam-repository#28918)
  • Maintenance intent metadata adoption accelerating in ocaml/opam-repository with 57 packages updated by @redianthus to include x-maintenance-intent fields (ocaml/opam-repository#28908), supporting repository archiving policy implementation
  • Linux distribution support expansion in ocaml/opam-repository with Török Edwin fixing Rocky Linux 9 (ocaml/opam-repository#28925), Ryan Gibb addressing NixOS packages (ocaml/opam-repository#28921, ocaml/opam-repository#28931), demonstrating broader distribution coverage
  • MirageOS ecosystem sustained development in ocaml/opam-repository with Hannes Mehnert updating albatross (ocaml/opam-repository#28915) and ca-certs-nss (ocaml/opam-repository#28924), Pau Ruiz Safont releasing qcow (ocaml/opam-repository#28936), Reynir Björnsson submitting mirage (ocaml/opam-repository#28942)
  • Web development tooling growth in ocaml/opam-repository with Xavier Van de Woestyne releasing yocaml static site generator (ocaml/opam-repository#28919), Ben Faerber submitting liquid-ml templating (ocaml/opam-repository#28951), Yawar Amin updating dream-html (ocaml/opam-repository#28954), @hirrolot adding mazeppa (ocaml/opam-repository#28949), Zoggy releasing ojs_base and css (ocaml/opam-repository#28882, ocaml/opam-repository#28870)
  • Static analysis and verification advancing in ocaml/opam-repository with Benoit Montagu releasing salto-analyzer (ocaml/opam-repository#28917), Frédéric Blanqui updating hol2dk (ocaml/opam-repository#28937), ongoing Frama-C ecosystem work (ocaml/opam-repository#28843, ocaml/opam-repository#28841)
  • Data format and protocol support expanding in ocaml/opam-repository with Tim McGilchrist contributing Apache Avro implementation (ocaml/opam-repository#28910), Simon Cruanes enhancing Protocol Buffers support (ocaml/opam-repository#28902), Pau Ruiz Safont adding Qcow2 image support (ocaml/opam-repository#28936)
  • OCaml 5.0+ adoption progressing in ocaml/opam-repository with new packages requiring effects (ocaml/opam-repository#28955, ocaml/opam-repository#28910) and compatibility work for existing libraries (ocaml/opam-repository#28849)
  • Automated content scraping continues on ocaml/ocaml.org to be a core workflow for keeping the OCaml Planet aggregator up-to-date with community blog posts and videos, with infrastructure improvements ensuring reliability as content volume grows (ocaml/ocaml.org#3392)
  • Documentation tooling enhancements on ocaml/ocaml.org showing attention to developer experience improvements, making it easier for OCaml developers to generate and view documentation (ocaml/ocaml.org#3391)
  • Routine dependency maintenance through automated Dependabot PRs keeping GitHub Actions workflows current with latest tooling versions across both repositories (ocaml/opam-repository#28943, ocaml/ocaml.org#3396)

    • OCaml Tools

    Dune OxCaml parameterised libraries merged, opam 2.5.0~rc1 released, and testing infrastructure improvements across tools

    New Features

  • OxCaml parameterised library instantiation merged in ocaml/dune#12561 by @art-w, enabling instantiation of parameterised libraries with arguments using syntax like (foo bar qux) or (foo bar qux :as new_name) with automatic parameter inheritance
  • Opam 2.5.0~rc1 released in ocaml/opam#6800 by Kate with binaries for all supported platforms, marking a release candidate milestone
  • Persistent KaTeX macros in odoc HTML backend merged in ocaml/odoc#1391 by Dorian Lesbre, allowing macros defined with \gdef to persist across multiple math blocks
  • Better archive extraction error messages in ocaml/dune#12683 by Sudha Parimala, explicitly reporting when tools like unzip are missing from PATH
  • AppArmor profile installation improvements in ocaml/opam#6760 by R. Boujbel, using install command for safer profile creation with proper permissions and update options
  • Dune cmdliner documentation enforcement in ocaml/dune#12728 by Ali Caglayan, ensuring all CLI commands have explicit doc parameters across 45 files
  • Dune package management memoization in ocaml/dune#12758 by Ali Caglayan, optimizing lock directory access to avoid redundant reads
  • Binary distribution guide in ocaml/dune#12745 by Stephen Sherratt, documenting how to release application binaries on GitHub using dune package management
  • Opam Makefile shell hardening in ocaml/opam#6751 by Kate, adding -euo pipefail flags to catch errors in shell scripts during builds

    • Overview

  • Week 47 saw major milestones with ocaml/dune's OxCaml parameterised library instantiation merged in ocaml/dune#12561 and opam 2.5.0~rc1 released in ocaml/opam#6800
  • ocaml/dune led activity with 11 new PRs opened and significant work on package management documentation, with ongoing discussions about changing compiler warning defaults in ocaml/dune#12766
  • ocaml/merlin focused on test coverage expansion with 5 new reproduction test PRs by Tim ats for historical bugs, building a regression test suite
  • ocaml/opam prepared 2.5.0~rc1 release with installer improvements and documentation updates, with ongoing work on performance optimization and repository format changes
  • ocaml/odoc merged KaTeX macros support in ocaml/odoc#1391 and opened PR in ocaml/odoc#1392 to remove symlinks for dune package management compatibility
  • ocaml/ocamlfind received bug report in ocaml/ocamlfind#114 about improper shell quoting in -i-format output
  • ocaml/ocaml-lsp saw automated dependency updates and ongoing investigation of watch mode bugs in ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1209
  • Three repositories (ocaml/opam-file-format, ocaml-dune/spawn, ocsigen/jsofocaml) had no activity during this period

    • Activity

  • Dune package management evolution with 11 new PRs opened including documentation on opam integration in ocaml/dune#12761 and homebrew packaging in ocaml/dune#12744 by Stephen Sherratt, plus internal improvements like repository handling consolidation in ocaml/dune#12743
  • Compiler warning defaults debate intensified with Nicolás Ojeda Bär proposing in ocaml/dune#12766 to stop modifying compiler's default warnings in dune 3.21, addressing long-standing issue ocaml/dune#8645
  • Test coverage expansion as Tim ats opened 5 PRs in merlin for issue reproductions covering ocaml/merlin#1983, ocaml/merlin#1949, ocaml/merlin#1786, ocaml/merlin#2000, and ocaml/merlin#1118
  • Opam documentation improvements under review with Kate working on man page HTML generation in ocaml/opam#6807 and API example replacements in ocaml/opam#6809
  • OxCaml follow-up work progressing with @art-w working on jsofocaml integration in ocaml/dune#12762 and CI migration from nix to opam in ocaml/dune#12763
  • Cross-platform improvements with Antonin Décimo enhancing BSD and Windows support in merlin C codebase in ocaml/merlin#1998
  • Opam reftest improvements with hash collision fix in ocaml/opam#6793 and benchmark data additions in ocaml/opam#6567 by Kate
  • Internal refactoring across dune including Action_builder migration in ocaml/dune#12771, global env parsing optimization in ocaml/dune#12764, and unused library removal in ocaml/dune#12769 by Rudi Grinberg

    • Notable Discussions

  • Compiler warning defaults reconsideration in ocaml/dune#12766 proposing to stop modifying compiler's default warning set in dune 3.21, addressing 6-year-old debate in ocaml/dune#8645 about alignment with upstream OCaml decisions
  • Shell completion script support discussed in ocaml/opam#6427 with Brian Ward offering to implement automatic completion script path setup in opam env, similar to existing MANPATH handling
  • Opam environment variable cleanup in ocaml/opam#6455 with Louis suggesting opam doctor command to detect conflicting environments after nuked opam roots
  • CI compatibility challenges in ocaml/merlin#2006 where ppxlib 0.35.0 doesn't support OCaml 5.4.0, requiring ppxlib >= 0.36.0 but blocked by ppx_repr dependency constraints
  • Convention over configuration discussions in ocaml/dune#12740 around implicit project configurations and simplified dune modes for newcomers, plus single-file script support in ocaml/dune#1385
  • Depext status checking optimization in ocaml/opam#6489 with R. Boujbel noting need to store os-family in repository state cache for proper invalidation

    • Emerging Trends

  • Package management maturity focus with extensive documentation being written for real-world workflows including binary distribution in ocaml/dune#12745, opam integration in ocaml/dune#12761, and homebrew packaging in ocaml/dune#12744
  • OxCaml reaching production readiness with parameterised library instantiation merged in ocaml/dune#12561, completing the final piece from the parameterised libraries roadmap in ocaml/dune#12088
  • Test infrastructure investment with systematic reproduction test creation by Tim ats in merlin and expanded test coverage for short-paths by Xavier Van de Woestyne in ocaml/merlin#1994
  • Release preparation activity with opam 2.5.0~rc1 published in ocaml/opam#6800 and dune release tracking in ocaml/dune#12619
  • Error message quality improvements across tools with better archive extraction errors in ocaml/dune#12683, AppArmor profile messages in ocaml/opam#6760, and ongoing work on RPC warning transfer issues in ocaml/dune#12752
  • Build infrastructure hardening with Makefile shell flags in ocaml/opam#6751 and GitHub Actions workflow refinements in ocaml/opam#6767
  • Compiler integration improvements including tracking of new OCaml features in ocaml/merlin#1999 and warning defaults alignment discussions in ocaml/dune#12766

    • OxCaml

    Compiler advances in mixed modules, type system, backend CFG optimizations, runtime GC improvements, and editor tooling

    New Features

  • Mixed module support enables unboxed elements at top-level of modules through Module_mixed representation with mixed block shapes, allowing modules to contain both values and unboxed primitives in oxcaml/oxcaml#4020
  • Jkind expansion API adds format_expanded function for Merlin to display fully-expanded jkinds on hover in oxcaml/oxcaml#5041
  • Architecture compile-time constants via %arch_amd64 and %arch_arm64 builtins plus Sys.architecture for runtime detection in oxcaml/oxcaml#4972
  • Unoptimized probes implementation for arm64 with enabled_at_init field on Probe_is_enabled primitive and -probes-optimized/-no-probes-optimized flags in oxcaml/oxcaml#5007
  • CFG value propagation extended to float values (Const_float and Const_float32) with terminator simplification improvements in oxcaml/oxcaml#4879 and oxcaml/oxcaml#4807
  • CFG reducibility checking via Cfg_reducibility module to validate loop information trustworthiness in oxcaml/oxcaml#4920
  • Fiber error handling raises Effect.Out_of_fibers exception instead of Out_of_memory when mmap stack allocation fails in oxcaml/oxcaml#5021
  • Fiber cache limit via -Xcache_stacks_per_class= GC parameter to prevent unbounded memory growth in oxcaml/oxcaml#5017
  • GC stat sampling includes current minor words for more accurate Gc.quick_stat results in single-domain programs in oxcaml/oxcaml#5030
  • Makefile cleanup targets with make clean and make distclean preserving editor configs in oxcaml/oxcaml#5035
  • Runtime metaprogramming extension gates quotes, splices, and quotation evaluation in oxcaml/oxcaml#5012
  • Merlin outline functionality now includes items from include statements, enabling editor users (particularly Emacs imenu) to navigate to definitions within included modules, benefiting ppx_template users in oxcaml/merlin#199

    • Activity

  • Newly opened PRs include separability as scannable axis renaming pointerness in oxcaml/oxcaml#5031, fuel optimization with linear consumption in oxcaml/oxcaml#5009, AVX2 gather intrinsics support in oxcaml/oxcaml#5040, 128-bit integer arithmetic intrinsics in oxcaml/oxcaml#5025, staticity mode checking in oxcaml/oxcaml#5029, immutable arrays of unboxed products in oxcaml/oxcaml#5026, typed DSL for arm64 in oxcaml/oxcaml#5037, and module mode hint system in oxcaml/oxcaml#5034
  • Type system improvements delivered through Tof_jkind for unboxed existentials and Tpolys by Liam Stevenson in oxcaml/oxcaml#4995, v1 safety check optimization avoiding substitutions in oxcaml/oxcaml#5039, and upstream PR 13866 with marking mechanism updates in oxcaml/oxcaml#5015
  • Backend enhancements include probes code generation refactoring by Greta Yorsh in oxcaml/oxcaml#5011, CFG profiling counters for instructions, blocks, and moves by Xavier Clerc in oxcaml/oxcaml#5027, and CFG terminator simplification reinstated with reducibility check in oxcaml/oxcaml#4921
  • Runtime optimizations landed via marking loop optimization removing global access by Nick Barnes in oxcaml/oxcaml#4997, sweep loop global variable elimination in oxcaml/oxcaml#5022, and multidomain testing without stack-checks by Vesa Karvonen in oxcaml/oxcaml#5019
  • Infrastructure updates merged including metrics collection refactor for per-artifact tracking by Xavier Clerc in oxcaml/oxcaml#5003, compiler profile data archiving in oxcaml/oxcaml#5004, Dune version bump to 3.17.2 by Sadiq Jaffer in oxcaml/oxcaml#5000, and Chamelon boot compiler compatibility by Basile Clément in oxcaml/oxcaml#5020
  • Active development continues on .cmxs format optimization with consolidated imports in oxcaml/oxcaml#5014, slambda splices integration in oxcaml/oxcaml#5023, arm64 intrinsics for RDTSC and CRC32 in oxcaml/oxcaml#5024, reaper consistency for apply in oxcaml/oxcaml#5038, dump-dir race condition fix in oxcaml/oxcaml#5010, and manifest files support in oxcaml/oxcaml#4986
  • Merlin integration work includes internal API improvements refining function signatures in short_paths modules to use Global_module.Name.t instead of raw strings for better type safety in oxcaml/merlin#199

    • Emerging Trends

  • Unboxed types maturation shown through mixed modules at top-level in oxcaml/oxcaml#4020, immutable arrays of unboxed products in oxcaml/oxcaml#5026, and enhanced type system support for existentials in oxcaml/oxcaml#4995
  • Backend optimization focus evidenced by CFG value propagation extensions in oxcaml/oxcaml#4879 and oxcaml/oxcaml#4807, reducibility checking in oxcaml/oxcaml#4920 and oxcaml/oxcaml#4921, probes implementation in oxcaml/oxcaml#5007 and oxcaml/oxcaml#5011, and multiple WIP peephole optimizations in oxcaml/oxcaml#5018, oxcaml/oxcaml#5016, oxcaml/oxcaml#5028, oxcaml/oxcaml#5032, and oxcaml/oxcaml#5033
  • Type system precision advances through jkind inference improvements in oxcaml/oxcaml#5039 and oxcaml/oxcaml#5009, scannable axis development in oxcaml/oxcaml#5006 and oxcaml/oxcaml#5031, mode checking enhancements in oxcaml/oxcaml#5029 and oxcaml/oxcaml#5034, and upstream synchronization in oxcaml/oxcaml#5015
  • Runtime performance improvements through GC micro-optimizations reducing global access in oxcaml/oxcaml#4997 and oxcaml/oxcaml#5022, fiber cache management in oxcaml/oxcaml#5017, error handling improvements in oxcaml/oxcaml#5021, and profiling accuracy in oxcaml/oxcaml#5030
  • SIMD and intrinsics expansion with AVX2 gather instructions in oxcaml/oxcaml#5040, 128-bit arithmetic in oxcaml/oxcaml#5025, architecture detection in oxcaml/oxcaml#4972, and arm64 platform parity in oxcaml/oxcaml#5024 and oxcaml/oxcaml#5037
  • Editor integration enhancements continue with Merlin outline improvements in oxcaml/merlin#199 and preparation for advanced type information display in oxcaml/merlin#200, coordinating with compiler API development in oxcaml/oxcaml#5041

    • OCaml Core

    Format/Printf heterogeneous lists merged, runtime memory safety fixes landed, and uniform array RFC discussions advanced

    New Features

  • New Format and Printf functions accepting heterogeneous lists as arguments (lfprintf, lprintf, leprintf, lasprintf, ldprintf and Printf equivalents) with improved type error messages and compile-time argument checking by Leonardo Santos in ocaml/ocaml#13372
  • Domain.join now preserves backtraces when re-raising exceptions from exceptionally terminated domains, improving debugging experience for concurrent programs by KC Sivaramakrishnan in ocaml/ocaml#14363
  • Fixed C++ header compatibility issues in unixsupport.h and made internal by Antonin Décimo in ocaml/ocaml#14370
  • Fixed compiler bug where Simplif was incorrectly substituting under letrec lambdas by Stephen Dolan in ocaml/ocaml#14368
  • Fixed data race in weak pointers runtime with TSan-compliant relaxed atomic writes for ephemeron data by Gabriel Scherer and Damien Doligez in ocaml/ocaml#14210
  • Fixed memory model issue in Weak.set operations by Damien Doligez in ocaml/ocaml#14209
  • Improved GC pacing by resetting major GC's pacing clock after any synchronous GC work by Nick Barnes in ocaml/ocaml#13736

    • Activity

  • Nine new PRs opened in ocaml/ocaml including idle phase for major GC by Damien Doligez, named GC parameters mechanism by Stephen Dolan, String.{drop,take,cut}{first,last}while operations by Daniel Bünzli, cmt file environment stripping by Florian Angeletti, debugger magic number messages by @Alex1005a, and Filename.quote optimization by Kate
  • Typing system refactoring opportunities identified by Gabriel Scherer including code sharing between Ctype.moregen and Ctype.eqtype in ocaml/ocaml#14364 and removing global state from Ctype.nondep_* functions in ocaml/ocaml#14366
  • Relocatable OCaml work continues in ocaml/ocaml with three large PRs by David Allsopp covering explicit-relative paths in ld.conf (#14243), --with-relative-libdir configuration (#14244), and comprehensive switch relocation (#14247)
  • Merlin's typing recovery integration PR by Xavier Van de Woestyne remains under review with 1780 additions across 40 files in ocaml/ocaml#14241
  • Modular explicits feature and M.true/M.false parsing support continue development by Samuel Vivien in ocaml/ocaml#13275 and ocaml/ocaml#13246
  • Windows socketpair improvements with AF_UNIX emulation fixes by Antonin Décimo in ocaml/ocaml#13450, with Nathan Taylor identifying potential TOCTOU race condition in ocaml/ocaml#14372
  • Language committee governance proposal in ocaml/RFCs#55 by Florian Angeletti addressing conflicts of interest through transparency-based policy was amended per feedback, with plans to merge by end of week

    • Notable Discussions

  • Float array optimization future sparked technical debate in ocaml/RFCs#37 with Alain Frisch questioning whether uniform representation should become the default mode given complexity reduction benefits, Gabriel Scherer arguing for improving floatarray ergonomics first to address performance concerns, and Richard Eisenberg detailing Jane Street's investigation of 'a buoyant_array and unboxed types as alternatives
  • Runtime semantic challenges highlighted by Pierre-Marie Pédrot in ocaml/RFCs#37 explaining how float array semantics create type-theoretic issues where Obj.t cannot be treated as a proper universal type, making the runtime problematic for Rocq across VM, native, and extraction targets
  • String module improvements proposed by Daniel Bünzli in ocaml/ocaml#14137 including new operations for taking, dropping, and cutting substrings, with implementation PR opened in ocaml/ocaml#14362

    • Emerging Trends

  • Runtime memory safety improvements with fixes for TSan-reported issues, weak pointers, and ephemeron data races reflecting increased focus on thread safety in ocaml/ocaml#14210, ocaml/ocaml#14209, and ocaml/ocaml#14303
  • GC enhancement work with additions for idle phases in ocaml/ocaml#14365, named parameters in ocaml/ocaml#14367, and pacing improvements in ocaml/ocaml#13736 showing active optimization of memory management
  • Standard library API expansion with new Format/Printf heterogeneous list functions in ocaml/ocaml#13372 and proposed String operations in ocaml/ocaml#14362 and ocaml/ocaml#14137
  • Type system evolution discussions in ocaml/RFCs#37 around uniform arrays, with Richard Eisenberg sharing Jane Street's exploration of alternatives including 'a buoyant_array requiring runtime float representation and kind system extensions
  • Typing system refactoring focus with identification of code sharing opportunities and global state removal in ocaml/ocaml#14364 and ocaml/ocaml#14366

    • Multicore

    Limited activity with Eio resource management feature request and Meio Eio 0.14+ compatibility work

    Overview

  • Activity concentrated in 2 repositories (ocaml-multicore/eio and ocaml-multicore/meio) with 7 repositories showing no activity
  • Shon Feder requested resource pool disposal feature in ocaml-multicore/eio#824 for better lifecycle management
  • Tim McGilchrist advanced Eio 0.14+ compatibility work in ocaml-multicore/meio#72, building on Patrick Ferris's earlier implementation
  • No merged PRs, releases, or significant discussions across the group

    • Activity

  • Shon Feder opened ocaml-multicore/eio#824 requesting a Pool.dispose function to enable resource cleanup for pools created with Pool.create, allowing disposal of expensive resources within a switch's lifetime rather than waiting for the switch to end
  • Tim McGilchrist opened ocaml-multicore/meio#72 for Eio 0.14+ compatibility, rebasing Patrick Ferris's work from ocaml-multicore/meio#71 with dependency updates across 22 files (121 additions, 160 deletions)
  • Tim McGilchrist closed ocaml-multicore/meio#69 without merging, which would have updated opam switch creation instructions in the README

    • Emerging Trends

  • Resource lifecycle management continues to be refined, with ocaml-multicore/eio#824 requesting more granular control over resource pool disposal
  • Eio 0.14+ compatibility work indicates ongoing maintenance burden for ecosystem packages, as seen in ocaml-multicore/meio#72
entry.summary: Format/Printf heterogeneous lists merged in core, OxCaml released mixed modules and SIMD extensions, opam 2.5.0-rc1 published

entry.title: Week 46, 2025: String module extended with splitting functions, opam 2.5.0~beta1 released, compiler advances with modes and SIMD, Eio environment API proposed
entry.content:
Weekly Summary

New Features

  • OCaml Core String module splitting functions added by Daniel Bünzli with String.take_first, String.take_last, String.drop_first, String.drop_last, String.cut_first, and String.cut_last to simplify string manipulation operations without manual index calculations ocaml/ocaml#14352
  • OCaml Core Opam configuration tooling enhanced by David Allsopp with ocaml-config.install deployment script and historical compatibility support for system compilers ocaml/ocaml#14351
  • OCaml Core C dependency generation fixed in otherlibs build system by David Allsopp to properly handle compilation dependencies ocaml/ocaml#14356
  • OCaml Core Documentation formatting corrected for polymorphic function parameters feature by Bozhidar Batsov ocaml/ocaml#14357
  • OCaml Ecosystem OPAM 2.5.0~beta1 released with 8 core packages (opam-client, opam-core, opam-devel, opam-format, opam-installer, opam-repository, opam-solver, opam-state) by Kate ocaml/opam-repository#28877, with changelog added to ocaml/ocaml.org ocaml/ocaml.org#3395, including dry-run mode fixes preventing switch directory creation ocaml/opam#6540, macOS sandbox fixes allowing writes in /var/folders/ and /var/db/mds/ directories required by macOS core tools ocaml/opam#4797, and version-equivalent package rename bug fix ocaml/opam#6774
  • OxCaml Shareable mode added to portability axis in oxcaml/oxcaml, distinguishing functions that capture shared state and can execute in parallel from portable (contended) and nonportable (uncontended) functions oxcaml/oxcaml#4982
  • OxCaml Slambda intermediate representation introduced in oxcaml/oxcaml as new compilation phase between lambda and static evaluation, with -dslambda flag for debugging oxcaml/oxcaml#4776
  • OxCaml SIMD load/store intrinsics for all SSE and AVX operations using memory operands in oxcaml/oxcaml, including specialized handling for maskmovdqu with implicit RDI addressing oxcaml/oxcaml#4994, oxcaml/oxcaml#4988
  • OxCaml Global implies aliased constraint enforced syntactically in oxcaml/oxcaml, preventing unsound @@ global unique combinations for future borrowing implementation oxcaml/oxcaml#4889
  • OxCaml Mode hints for containing relationships added between containers (tuples, records, arrays) and their elements in oxcaml/oxcaml, improving error messages oxcaml/oxcaml#4919
  • OxCaml Share context moved to mode hints in oxcaml/oxcaml through new Is_used_in hint and Const_closure_lock, replacing previous share_context mechanism oxcaml/oxcaml#4983
  • OxCaml Camlinternaleval shared JIT in oxcaml/oxcaml allowing mdx to reuse bindings across fragments without bundle mechanism oxcaml/oxcaml#4900, oxcaml/oxcaml#4909, oxcaml/oxcaml#4899
  • OxCaml Installation of .cms files alongside .cmt files in oxcaml/oxcaml for debug information and Merlin integration, adding 352 files (~4 MB) oxcaml/oxcaml#5005
  • OxCaml AFL instrumentation flags support (-afl-instrument and -afl-inst-ratio) added to oxcaml/merlin to enable fuzzing workflows without Merlin interference oxcaml/merlin#198
  • OxCaml Ghost location filtering in syntax documentation for oxcaml/merlin to fix spurious [@nontail] attribute hints from PPX-generated ghost nodes oxcaml/merlin#197
  • OxCaml Parameterized library crash prevention in oxcaml/merlin through proper handling of module name types and dependency tracking in short path analysis oxcaml/merlin#196
  • OCaml Tools Portable lockdirs enabled by default in ocaml/dune by Stephen Sherratt, making lock directories work across different platforms ocaml/dune#12680
  • OCaml Tools Autolocking feature in ocaml/dune by Ali Caglayan, allowing building package dependencies without running dune pkg lock first when (pkg enabled) is in dune-workspace ocaml/dune#12653
  • OCaml Tools Unused libraries detection via new @unused-libs alias in ocaml/dune by Rudi Grinberg to detect unused library dependencies ocaml/dune#12623
  • OCaml Tools New dune describe tests command in ocaml/dune by Leitao -- Pereira Dias Rodrigue providing comprehensive test metadata ocaml/dune#12545
  • OCaml Tools Artifact variables %{cmt:...} and %{cmti:...} in ocaml/dune by Ali Caglayan for referencing compiled annotation files with typed AST ocaml/dune#12634
  • OCaml Tools PPX pform %{ppx:lib1+..+libn} in ocaml/dune by Rudi Grinberg for referring to ppx executables in tests ocaml/dune#12711
  • OCaml Tools Package build progress enabled by default in ocaml/dune by Puneeth Chaganti, now respecting display settings ocaml/dune#12695
  • OCaml Tools CoqProject file generation in ocaml/dune by Rodolphe Lepigre with opt-in (generate_project_file) in coq.theory stanza for better editor support ocaml/dune#11752
  • OCaml Tools Coqdoc header and footer customization in ocaml/dune by Rodolphe Lepigre with new coqdoc_header and coqdoc_footer fields ocaml/dune#11131
  • OCaml Tools Fixed runtime behavior in ocsigen/jsofocaml for target-env=browser to eliminate erroneous require("node:util") and similar Node.js imports in browser-targeted builds ocsigen/jsofocaml#2129
  • OCaml Ecosystem Catala 1.0.0 legal programming language reached production milestone ocaml/opam-repository#28853
  • OCaml Ecosystem OCaml/Unikraft 1.1.0 adds support for OCaml 5.4.0 and Unikraft 0.20.0 with 19 updated packages ocaml/opam-repository#28750
  • OCaml Ecosystem Frama-C 32.0~beta (Germanium) introduces ANSI color terminal support, improved C23 alignment directives, and new \aligned predicate in ACSL ocaml/opam-repository#28842
  • OCaml Ecosystem libdrm 0.1 initial release provides OCaml bindings for Direct Rendering Manager ocaml/opam-repository#28883
  • OCaml Ecosystem raga 0.1.0 new static site generator with Handlebars templating by Kaustubh Maske Patil ocaml/opam-repository#28847
  • OCaml Ecosystem handlebars-ml 0.3.0 brings Handlebars.js templating to OCaml ocaml/opam-repository#28846
  • OCaml Ecosystem jsonfeed 1.1.0 parser for JSON Feed specification by Anil Madhavapeddy ocaml/opam-repository#28884
  • OCaml Ecosystem crockford 1.0.0 implements Crockford Base32 encoding ocaml/opam-repository#28885
  • OCaml Ecosystem tsdl 1.2.0 adds preferred locales support and message box fixes for SDL2 bindings ocaml/opam-repository#28878
  • OCaml Ecosystem ctypes 0.24.0 foreign function interface library update ocaml/opam-repository#28855
  • OCaml Ecosystem patch 3.1.0 performance improvements using rope data structure ocaml/opam-repository#28854
  • OCaml Ecosystem moonpool 0.10 thread/domain pools with breaking changes (removed around_task and moonpool.fib) ocaml/opam-repository#28891
  • OCaml Ecosystem ansifmt 2.0.0 complete rewrite using rich-string for ANSI terminal styling ocaml/opam-repository#28803
  • OCaml Ecosystem visitors.20251114 syntax extension for generating visitor classes by François Pottier ocaml/opam-repository#28893
  • OCaml Ecosystem Binaryen WebAssembly tooling with 9 packages released: libbinaryen 122.0.1, 123.0.1, 124.0.1 and binaryen 0.32.0, 0.33.0, 0.34.0 by Oscar Spencer ocaml/opam-repository#28859, ocaml/opam-repository#28860, ocaml/opam-repository#28861, ocaml/opam-repository#28880, ocaml/opam-repository#28887, ocaml/opam-repository#28888
  • OCaml Ecosystem logs 0.10.0 logging library update, bytesrw 0.3.0 bytes readers and writers library, bitstring 5.0.2 pattern matching for binary data, directories 0.7 platform-appropriate standard directories, and elpi 3.4.3 embeddable lambda-Prolog interpreter merged

    • Group Activity Summaries

    OCaml Ecosystem

    OPAM 2.5.0~beta1 released with 43 packages merged including Catala 1.0.0, WebAssembly tooling, and cross-platform improvements

    New Features

  • OPAM 2.5.0~beta1 released with 8 core packages (opam-client, opam-core, opam-devel, opam-format, opam-installer, opam-repository, opam-solver, opam-state) by Kate (ocaml/opam-repository#28877), with changelog added to ocaml/ocaml.org (ocaml/ocaml.org#3395)
  • Catala 1.0.0 legal programming language reached production milestone (ocaml/opam-repository#28853)
  • OCaml/Unikraft 1.1.0 adds support for OCaml 5.4.0 and Unikraft 0.20.0 with 19 updated packages (ocaml/opam-repository#28750)
  • Frama-C 32.0~beta (Germanium) introduces ANSI color terminal support, improved C23 alignment directives, and new \aligned predicate in ACSL (ocaml/opam-repository#28842)
  • libdrm 0.1 initial release provides OCaml bindings for Direct Rendering Manager (ocaml/opam-repository#28883)
  • raga 0.1.0 new static site generator with Handlebars templating by Kaustubh Maske Patil (ocaml/opam-repository#28847)
  • handlebars-ml 0.3.0 brings Handlebars.js templating to OCaml (ocaml/opam-repository#28846)
  • jsonfeed 1.1.0 parser for JSON Feed specification by Anil Madhavapeddy (ocaml/opam-repository#28884)
  • crockford 1.0.0 implements Crockford Base32 encoding (ocaml/opam-repository#28885)
  • tsdl 1.2.0 adds preferred locales support and message box fixes for SDL2 bindings (ocaml/opam-repository#28878)
  • ctypes 0.24.0 foreign function interface library update (ocaml/opam-repository#28855)
  • patch 3.1.0 performance improvements using rope data structure (ocaml/opam-repository#28854)
  • moonpool 0.10 thread/domain pools with breaking changes (removed around_task and moonpool.fib) (ocaml/opam-repository#28891)
  • ansifmt 2.0.0 complete rewrite using rich-string for ANSI terminal styling (ocaml/opam-repository#28803)

    Compiler work on modes system, SIMD intrinsics, and slambda IR with IDE tooling improvements in Merlin

    New Features

  • Shareable mode added to portability axis in oxcaml/oxcaml, distinguishing functions that capture shared state and can execute in parallel from portable (contended) and nonportable (uncontended) functions (oxcaml/oxcaml#4982)
  • Slambda intermediate representation introduced in oxcaml/oxcaml as new compilation phase between lambda and static evaluation, with -dslambda flag for debugging (oxcaml/oxcaml#4776)
  • SIMD load/store intrinsics for all SSE and AVX operations using memory operands in oxcaml/oxcaml, including specialized handling for maskmovdqu with implicit RDI addressing (oxcaml/oxcaml#4994, oxcaml/oxcaml#4988)
  • Global implies aliased constraint enforced syntactically in oxcaml/oxcaml, preventing unsound @@ global unique combinations for future borrowing implementation (oxcaml/oxcaml#4889)
  • Mode hints for containing relationships added between containers (tuples, records, arrays) and their elements in oxcaml/oxcaml, improving error messages (oxcaml/oxcaml#4919)
  • Share context moved to mode hints in oxcaml/oxcaml through new Is_used_in hint and Const_closure_lock, replacing previous share_context mechanism (oxcaml/oxcaml#4983)
  • Camlinternaleval shared JIT in oxcaml/oxcaml allowing mdx to reuse bindings across fragments without bundle mechanism (oxcaml/oxcaml#4900, oxcaml/oxcaml#4909, oxcaml/oxcaml#4899)
  • Installation of .cms files alongside .cmt files in oxcaml/oxcaml for debug information and Merlin integration, adding 352 files (~4 MB) (oxcaml/oxcaml#5005)
  • AFL instrumentation flags support (-afl-instrument and -afl-inst-ratio) added to oxcaml/merlin to enable fuzzing workflows without Merlin interference (oxcaml/merlin#198)
  • Ghost location filtering in syntax documentation for oxcaml/merlin to fix spurious [@nontail] attribute hints from PPX-generated ghost nodes (oxcaml/merlin#197)
  • Parameterized library crash prevention in oxcaml/merlin through proper handling of module name types and dependency tracking in short path analysis (oxcaml/merlin#196)

  • Opam system compiler capabilities expanded with PRs by David Allsopp enabling trunk compiler installation (ocaml/ocaml#14354) and branch pinning (ocaml/ocaml#14355)

  • Runtime fixes progressing with ephemeron marking improvements by Gabriel Scherer (ocaml/ocaml#14338) and backup thread synchronization by Gabriel Scherer (ocaml/ocaml#14303)
  • Platform integration work continues with Haiku native backend activation by Anarchos (ocaml/ocaml#14138) and typing recovery from Merlin by Xavier Van de Woestyne (ocaml/ocaml#14241)
  • Termux/Android build issues resolved with three issues closed after fixing getentropy and build system problems (ocaml/ocaml#14087, ocaml/ocaml#13380, ocaml/ocaml#14346)

    • Notable Discussions

  • String module API design discussion by Daniel Bünzli exploring improvements to string manipulation functions, directly related to the merged splitting functions and newly proposed predicate variants (ocaml/ocaml#14137)
  • DLS API redesign discussion by Gabriel Scherer examining potential improvements to domain-local storage mechanisms (ocaml/ocaml#13356)
  • Repository maintenance discussion about TODO.md documentation updates proposed by @TimeForTypes (ocaml/ocaml#14361)
  • Domain backtrace inheritance issue discussing whether Printexc.record_backtrace true should be inherited by new domains, with recent interest from Nathan Taylor who offered to work on it (ocaml/ocaml#12363)

    • Emerging Trends

  • Standard library ergonomics receiving focused attention through String module extensions that eliminate manual index calculations, building on community feedback about API usability from Daniel Bünzli (ocaml/ocaml#14137)
  • Opam ecosystem integration being strengthened with improved system compiler support, historical compatibility tracking, and relocatable installation capabilities to ease distribution and deployment (ocaml/ocaml#14351, ocaml/ocaml#14354, ocaml/ocaml#14355)
  • Runtime robustness concerns emerging with multiple segfault reports in Memprof by Austin Theriault (ocaml/ocaml#14340, ocaml/ocaml#14341), ephemeron handling by Jan Midtgaard (ocaml/ocaml#14349), and domain shutdown issues (ocaml/ocaml#14319)
  • Developer tooling improvements proposed including debugger command history by Joel Reymont (ocaml/ocaml#14353) and AI contribution guidelines discussion (ocaml/ocaml#14052)

    • Multicore

    Proposal for new environment update API in Eio to support capability-based programming patterns

    Overview

  • Activity this week focused on ocaml-multicore/eio, with a new API proposal to improve ergonomics for capability-based programming
  • Patrick Ferris proposed ocaml-multicore/eio#823 to add Eio_unix.Stdenv.with_env function for updating environments with modified capabilities
  • Anil Madhavapeddy participated in design discussions, suggesting potential reconsideration of object-based APIs for Eio resources
  • No activity was recorded in the other multicore repositories this week

    • Activity

  • Patrick Ferris opened ocaml-multicore/eio#823 proposing Eio_unix.Stdenv.with_env function to address ergonomic challenges when using subtyped environment patterns, where programs define custom environment types extending Eio_unix.Stdenv.t and need to swap individual capabilities like process managers for debugging or testing

    • Notable Discussions

  • Anil Madhavapeddy commented on ocaml-multicore/eio#823 expressing interest in reconsidering object-based APIs for Eio resources, suggesting that object ergonomics may be superior to the current Eio.Resource.T API approach
entry.summary: String module extended with splitting functions, opam 2.5.0~beta1 released, compiler advances with modes and SIMD, Eio environment API proposed

entry.title: Week 45, 2025: Mode system maturation and performance optimization across ecosystem with 37 PRs in OxCaml, package management nearing default status in tools
entry.content:
Weekly Summary

New Features

  • OxCaml F16C and FMA SIMD intrinsics added with new Float16x8, Float16x16, and Float16x32 vector types for half-precision floating-point operations, plus fused multiply-add support in oxcaml/oxcaml#4964 by Max Slater
  • OxCaml Domain index API exposed via Domain.self_index() to get a unique integer identifier for the current domain, in range [0; N-1] where N is the peak number of simultaneously running domains in oxcaml/oxcaml#4950 by Vesa Karvonen
  • OxCaml Thread-local storage primitive %tls_get added for accessing thread-local state blocks, complementing the existing domain-local state in oxcaml/oxcaml#4959 by Max Slater
  • OxCaml Untagged char range patterns now supported (e.g., #'a'..#'z') with improved match exhaustion checking for small integers and unboxed ints in oxcaml/oxcaml#4729 by James Rayman
  • OxCaml Unix module local annotations added to parameters in functions like execv, execve, openfile, read, write, stat, lstat, and many file operations to support locality modes in oxcaml/oxcaml#4830 by Vesa Karvonen
  • OxCaml Quiet flag for ocamldebug (-quiet) suppresses printing while executing initialization files, useful for cleaner startup in scripts in oxcaml/oxcaml#4869 by Jakub Bachurski
  • OCaml Core Unix library socket API modernization by Antonin Décimo deprecating union sock_addr_union in favor of standard struct sockaddr_storage and socklen_param_type in favor of socklen_t, with backward compatibility macros for C and C++ in ocaml/ocaml#14310
  • OCaml Core Runtime callback safety fix by Max Slater preventing segfaults by ensuring C callback mechanism properly calls caml_continuation_use when handling continuations, addressing dropped continuation issues in ocaml/ocaml#14337
  • OCaml Core GC ephemeron accounting improvements by Damien Doligez removing quadratic term from ephemeron marking work calculation to improve garbage collection pacing accuracy in ocaml/ocaml#14336
  • OCaml Core GC work accounting fixes by Damien Doligez correcting domain-local work counter tracking for mark and sweep phases to prevent pacing logic errors in ocaml/ocaml#14329
  • OCaml Core Runtime header improvements by Antonin Décimo making self-standing by adding necessary includes, improving C extension compatibility in ocaml/ocaml#14342
  • OCaml Tools Merlin performance improved 25% for error queries through lazy buffer indexing that only performs indexing when queries require it in ocaml/merlin#1991 by Ulysse
  • OCaml Tools Merlin short-paths optimization eliminating forced substitutions in graph construction, addressing performance issues in large modules especially with ppx_template in ocaml/merlin#1988 by Liam Stevenson
  • OCaml Tools Merlin parser generation now uses --lalr flag for menhir invocations, matching the compiler's configuration for improved parser performance in oxcaml/merlin#194 by Liam Stevenson
  • OCaml Tools OCaml-LSP mlx support added full LSP features for .mlx files including diagnostics, code actions, hover, formatting via ocamlformat-mlx, and counterpart file discovery in ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1528 by David Sancho
  • OCaml Tools Dune package management made progress with error deduplication for portable lockdirs in ocaml/dune#12684 and ocaml/dune#12670, cross-device link error handling via copy+delete fallback in ocaml/dune#12649, and improved runtest error messages with better hints in ocaml/dune#12663 by Stephen Sherratt and Ali Caglayan
  • OCaml Tools opam 2.5.0-beta1 release preparation included macOS sandbox fix allowing access to /var/folders/ and /var/db/mds/ directories in ocaml/opam#4797, version-equivalent package rename bug fix in ocaml/opam#6774, and AppArmor abi/4.0 support checking in ocaml/opam#6764
  • OCaml Tools Jsofocaml PPX fixes resolved spurious unused variable warnings for self in object%js in ocsigen/jsofocaml#2128 and restored labelled arguments support for methods broken in 6.2.0 in ocsigen/jsofocaml#2126
  • OCaml Ecosystem Flux streaming library introduces composable streaming abstractions with Miou for concurrent programming in ocaml/opam-repository#28804 by Calascibetta Romain
  • OCaml Ecosystem Elpi 3.4.3 embeddable λProlog interpreter with updated language features and improved performance in ocaml/opam-repository#28832 by Enrico Tassi
  • OCaml Ecosystem Binaryen bindings series adding OCaml bindings for binaryen versions 0.28.0 through 0.31.0 and libbinaryen 122.0.0 through 124.0.0 by Oscar Spencer in ocaml/opam-repository#28817, ocaml/opam-repository#28819, ocaml/opam-repository#28821, ocaml/opam-repository#28822, ocaml/opam-repository#28823, ocaml/opam-repository#28824, ocaml/opam-repository#28809
  • OCaml Ecosystem Core library updates by Daniel Bünzli including bytesrw 0.3.0 with cryptographic random module in ocaml/opam-repository#28836, logs 0.10.0 with mutex safety improvements in ocaml/opam-repository#28838, topkg 1.1.1 in ocaml/opam-repository#28833, and cmarkit 0.4.0 with CommonMark 0.31.2 support in ocaml/opam-repository#28811
  • OCaml Ecosystem Compilation target documentation added comprehensive guides covering native code (ocamlopt), bytecode (ocamlc), JavaScript targets (Jsofocaml and Melange), WebAssembly targets (wasmofocaml and Wasocaml), and unikernels (MirageOS) with platform support details and use case guidance in ocaml/ocaml.org#3378 by @sabine
  • OCaml Ecosystem OCaml Infrastructure article published detailing how ocaml/opam-repository works, including CI pipeline architecture with OCurrent-powered testing, governance policies, and maintainer acknowledgments in ocaml/ocaml.org#3379 by @sabine

    • Group Activity Summaries

    OCaml Ecosystem

    Package ecosystem growth with 35+ new releases and comprehensive platform documentation covering all OCaml compilation targets

    New Features

  • Flux streaming library (ocaml/opam-repository#28804) by Calascibetta Romain introduces composable streaming abstractions with Miou for concurrent programming
  • Elpi 3.4.3 (ocaml/opam-repository#28832) by Enrico Tassi provides embeddable λProlog interpreter with updated language features and improved performance
  • ppxexpectnobase 0.17.3.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#28790) by Dmitrii Kosarev delivers cram-like testing framework with stripped dependencies for lighter-weight testing
  • Binaryen bindings series (ocaml/opam-repository#28817, ocaml/opam-repository#28819, ocaml/opam-repository#28821, ocaml/opam-repository#28822, ocaml/opam-repository#28823, ocaml/opam-repository#28824, ocaml/opam-repository#28809) by Oscar Spencer adds OCaml bindings for binaryen versions 0.28.0 through 0.31.0 and libbinaryen 122.0.0 through 124.0.0
  • Core library updates by Daniel Bünzli including bytesrw 0.3.0 with cryptographic random module (ocaml/opam-repository#28836), logs 0.10.0 with mutex safety improvements (ocaml/opam-repository#28838), topkg 1.1.1 (ocaml/opam-repository#28833), and cmarkit 0.4.0 with CommonMark 0.31.2 support (ocaml/opam-repository#28811)
  • QCheck 0.27 (ocaml/opam-repository#28808) by Jan Midtgaard updates property-based testing framework across 4 packages
  • FFmpeg bindings 1.2.7 (ocaml/opam-repository#28810) by Casey Reeves provides updated bindings across 8 packages for multimedia processing
  • Compilation target documentation (ocaml/ocaml.org#3378) by @sabine added comprehensive guides covering native code (ocamlopt), bytecode (ocamlc), JavaScript targets (Jsofocaml and Melange), WebAssembly targets (wasmofocaml and Wasocaml), and unikernels (MirageOS) with platform support details and use case guidance
  • OCaml Infrastructure article (ocaml/ocaml.org#3379) by @sabine published detailing how ocaml/opam-repository works, including CI pipeline architecture with OCurrent-powered testing, governance policies, and maintainer acknowledgments

    • Overview

  • Package ecosystem expanded with 35+ contributors submitting new packages and updates across ocaml/opam-repository, including streaming libraries, testing frameworks, WebAssembly tooling, and core library maintenance
  • Platform support improvements added Centos 9+ and Fedora 41+ configuration packages (ocaml/opam-repository#28814, ocaml/opam-repository#28828, ocaml/opam-repository#28829, ocaml/opam-repository#28831) and Windows CI workflow enhancements (ocaml/opam-repository#28856, ocaml/opam-repository#28806)
  • Documentation infrastructure advanced with comprehensive compilation target guides (ocaml/ocaml.org#3378) covering all OCaml deployment options and infrastructure transparency article (ocaml/ocaml.org#3379) explaining opam-repository operations
  • Pending releases include Melange 6.0.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#28866), reason 3.17.1 (ocaml/opam-repository#28867), Catala 1.0.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#28853), and Frama-C 32.0 beta (ocaml/opam-repository#28842)

    • Activity

  • Melange 6.0.0 and reason 3.17.1 (ocaml/opam-repository#28866, ocaml/opam-repository#28867) by Antonio Nuno Monteiro awaiting merge with printer improvements for JavaScript compilation toolchain
  • Catala 1.0.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#28853) law specification language by Louis Gesbert in review
  • Frama-C 32.0 beta Germanium (ocaml/opam-repository#28842) with ANSI terminal support by Basile Desloges, plus frama-c-metacsl 0.10~beta (ocaml/opam-repository#28841) and frama-clang 0.0.19~beta (ocaml/opam-repository#28843) in progress
  • Additional package submissions include acgtk 2.2.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#28858), ctypes 0.24.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#28855), patch 3.1.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#28854), qcaml 0.1.4 quantum computing library (ocaml/opam-repository#28840), ansifmt 2.0.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#28803), and OCaml/Unikraft 1.1.0 with OCaml 5.4.0 support (ocaml/opam-repository#28750)
  • Video scraper fix (ocaml/ocaml.org#3392) by @sabine in progress to increase YAML buffer size and address decode error preventing automated video scraping
  • Documentation tutorial enhancement (ocaml/ocaml.org#3391) by @sabine adding dune ocaml doc command to generating-documentation guide based on suggestion from Ali Caglayan
  • Merged package updates include bitstring 5.0.2 (ocaml/opam-repository#28837), directories 0.7 (ocaml/opam-repository#28830), climate 0.8.6 (ocaml/opam-repository#28839), oplot 0.85 (ocaml/opam-repository#28826), and coq-waterproof 3.1.0+9.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#28835)
  • Automated blog scraping continued with merged PRs adding new OCaml blog posts and videos (ocaml/ocaml.org#3387, ocaml/ocaml.org#3389) and Ryan Gibb's OCaml feed added to planet sources (ocaml/ocaml.org#3388)

    • Notable Discussions

  • Windows CI improvements proposal (ocaml/opam-repository#28856) by @shym to implement x-ci-accept-failures handling in Windows CI tests matching other platforms, emerged from OCaml/Unikraft work (ocaml/opam-repository#28750)
  • Unison Windows compatibility (ocaml/opam-repository#28851) discussion by Jacques-Henri Jourdan regarding host-system-msys conflicts and proper platform constraints, with input from Jan Midtgaard on correct Windows filtering syntax
  • Opam metadata format discussion (ocaml/opam-repository#28865) by @art-w identifying solo5 packages with duplicate x-ci-accept-failures fields causing opam2json errors
  • Compilation targets documentation review (ocaml/ocaml.org#3378) received detailed feedback from @ILeandersson on British English consistency and Frédéric Loyer about WebAssembly support in Dune and MirageOS build system details
  • Infrastructure documentation review (ocaml/ocaml.org#3379) with Anil Madhavapeddy clarifying infrastructure funding sources and Mark Elvers ensuring IBM LinuxONE and Marist University s390x CI contributions were properly credited
  • Planet feed issue (ocaml/ocaml.org#3394) reported by Hannes Mehnert regarding blog article not appearing in Planet feed despite being present in atom feed

    • Emerging Trends

  • Centos and Fedora platform support expansion by Jan Midtgaard systematically addressing configuration package gaps across ffmpeg (ocaml/opam-repository#28814, ocaml/opam-repository#28828), python (ocaml/opam-repository#28829), and OpenGL libraries (ocaml/opam-repository#28831) for Centos 9+ and Fedora 41+
  • WebAssembly ecosystem growth with binaryen binding series (ocaml/opam-repository#28817 through ocaml/opam-repository#28824) by Oscar Spencer supporting Grain language development, plus comprehensive WebAssembly documentation (ocaml/ocaml.org#3378) covering wasmofocaml and Wasocaml compilation targets
  • JavaScript compilation toolchain activity with Melange 6.0.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#28866) and reason 3.17.1 (ocaml/opam-repository#28867) by Antonio Nuno Monteiro, documented alongside Jsofocaml in compilation targets guide (ocaml/ocaml.org#3378)
  • Formal verification ecosystem development with Frama-C 32.0 beta (ocaml/opam-repository#28842), frama-clang (ocaml/opam-repository#28843), frama-c-metacsl (ocaml/opam-repository#28841), coq-waterproof (ocaml/opam-repository#28835), and Catala 1.0.0 law specification language (ocaml/opam-repository#28853)
  • Platform documentation maturity with comprehensive guides covering all compilation targets from traditional native/bytecode to modern web and cloud deployments (ocaml/ocaml.org#3378), plus infrastructure transparency article (ocaml/ocaml.org#3379) explaining opam-repository operations
  • Windows platform compatibility improvements including constraint syntax corrections (ocaml/opam-repository#28805), CI test enhancements (ocaml/opam-repository#28856), workflow variable visibility (ocaml/opam-repository#28806), and platform filtering discussions (ocaml/opam-repository#28851)
  • OCaml 5.x ecosystem support continuing with Unikraft 1.1.0 adding OCaml 5.4.0 support (ocaml/opam-repository#28750), ocaml-system dev version matching (ocaml/opam-repository#28455), and MLCUDDIDL 5.0 compatibility work (ocaml/opam-repository#28849)

    • OCaml Tools

    Package management maturation with Dune lockdirs nearing default, opam 2.5.0-beta1 prep, and performance improvements across tools

    New Features

  • Dune package management made significant progress with error deduplication for portable lockdirs (ocaml/dune#12684, ocaml/dune#12670), cross-device link error handling via copy+delete fallback (ocaml/dune#12649), and improved runtest error messages with better hints (ocaml/dune#12663)
  • opam 2.5.0-beta1 release preparation included macOS sandbox fix allowing access to /var/folders/ and /var/db/mds/ directories (ocaml/opam#4797), version-equivalent package rename bug fix (ocaml/opam#6774), and AppArmor abi/4.0 support checking (ocaml/opam#6764)
  • Merlin performance improved 25% for error queries through lazy buffer indexing that only performs indexing when queries require it (ocaml/merlin#1991), plus short-paths optimizations eliminating forced substitutions (ocaml/merlin#1988)
  • OCaml-LSP mlx support added full LSP features for .mlx files including diagnostics, code actions, hover, formatting via ocamlformat-mlx, and counterpart file discovery (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1528)
  • Jsofocaml PPX fixes resolved spurious unused variable warnings for self in object%js (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2128) and restored labelled arguments support for methods broken in 6.2.0 (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2126)

    • Overview

  • Dune focused on portable lock directories maturation with 10 PRs merged addressing error handling, cross-device links, and user experience improvements (ocaml/dune#12684, ocaml/dune#12649), while Shon Feder identified a performance regression showing 3 orders of magnitude slowdown in no-op builds when using package management (ocaml/dune#12693)
  • opam entered release preparation mode with Kate leading cmdliner vendoring to avoid breaking changes (ocaml/opam#6755), OCaml 5.5 support (ocaml/opam#6670), and 2.5.0-beta1 release PR (ocaml/opam#6787)
  • Merlin achieved measurable performance gains with Ulysse implementing lazy buffer indexing delivering 25% speedup (ocaml/merlin#1991) and Liam Stevenson optimizing short-paths graph construction (ocaml/merlin#1988)
  • OCaml-LSP added comprehensive .mlx file support by David Sancho with formatting integration and full LSP features (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1528)
  • Jsofocaml maintained PPX reliability with bug fixes for unused variable warnings and labelled arguments while continuing development on effects implementation and WASI runtime (ocsigen/jsofocaml#1832, ocsigen/jsofocaml#1831)
  • odoc saw UI/UX discussions around code block rendering and module navigation improvements with Jon Ludlam providing technical guidance (ocaml/odoc#1389, ocaml/odoc#1386)
  • ocamlfind, opam-file-format, and spawn had no activity this week

    • Activity

  • Dune portable lockdirs approaching production readiness with Stephen Sherratt proposing to make it default (ocaml/dune#12680) and Shon Feder proposing default configuration (ocaml/dune#12694), while Ali Caglayan led testing improvements (ocaml/dune#12664, ocaml/dune#12663) and CI enhancements (ocaml/dune#12690)
  • opam 2.5.0-beta1 release preparation included extensive backporting to 2.5 branch with R. Boujbel working on dry-run mode fixes (ocaml/opam#6788, ocaml/opam#6565) and @arozovyk fixing version-equivalent package bugs (ocaml/opam#6774) and cache invalidation issues (ocaml/opam#6782)
  • Merlin cache architecture evolved with Ulysse refactoring imperative stamped hashtable to sharing-based approach (ocaml/merlin#1990), enabling lazy indexing implementation that delivers 25% speedup (ocaml/merlin#1991)
  • OCaml-LSP build system interoperability improved with Ulysse implementing more natural fallback to .merlin files when no dune-project exists (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1563), addressing ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1522
  • Jsofocaml Wasm development continued with Jérôme Vouillon working on effects implementation based on Stack Switching proposal (ocsigen/jsofocaml#1832), WASI runtime with wasmtime support (ocsigen/jsofocaml#1831), and string conversion optimizations (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2124)
  • OxCaml ecosystem development progressed in Dune with @art-w developing parameterized libraries instantiation (ocaml/dune#12561) and Sudha Parimala completing tooling support analysis for Merlin and OCaml-LSP (ocaml/dune#12536)

    • Notable Discussions

  • Package management performance regression in Dune identified by Shon Feder showing 3 orders of magnitude slowdown (850ms → 12s) in no-op builds when using dune package management (ocaml/dune#12693), prompting proposal for benchmarking CI to prevent future regressions (ocaml/dune#12702)
  • cmdliner vendoring decision in opam sparked technical discussion where Daniel Bünzli (cmdliner author) argued for upgrading to 2.0.0 for better shell completion, while Kate and R. Boujbel prioritized CLI stability for opam 2.x series, ultimately proceeding with vendoring (ocaml/opam#6755)
  • Dune package management usability issues surfaced with Ali Caglayan reporting that dune cannot execute pkg build rules when dune binary not in PATH (ocaml/dune#12697) and requesting SSH URL support for package repositories to match opam functionality (ocaml/dune#12701)
  • LSP protocol enhancement proposal from Xavier Van de Woestyne suggesting optional parameter for identifier-based lookup in definition/declaration requests to leverage Merlin's locate-ident and occurrences capabilities for improved Emacs integration (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1570)
  • odoc navigation UX discussed by FrançoisT comparing sibling module navigation (3 clicks in odoc vs 1 in Rustdoc), with Jon Ludlam explaining odoc 3's global navigation feature and need for dune rules updates (ocaml/odoc#1386)

    • Emerging Trends

  • Package management maturation across both Dune and opam with portable lockdirs approaching default status in Dune (ocaml/dune#12680, ocaml/dune#12694) and opam 2.5.0-beta1 resolving long-standing cross-platform issues (ocaml/opam#4797, ocaml/opam#6779)
  • Performance optimization focus with lazy evaluation patterns emerging in Merlin for both short-paths and buffer indexing (ocaml/merlin#1988, ocaml/merlin#1991), Dune identifying no-op build regression (ocaml/dune#12693), and opam updating patch for better diff handling (ocaml/opam#6772)
  • Error message quality improvements spanning Dune solver diagnostics deduplication (ocaml/dune#12670, ocaml/dune#12684), runtest hints (ocaml/dune#12663), and opam stale directory cleanup UX (ocaml/opam#6735)
  • Cross-platform compatibility emphasized with opam Windows build fixes (ocaml/opam#6769), macOS sandbox improvements (ocaml/opam#4797), and Linux AppArmor abi/4.0 support (ocaml/opam#6764)
  • Dialect and alternate syntax support expanding with OCaml-LSP .mlx file support (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1528) and Dune Melange documentation overhaul (ocaml/dune#12631)
  • Wasm capabilities development in jsofocaml with effects implementation using Stack Switching proposal (ocsigen/jsofocaml#1832), WASI runtime support (ocsigen/jsofocaml#1831), and performance optimizations (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2124)
  • Long-standing issue resolution prioritized in opam with multiple 4+ year old bugs fixed including macOS sandbox from 2021 (ocaml/opam#4797) and file-to-directory rename from 2019 (ocaml/opam#6779)

    • OxCaml

    Mode system maturation, SIMD expansion, and performance optimizations across compiler and tooling with 37 PRs merged.

    New Features

  • F16C and FMA SIMD intrinsics added with new Float16x8, Float16x16, and Float16x32 vector types for half-precision floating-point operations, plus fused multiply-add support in oxcaml/oxcaml#4964 by Max Slater
  • Domain index API exposed via Domain.self_index() to get a unique integer identifier for the current domain, in range [0; N-1] where N is the peak number of simultaneously running domains in oxcaml/oxcaml#4950 by Vesa Karvonen
  • Thread-local storage primitive %tls_get added for accessing thread-local state blocks, complementing the existing domain-local state in oxcaml/oxcaml#4959 by Max Slater
  • Untagged char range patterns now supported (e.g., #'a'..#'z') with improved match exhaustion checking for small integers and unboxed ints in oxcaml/oxcaml#4729 by James Rayman
  • Short-paths graph construction in Merlin no longer forces expensive substitutions, addressing performance issues in large modules especially with ppx_template in oxcaml/merlin#193 by Liam Stevenson
  • Parser generation in Merlin now uses --lalr flag for menhir invocations, matching the compiler's configuration for improved parser performance in oxcaml/merlin#194 by Liam Stevenson
  • Index caching in Merlin refactored to use lazy evaluation, with the index buffer only computed when queries actually need it in oxcaml/merlin#195 by Liam Stevenson
  • Unix module local annotations added to parameters in functions like execv, execve, openfile, read, write, stat, lstat, and many file operations to support locality modes in oxcaml/oxcaml#4830 by Vesa Karvonen
  • Quiet flag for ocamldebug (-quiet) suppresses printing while executing initialization files, useful for cleaner startup in scripts in oxcaml/oxcaml#4869 by Jakub Bachurski
  • Locking scheme version added to track runtime locking protocol changes in oxcaml/oxcaml#4958
  • Stdlib local annotations now printed for standard library functions to improve visibility of locality mode constraints in oxcaml/oxcaml#4943
  • Skiplist for natdynlink roots in the runtime improves performance of dynamic linking in oxcaml/oxcaml#4949

    • Overview

  • 37 PRs merged across oxcaml/oxcaml (34 PRs) and oxcaml/merlin (3 PRs) with 17 new PRs opened in oxcaml/oxcaml
  • Mode system maturation was the primary focus with Zesen Qian leading 11 merged PRs covering legacy syntax removal (oxcaml/oxcaml#4984, oxcaml/oxcaml#4968), improved error messages (oxcaml/oxcaml#4979), and mode compilation (oxcaml/oxcaml#4792)
  • SIMD capabilities expanded with F16C/FMA support (oxcaml/oxcaml#4964) and new WIP PRs for generalized memory operands (oxcaml/oxcaml#4988) and cast improvements (oxcaml/oxcaml#4987)
  • Performance optimization was a cross-repository theme with Xavier Clerc opening 5 WIP PRs on x86 peephole optimizations (oxcaml/oxcaml#4973, oxcaml/oxcaml#4975, oxcaml/oxcaml#4977, oxcaml/oxcaml#4985) and Liam Stevenson improving Merlin's type-checking performance (oxcaml/merlin#193) and making module finding lazy (oxcaml/oxcaml#4970)
  • Type system and jkinds work included adding levels to sort variables (oxcaml/oxcaml#4785), fixing or_null with default optional arguments (oxcaml/oxcaml#4953), and exceptions crossing statefulness (oxcaml/oxcaml#4891)
  • Locality mode annotations continued spreading through the standard library with Unix module coverage (oxcaml/oxcaml#4830) and improved printing support (oxcaml/oxcaml#4943)

    • Activity

  • Quotations and splicing saw fixes with Jakub Bachurski landing inclusion checks with quotes and splices in oxcaml/oxcaml#4974, Leo White fixing quotation unification in oxcaml/oxcaml#4906, and Zesen Qian fixing constructor quotation locks in oxcaml/oxcaml#4910
  • Compiler internals improved with Mark Shinwell removing global state from Linkenv in oxcaml/oxcaml#4947 and Luke Maurer fixing a segfault by disallowing aliases to parameter modules in oxcaml/oxcaml#4948
  • Documentation updates included Max Slater fixing tutorial typos in oxcaml/oxcaml#4954 and oxcaml/oxcaml#4969, and Zesen Qian rewording allocation hints in oxcaml/oxcaml#4957
  • New mode work started with Max Slater opening oxcaml/oxcaml#4982 for a new sharable mode and oxcaml/oxcaml#4983 to move share_context to mode hints
  • Runtime improvements included hole expression parsing enhancements (oxcaml/oxcaml#4956) and oxcaml-metrics push restoration (oxcaml/oxcaml#4967)

    • Emerging Trends

  • Mode system stabilization with migration away from legacy syntax (oxcaml/oxcaml#4984, oxcaml/oxcaml#4968), improved error messages (oxcaml/oxcaml#4979), and better tooling integration (oxcaml/oxcaml#4943)
  • Lazy evaluation patterns being applied systematically across the codebase for performance gains in short-paths (oxcaml/merlin#193), module finding (oxcaml/oxcaml#4970), and indexing (oxcaml/merlin#195)
  • SIMD instruction set expansion continuing with F16C/FMA support (oxcaml/oxcaml#4964) and ongoing work on memory operands (oxcaml/oxcaml#4988) and type conversions (oxcaml/oxcaml#4987)
  • Compiler optimization infrastructure being built out with peephole optimization framework (oxcaml/oxcaml#4973, oxcaml/oxcaml#4975, oxcaml/oxcaml#4977, oxcaml/oxcaml#4985) and runtime improvements (oxcaml/oxcaml#4949)
  • Locality mode adoption spreading through standard library APIs with Unix module coverage (oxcaml/oxcaml#4830) and enhanced visibility through annotation printing (oxcaml/oxcaml#4943)

    • OCaml Core

    Seven PRs merged in ocaml/ocaml focusing on runtime safety and API modernization, plus RFC governance improvements

    New Features

  • Unix library socket API modernization by Antonin Décimo deprecating union sock_addr_union in favor of standard struct sockaddr_storage and socklen_param_type in favor of socklen_t, with backward compatibility macros for C and C++ (ocaml/ocaml#14310)
  • Runtime callback safety fix by Max Slater preventing segfaults by ensuring C callback mechanism properly calls caml_continuation_use when handling continuations, addressing dropped continuation issues (ocaml/ocaml#14337)
  • GC ephemeron accounting improvements by Damien Doligez removing quadratic term from ephemeron marking work calculation to improve garbage collection pacing accuracy (ocaml/ocaml#14336)
  • GC work accounting fixes by Damien Doligez correcting domain-local work counter tracking for mark and sweep phases to prevent pacing logic errors (ocaml/ocaml#14329)
  • Runtime header improvements by Antonin Décimo making self-standing by adding necessary includes, improving C extension compatibility (ocaml/ocaml#14342)

    • Overview

  • Seven PRs merged in ocaml/ocaml covering Unix API modernization (ocaml/ocaml#14310, ocaml/ocaml#14342), GC pacing improvements (ocaml/ocaml#14336, ocaml/ocaml#14329), and runtime safety fixes (ocaml/ocaml#14337)
  • Two new governance PRs in ocaml/RFCs from Florian Angeletti focused on committee vote procedures (ocaml/RFCs#58) and conflict of interest policy (ocaml/RFCs#55)
  • Active code review and discussion across both repositories involving core team members from Inria, Tarides, Jane Street, and University of Cambridge
  • Multiple bug reports filed in ocaml/ocaml including Memprof segfaults (ocaml/ocaml#14341, ocaml/ocaml#14340), platform build issues (ocaml/ocaml#14346), and type system edge cases (ocaml/ocaml#14343)

    • Activity

  • Ephemeron marking edge case addressed by Gabriel Scherer with new PR fixing marking logic in major_gc.c (ocaml/ocaml#14338)
  • Relocatable OCaml initiative by David Allsopp progressing with five active PRs covering opam integration, search/suffix handling, relative libdir configuration, and explicit-relative paths in ld.conf (ocaml/ocaml#14246, ocaml/ocaml#14245, ocaml/ocaml#14244, ocaml/ocaml#14243, ocaml/ocaml#14250)
  • Multicore class initialization safety work continues with Vincent Laviron proposing atomic accesses for class cache operations, with discussion about mutex-based approaches versus atomics (ocaml/ocaml#14333)
  • Module spellchecking hints PR by Florian Angeletti under review with implementation discussion (ocaml/ocaml#14330)
  • Include functor language feature proposal by Olivier Nicole allowing functor inclusion syntax (ocaml/ocaml#14177)
  • Haiku native backend activation continuing with platform-specific changes by Anarchos (ocaml/ocaml#14138)
  • CI infrastructure updates including macOS 15 migration (ocaml/ocaml#14339) and C++ compiler installation for Cygwin testing (ocaml/ocaml#14347)
  • RFC governance refinements with vote procedure PR (ocaml/RFCs#58) and conflict of interest policy updates (ocaml/RFCs#55) by Florian Angeletti
  • Uniform array RFC discussion ongoing with Gabriel Scherer addressing mutability and syntax questions from Gaëtan Gilbert and Olivier Nicole (ocaml/RFCs#37)

    • Notable Discussions

  • Richard Eisenberg provided thoughtful analysis on how voting drives consensus in the Language Committee, noting that votes help map preferences but technical content overrides vote results when parsing or implementation concerns emerge (ocaml/RFCs#58)
  • Jeremy Yallop suggested refinements to conflict of interest policy language, focusing on bias in "technical judgment" rather than "discussion" to better capture core concerns (ocaml/RFCs#55)
  • Multicore class initialization safety debate between Vincent Laviron, Gabriel Scherer, and Nathan Taylor about whether atomic operations or mutex-based locking is appropriate for thread-safe class initialization (ocaml/ocaml#14333)
  • Unix socket API migration conversation led by Antonin Décimo and @shym about migration path from non-standard types to POSIX standard sockaddr_storage and socklen_t (ocaml/ocaml#14310)
  • Daniel Bünzli initiated discussion on String search API proposal for substring search functionality in standard library (ocaml/ocaml#14099)
  • Uniform array design debate with Gaëtan Gilbert raising questions about mutability requirements and array literal syntax compatibility, with Olivier Nicole noting type-disambiguated literals could resolve syntax concerns (ocaml/RFCs#37)

    • Emerging Trends

  • Runtime safety hardening focus across GC work accounting fixes (ocaml/ocaml#14329, ocaml/ocaml#14336), continuation handling in C callbacks (ocaml/ocaml#14337), and ephemeron marking corrections (ocaml/ocaml#14338) to improve multicore stability
  • API modernization drive moving Unix library toward standard POSIX types while maintaining backward compatibility through C11 _Generic macros and C++ overloading (ocaml/ocaml#14310, ocaml/ocaml#14342)
  • Governance process refinement in RFC repository with committee members clarifying decision-making procedures, transparency norms, and conflict of interest handling (ocaml/RFCs#58, ocaml/RFCs#55)
  • Platform support expansion with Haiku native backend work (ocaml/ocaml#14138), macOS 15 CI migration (ocaml/ocaml#14339), and Termux compatibility fixes (ocaml/ocaml#14346)
