  • Cross-institutional collaboration visible through contributions from Inria, Tarides, Jane Street, University of Cambridge, OCamlPro, and Semgrep engineers working together on compiler improvements and language design

    • Multicore

    Eio documentation fix merged and incremental directory reading API under active review

    New Features

  • Fixed documentation for Fiber.without_binding function in ocaml-multicore/eio to correctly show function name instead of referencing with_binding in the docstring (ocaml-multicore/eio#822)

    • Overview

  • Activity concentrated in ocaml-multicore/eio with documentation fix merged and draft PR for incremental directory reading API under active review (ocaml-multicore/eio#821, ocaml-multicore/eio#822)
  • Patrick Ferris authored both changes while Thomas Leonard reviewed the documentation fix and Anil Madhavapeddy provided feedback on API design (ocaml-multicore/eio#821, ocaml-multicore/eio#822)
  • No activity recorded in ocaml-multicore/domainslib, ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring, ocaml-multicore/meio, ocaml-multicore/saturn, ocaml-multicore/eio-trace, ocaml-multicore/picos, ocaml-multicore/kcas, or ocaml-multicore/ocaml-iomux

    • Activity

  • Incremental directory reading draft PR opened by Patrick Ferris proposing Eio.Path.walk API for directory traversal with sequences, showing performance improvements from 1.46s to 110ms on Eiolinux and 2.02s to 1.58s on Eioposix in benchmarks with 15-level deep directories containing 20,000 files (ocaml-multicore/eio#821)
  • Discussion between Patrick Ferris and Anil Madhavapeddy on whether the API should recurse into directories by default, with agreement that non-recursive behavior with manual descent allows building recursive functionality on top of the base interface (ocaml-multicore/eio#821)

    • Notable Discussions

  • API design discussion on incremental directory reading in ocaml-multicore/eio#821 between Patrick Ferris and Anil Madhavapeddy regarding whether Eio.Path.walk should recurse into directories by default, concluding that non-recursive behavior with manual descent provides better flexibility

    • Emerging Trends

  • Focus on improving file system operations performance in ocaml-multicore/eio with sequence-based incremental directory reading showing performance gains from 1.46s to 110ms on Eio_linux (ocaml-multicore/eio#821)
  • Preference for composable, non-recursive base APIs that enable building higher-level functionality rather than providing all features at the base level (ocaml-multicore/eio#821)
entry.summary: Mode system maturation and performance optimization across ecosystem with 37 PRs in OxCaml, package management nearing default status in tools

entry.title: Week 44, 2025: Type system precision and thread safety in core, compiler infrastructure advances in OxCaml, minimal multicore activity, ecosystem growth
entry.content:
Weekly Summary

New Features

  • OCaml Core Existential types now supported in as-patterns, completing previous work and lifting restrictions on retyping patterns containing existentials by Takafumi Saikawa in ocaml/ocaml#14327
  • OCaml Core Recursive module error messages improved with abstract environment for printing -short-paths and added error message for types considered abstract during recursive module checking by Brandon Stride in ocaml/ocaml#14037
  • OCaml Core Pattern constraint handling cleaned up by removing legacy hacks, with behavior change that let rec (_ as x) = ... is now consistently rejected instead of being treated as let rec x = ... by Vincent Laviron in ocaml/ocaml#14322
  • OCaml Core Type-level scope documentation added with detailed explanation of Ctype.create_scope and enforcement of current_level <= generic_level invariant by Jacques Garrigue in ocaml/ocaml#14331
  • OCaml Core TSan instrumentation fixed to properly instrument subexpressions and shared heap operations, addressing race detection gaps by Vincent Laviron in ocaml/ocaml#14332 and Gabriel Scherer in ocaml/ocaml#14335
  • OCaml Core Dune build support restored with fixes for label reordering and iarray availability in OCaml 5.4 by Gabriel Scherer in ocaml/ocaml#14328
  • OxCaml Thread naming support added via Thread.set_current_thread_name function backported from upstream OCaml, enabling developers to set thread names for improved debugging in GDB and stacktraces by Aspen Smith in oxcaml/oxcaml#4946
  • OxCaml Extended locking scheme interface with caml_domain_send_interrupt_hook callback for better backup thread interactions in multi-domain programs using non-default locking schemes, improving Python integration support by Stephen Dolan in oxcaml/oxcaml#4914
  • OxCaml Native Dynlink fix for parameterized modules, now correctly using Compilation_unit.full_path_as_string instead of name_as_string to distinguish compilation units differing only by arguments by Luke Maurer in oxcaml/oxcaml#4935
  • OxCaml DWARF test improvements with pedantic mode enabled by default and new test coverage for closures, larger data structures, tuples, and bigarrays to prevent regressions by Simon Spies in oxcaml/oxcaml#4626
  • OxCaml CI infrastructure upgrades deploying larger GitHub Actions runners across all CI jobs for improved build performance by Jacob Van Buren in oxcaml/oxcaml#4908
  • OxCaml Metrics collection modernization translating bash scripts to Python with type annotations and extensible CSV format supporting different metric types beyond artifact sizes by Xavier Clerc in oxcaml/oxcaml#4926 and oxcaml/oxcaml#4927
  • OxCaml Dune version constraint relaxation in ocaml-variants.5.2.0+ox from exact version 3.20.2+ox to allow versions greater than 3.20.2 by Patrick Ferris via commit oxcaml/opam-repository@159337c
  • Multicore OCaml 5.4 compatibility for benchmarks with Docker image updated to debian-ocaml-5.4 in ocaml-multicore/picos by Vesa Karvonen in ocaml-multicore/picos#377
  • Multicore Higher contention benchmarking for mpscq with 8 adder threads added to test suite in ocaml-multicore/picos via commit 6aaf75f
  • Multicore ocamlformat 0.28.1 upgrade with reformatting applied across 22 files affecting 248 additions and 289 deletions in ocaml-multicore/picos in ocaml-multicore/picos#376
  • OCaml Tools Dune portable lockdirs now display dependency solutions grouped by platform with clear indication of common and platform-specific packages by Stephen Sherratt in ocaml/dune#12620, deduplicate solver errors across platforms in ocaml/dune#12642, and correctly validate packages for multiple platforms in ocaml/dune#12640
  • OCaml Tools Dune ocamlformat auto-relocking triggers when .ocamlformat version changes to keep dev tools synchronized by Stephen Sherratt in ocaml/dune#12605
  • OCaml Tools Dune Melange support improved with module compilation added to @all alias in libraries in ocaml/dune#12628 and complete documentation overhaul for melange 1.0 by Ali Caglayan in ocaml/dune#12631
  • OCaml Tools Dune cram test enhancements allow text after conflict markers with renamed option from (conflict error|ignore) to (conflict_markers error|ignore) by Ali Caglayan in ocaml/dune#12655 and ocaml/dune#12651
  • OCaml Tools Dune virtual library bug fix for dune build @check crashes when virtual modules were present in ocaml/dune#12644
  • OCaml Tools Merlin completion fix for inlined record labels in pattern matching contexts by Ulysse in ocaml/merlin#1978
  • OCaml Tools OCaml-LSP configuration parameter renamed from for_nested_bindings to forNestedBindings for VSCode compatibility by Xavier Van de Woestyne in ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1568
  • OCaml Tools jsofocaml exit code handling fixed in jsoo_minify and wasmoo_link_wasm tools to properly propagate error codes in ocsigen/jsofocaml#2121
  • OCaml Tools jsofocaml test suite concurrency issue resolved with file lock and cleanup to prevent race conditions in ocsigen/jsofocaml#2123
  • OCaml Ecosystem Quantum computing library qcaml 0.1.3 provides experimental quantum computing simulation with single qubit states, quantum gates (Hadamard, Pauli-X/Y/Z), measurements with probabilistic collapse, and Bloch sphere visualization by Elias in ocaml/opam-repository#28825
  • OCaml Ecosystem Mathematical plotter oplot 0.85 offers library for plotting 2D/3D mathematical functions with animation support and LaTeX formula rendering by 珊瑚 in ocaml/opam-repository#28826
  • OCaml Ecosystem Binaryen ecosystem updates delivered twelve releases from v117 to v124 adding OCaml 5 support, esy 0.8.0 compatibility, and requiring jsoo >= 6.0 with node >= 22 by Oscar Spencer across ocaml/opam-repository#28797 through ocaml/opam-repository#28824
  • OCaml Ecosystem OCaml 5.4.0 stabilization with removed avoid-version flag to properly support the released compiler by Marcello Seri in ocaml/opam-repository#28787, fixed trunk variant issues by David Allsopp in ocaml/opam-repository#28793, and added missing conf-unwind dependency for tsan variant in ocaml/opam-repository#28794
  • OCaml Ecosystem Cryptoverif 2.12 updated cryptographic protocol verifier in the computational model by @bruno-blanchet in ocaml/opam-repository#28802
  • OCaml Ecosystem MirageOS 4.10.3 improved output file extension handling in Makefile and added solo5 0.10.0 support by Hannes Mehnert in ocaml/opam-repository#28785
  • OCaml Ecosystem Solo5 0.10.0 fixes for OpenBSD compilation, MTU detection on TAP interfaces, and .note.GNU-stack section handling by Calascibetta Romain in ocaml/opam-repository#28784
  • OCaml Ecosystem Conex 1.0.0 enables trust establishment in community repositories with Ed25519 support and snapshot/timestamp capabilities by Hannes Mehnert in ocaml/opam-repository#28773
  • OCaml Ecosystem Testing infrastructure improvements with Tezt 4.3.0 fixing SIGPIPE handling issues causing flaky tests by @rbardou in ocaml/opam-repository#28791 and QCheck 0.27 adding float shrinking bindings by Jan Midtgaard in ocaml/opam-repository#28808
  • OCaml Ecosystem Cmarkit 0.4.0 CommonMark parser supporting 0.31.2 specification with improved task items extension semantics and Unicode 17.0.0 support by Daniel Bünzli in ocaml/opam-repository#28811
  • OCaml Ecosystem PPX tutorial clarity improvement removed redundant information about environment variables and compilation timing by Tazmilur Saad in ocaml/ocaml.org#3382
  • OCaml Ecosystem OCaml Workshop 2025 update added complete presentation listings with authors and links, full program committee roster with affiliations, and updated video links by Yasunari Watanabe in ocaml/ocaml.org#3384

    • Group Activity Summaries

    OCaml Ecosystem

    33 packages merged in opam-repository including quantum computing and plotting libraries; ocaml.org documentation improved

    New Features

  • Quantum computing library qcaml 0.1.3: New experimental library for quantum computing simulation with single qubit states, quantum gates (Hadamard, Pauli-X/Y/Z), measurements with probabilistic collapse, and Bloch sphere visualization by Elias in ocaml/opam-repository#28825
  • Mathematical plotter oplot 0.85: New library for plotting 2D/3D mathematical functions with animation support and LaTeX formula rendering by 珊瑚 in ocaml/opam-repository#28826
  • Binaryen ecosystem updates: Twelve releases from v117 to v124 adding OCaml 5 support, esy 0.8.0 compatibility, and requiring jsoo >= 6.0 with node >= 22 by Oscar Spencer in ocaml/opam-repository#28797, ocaml/opam-repository#28798, ocaml/opam-repository#28799, ocaml/opam-repository#28800, ocaml/opam-repository#28801, ocaml/opam-repository#28809, ocaml/opam-repository#28817, ocaml/opam-repository#28819, ocaml/opam-repository#28821, ocaml/opam-repository#28822, ocaml/opam-repository#28823, ocaml/opam-repository#28824
  • OCaml 5.4.0 stabilization: Removed avoid-version flag to properly support the released OCaml 5.4.0 by Marcello Seri in ocaml/opam-repository#28787, fixed trunk variant issues by David Allsopp in ocaml/opam-repository#28793, and added missing conf-unwind dependency for tsan variant in ocaml/opam-repository#28794
  • Cryptoverif 2.12: Updated cryptographic protocol verifier in the computational model by @bruno-blanchet in ocaml/opam-repository#28802
  • MirageOS 4.10.3: Improved output file extension handling in Makefile and added solo5 0.10.0 support by Hannes Mehnert in ocaml/opam-repository#28785
  • Solo5 0.10.0: Fixes for OpenBSD compilation, MTU detection on TAP interfaces, and .note.GNU-stack section handling by Calascibetta Romain in ocaml/opam-repository#28784
  • Conex 1.0.0: Trust establishment in community repositories now with Ed25519 support and snapshot/timestamp capabilities by Hannes Mehnert in ocaml/opam-repository#28773
  • Testing infrastructure improvements: Tezt 4.3.0 fixed SIGPIPE handling issues causing flaky tests by @rbardou in ocaml/opam-repository#28791, QCheck 0.27 added float shrinking bindings by Jan Midtgaard in ocaml/opam-repository#28808
  • Cmarkit 0.4.0: CommonMark parser supporting 0.31.2 specification with improved task items extension semantics and Unicode 17.0.0 support by Daniel Bünzli in ocaml/opam-repository#28811
  • PPX tutorial clarity improvement: Removed redundant information about environment variables and compilation timing by Tazmilur Saad in ocaml/ocaml.org#3382
  • OCaml Workshop 2025 update: Added complete presentation listings with authors and links, full program committee roster with affiliations, and updated video links by Yasunari Watanabe in ocaml/ocaml.org#3384

    • Overview

  • Package repository activity: 33 packages merged in ocaml/opam-repository including new scientific computing libraries (quantum computing, mathematical plotting), twelve Binaryen WebAssembly toolchain updates, OCaml 5.4.0 stabilization fixes, MirageOS ecosystem releases, and testing infrastructure improvements in ocaml/opam-repository#28825, ocaml/opam-repository#28826, ocaml/opam-repository#28787
  • Website content updates: Three merged PRs in ocaml/ocaml.org improving PPX tutorial documentation, adding OCaml Workshop 2025 details, and automated blog post additions in ocaml/ocaml.org#3382, ocaml/ocaml.org#3384
  • Repository maintenance focus: Package policy enforcement including checksum immutability in ocaml/opam-repository#28777, x-maintenance-intent metadata checks in ocaml/opam-repository#28810, and distribution compatibility work addressing Debian, Centos, and Fedora package transitions in ocaml/opam-repository#28769, ocaml/opam-repository#28814
  • Platform compatibility work: Windows CI improvements in ocaml/opam-repository#28806, OS constraint corrections in ocaml/opam-repository#28805, and FFmpeg 7/8 binding updates encountering platform-specific issues in ocaml/opam-repository#28810
  • Documentation and infrastructure transparency: Draft PRs on compilation targets documentation in ocaml/ocaml.org#3378 and opam-repository governance post discussing maintainer recognition and funding in ocaml/ocaml.org#3379

    • Activity

  • FFmpeg bindings 1.2.7 opened by Casey Reeves for eight packages supporting ffmpeg 7 and 8, encountering AVChannelLayout issues on older platforms like Debian 11, Ubuntu 22.04, and openSUSE 15.6 in ocaml/opam-repository#28810
  • Distribution package compatibility work with conf-ffmpeg improvements for Centos 9 and Fedora 41 using ffmpeg-free-devel by Jan Midtgaard still encountering EPEL repository issues in ocaml/opam-repository#28814
  • Build system modernization with Dune Package Management adoption by @sabine migrating the OCaml.org build from opam to Dune's package management system, addressing Docker build issues and performance impacts in ocaml/ocaml.org#3281
  • Infrastructure documentation including draft compilation targets documentation by @sabine with community feedback from Frédéric Loyer suggesting Dune manual cross-references in ocaml/ocaml.org#3378
  • Package maintainability discussions including version scheme clarifications for ppxexpectnobase in ocaml/opam-repository#28790, x-maintenance-intent policy recommendations in ocaml/opam-repository#28810, and preventive upper bound policy violations in ocaml/opam-repository#28790
  • Build compatibility fixes addressing opam-2.0 cyclic dependency resolution in ocaml/opam-repository#28808, MinGW MSys2 topkg failures, FreeBSD/RISC-V warnings-as-errors in libbinaryen in ocaml/opam-repository#28809, and dune version bound adjustments in ocaml/opam-repository#28825
  • OpenGL/GLUT dependency fixes affecting qcaml package requiring conf-freeglut addition to fix missing GL/glut.h header in ocaml/opam-repository#28813, ocaml/opam-repository#28825
  • Closed issues include resolving OCaml 5.4.0 avoid-version flag reported by Török Edwin and fixed by Marcello Seri in ocaml/opam-repository#28786, ocaml/opam-repository#28787

    • Notable Discussions

  • Repository infrastructure and funding transparency: Comprehensive discussion in ocaml/ocaml.org#3379 covering opam-repository maintainer history, funding sources (Tarides, OCaml Software Foundation), ecosystem design principles, and maintainer recognition involving Anil Madhavapeddy, Thomas Gazagnaire, Hannes Mehnert, Mark Elvers, Kate, and Marcello Seri
  • Package maintenance policy refinement: Discussions about x-maintenance-intent metadata for package lifecycle management in ocaml/opam-repository#28810, checksum immutability enforcement preventing version reuse in ocaml/opam-repository#28777, and preventive upper bound policy debates in ocaml/opam-repository#28790
  • Distribution compatibility challenges: Discussion of Debian libpcre3-dev to libpcre2-dev transition guidance in ocaml/opam-repository#28769, Centos/Fedora ffmpeg-devel package renaming and EPEL issues in ocaml/opam-repository#28814, and platform-specific AVChannelLayout compatibility problems in ocaml/opam-repository#28810
  • Version scheme and dependency management: Discussion balancing compatibility with upstream ppx_expect while maintaining nobase suffix in ocaml/opam-repository#28790, addressing opam-2.0 cyclic dependency resolution in ocaml/opam-repository#28808
  • Build system evolution: Community discussion about Dune Package Management migration impacts on Docker builds and performance in ocaml/ocaml.org#3281 with collaboration between Cuihtlauac Alvarado and Antonin Décimo

    • Emerging Trends

  • WebAssembly ecosystem expansion with twelve Binaryen/libbinaryen updates spanning versions 117 through 124 by Oscar Spencer, modernizing OCaml WebAssembly compilation toolchain with OCaml 5 support, esy 0.8.0 compatibility, and updated JavaScript tooling requirements in ocaml/opam-repository#28797 through ocaml/opam-repository#28824
  • OCaml 5.4.0 ecosystem stabilization following the October 9th release with avoid-version flag removal in ocaml/opam-repository#28787, compiler variant fixes in ocaml/opam-repository#28793 and ocaml/opam-repository#28794, codept adding 5.4 support in ocaml/opam-repository#28780
  • Scientific and specialized computing emergence with quantum computing simulation library qcaml in ocaml/opam-repository#28825, mathematical plotting library oplot in ocaml/opam-repository#28826, and cryptographic protocol verification tool cryptoverif 2.12 in ocaml/opam-repository#28802
  • Testing and debugging tooling growth with PPX extensions including ppxexpectnobase with lighter dependencies in ocaml/opam-repository#28790, ppxmatches bringing Rust patterns in ocaml/opam-repository#28755, ppxminidebug in ocaml/opam-repository#28771, QCheck 0.27 with float shrinking in ocaml/opam-repository#28808, and Tezt reliability fixes in ocaml/opam-repository#28791
  • Distribution compatibility modernization addressing Linux distribution evolution including Debian libpcre3-dev to libpcre2-dev transition in ocaml/opam-repository#28769, Centos/Fedora ffmpeg-devel to ffmpeg-free-devel renaming in ocaml/opam-repository#28814, removing conf-gmp packages failing with modern GCC in ocaml/opam-repository#28775
  • MirageOS ecosystem evolution with MirageOS 4.10.3 improvements in ocaml/opam-repository#28785, Solo5 0.10.0 unikernel fixes in ocaml/opam-repository#28784, and Conex 1.0.0 reaching stability milestone for repository trust in ocaml/opam-repository#28773
  • Infrastructure transparency and documentation reflected in comprehensive opam-repository governance discussion covering maintainer recognition, funding sources, and ecosystem design principles in ocaml/ocaml.org#3379, coupled with build system modernization through Dune Package Management adoption in ocaml/ocaml.org#3281
  • Repository governance refinement including increased emphasis on x-maintenance-intent metadata for package lifecycle management, stricter checksum immutability enforcement in ocaml/opam-repository#28777, preventive upper bound policy discussions in ocaml/opam-repository#28790, and OS constraint correctness in ocaml/opam-repository#28805

    • OCaml Tools

    Portable lockdir improvements in Dune, opam 2.5.0-alpha1 fixes, and tooling updates across the ecosystem

    New Features

  • Dune portable lockdirs now display dependency solutions grouped by platform with clear indication of common and platform-specific packages (ocaml/dune#12620), deduplicate solver errors across platforms (ocaml/dune#12642), and correctly validate packages for multiple platforms (ocaml/dune#12640)
  • Dune ocamlformat auto-relocking triggers when .ocamlformat version changes to keep dev tools synchronized (ocaml/dune#12605)
  • Dune Melange support improved with module compilation added to @all alias in libraries (ocaml/dune#12628) and complete documentation overhaul for melange 1.0 (ocaml/dune#12631)
  • Dune cram test enhancements allow text after conflict markers and renamed option from (conflict error|ignore) to (conflict_markers error|ignore) (ocaml/dune#12655, ocaml/dune#12651)
  • Dune virtual library bug fix for dune build @check crashes when virtual modules were present (ocaml/dune#12644)
  • Merlin completion fix for inlined record labels in pattern matching contexts (ocaml/merlin#1978)
  • OCaml-LSP configuration parameter renamed from for_nested_bindings to forNestedBindings for VSCode compatibility (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1568)
  • jsofocaml exit code handling fixed in jsoo_minify and wasmoo_link_wasm tools to properly propagate error codes (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2121)
  • jsofocaml test suite concurrency issue resolved with file lock and cleanup to prevent race conditions (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2123)

    • Overview

  • Dune led activity with portable lockdir improvements including platform-grouped output, solver error deduplication, and validation fixes, plus Melange documentation overhaul and cram test enhancements across 15+ merged PRs
  • Opam 2.5.0-alpha1 release quality improvements addressing build system issues on OpenBSD (ocaml/opam#6765) and AppArmor compatibility on Debian (ocaml/opam#6764)
  • Tooling maintenance wave across the ecosystem with OCamlformat upgrades to 0.28.1 in ocaml/merlin#1984, ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1569, and ocsigen/jsofocaml#2119
  • Editor support improvements with Merlin fixing completion for inlined record labels (ocaml/merlin#1978) and OCaml-LSP renaming configuration parameter for better VSCode integration (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1568)
  • No activity recorded for ocaml/ocamlfind, ocaml/odoc, ocaml/opam-file-format, and ocaml-dune/spawn repositories this week

    • Activity

  • Dune package management development continues with Stephen Sherratt implementing multiple portable lockdir features (ocaml/dune#12620, ocaml/dune#12642, ocaml/dune#12640, ocaml/dune#12605) and ongoing PRs for Windows platform exclusion (ocaml/dune#12654)
  • Dune cram test ecosystem expanding with Ali Caglayan delivering conflict marker improvements (ocaml/dune#12655, ocaml/dune#12663), Rudi Grinberg implementing setup scripts (ocaml/dune#12650), and ongoing location tracking refactoring (ocaml/dune#12335)
  • Dune OxCaml integration progressing with Ali Caglayan migrating CI to Nix-based workflow (ocaml/dune#12632) and @art-w working on parameterized library instantiation (ocaml/dune#12561)
  • Dune code quality improvements including Ali Caglayan removing open! directive across 120 files (ocaml/dune#12662), Ambre Austen Suhamy deleting redundant RPC functions (ocaml/dune#12656), and ongoing RPC promotion fixes (ocaml/dune#12604)
  • Opam release preparation for 2.5.0 with Kate fixing release tarball vendored archive placement (ocaml/opam#6765) and R. Boujbel improving installer script AppArmor handling (ocaml/opam#6760)
  • Opam build system enhancements with R. Boujbel adding support for more install directory customization beyond prefix (ocaml/opam#6761)
  • Merlin tooling updates with Ulysse upgrading to OCamlformat 0.28.1 (ocaml/merlin#1984) and testing OCamlformat patches (ocaml/merlin#1985)
  • jsofocaml Wasm backend development with Jérôme Vouillon implementing runtime JavaScript eval function access (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2108), ppxjs cleanup (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2120), and ongoing Oxcaml support (ocsigen/jsof_ocaml#2105)
  • Automated infrastructure updates with Dependabot bumping GitHub Actions dependencies across ocaml/dune#12630, ocaml/merlin#1982, ocaml/merlin#1981, and ocaml/opam#6758

    • Notable Discussions

  • Dune lockdir renaming proposal sparked debate in ocaml/dune#12648 about renaming dune.lock to .dune-solution-cache to discourage version control commits, with mixed community opinions on the approach
  • Dune portable lockdir UX discussed in ocaml/dune#11868 with Stephen Sherratt and Rudi Grinberg debating default platform sets and whether to enable portable lockdirs by default
  • Dune RPC forwarding EINVAL error reported by Anil Madhavapeddy in ocaml/dune#12660 with Ali Caglayan investigating and creating speculative fix in ocaml/dune#12665
  • Opam 2.5.0-alpha1 release issues identified by @madroach in ocaml/opam#6762 where -full tarball incorrectly attempts network downloads despite including vendored dependencies, breaking OpenBSD's network-restricted build phase
  • Opam AppArmor compatibility reported by Boris Yakobowski in ocaml/opam#6763 where abi/4.0 doesn't exist on Debian bookworm, with discussion about fallback strategies for older AppArmor versions
  • Opam build configuration gaps highlighted by @ccxcz in ocaml/opam#6759 where ./configure --bindir option is not respected by opam-installer
  • OCaml-LSP configuration capabilities discussed in ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1568 with Xavier Van de Woestyne questioning whether capabilities are necessary for configuration parameters
  • Merlin documentation bug reported by Liam Stevenson in ocaml/merlin#1983 regarding document command concatenating documentation for consecutive variant and record entries

    • Emerging Trends

  • Package management maturation evident in Dune with refined portable lockdir implementation including platform grouping (ocaml/dune#12620), error deduplication (ocaml/dune#12642), and auto-relocking (ocaml/dune#12605), while opam prepares 2.5.0 release with platform compatibility fixes
  • Developer experience improvements across tools with better error messages, enhanced documentation structure, improved IDE integration, and tooling reliability fixes in exit code handling and test infrastructure
  • Coordinated tooling updates with OCamlformat 0.28.1 adoption across Merlin, OCaml-LSP, and jsofocaml demonstrating ecosystem-wide maintenance coordination
  • Platform compatibility focus addressing edge cases in AppArmor support (ocaml/opam#6763), OpenBSD builds (ocaml/opam#6762), and Windows platform handling (ocaml/dune#12641)
  • OxCaml integration progress spanning Dune CI (ocaml/dune#12632), parameterized libraries (ocaml/dune#12561), and jsofocaml Oxcaml support (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2105)
  • Cram test ecosystem expansion in Dune with conflict marker handling, setup scripts, location tracking, and better suggestions showing investment in testing infrastructure
  • Wasm backend development continuing in jsofocaml with runtime feature parity work and optimization consistency between JavaScript and WebAssembly backends (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2108)

    • OxCaml

    Compiler improvements with thread naming, Flambda2 type system advances, debugging infrastructure, and package maintenance

    New Features

  • Thread naming support added via Thread.set_current_thread_name function backported from upstream OCaml by Aspen Smith, enabling developers to set thread names for improved debugging in GDB and stacktraces (oxcaml/oxcaml#4946)
  • Extended locking scheme interface with caml_domain_send_interrupt_hook callback by Stephen Dolan for better backup thread interactions in multi-domain programs using non-default locking schemes, improving Python integration support (oxcaml/oxcaml#4914)
  • Native Dynlink fix for parameterized modules by Luke Maurer, now correctly using Compilation_unit.full_path_as_string instead of name_as_string to distinguish compilation units differing only by arguments (oxcaml/oxcaml#4935)
  • DWARF test improvements by Simon Spies with pedantic mode enabled by default and new test coverage for closures, larger data structures, tuples, and bigarrays to prevent regressions (oxcaml/oxcaml#4626)
  • CI infrastructure upgrades by Jacob Van Buren deploying larger GitHub Actions runners across all CI jobs for improved build performance (oxcaml/oxcaml#4908)
  • Metrics collection modernization by Xavier Clerc translating bash scripts to Python with type annotations and extensible CSV format supporting different metric types beyond artifact sizes (oxcaml/oxcaml#4926, oxcaml/oxcaml#4927)
  • Dune version constraint relaxation in ocaml-variants.5.2.0+ox from exact version 3.20.2+ox to allow versions greater than 3.20.2 by Patrick Ferris (oxcaml/opam-repository@159337c)

    • Overview

  • Week 44 saw concentrated activity in the oxcaml/oxcaml compiler repository with 15 contributors advancing runtime features, type system improvements, debugging infrastructure, and CI modernization
  • Package maintenance work in oxcaml/opam-repository focused on jsofocaml patch compatibility with stricter opam validation logic (oxcaml/opam-repository#19, oxcaml/opam-repository#20)
  • Flambda2 type system received significant enhancements with relations stored as projections enabling precise optimization analysis (oxcaml/oxcaml#4390)
  • Modality system maturation continued with multiple PRs addressing stateless, contended, aliased, and portable annotations across the type system and stdlib (oxcaml/oxcaml#4889, oxcaml/oxcaml#4891, oxcaml/oxcaml#4929)
  • DWARF debugging infrastructure saw substantial progress with runtime type information layout improvements, shape constructors, function sections support, and phantom variable handling (oxcaml/oxcaml#4916, oxcaml/oxcaml#4928, oxcaml/oxcaml#4934, oxcaml/oxcaml#4595)

    • Activity

  • Flambda2 type system enhancement by Basile Clément storing relations as projections in type kinds, enabling precise tracking during n-way joins for the match-in-match heuristic, with extensive review from Vincent Laviron (oxcaml/oxcaml#4390)
  • Profiling infrastructure for speculative inlining added by Basile Clément to better understand compilation behavior (oxcaml/oxcaml#4375)
  • Domain index exposure proposed by Vesa Karvonen adding Domain.self_index API for per-domain array elements to avoid contention, referencing upstream ocaml/ocaml#13171 (oxcaml/oxcaml#4950)
  • Linkenv refactoring by Mark Shinwell removing global state to simplify code and support future work, under review by Jack Rickard (oxcaml/oxcaml#4947)
  • Natdynlink performance improvement by Nicolas Trangez using skiplist instead of linked list for module GC roots, enabling efficient duplicate checking during dynamic linking (oxcaml/oxcaml#4949)
  • Parameterized modules segfault fix by Luke Maurer disallowing aliases to parameter modules to prevent signature substitution issues until transparent ascription is available (oxcaml/oxcaml#4948)
  • DWARF debugging advances including layout improvements for runtime type information by Simon Spies (oxcaml/oxcaml#4916), shape constructors for unknown types (oxcaml/oxcaml#4928), function sections support (oxcaml/oxcaml#4934), and phantom variable support by Mark Shinwell (oxcaml/oxcaml#4595)
  • Modality system work by @dkalinichenko-js with @@ global implying @@ aliased for borrowing soundness (oxcaml/oxcaml#4889), mod bound parsing refactoring (oxcaml/oxcaml#4931), exceptions crossing statefulness and visibility (oxcaml/oxcaml#4891), and stdlib stateless annotations (oxcaml/oxcaml#4839, oxcaml/oxcaml#4930)
  • Stdlib local annotations for printing functions by @tkoukpari across multiple iterations (oxcaml/oxcaml#4937, oxcaml/oxcaml#4938, oxcaml/oxcaml#4943)
  • Mixed modules progress by James Rayman with automatic field reordering (oxcaml/oxcaml#4020) and unsigned divmod work (oxcaml/oxcaml#4936)
  • Backend optimizations by Xavier Clerc including CFG peephole rules for neutral elements (oxcaml/oxcaml#4932), float value propagation (oxcaml/oxcaml#4879), terminator simplification extensions (oxcaml/oxcaml#4807), and CFG reducibility work (oxcaml/oxcaml#4920, oxcaml/oxcaml#4921)
  • Name mangling scheme development by Tim McGilchrist enabling reversible demangling with full module paths for improved debugging (oxcaml/oxcaml#4850)
  • Runtime improvements including memprof configuration on major heap by Stephen Dolan (oxcaml/oxcaml#4939) and to_cmm illegal reordering prevention by Guillaume Bury (oxcaml/oxcaml#4941)
  • Package maintenance by Patrick Ferris fixing jsofocaml iarray primitives patch compatibility (oxcaml/opam-repository#19) and removing obsolete ppx_optcomp patches (oxcaml/opam-repository#20)

    • Notable Discussions

  • Patch validation compatibility discussion in oxcaml/opam-repository#19 revealed that recent opam versions switched to stricter patch validation logic than GNU patch, with resolution that publishing code now uses the same logic to prevent future errors
  • ppxoptcomp dependency investigation in oxcaml/opam-repository#20 examined how patches that had previously been removed returned, suggesting potential interactions with other patch sets that may have introduced ppxoptcomp as a dependency
  • Flambda2 type grammar review in oxcaml/oxcaml#4390 with Vincent Laviron providing extensive feedback on type variance consistency and projection handling during n-way joins
  • Linkenv API mutability analysis in oxcaml/oxcaml#4947 with Jack Rickard reviewing potential re-entry issues in global state removal

    • Emerging Trends

  • Type system sophistication continuing with Flambda2 relations stored as projections enabling more precise optimization analysis (oxcaml/oxcaml#4390) and the match-in-match heuristic requiring careful handling of type variance (oxcaml/oxcaml#4374, oxcaml/oxcaml#4394)
  • Debugging infrastructure maturation across DWARF generation (oxcaml/oxcaml#4626, oxcaml/oxcaml#4916), phantom variables (oxcaml/oxcaml#4595), name mangling (oxcaml/oxcaml#4850), and test coverage indicating production readiness priorities
  • Modality system evolution with stateless, contended, aliased, and portable annotations being refined through stdlib usage (oxcaml/oxcaml#4839, oxcaml/oxcaml#4930) and soundness fixes (oxcaml/oxcaml#4889, oxcaml/oxcaml#4891)
  • Parameterized modules refinement addressing edge cases in Dynlink (oxcaml/oxcaml#4935) and alias handling (oxcaml/oxcaml#4948) while automatic field reordering enables mixed module support (oxcaml/oxcaml#4020)
  • Infrastructure modernization with Python replacing bash scripts (oxcaml/oxcaml#4926), CI runner upgrades (oxcaml/oxcaml#4908), and extensible metrics collection (oxcaml/oxcaml#4927) supporting performance tracking
  • Backend optimization focus on CFG analysis including value propagation (oxcaml/oxcaml#4879), reducibility checking (oxcaml/oxcaml#4920), and peephole optimizations (oxcaml/oxcaml#4932) for better code generation
  • Concurrent programming support through preemption work (oxcaml/oxcaml#4881), locking scheme extensions (oxcaml/oxcaml#4914), thread naming (oxcaml/oxcaml#4946), and domain-aware primitives (oxcaml/oxcaml#4950)
  • Patch maintenance challenges as stricter opam validation requires closer alignment between patch generation and application tools (oxcaml/opam-repository#19)

    • OCaml Core

    Type system improvements, TSan fixes, and renewed RFC discussion on implicit source positions

    New Features

  • Existential types now supported in as-patterns, completing previous work and lifting restrictions on retyping patterns containing existentials in ocaml/ocaml#14327 by Takafumi Saikawa
  • Recursive module error messages improved with abstract environment for printing -short-paths and added error message for types considered abstract during recursive module checking in ocaml/ocaml#14037 by Brandon Stride
  • Pattern constraint handling cleaned up by removing legacy hacks, with behavior change that let rec (_ as x) = ... is now consistently rejected instead of being treated as let rec x = ... in ocaml/ocaml#14322 by Vincent Laviron
  • Type-level scope documentation added with detailed explanation of Ctype.create_scope and enforcement of current_level <= generic_level invariant in ocaml/ocaml#14331 by Jacques Garrigue
  • TSan instrumentation fixed to properly instrument subexpressions and shared heap operations, addressing race detection gaps in ocaml/ocaml#14332 and ocaml/ocaml#14335 by Vincent Laviron and Gabriel Scherer
  • Dune build support restored with fixes for label reordering and iarray availability in OCaml 5.4 in ocaml/ocaml#14328 by Gabriel Scherer

    • Overview

  • Primary focus on type system precision and thread safety improvements across ocaml/ocaml with 6 PRs merged and 4 new PRs opened for review
  • Type system work delivered existential type support in as-patterns (ocaml/ocaml#14327), pattern constraint cleanup (ocaml/ocaml#14322), and scope level enforcement (ocaml/ocaml#14331)
  • Thread safety improvements through TSan instrumentation fixes (ocaml/ocaml#14332, ocaml/ocaml#14335) and atomic class cache accesses under review (ocaml/ocaml#14333)
  • RFC activity on ocaml/RFCs with renewed discussion on implicit source positions (ocaml/RFCs#52) for call tracing functionality
  • GC improvements initiated with meta-issue tracking pacing logic changes (ocaml/ocaml#14324) and work accounting fixes under review (ocaml/ocaml#14329)
  • Developer tooling enhanced through dune build restoration (ocaml/ocaml#14328), better error messages (ocaml/ocaml#14037, ocaml/ocaml#14330), and internal API documentation (ocaml/ocaml#14331)
  • Community engagement from 12 contributors including core team members from Inria, OCamlPro, and academic institutions

    • Activity

  • Under review are four new PRs: atomic class cache accesses by Vincent Laviron (ocaml/ocaml#14333), GC work accounting fixes by Damien Doligez (ocaml/ocaml#14329), spellchecking hints for module errors by Florian Angeletti (ocaml/ocaml#14330), and treating polymorphic variables on let constraints as locally abstract by Alistair (ocaml/ocaml#14325)
  • TSan reliability work identified race in tests/parallel/churn leading to investigation and quick resolution in ocaml/ocaml#14334 opened by Gabriel Scherer
  • Implicit source positions RFC (ocaml/RFCs#52) discussion restarted by Antonin Décimo requesting simple call traces, with Olivier Nicole noting the feature is pending Jane Street investigation on internal representation changes
  • Four PRs closed without merging: superseded existential types PR (ocaml/ocaml#14229), polymorphic variant specification fix (ocaml/ocaml#14326) by @mendelsshop, aliasing operators proposal (ocaml/ocaml#9080), and pattern translation fix (ocaml/ocaml#14321) replaced by ocaml/ocaml#14322

    • Notable Discussions

  • GC pacing logic meta-issue opened by Damien Doligez to track changes and improvements to garbage collection work accounting in ocaml/ocaml#14324
  • Implicit source positions RFC discussion renewed by Antonin Décimo for call tracing functionality in ocaml/RFCs#52, proposing loc:[%call_pos] syntax for automatic call site position tracking useful for monadic bind chains, testing frameworks, and error reporting
  • Dynlink error handling discussion initiated by Fabrice Le Fessant proposing dlclose on error to prevent resource leaks in ocaml/ocaml#14323
  • TSan race detection revealed issue in tests/parallel/churn leading to investigation in ocaml/ocaml#14334 by Gabriel Scherer

    • Emerging Trends

  • Thread safety focus continues with TSan instrumentation improvements (ocaml/ocaml#14332, ocaml/ocaml#14335), race detection fixes (ocaml/ocaml#14334), and atomic class cache work (ocaml/ocaml#14333)
  • Type system refinement advancing through scope enforcement (ocaml/ocaml#14331), existential type support (ocaml/ocaml#14327), pattern constraint cleanup (ocaml/ocaml#14322), and polymorphic variable handling (ocaml/ocaml#14325)
  • Developer experience improvements through better error messages (ocaml/ocaml#14037, ocaml/ocaml#14330), build system fixes (ocaml/ocaml#14328), and documentation of internal APIs (ocaml/ocaml#14331)
  • GC optimization work emerging with meta-issue for pacing logic (ocaml/ocaml#14324) and work accounting fixes (ocaml/ocaml#14329)

    • Multicore

    Quiet week with activity limited to picos: OCaml 5.4 support, ocamlformat upgrade, and adaptive backoff work

    New Features

  • OCaml 5.4 compatibility for benchmarks in ocaml-multicore/picos with Docker image updated to debian-ocaml-5.4 (ocaml-multicore/picos#377)
  • Higher contention benchmarking for mpscq with 8 adder threads added to test suite in ocaml-multicore/picos (6aaf75f)
  • ocamlformat 0.28.1 upgrade with reformatting applied across 22 files in ocaml-multicore/picos affecting 248 additions and 289 deletions (ocaml-multicore/picos#376)

    • Overview

  • Single active repository: Only ocaml-multicore/picos showed activity this week with 3 PRs (2 merged, 1 draft)
  • Tooling focus: Work concentrated on infrastructure updates including OCaml 5.4 support (ocaml-multicore/picos#377) and code formatting standardization (ocaml-multicore/picos#376)
  • Performance optimization: Continued development on synchronization primitives with adaptive backoff for mpmcq (ocaml-multicore/picos#375) and expanded contention testing (6aaf75f)
  • Quiet period: Eight repositories (ocaml-multicore/eio, ocaml-multicore/domainslib, ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring, ocaml-multicore/meio, ocaml-multicore/saturn, ocaml-multicore/eio-trace, ocaml-multicore/kcas, ocaml-multicore/ocaml-iomux) had no recorded activity

    • Activity

  • Adaptive backoff implementation for mpmcq opened as draft PR by Vesa Karvonen in ocaml-multicore/picos with 217 additions across 13 files (ocaml-multicore/picos#375)
  • OCaml 5.4 benchmark support merged in ocaml-multicore/picos to enable testing with latest OCaml release (ocaml-multicore/picos#377)
  • Code formatting standardization completed in ocaml-multicore/picos with ocamlformat 0.28.1 upgrade affecting entire codebase (ocaml-multicore/picos#376)
  • Ongoing condition variable work continues in ocaml-multicore/picos with counter-based implementation PR from June still in draft status (ocaml-multicore/picos#371)
  • No activity recorded in ocaml-multicore/eio, ocaml-multicore/domainslib, ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring, ocaml-multicore/meio, ocaml-multicore/saturn, ocaml-multicore/eio-trace, ocaml-multicore/kcas, or ocaml-multicore/ocaml-iomux during this week

    • Emerging Trends

  • Performance benchmarking focus in ocaml-multicore/picos with expanded mpscq contention testing now including 8 adder threads to stress test multi-producer scenarios (6aaf75f)
  • OCaml 5.4 adoption with tooling and infrastructure in ocaml-multicore/picos updated to support the latest OCaml release (ocaml-multicore/picos#377)
  • Synchronization primitive optimization continuing in ocaml-multicore/picos with both adaptive backoff for mpmcq (ocaml-multicore/picos#375) and counter-based condition variables (ocaml-multicore/picos#371) under development
entry.summary: Type system precision and thread safety in core, compiler infrastructure advances in OxCaml, minimal multicore activity, ecosystem growth

entry.title: Week 43, 2025: opam 2.5.0~alpha1 released with 70% faster updates, runtime safety improvements in core, metaprogramming advances in OxCaml, minimal multicore activity
entry.content:
Weekly Summary

New Features

  • OCaml Ecosystem opam 2.5.0~alpha1 released with up to 70% speedup in opam update through improved loading of opam files, delivered by R. Boujbel and announced on ocaml/ocaml.org#3376 with packages published to ocaml/opam-repository#28748
  • OCaml Ecosystem Catala 1.0.0~beta literate programming language compiler for tax code specification released by Denis Merigoux including catala, catala-lsp, and catala-format packages in ocaml/opam-repository#28723
  • OCaml Ecosystem OCamlformat 0.28.1 released by Jules Aguillon with OCaml 5.4 support, reduced indentation improvements, and fixes for two crash-inducing bugs discovered after 0.28.0 release in ocaml/opam-repository#28774
  • OCaml Core DWARF version detection for the Clang assembler added to configuration system, enabling proper debug information handling and fixing test-in-prefix for other-configs tests by David Allsopp in ocaml/ocaml#14314
  • OCaml Core Race condition fix between memprof and the minor GC detected by ThreadSanitizer, where memprof configuration fields now stored on major heap instead of minor heap by Gabriel Scherer in ocaml/ocaml#14300, ocaml/ocaml#14304
  • OCaml Core Improved #show_constructor directive in toplevel to correctly print type parameters for non-GADT constructors by using actual constructor type parameters rather than type declaration parameters in ocaml/ocaml#14239
  • OCaml Core Native debugger tests on Linux now skip when using Clang due to DWARF compatibility issues by David Allsopp in ocaml/ocaml#14317
  • OxCaml GC debugging control added via Xenable_segv_handler=0 tweak to disable SIGSEGV handler for better coredump analysis during segfaults in oxcaml/oxcaml#4913
  • OxCaml Phantom bindings support implemented in Flambda2 allowing debug information generation without keeping dead code alive, controlled via -gdwarf-may-alter-codegen-experimental flag in oxcaml/oxcaml#3937
  • OxCaml Domain locking unification merging backup thread and systhreads locks into single mechanism, enabling Python interop with multi-domain programs in oxcaml/oxcaml#4769
  • OxCaml Runtime4 TLS fix for threads created via caml_c_thread_register ensuring proper thread-local storage initialization in oxcaml/oxcaml#4915
  • OxCaml LLVM backend now implements Dls_get operation for domain-local storage access in oxcaml/oxcaml#4903
  • OxCaml Mode hint improvements providing clearer error messages for allocation and regional mode errors with full hint chains in oxcaml/oxcaml#4917
  • OxCaml Regional mode printing simplified to show "local to the parent region" consistently instead of special-cased "regional" in oxcaml/oxcaml#4918
  • OxCaml Compiler crash fix for width checking in record types with crossing annotations preventing segfaults in oxcaml/oxcaml#4902
  • OxCaml Primitive simplification fix resolving binding ordering bug when extra bindings were introduced during optimization in oxcaml/oxcaml#4923
  • OCaml Tools LLVM flag handling updated in Merlin to ignore -llvm-backend and -no-llvm-backend flags, with -llvm-path moved to parametrized flags in oxcaml/merlin#192
  • OCaml Tools Package directory isolation via (dir ..) field in Dune enables automatic filtering with --only-packages in ocaml/dune#12614
  • OCaml Tools Automatic Dune self-pinning prevents package incompatibilities in ocaml/dune#12583
  • OCaml Tools Conflict marker detection for Git/diff3/Jujutsu in Dune cram tests in ocaml/dune#12617, ocaml/dune#12616
  • OCaml Tools Installation script support for opam 2.5.0~alpha1 with platform binaries and checksums in ocaml/opam#6748
  • OCaml Tools OpenBSD static linking support in opam in ocaml/opam#6705
  • OCaml Tools Configurable code lenses for nested bindings in ocaml-lsp via for_nested_bindings option in ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1567
  • OCaml Tools Wasm runtime fix for caml_floatarray_concat type checking bug in jsofocaml preventing crashes in commit 1621a19

    • Group Activity Summaries

    OCaml Ecosystem

    opam 2.5.0~alpha1 released with 70% faster updates, 32 packages merged, documentation expanded on compilation targets

    New Features

  • opam 2.5.0~alpha1 released with up to 70% speedup in opam update through improved loading of opam files, announced on ocaml/ocaml.org#3376 and published to ocaml/opam-repository#28748 by R. Boujbel with 8 packages covering client, core, devel, format, installer, repository, solver, and state libraries
  • Catala 1.0.0~beta literate programming language compiler for tax code specification released by Denis Merigoux including catala, catala-lsp, and catala-format packages (ocaml/opam-repository#28723)
  • OCamlformat 0.28.1 released by Jules Aguillon with OCaml 5.4 support, reduced indentation improvements, and fixes for two crash-inducing bugs discovered after 0.28.0 release (ocaml/opam-repository#28774)
  • Governance documentation updated with Jan Midtgaard added to the official maintainer list and streamlined contributor acknowledgments (ocaml/opam-repository#28762)

    • Overview

  • opam 2.5.0~alpha1 release coordination across both repositories with Kate publishing packages to ocaml/opam-repository#28748 and ocaml/ocaml.org#3376 announcing the 70% opam update speedup, followed by quick constraint fixes by Marcello Seri to address revdep failures in odoc-driver, opam-publish, and orb (ocaml/opam-repository#28766)
  • Documentation efforts focused on opam-repository infrastructure with sabine authoring comprehensive articles on compilation targets (ocaml/ocaml.org#3378) and repository governance (ocaml/ocaml.org#3379) while Raphaël Proust updated maintainer documentation adding Jan Midtgaard officially (ocaml/opam-repository#28762)
  • Package ecosystem activity with 32 packages merged and 20 open PRs in opam-repository including tooling releases (OCamlformat 0.28.1, Catala 1.0.0~beta), MirageOS ecosystem updates (dns 10.2.2, arp 4.1.0, mirage-ptime 5.2.0), and specialized tooling (ppx_matches, regrade, pageantty)
  • OCaml 5.4 adoption progressing with OCamlformat 0.28.1 (ocaml/opam-repository#28774), codept 0.12.2 (ocaml/opam-repository#28780), and OCaml/Unikraft 1.1.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#28750) adding support while Kate marked 5.4 preview packages unavailable (ocaml/opam-repository#28719)
  • ICFP 2025 content being aggregated into OCaml Planet with automated scraping bringing in conference coverage and community reflections (ocaml/ocaml.org#3375, ocaml/ocaml.org#3377, ocaml/ocaml.org#3380, ocaml/ocaml.org#3381)

    • Activity

  • Documentation expansion with comprehensive compilation targets article by sabine covering bytecode, native code, JavaScript, WebAssembly, and unikernel targets (ocaml/ocaml.org#3378), detailed opam-repository infrastructure article explaining CI system, governance, and maintainer processes (ocaml/ocaml.org#3379), and PPX tutorial cleanup by Tazmilur Saad (ocaml/ocaml.org#3382)
  • MirageOS ecosystem updates with dns 10.2.2 (13 packages) by Hannes Mehnert exposing module types and improving shared libraries (ocaml/opam-repository#28739), mirage-ptime 5.2.0 fixing solo5 compilation (ocaml/opam-repository#28756), arp 4.1.0 introducing LRU cache for dynamic entries (ocaml/opam-repository#28738), opatch 3.0.1 (ocaml/opam-repository#28720), and conex 1.0.0 establishing trust in repositories with Ed25519 support (ocaml/opam-repository#28773)
  • Library releases including Fmlib 0.6.0 functional library with browser, pretty printer, and parser improvements by hbr (ocaml/opam-repository#28732), goblint-cil 2.0.8 C front-end with 32bit Machdep fix by Simmo Saan (ocaml/opam-repository#28478), elpi 3.4.2 embeddable λProlog interpreter with CHR rules bug fix by Enrico Tassi (ocaml/opam-repository#28729), genjsapi 1.1.6 for JavaScript bindings by Nicolás Ojeda Bär (ocaml/opam-repository#28721), ocaml-dockerfile 8.3.3 eDSL by Mark Elvers (ocaml/opam-repository#28736), and aifad 2.3.2 with Pcre2 migration by Markus Mottl (ocaml/opam-repository#28737)
  • New packages with huml-ml 0.1.1 OCaml parser for Huml markup language and CLI by Kaustubh Maske Patil (ocaml/opam-repository#28727), handlebars-ml 0.2.0 templating by Kaustubh Maske Patil (ocaml/opam-repository#28730), oglsl 0.1.0 embedding GLSL in OCaml by Kinten Le (ocaml/opam-repository#28731), cure2 library for re2 regexps using combinators by Emile Trotignon (ocaml/opam-repository#28743), ninja_utils 1.0.0 for generating Ninja build files by Louis Gesbert (ocaml/opam-repository#28724), and otp 0.2 One Time Password library with HMAC-SHA1 by A.G. (ocaml/opam-repository#28704)
  • Tooling and infrastructure with raylib and raygui 1.5.0 bindings upgraded to raylib 5.5 by Tobias Mock (ocaml/opam-repository#28680), doi2bib 0.7.9 bibliography management with deduplication improvements by Marcello Seri (ocaml/opam-repository#28703), Rocq 9.1.0 proof assistant released by Guillaume Melquiond (ocaml/opam-repository#28706), and playground editor keyboard shortcut fix where pressing / would incorrectly focus search bar instead of allowing input (ocaml/ocaml.org#3031)
  • Twenty packages currently open for review including gapi-ocaml 0.4.7 by Alessandro Strada (ocaml/opam-repository#28781), codept 0.12.2 with OCaml 5.4 support by Florian Angeletti (ocaml/opam-repository#28780), vsrocq 2.3.2 language server packages by @vscoqbot (ocaml/opam-repository#28761), ppxmatches 0.1.0 introducing Rust-style matches! syntax by Alistair (ocaml/opam-repository#28755), and ppxminidebug 3.0.0 with HTML output by Lukasz Stafiniak (ocaml/opam-repository#28771)

    • Notable Discussions

  • conf-mbedtls versioning semantics generated extensive policy discussion in ocaml/opam-repository#28742 by Daniel Bünzli about whether version should represent bound on underlying package versus version of packaging, opam repository solver limitations with depext versions, and references to academic hyperres paper, ultimately closing without resolution and spawning alternative approach in ocaml/opam-repository#28770 marked do-not-merge by Raphaël Proust
  • Compilation targets documentation review (ocaml/ocaml.org#3378) generated substantive feedback from Christian Lindig, Jan Midtgaard, Calascibetta Romain, and @shym covering integer size portability across platforms, PPC backend mention, wasmofocaml repository merge, OCaml 5 effects and Domain support limitations, Solo5 target accuracy, and Unikraft backend integration
  • opam-repository infrastructure article review (ocaml/ocaml.org#3379) received detailed editorial suggestions from Raphaël Proust and Shon Feder focusing on repository governance framing, CI system capabilities including reverse dependency checking, package naming policies, maintainer onboarding documentation, and commons-based curation approach versus publishing platform model
  • vsrocq-language-server constraints discussion in ocaml/opam-repository#28761 by @vscoqbot addressed installation failures from conflicts entries, maintenance intent requirements, and constraint refinement needs with input from Enrico Tassi and Jan Midtgaard
  • OCamlformat rapid release cycle documented in ocaml/opam-repository#28752 and ocaml/opam-repository#28774 where two crash-inducing bugs discovered after 0.28.0 prompted quick 0.28.1 release with patches by Jules Aguillon
  • opam 2.5.0~alpha1 compatibility issues discussed in ocaml/opam-repository#28748 identifying revdep failures in odoc-driver, opam-publish, and orb with unbound values, leading to quick constraint fix PR ocaml/opam-repository#28766 by Marcello Seri

    • Emerging Trends

  • OCaml 5.4 adoption progressing with OCamlformat 0.28.1 adding support (ocaml/opam-repository#28774), codept 0.12.2 implementing compatibility (ocaml/opam-repository#28780), OCaml/Unikraft 1.1.0 supporting 5.4.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#28750), libbinaryen 117.0.0-b enabling OCaml 5 (ocaml/opam-repository#28763), while Kate marked 5.4 preview packages unavailable (ocaml/opam-repository#28719) and multiple constraint updates address compatibility (ocaml/opam-repository#28745, ocaml/opam-repository#28744)
  • MirageOS ecosystem coordination evident with Hannes Mehnert releasing dns 10.2.2 with 13 packages (ocaml/opam-repository#28739), mirage-ptime 5.2.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#28756), arp 4.1.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#28738), opatch 3.0.1 (ocaml/opam-repository#28720), and conex 1.0.0 (ocaml/opam-repository#28773) showing concentrated development activity
  • Policy and governance refinement with maintainer documentation updated adding Jan Midtgaard officially (ocaml/opam-repository#28762), conf-mbedtls versioning debate generating multiple proposals without resolution (ocaml/opam-repository#28742, ocaml/opam-repository#28770), and infrastructure documentation expansion on ocaml/ocaml.org (ocaml/ocaml.org#3379)
  • Specialized tooling emergence with ppxmatches introducing Rust-style syntax (ocaml/opam-repository#28755), regrade automated homework grading (ocaml/opam-repository#28758), pageantty terminal pager for diffs (ocaml/opam-repository#28749), ppxminidebug debug logs with HTML output (ocaml/opam-repository#28771), and passage secrets manager (ocaml/opam-repository#28754)
  • Documentation expansion targeting both technical platform details (compilation targets in ocaml/ocaml.org#3378, opam-repository CI in ocaml/ocaml.org#3379) and developer education (PPX tutorials in ocaml/ocaml.org#3382), with collaborative review processes showing extensive technical feedback on platform-specific details and governance processes
  • Template and DSL proliferation including handlebars-ml for Handlebars templating (ocaml/opam-repository#28730, ocaml/opam-repository#28765), huml-ml markup language parser (ocaml/opam-repository#28727), oglsl embedding GLSL (ocaml/opam-repository#28731), rich-string enriching string capabilities (ocaml/opam-repository#28759), and ocaml-dockerfile eDSL (ocaml/opam-repository#28736)
  • Build system evolution with ninja_utils 1.0.0 for Ninja build file generation by Louis Gesbert (ocaml/opam-repository#28724), conf-ninja CentOS support then revert by Jan Midtgaard (ocaml/opam-repository#28741) and Kate (ocaml/opam-repository#28733), and cure2 for re2 regexp generation (ocaml/opam-repository#28743)

    • OCaml Tools

    Package directory isolation and Dune 3.21.0 prep, opam cmdliner vendoring, LSP code lens config, js_of_ocaml OCaml 5.4 support

    New Features

  • Dune: Package directory isolation via (dir ..) field enables automatic filtering with --only-packages (ocaml/dune#12614), automatic Dune self-pinning prevents package incompatibilities (ocaml/dune#12583), conflict marker detection for Git/diff3/Jujutsu in cram tests (ocaml/dune#12617, ocaml/dune#12616), parallelized Melange cmj/cmi rule creation (ocaml/dune#12626), and OxCaml development environment with Nix devShells (ocaml/dune#12582)
  • opam: Installation script support for 2.5.0~alpha1 with platform binaries and checksums (ocaml/opam#6748), OpenBSD static linking support (ocaml/opam#6705), and opam repo show command for repository information (ocaml/opam#6720)
  • ocaml-lsp: Configurable code lenses for nested bindings via for_nested_bindings option (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1567) and metrics timestamp precision improved to sub-second measurement (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1565)
  • jsofocaml: Fixed Wasm runtime caml_floatarray_concat type checking bug preventing crashes (1621a19)

    • Activity

  • Dune 3.21.0 release preparation with tracker opened by Shon Feder targeting October 27th (ocaml/dune#12619), alongside ongoing work on OxCaml parameterized library instantiation (ocaml/dune#12561), package management UX improvements with portable lockdir platform grouping (ocaml/dune#12620), and documentation restructuring (ocaml/dune#12612)
  • opam cmdliner vendoring PRs opened by Kate across main (ocaml/opam#6755), 2.5 (ocaml/opam#6756), and 2.4 branches (ocaml/opam#6757) to address cmdliner 2.0 compatibility issues blocking Fedora packaging, with Daniel Bünzli suggesting alternative approaches (ocaml/opam#6755)
  • Merlin editor bugs investigated by Thomas Refis including jump-to-definition failures in recursive modules (ocaml/merlin#1980) and completion failures on inlined record fields (ocaml/merlin#1977), revealing shape system limitations
  • ocamlfind Windows support improved by David Allsopp with fixes for Cygwin, MSYS2, and mingw-w64 environments (ocaml/ocamlfind#112) and new CI infrastructure (ocaml/ocamlfind#113)
  • ocaml-lsp labelled argument autocompletion PR opened by Tom Ekander with real-world testing at Ahrefs (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1564)
  • jsofocaml OCaml 5.4 support expanded with test suite updates (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2103, ocsigen/jsofocaml#2115) and ongoing Wasm runtime development for JavaScript eval access (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2108)

    • Notable Discussions

  • dune-project formatting improvements proposed by Tom Ekander to group related fields and reduce excessive spacing for better readability (ocaml/dune#12629)
  • cmdliner 2.0 adoption strategies debated between Kate and Daniel Bünzli on ocaml/opam#6755, with Daniel Bünzli suggesting simpler workarounds using CMDLINER_LEGACY_PREFIXES and custom Arg.enum, while Brian Ward noted cross-compilation impacts preventing simultaneous native and Windows builds (ocaml/opam#6425)
  • OCAMLPATH priority ordering debated between Kate and David Allsopp regarding whether opam site-lib should override compiler META files (ocaml/ocamlfind#106)
  • Recursive module shape resolution analyzed by Thomas Refis revealing Merlin shape system limitations where UIDs fail to resolve despite appearing correct (ocaml/merlin#1980)
  • Code lens configuration design discussed between Ulysse and Tim ats about option naming evolution from only_toplevel to for_nested_bindings for future extensibility (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1567)

    • Emerging Trends

  • Package management maturation across the toolchain with Dune adding self-pinning (ocaml/dune#12583), portable lockdir platform grouping (ocaml/dune#12620), and ocamlformat version tracking (ocaml/dune#12605), while opam prepares 2.5.0~alpha1 release (ocaml/opam#6748)
  • Cross-platform support improvements with Windows fixes in ocamlfind (ocaml/ocamlfind#112), OpenBSD static linking in opam (ocaml/opam#6705), and platform-specific binary distribution
  • Editor experience refinement through LSP code lens configuration (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1567), metrics improvements (ocaml/ocaml-lsp#1565), and investigation of Merlin shape system bugs (ocaml/merlin#1980)
  • OCaml 5.4 adoption progressing with test infrastructure updates in jsofocaml (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2103, ocsigen/jsofocaml#2115) and CI fixes in ocaml-lsp
  • OxCaml experimental features advancing with parameterized library support in Dune (ocaml/dune#12561), development environments (ocaml/dune#12582), and jsofocaml implementation (ocsigen/jsofocaml#2105)
  • Dependency vendoring strategy emerging as preferred approach for handling breaking changes, seen in opam cmdliner vendoring (ocaml/opam#6755, ocaml/opam#6756, ocaml/opam#6757) to balance compatibility with modern library versions

    • OxCaml

    Runtime threading and GC improvements, mode system refinements, and LLVM backend development across compiler and tooling

    New Features

  • GC debugging control added via Xenable_segv_handler=0 tweak to disable SIGSEGV handler for better coredump analysis during segfaults (oxcaml/oxcaml#4913)
  • Phantom bindings support implemented in Flambda2 allowing debug information generation without keeping dead code alive, controlled via -gdwarf-may-alter-codegen-experimental flag (oxcaml/oxcaml#3937)
  • Domain locking unification merging backup thread and systhreads locks into single mechanism, enabling Python interop with multi-domain programs (oxcaml/oxcaml#4769)
  • Runtime4 TLS fix for threads created via caml_c_thread_register ensuring proper thread-local storage initialization (oxcaml/oxcaml#4915)
  • LLVM backend now implements Dls_get operation for domain-local storage access (oxcaml/oxcaml#4903)
  • Mode hint improvements providing clearer error messages for allocation and regional mode errors with full hint chains (oxcaml/oxcaml#4917)
  • Regional mode printing simplified to show "local to the parent region" consistently instead of special-cased "regional" (oxcaml/oxcaml#4918)
  • Compiler crash fix for width checking in record types with crossing annotations preventing segfaults (oxcaml/oxcaml#4902)
  • Primitive simplification fix resolving binding ordering bug when extra bindings were introduced during optimization (oxcaml/oxcaml#4923)
  • LLVM flag handling updated in Merlin to ignore -llvm-backend and -no-llvm-backend flags, with -llvm-path moved to parametrized flags (oxcaml/merlin#192)

    • Overview

  • Primary activity concentrated in oxcaml/oxcaml with 11 merged features and 25+ ongoing development efforts spanning runtime, type system, and backend improvements
  • Tooling coordination demonstrated through oxcaml/merlin#192 updating configuration to support new LLVM compiler flags from oxcaml/oxcaml#4903 and oxcaml/oxcaml#4904
  • Runtime focus on threading model improvements with domain lock unification (oxcaml/oxcaml#4769), backup thread locking enhancements (oxcaml/oxcaml#4914), and TLS fixes (oxcaml/oxcaml#4915)
  • Type system development advancing mode system error messages (oxcaml/oxcaml#4917), crossing syntax parsing (oxcaml/oxcaml#4781), and experimental ikind algorithms (oxcaml/oxcaml#4675)
  • Backend expansion with LLVM domain-local storage support (oxcaml/oxcaml#4903), jsofocaml test integration (oxcaml/oxcaml#4753), and CFG optimization work (oxcaml/oxcaml#4920)
  • No activity recorded in oxcaml/opam-repository, oxcaml/jsofocaml, or janestreet/opam-repository during this period

    • Activity

  • Preemption support under active development with 2500+ line draft PR affecting 62 files for concurrent execution control by Aspen Smith (oxcaml/oxcaml#4881)
  • Name mangling scheme advancing with reversible mangling for full module path reconstruction and demangling implementations for LLVM, Linux kernel, and binutils by Tim McGilchrist (oxcaml/oxcaml#4850)
  • Crossing syntax parsing adding mod support for per-value mode tracking with 1100+ line implementation by Zack Eisbach (oxcaml/oxcaml#4781)
  • Mixed modules with non-values allowing automatic reordering of module fields to support unboxed types across module boundaries by James Rayman (oxcaml/oxcaml#4020)
  • Quotation system fixes addressing unification bugs in quote/splice handling for metaprogramming by Leo White (oxcaml/oxcaml#4906, oxcaml/oxcaml#4911, oxcaml/oxcaml#4912)
  • Constructor quotation locks bug fixed to properly handle locally-defined constructors in predef type checking by Zesen Qian (oxcaml/oxcaml#4910)
  • Frametable relocation optimization proposing .lrodata section placement to reduce text section size and prevent linker failures by Mark Shinwell (oxcaml/oxcaml#4905)
  • CFG reducibility checking and terminator simplification improvements for backend optimization by Xavier Clerc (oxcaml/oxcaml#4920, oxcaml/oxcaml#4921)
  • Untagged int arrays implementation adding int8#, int16#, and int# array support with proper tag selection by James Rayman (oxcaml/oxcaml#4643)
  • jsofocaml integration comprehensive test suite and CI updates for JavaScript backend by Jacob Van Buren (oxcaml/oxcaml#4753)
  • CI infrastructure improved with shell injection prevention (oxcaml/oxcaml#4907) and larger runner machines (oxcaml/oxcaml#4908) by James Rayman and Jacob Van Buren
  • Debug information layouts improving runtime type representation for flattened arrays by Simon Spies (oxcaml/oxcaml#4916)
  • Slambda IR development introducing static evaluation phase between translation and lambda by Luke Maurer (oxcaml/oxcaml#4776)
  • Ikind system prototype implementing new subsumption and mode crossing algorithms behind -extension ikinds flag by @julesjacobs (oxcaml/oxcaml#4675)

    • Emerging Trends

  • Runtime concurrency advancing through domain lock unification (oxcaml/oxcaml#4769), backup thread improvements (oxcaml/oxcaml#4914), TLS fixes (oxcaml/oxcaml#4915), and large-scale preemption implementation (oxcaml/oxcaml#4881)
  • Mode system maturation progressing with improved error messages (oxcaml/oxcaml#4917), crossing syntax (oxcaml/oxcaml#4781), regional printing simplification (oxcaml/oxcaml#4918), and experimental ikind algorithms (oxcaml/oxcaml#4675)
  • Debugging infrastructure expanding with phantom bindings (oxcaml/oxcaml#3937), GC handler control (oxcaml/oxcaml#4913), debug layouts (oxcaml/oxcaml#4916), and reversible name mangling (oxcaml/oxcaml#4850)
  • Backend diversification through LLVM domain-local storage (oxcaml/oxcaml#4903), jsofocaml integration (oxcaml/oxcaml#4753), and CFG optimization (oxcaml/oxcaml#4920, oxcaml/oxcaml#4921)
  • Metaprogramming support developing through quotation system fixes (oxcaml/oxcaml#4906, oxcaml/oxcaml#4911, oxcaml/oxcaml#4912, oxcaml/oxcaml#4910) and slambda IR introduction (oxcaml/oxcaml#4776)
  • Type system power growing with mixed modules (oxcaml/oxcaml#4020), untagged arrays (oxcaml/oxcaml#4643), and effect primitive refactoring (oxcaml/oxcaml#4901)

    • OCaml Core

    Eight PRs merged in ocaml/ocaml fixing runtime race conditions, improving debugging support, and enhancing developer tooling

    New Features

  • DWARF version detection for the Clang assembler added to configuration system, enabling proper debug information handling and fixing test-in-prefix for other-configs tests (ocaml/ocaml#14314) by David Allsopp
  • Fixed race condition between memprof and the minor GC detected by ThreadSanitizer, where memprof configuration fields now stored on major heap instead of minor heap (ocaml/ocaml#14300, ocaml/ocaml#14304) by Gabriel Scherer
  • Improved #show_constructor directive in toplevel to correctly print type parameters for non-GADT constructors by using actual constructor type parameters rather than type declaration parameters (ocaml/ocaml#14239)
  • Always use "I" format specifier for size_t with mingw compilers, completing C99 stdint.h/inttypes.h fixed-width integer types migration (ocaml/ocaml#13656, ocaml/ocaml#14114, ocaml/ocaml#14308) by Antonin Décimo
  • Native debugger tests on Linux now skip when using Clang due to DWARF compatibility issues (ocaml/ocaml#14317) by David Allsopp

    • Overview

  • ocaml/ocaml merged eight PRs this week, focusing on runtime reliability improvements with ThreadSanitizer-detected race condition fixes (ocaml/ocaml#14304), build system enhancements including DWARF version detection (ocaml/ocaml#14314), and developer tooling improvements
  • Five new issues opened covering stdlib iarray implementation gaps (ocaml/ocaml#14320), manual page hierarchy improvements (ocaml/ocaml#14318), and compiler feature requests for static linking support (ocaml/ocaml#14313)
  • ocaml/RFCs saw continued discussion on the tuple projections RFC (ocaml/RFCs#57) by Alistair, with author follow-up seeking guidance on next steps for the proposal

    • Activity

  • Andreas Rossberg reported stdlib oversights around iarray implementation (ocaml/ocaml#14320), highlighting gaps in the recently added feature
  • Antonin Décimo proposed to reverse page hierarchy order in manual page titles for better navigation (ocaml/ocaml#14318)
  • Gabriel Scherer requested documentation for internal Ctype.create_scope function (ocaml/ocaml#14316) and opened feature request for compiler support for static linking of C dependencies (ocaml/ocaml#14313) with discussion about build system integration
  • @rwmjones reported caml_shutdown segmentation fault issue (ocaml/ocaml#14319), resolved quickly as duplicate of earlier crash issue (ocaml/ocaml#14298)
  • Stefan Muenzel continued discussion on recursive functors with module aliases (ocaml/ocaml#14217)
  • Ongoing discussions on configurable domain stack sizes (ocaml/ocaml#14195) by Nathan Taylor and parallel Sys calls hang (ocaml/ocaml#14278) by Jan Midtgaard
  • Kate's proposal to allow open (struct ... end) in mli files (ocaml/ocaml#13564) marked as stale and closed
  • Tim McGilchrist updated frame pointer tests to normalize symbols for more reliable test results (ocaml/ocaml#14295)
  • Changes file maintenance by Zoggy fixing missing punctuation (ocaml/ocaml#14312) and Simon Cruanes adding missing reviewers (ocaml/ocaml#14311)
  • Alistair followed up on tuple projections RFC (ocaml/RFCs#57), seeking clarification on next steps to advance the proposal introducing labeled and 0-indexed unlabeled tuple projections to OCaml syntax

    • Emerging Trends

  • Runtime reliability improvements through ThreadSanitizer-detected race condition fixes, particularly in memprof subsystem (ocaml/ocaml#14300, ocaml/ocaml#14304) and caml_shutdown crash resolution (ocaml/ocaml#14298, ocaml/ocaml#14319), showing increased focus on automated testing tools
  • Build system and toolchain enhancements with DWARF version detection for Clang (ocaml/ocaml#14314), C99 integer type standardization (ocaml/ocaml#14308), and discussions about static linking support (ocaml/ocaml#14313)
  • Developer experience focus through better debugging support, improved toplevel directives (ocaml/ocaml#14239), documentation enhancements (ocaml/ocaml#14316, ocaml/ocaml#14318), and test infrastructure improvements (ocaml/ocaml#14295, ocaml/ocaml#14317)
  • Ongoing attention to multicore runtime edge cases including parallel execution issues (ocaml/ocaml#14278) and domain stack size configuration (ocaml/ocaml#14195)
  • Stdlib refinement discussions around iarray implementation completeness (ocaml/ocaml#14320), indicating continued maturation of recently added features

    • Multicore

    Light activity week with continued API design work on socket options in eio

    Overview

  • Minimal activity across the multicore group this week, with work limited to ocaml-multicore/eio
  • Anil Madhavapeddy continued refining the socket options API proposal in ocaml-multicore/eio#575
  • No activity recorded in the other 8 repositories: domainslib, ocaml-uring, meio, saturn, eio-trace, picos, kcas, and ocaml-iomux

    • Activity

  • Anil Madhavapeddy updated ocaml-multicore/eio#575, a long-standing PR proposing an Eio_unix.Sockopt module for setting and getting socket options
  • The PR explores API design for exposing Linux-specific socket options through a GADT interface, with recent work focusing on fixing issues and refining the interface for exposing pp functions
entry.summary: opam 2.5.0~alpha1 released with 70% faster updates, runtime safety improvements in core, metaprogramming advances in OxCaml, minimal multicore activity

entry.title: Week 42, 2025: BLAKE128 hash migration and runtime safety focus in core, metaprogramming advances in OxCaml, and package management maturation in tools
entry.content:
Weekly Summary

New Features

  • OCaml Core BLAKE128 hash migration for compiler CRCs replacing MD5 across all file formats (cmi, cmo, cmx, cmxs) and consistency checking by Vincent Laviron in ocaml/ocaml#13913
  • OCaml Core New C API function caml_c_thread_register_in_domain for registering C threads in specific OCaml domains by Jack Joergensen in ocaml/ocaml#14275
  • OCaml Core TSan fixes for C calls with many stack arguments affecting ARM64, POWER, RISC-V, s390x, and x86_64 architectures by Olivier Nicole in ocaml/ocaml#14255
  • OCaml Core FlexDLL build improvements with new configuration options for MANIFEST_TOOL, RC (resource compiler), and FLEXLINKFLAGS, requiring FlexDLL >= 0.44 by Antonin Décimo in ocaml/ocaml#14034
  • OCaml Core Type checker determinism improvements avoiding hash table iteration for types and terms by Vincent Laviron in ocaml/ocaml#14297, ocaml/ocaml#14299
  • OCaml Core Symbol naming changes using $ instead of . to separate module from identifiers in symbols by Tim McGilchrist in ocaml/ocaml#13050
  • OxCaml Quotation API functions Code.Closed.to_exp and Code.Closed.print added to CamlinternalQuote module for converting closed code to expressions and formatted printing in oxcaml/oxcaml#4896
  • OxCaml Quotation and metaprogramming support integrated into Merlin via new CamlinternalQuote module (2,805 lines) providing infrastructure for compile-time code generation with variable binding, staging, and AST manipulation in oxcaml/merlin#191
  • OxCaml Layout polymorphism language extension (Layout_poly) with maturity levels (alpha, beta, stable) allowing types to be polymorphic over memory representations in oxcaml/merlin#191
  • OxCaml New jkind primitives including immediate64_or_null for nullable immediate64 values and kind_of_idx for block indices with mode crossing support in oxcaml/merlin#191
  • OxCaml bits8 and bits16 kinds now allowed without requiring the small_numbers extension in oxcaml/oxcaml#4898
  • OxCaml Location information in pattern matching improved for better debugger stepping behavior and source code position reporting in oxcaml/oxcaml#4884
  • OCaml Tools Package search command in Dune via dune pkg search for finding packages by name using substring or glob patterns in ocaml/dune#12547
  • OCaml Tools Concurrent test execution with watch mode in Dune allowing dune runtest while watch server is active in ocaml/dune#12473, ocaml/dune#8114
  • OCaml Tools Completion for inlined record labels in Merlin fixing pattern matching against constructors with inline record syntax in ocaml/merlin#1978
  • OCaml Tools Multi-file support in odoc for markdown-generate and html-generate commands accepting multiple .odocl files in ocaml/odoc#1388
  • OCaml Tools Shell initialization improvements in opam including writing to .bashrc instead of .profile for Bash users in ocaml/opam#6603
  • OCaml Tools opam 2.5.0~alpha1 released with AppArmor support resolving issues on Ubuntu 24.04 in ocaml/opam#6647, ocaml/opam#6744
  • OCaml Tools Consistent NaN handling in jsofocaml across JavaScript engines by converting signaling NaNs to quiet NaNs in ocsigen/jsofocaml#2110
  • OCaml Ecosystem Sail 0.20 released with Rocq semantics implementation - core stepwise semantics now in Rocq, improved C++ backend support across 13 packages by Alasdair Armstrong in ocaml/opam-repository#28713
  • OCaml Ecosystem Rocq 9.1.0 and 9.0.1 releases by Guillaume Melquiond bringing latest Coq fork updates in ocaml/opam-repository#28706, ocaml/opam-repository#28707
  • OCaml Ecosystem ppxlib 0.37.0 released with ppxlib-tools by Nathan Rebours in ocaml/opam-repository#28686
  • OCaml Ecosystem lambdapi 3.0.0 released with new tactics (simplify, orelse, repeat, eval), string literal builtins, and websearch options by Frédéric Blanqui in ocaml/opam-repository#28178
  • OCaml Ecosystem miou 0.5.0 performance improvement - now uses poll(2)/ppoll(2) instead of select(3P) for better concurrency by Calascibetta Romain in ocaml/opam-repository#28714
  • OCaml Ecosystem domain-name 0.5.0 bug fix disallowing trailing hyphen (-) in host labels per RFC requirements by Hannes Mehnert in ocaml/opam-repository#28709
  • OCaml Ecosystem ca-certs-nss 3.117 security update with latest Mozilla NSS X.509 trust anchors from 2025-10-03 by Hannes Mehnert in ocaml/opam-repository#28712
  • OCaml Ecosystem Mobile package page layout improved by moving table of contents from right sidebar to mobile-friendly location by Seth Rider in ocaml/ocaml.org#3369
